$MyPCName$, I'm sorry to bother you all of the sudden. <font color="#00aaef"><font size="20">(Note: The following content takes place after the events of the epic quest "$quest:20002263$.")</font></font>
I'd ask you how you are, but I know that no one's been quite themselves since the attack on Tria.

Farmlands were trampled by the enemy, industrial facilities are on the verge of shutting down... Even the merchants have ceased their trade for fear of their safety. As a result, we're facing food and supply shortages throughout the city.
So I was hoping you might assist me in a matter that might help address the situation.
I'll explain further in person. I'll be waiting for you at $map:02000153$.
$MyPCName$, come to $map:02000153$.
Ah, $MyPCName$, you're here.
We've only just arrived ourselves.
Thank you for joining us on short notice.
Well, now that our key asset is here, shall we begin?
We need to go over the plan.
No time better than the present.
Ever since the assault on Tria, Dark Wind, the Green Hoods, the Order of the Eclipse, and the Royal Guard have held countless meetings on addressing the crisis at hand.
We've discussed the topic of how best to defend Maple World and aid in its recovery, but ultimately…

There's no one magic solution. So we decided that everyone should focus on what they do best. The Royal Guard will see to the well-being and safety of the people, the Green Hoods will gather and redistribute supplies…
And the Order of the Eclipse... Err, Allon, what is it exactly that they do again?
They keep an eye on the gates to the Shadow World, and root out any traces of the darkness in our own—though in the end these efforts were for naught.
Well... it's not like Dark Winds' efforts came to much either, with Katvan at the helm. Or so we thought.
There was only one good thing to come from his treachery...
Since his disappearance, Dark Wind has collected every scrap of information they can about the traitor Katvan, but we still don't know how or when he might return.
But our investigation did uncover Katvan's secret data server hidden within Dark Wind HQ.
And what we found on that server was more than just data...
We also found the blueprints for Project Aegis: the Sky Fortress. It's a next-generation airborne aircraft carrier.
It's a large vessel, intended to be used as Dark Wind's mobile command center.

The story goes that Katvan was concerned with HQ's safety after the Black Mushroom incident, and saw the need for a mobile command center that could continue operating even if Kerning City was plunged into chaos.
Of course, that was all just a pretext for his true motives. Nevertheless, he kept both the empress and Prime Minister Vidrem in the dark about his plan.
It's obvious for whom Katvan was really constructing Sky Fortress.
So... Are you going to destroy the carrier?
Hahahaha…
Haha…
Don't be silly, $MyPCName$.
We would never destroy such a valuable asset!
Dark Wind has already taken the liberty of securing both the carrier and its construction facility.
It wasn't much of a challenge. With Katvan gone, it seems the engineers abandoned the facility.
We have on our hands a unique opportunity. Maple World has always been under siege, but so rarely do we stumble upon tools we can use to strike back.
That's why Dark Wind has retrofitted the carrier as the new base of operations for the alliance.
The alliance...?
The Maple Alliance, composed of the allied factions of Dark Wind, the Order of the Eclipse, the Green Hoods, and the Royal Guard.
Sky Fortress will be our flagship.
The Alliance will be able to travel quickly and safely wherever its aid is needed. We will be able to deliver supplies with precision and without harassment from monsters or our enemies.
This fortress will become the shield of the skies—Maple World's last line of defense.
This is the plan we called you here to discuss: the operation of Sky Fortress.
The ship has nearly everything it needs. Firepower, a command center, and a plan of action. But it's missing the most important component.
What's that?
Haha. The most important component is...
You.
Me?
Empress Ereve made only one request regarding our plan for the Sky Fortress.
You are to serve as the heart of Sky Fortress.
It took me a while to come around to the empress's line of thinking myself, but now I get it.
I, Blackeye, Oska, and Frey may possess outstanding skills, and our forces may be well-trained, however...
Our methods are very different, and this alliance is very young. It will not be easy to coordinate our efforts.
However, you have worked alongside each of our organizations. You understand how we operate.
Therefore, there is no one better suited to serve as an intermediary between us! The empress was wise enough to see the potential of your contributions to our new enterprise.
$MyPCName$, I'm sorry to put you on the spot like this, but we need to start setting plans into motion.
Will you answer the call, and serve as the vanguard of the Maple Alliance?
I will give you some time to think it over. Let me know once you have decided.
I will give you some time to think it over. Let me know once you have decided.
Hm, you've made up your mind already?
I suppose the empress wouldn't have recommended you, if you hadn't already proven yourself a determined defender of our world.
Very well, then. $MyPCName$, from this day forward, I welcome you to the vanguard of the Maple Alliance.
Now is your chance to prove yourself before all of Maple World. Make us proud.
Shall we depart?
Huh? Depart for where?
To the Maple Alliance's new base of operations, the Sky Fortress, of course.
Preparations for launch are nearly complete, hence the urgency of this meeting.
Couldn't you have given me a little heads up?
Haha, I'm sorry but this whole operation is top secret.
Now, enough whinging! The hangar is quite a long ways from here.
Where exactly is it?
Haha... I'll let you see for yourself. Sometimes the answer is right beneath your feet.
Haha... I'll let you see for yourself. Sometimes the answer is right beneath your feet.
Leave it to Dark Wind to transform Revoldic Dam into a secret weapons facility.
To think that Katvan managed to build all this right under our noses, a stone's throw from Tria.
It's ours now, so there's no point in worrying.
It seems we have some new faces. I suppose introductions are in order.
I'm Veliche Martini of Tria's Royal Navy.
Hm... Veliche? You've been selected to captain the Sky Fortress?
Do you have a problem with that?
Hmph. You're just as brusque as your father.
Captain Veliche, it's a pleasure. Our associate here was personally recommended by the empress.
Nice to meet you, I'm—
There will be time for pleasantries later. Right now, we've got to finish preparations for takeoff.
Our tactical officer should be waiting at the front of the airship. She'll give you a quick rundown of things, and then you can be on your way.
The operation will be carried out by your proteges.
...Hmph, she really is her father's daughter.
We've got work to do. Hurry to our tactical officer for a mission briefing. Dismissed.
Hello everyone! I'm Nairin, the tactical officer for Sky Fortress!
And you must be $MyPCName$! I hear you're taking a central role in this operation. I look forward to working with you!
Oh, Oska! I've missed you!
<font color="#909090">(She whispers angrily.)</font> <font size="20">Nairin, focus! You're a representative of the Green Hoods!</font>
Ah! Ahem...
Allow me to begin the briefing on the Sky Fortress, and the alliance's operational plan!
HMS-001, the capital-class airborne carrier Sky Fortress.
The airship was constructed under the direction of Dark Wind's previous leader, Katvan—
Erm... Nairin? Everyone here has been well briefed on Katvan's involvement. Let's skip the history lesson, shall we?
Oh... Um, of course…
Right! Then on to the task force's mission—
Working in concert with $MyPCName$, alliance representatives and the crew of the Sky Fortress will travel the globe eliminating threats and aiding the populace.
...Or at least that's what we've been told. Right, Oska?
Why not allow the tactical officer to explain, herself?!
Well... Looks like everyone's been briefed... I'll just…
Tactical Officer Nairin, I have a question.
I'm curious about the tactical capabilities of this vessel. Perhaps you could tell us about that?
...Huh?
S-sure! I can do that!

Well, there's forward and aft cannons, air-to-surface and anti-aircraft weaponry. It's got hull plating, a squadron of attack ships, oh, and infantry! There's radar, scanners, and a comms array. I can also tell you about engine output and general flight logistics!
So where should I start?!
Erm, Nairin, I think that will suffice…
Why don't you start by telling us about the guns?
Frey...!
Hah. I think this is going to take a while. $MyPCName$, why don't you go and meet the other representatives of the alliance?
Each of the leaders of the Maple Alliance hand-picked one officer to represent their interests aboard the Sky Fortress. Tactical Officer Nairin was Oska's choice.
As you will be working closely together, now would be a good time to make your introductions.
Hey there, $MyPCName$. Nice to officially meet you! I'm Schatten, representative and officer of Dark Wind.
Hey there, $MyPCName$. Nice to officially meet you! I'm Schatten, representative and officer of Dark Wind.
Hey there, $MyPCName$. Nice to officially meet you! I'm Schatten, representative and officer of Dark Wind.
You know, you're pretty cute up close. Not as tall as I thought you were though... I guess everyone looks bigger in a giant robot!
You were there during the invasion?
Of course. I've been keeping tabs on you since you first showed up in Lith Harbor. You didn't notice me?
You really should keep your eyes open. Hahaha!
I know everything there is to know about you. I used to be a member of the Shadow Walkers, so that's no surprise.
Heck, there's plenty of things I wish I didn't know. But it's all part of the job! We have eyes and ears all over the world.
Shadow Walkers? What's that?
Well, I can tell you, but I'll have to shoot you. Do you still want to know?
Ahahaha! Just kidding. You're adorable when you're terrified.
I'll be happy to tell you all about the Shadow Walkers... after you've earned my trust.
Uh... Okay.

Anyways, Dark Wind's new marching orders are to fly around the world busting criminals, working undercover to gather intel, and hunting down Katvan's remaining followers, all from the comfort of a giant airship!
I look forward to working closely together, and getting to know you, hehe!
Oh, you're going around meeting the officers, right? If you head around that corner you'll find $npcName:11003583$, the head of Tria's Imperial Vanguard.
Hehe, you probably should've spoken with him first, considering his notoriety. Well, good luck! I'll see you around, $male:handsome,female:gorgeous$.
Are you the sorry excuse for a warrior who pulled strings with the empress to get a spot on the task force?
Are you the sorry excuse for a warrior who pulled strings with the empress to get a spot on the task force?
Are you the sorry excuse for a warrior who pulled strings with the empress to get a spot on the task force?
P-pulled strings? I was recommended for this post!
Ha! What nonsense! Back in my day, no one would've stood for that sort of politicking. If you wanted a spot in the guard, you had to earn it! Hmph, kids today...
Uhh, anyway, are you $npcName:11003583$?
What if I am? <font color="#909090">(This introduction's off to a terrible start... Maybe it's time for a different approach.)</font>
I well, I just thought you must be, since you're so, uhh, buff and confident. I know you're the sort of person I'd want in charge, if I were in the Royal Guard!
...BAHAHAHAHA!
I like you, kid. You're okay!
Yes, you had the right of it! I'm $npcName:11003583$, former guard captain and current leader of the Imperial Vanguard. We represent Tria's interests within the Maple Alliance.
It's only been a handful of years since I passed the title of guard captain to Frey, and already things in the city have completely fallen apart.
After the attack on Tria, when I heard Frey was planning to abandon his duties to run off and play hero with the Maple Alliance, I knew it was time I had words with him.
The first duty of the captain of the guard is to protect Tria and the empress! What he had proposed to do wasn't just unheard of, it was an insult to the order!
And that is why I took up my sword once again to lead the Imperial Vanguard, leaving Frey to uphold his duty as the guardian of Tria.
What selflessness and courage!
Ha! You flatter me.
Bahahaha! I see what you're doing. Angling for a spot in the vanguard are you?
Uh...
Well, if you want to earn your place in the Imperial Vanguard, you'd better know what you're getting into.
It is our duty to travel the globe, protecting people from danger—not just Tria! We also deliver provisions to those in need.
To that end, any expertise you have in Life Skills will be tremendously valuable.
Of course, the ultimate decision on whether you've got what it takes to join the vanguard is mine. I'll be keeping an eye on you!
Well, you'd better introduce yourself to the other officers. Even if they are young, inexperienced buffoons. That fellow over on the bridge represents the Order of the Eclipse.
Look at him standing there with his coat dangling from his shoulders like an idiot. No decorum! If the guard's regulations on attire were enforced here, I'd give him an earful!
This vessel is far bigger than I could have imagined...
This vessel is far bigger than I could have imagined...
Sky Fortress is beyond anything I envisioned... The idea that something like this was built by human hands and ingenuity is simply amazing.
Of course, it's quite small compared to our headquarters—which is understandable, as the Eye of Providence was created by the goddess of light.
Are you the leader of the Order of the Eclipse?
The Order of the Eclipse... Yes, I suppose that's what they called us.
Allow me to introduce myself. I'm Mason, templar and representative of the Lumiknights.
...Lumiknights?
That's the official name of the Order of the Eclipse. Now that the security blackout regarding our organization has been lifted, there's no sense referring to it by other names.
For quite some time, the Lumiknights have worked in the shadows, observing the world without getting involved.
Just as we did during the War of Light and Darkness…
But things are going to be different. I'm glad to see that my superiors have learned from their mistakes.
The Lumiknights will work alongside the Alliance to investigate the Shadow World and defend Maple World against the forces of darkness.
Anyways, I look forward to working with you.
Do you know where I can find the captain?
Just continue this way and take the corridor to the left. Until we meet again.
Hm? Do you have business with me?
Hm? Do you have business with me?
Hm? Do you have business with me?
I just wanted to introduce myself.
That wasn't enough of an introduction before? Very well.
Welcome to the alliance, $MyPCName$. I'm Captain Veliche Martini of the Tria Navy.
<font color="#909090">(What's with her suddenly acting nice? Only a few minutes ago, she seemed so mean.)</font>
...? Was there anything else?
Err, well...
You've met with the officers of the different factions and heard about their roles, and now you're looking to learn about the Maple Alliance. Am I wrong?
No, that's exactly right.
Hm. It's understandable for you to be nervous in the face of the big mission ahead of us.
The component factions of the Maple Alliance each have their own goals and responsibilities, but there are also duties which belong to the union as a whole.
As the alliance's representative aboard the Sky Fortress, I will be dispatching you on special missions in service of the organization.
These assignments may range from dealing with threats throughout the world to testing experimental weapons aboard the ship, or even eliminating foes within dungeons.
Of course, you'll need to prove yourself qualified to take on such missions.
I don't care that you were hand-picked for this assignment by the empress. The simple fact is that I don't know you, and I don't want anyone I can't trust on my vessel.
You'll have plenty of opportunities to prove yourself just as soon as we launch.
Each representative within the Alliance will task you with more advanced missions as you prove yourself qualified.
Hm. Perhaps that wasn't the right thing to say to someone that's already nervous.
Actually, I'm feeling pretty good about this operation.
That's good to hear. We can talk more later. Report to tactical officer Nairin for a status update on launch preparations. That will be all.
...And finally, Green Hoods will temporarily redirect their efforts from the battlefield, to focus on support tasks for the rest of the alliance.
...And finally, Green Hoods will temporarily redirect their efforts from the battlefield, to focus on support tasks for the rest of the alliance.
...And finally, Green Hoods will temporarily redirect their efforts from the battlefield, to focus on support tasks for the rest of the alliance.
Then I presume the Green Hoods oversee the Radar System you mentioned earlier?
Excellent memory! The answer is yes.
I didn't know Frey was so interested in military matters…
Perhaps that's why he became a soldier.
Sky Fortress's multi-spectral radar imaging system is linked right into my data tablet. We're actually running a systems test right now. Would you like to see it?
Oh, what great timing! The radar caught something.
These dots represent radar contacts. Red represents biological entities without transponders for friend-or-foe identification, so it's a safe bet they're enemies…
Wait.
Why are there red dots there?!
Your first assignment is to subdue the monsters within the $map:02000011$.
As you may know, Pyrros Fard has taken refuge there. If the monsters there were to aggravate him, things could get real bad.
A good opportunity to test your skills, right? But you need to be careful because the consequences are quite real. I've got a transport ship ready to take you straight there.
Your first assessment mission is to subdue the monsters within the $map:02000011$.
Let's see... monster activity has dropped below the maximum threat threshold! I'd call that a successful mission, $MyPCName$.
Oh! And after you complete a mission, you can check your current standing with each faction from the Reputation window, under the character menu.
From the Reputation window, you can also see comments about your performance from other members of the task force. You should check it often to see how you're doing!
Hey Nainai, are you trying to hog $MyPCName$ all for yourself? It's my turn to talk with $male:him,female:her$!
What are you talking about? That's not my name, I'm Nairin!
Sure, sure. Got it.
Anyways $MyPCName$, there's something I could use your help with too.
There's some robots stirring up trouble near the site of your last mission.
$npcNamePlural:21000135$, to be specific.
$npcNamePlural:21000135$ are combat drones designed by the $map:02000163$ a long time ago for operation in hazardous areas. Somehow they got out of the lab and started attacking people.

Nobody knows exactly what happened, but I've always speculated that the guys from MSL intentionally released the robots into remote areas to test their battle capabilities, without regard for human life.
I want to arrest all of them and make them chew on dirty gym socks... but I don't have any evidence.
Aaaaaaaaaaaanyways, I want you to go blow up some prizboxes to protect unsuspecting tourists.
Where am I going?
You're about to find out!
ENGAGE THE SHORT-RANGE TELEPORTER! ...I'm just messing with you. But that would've been totally hilarious, right? Now get to the hangar, there's a transport ship waiting.
Find the mission location on the World Map and complete your mission.
Woo-hoo! You did it! How about a kiss on the cheek to celebrate your first field operation for Dark Wind?
Uhh... I'm good, thanks.
Haha, your loss!
So, that last mission was pretty reasonable, right?
Once we set sail, you'll be able to see the location of daily field missions right on the World Map!
And if you ever get in over your head on a mission or you need to take a break, there's no shame in leaving the area.
Your mission progress will be saved, up until midnight when the mission expires.
Nairin, status report!
We have unidentified lifeforms approaching from all directions... They're moving fast!
I know what this is... I've seen beings approach this quickly just once before.
...Fans at a Blake concert.
I'm sorry, why is he here again?
...M-mason! Now is hardly the time for jokes!
Hmph. Who's joking?
Oh...! We've got a visual from the exterior base cameras!
Is that...?
The Rooks? Katvan must have told them about this place...
Captain, there's too many of them! We won't win a head-on battle!

The captain is right. Our enemies have grown bold after the attack of Tria. We should set out at once.

I wanted to make sure you heard this from me, because I don't trust that kid to give you the right information.

Really, it's a sensible decision. High quality provisions are in short supply, so it's crucial that they be available to those who would make the best use of them, rather than some foolish cadet fresh out of boot camp.
Of course, if you want to join the Imperial Vanguard and be recognized as a hero, you'll probably need top-shelf equipment from our Faction Shop. Bahahahaha!
Of course, if you want to join the Imperial Vanguard and be recognized as a hero, you'll probably need top-shelf equipment from our Faction Shop. Bahahahaha!

$MyPCName$, I've received preliminary reports on your mission performance thus far...
And I've come to a decision regarding your presence on this ship.
And I've come to a decision regarding your presence on this ship.

Make us proud.

If you want to know where you are, just pop open the World Map and take a look!

$MyPCName$, you really don't know the fascinating history of airship trade in Maple World? Hmm. Why don't you swing by my quarters sometime for some private tutoring? <font color="#909090">(She winks.)</font>

$npcName:11003534[gender:0]$.
Yes, Captain.
The Imperial Vanguard will travel to Tria and the surrounding cities to track down information on the missing ships.

$npcName:11003535[gender:1]$.

Dark Wind will identify and secure the trade routes of the missing airships. This won't be an easy task, but you may use any methods at your disposal.

$npcName:11003536[gender:0]$.

$npcName:11003537[gender:0]$.

Assist each officer in any way necessary.

Good work.

<font color="#909090">(You relay the information you've gathered.)</font>

I know this is turning into more of a goose chase than we expected. When all this is over, how about I make it up to you with a nice massage? Anywho! There's a ship waiting to take you to the research station.

We're almost done. I just need your help a little longer, sweetie.
All right! Let's have a look at the map and see where my little kitten is going this time.

Theres a multi-antenna array that needs a good hacking at the $map:02000277$! Get a move on, $MyPCName$ your ship's waiting.

$map:02000113$ is celebrated as a source of crisp, clear drinking water for all of Ellinia. The falls' powerful flow is normally enough to disperse any harmful contaminants.
However, it's breeding season for the $npcNamePlural:21000341$, and the sheer volume of their sporedust has begun making people downstream sick.
We need to reduce the $npcNamePlural:21000341$' numbers so that so that the falls will have a fighting chance to purify themselves!
We need to reduce the $npcNamePlural:21000341$' numbers so that so that the falls will have a fighting chance to purify themselves!
This is great. The water should be safe to drink soon. Thanks!
With the influx of refugees from cities which have recently been attacked by forces of darkness, there are a lot of folks not familiar with the local ecology of $map:02000129$.
As a result, it seems there have been a number of folks looking for nice tasty mushrooms who've ended up taking a bite of a $npcName:21000006$ only to hurt themselves.
In the interest of public safety, your job is to address the issue by protecting the people from themselves.
Drive out the $npcNamePlural:21000006$ so no one else tries to eat them!
Wonderful work. You've done a great service for the people of $map:02000129$.
It was bad enough when the $npcNamePlural:21000030$ at the $map:02000112$ started merging to form King Slimes...
But the waste they excrete has increased the acidity of the pristine waters of the of the $map:02000112$, and started killing the surrounding flora.
If we're going to save the forest, we have to reduce the $npcNamePlural:21000030$' numbers! Please help us, $MyPCName$!
We must wipe out the $npcNamePlural:21000030$ and save the forest!
The forest ecosystem should rebound pretty quickly, thanks to your efforts. Great work, $MyPCName$!
$MyPCName$, the unicorns need our help! Some dark magic seems to have transformed them into violent, hideous $npcNamePlural:21000109$, and it's up to us to change them back!
We've got an experimental darkness neutralization ray aboard the ship that can isolate the corruption, but you'll still have to knock the sense back into our unicorn friends.
I don't like it any more than you, but it seems to be our only choice. Sometimes the only way to help your friends is to smack them really hard.
I'll give the go-ahead to blast the area with the cure. Knock some sense into those $npcNamePlural:21000109$, to return them to their unicorny selves.
I'll give the go-ahead to blast the area with the cure. Knock some sense into those $npcNamePlural:21000109$, to return them to their unicorny selves.
Those hideous $npcNamePlural:21000109$ have been changed back into beautiful unicorns, thanks to you!
Back when $map:02000172$'s ecosystem was healthy, $npcNamePlural:21000339$ used their spore-dust to break down fallen trees and eat them.
But hormones from plastic pollution in their water supply has driven their breeding into overdrive, and now they're so numerous that they're decomposing live trees too!
Your job is to bring the $npcName:21000339$ population back under control before they kill the whole forest.
Your job is to bring the $npcName:21000339$ population back under control before they kill the whole forest.
Phew! Thanks, $MyPCName$! The forest should be safe for now.
The world has seen so much violence since Madria's attack...
And now the $npcNamePlural:21090182$ who reside in $map:02000090$ have grown jealous of their tree-neighbors' smooth and lustrous bark.
They've taken to mutilating the trees with their razor-sharp crystals, and wearing their bark as a coat. No doubt the forces of darkness had something to unusual behavior.
To save the trees of the $map:02000090$, we have no choice but to cut down the $npcNamePlural:21090182$. I'm counting on you, $MyPCName$!
To save the trees of the $map:02000090$, we have no choice but to cut down the $npcNamePlural:21090182$. I'm counting on you, $MyPCName$!
The trees should be safe for now. Thank you, $MyPCName$.
Hey, cadet. I hope you're ready to get your hands dirty, because I need you to deal with a slimy situation. BAHAHAHA! Err... It'll be funnier after I've explained.
According to witnesses, a huge number of $npcNamePlural:21000029$ have gathered at $map:02000041$. Any moment now, they may start clumping together to form King Slimes!
Needless to say, we can't allow that to happen. Your mission is to cull the $npcNamePlural:21000029$ before they grow into an even bigger threat. Well, get to work!
Your mission is to cull the $npcNamePlural:21000029$ before they grow into an even bigger threat. Well, get to work!
You really knocked the slime of them, eh cadet? ...BAHAHAHAHA!
Big news, kid! $npcNamePlural:21000078$ have been amassing in the $map:02000043$ in tremendous numbers.
I'd love it if this were just some kind of family reunion, but our scouts say they're gearing up for an assault on the nearby settlements.
I need you to disperse those mischievous fairfolk before they do some serious harm.
Dispatch $npcNamePlural:21000078$ before they hurt someone!
Nice job thinning the herd, cadet. Those $npcNamePlural:21000078$ will think twice before trying to attack another settlement.
Logging in the $map:02000017$ is tightly regulated because chopping down the enchanted trees tends to leave a lot of angry, vengeful $npcNamePlural:21000041$ behind.
But since criminals don't care about the law, the trail is full of them. Now the little vermin are running around attacking any humans they encounter.
Good thing my favorite cadet's in the neighborhood! How about you get to work deal with that $npcName:21000041$ problem?
Good thing my favorite cadet's in the neighborhood! How about you get to work deal with that $npcName:21000041$ problem?
Nicely done, kid! As I always say, there's no point fixing something when a bandage will do just fine.
Since you're over in $map:02000117$, I could use your help with something. The feral $npcName:21000062$ population in the area has gotten out of control.
I want you to thin their numbers so I don't have to deal with so much paperwork for all the travelers that go missing there.
I want you to thin their numbers so I don't have to deal with so much paperwork for all the travelers that go missing there.
Great work kid! Fewer dead travelers means fewer missing persons reports for the Royal Guard.
Hey kid, we've got a problem! The $npcNamePlural:21000079$ and $npcNamePlural:21000080$ along $map:02000118$ have gotten all uppity, and they're trying to break into Tria!
Sure, there are plenty of guards at the gate, but many of them are fresh out of training. If those rookies let even one monster through the gates, people might get hurt.
Help the Royal Guard stop those $npcNamePlural:21000079$ and $npcNamePlural:21000080$, and while you're at it, show those rookies how it's done.
Thanks. The guard's still rebuilding after the siege of Tria, but that's no excuse for letting innocent people get hurt.
Listen up, cadet! The $npcNamePlural:21000234$ of $map:02000088$ are all grown up, and they've turned to a life of gang violence!
Those hooligans are roving around mugging travelers with their slingshots. I won't stand for it! Show those $npcNamePlural:21000234$ that the law reigns supreme!
Those hooligans are roving around mugging travelers with their slingshots. I won't stand for it! Show those $npcNamePlural:21000234$ that the law reigns supreme!
Nice job, cadet! Maybe now they know that crime doesn't pay, those $npcNamePlural:21000234$ will take up a righteous path. Or not. You can always hit 'em some more!
Zombies, $MyPCName$, flesh-eating zombies!!! They've already eaten some of the geologists investigating a local anomaly, and zombified a local cat!
Yes, there's a vaccine for zombieism, but at this stage the only real cure is a good old-fashioned brain-bashing. Eliminate the zombie threat!
Clear $map:02000087$ of zombies! Quickly!
Clear $map:02000087$ of zombies! Quickly!
Nice job, kid. Now it's safe for the surviving geologists to resume their... uh... geology stuff.
The $npcNamePlural:21000077$ of $map:02000116$ are using some kind of woo-woo forest magic to snare travelers with vines and rob them of their possessions.
Considering a large number delivery people pass through the area, bringing critical supplies to Tria, we can't just let this slide.
Drive the $npcNamePlural:21000077$ out of $map:02000116$ so our delivery people can do their jobs!
Drive the $npcNamePlural:21000077$ out of $map:02000116$ so our delivery people can do their jobs!
Good work, cadet. Thanks to your efforts, we shouldn't see any more important packages go missing.
Ever since that earthquake at the $map:02000115$, it's been much harder for the guard to police monster populations around Tria.
The $npcNamePlural:21000007$ can make for good hunting in smaller numbers, but with their population boom, they've started hunting us right back.
Tourists are reluctant to visit $map:02000115$ as-is what with the gaping hole. This is too much. I want you to take out as many $npcNamePlural:21000007$ as you can!
Tourists are reluctant to visit $map:02000115$ as-is what with the gaping hole. This is too much. I want you to take out as many $npcNamePlural:21000007$ as you can!
A fine job, cadet! Hopefully the road should be a little safer now for tourists and whatnot.
Hey $MyPCName$, I've got a job for you! As you know, $map:02000114$ is a part of one of our most important trade routes, linking $map:02000062$ and $map:02000001$.
But since the road traffic has driven off the local $npcName:21000351$ population's only real predator, their slimy ooze trails have become a serious problem.
Wagon accidents are up 50%, and that means it's time for you to set things back the way nature intended, by wiping those slippery $npcNamePlural:21000351$ off the map.
Wagon accidents are up 50%, and that means it's time for you to set things back the way nature intended, by wiping those slippery $npcNamePlural:21000351$ off the map.
Great work! Thanks to you, it should be smooth sailing for all trade vehicles from now on. Well, not too smooth... BAHAHAHAHA!

$map:02000097$ is treacherous enough to navigate without all the angry $npcNamePlural:21000111$ out for human blood.
It's time somebody did something, and by somebody, I mean you. Deal with the ornery, bucktoothed menaces!
It's time somebody did something, and by somebody, I mean you. Deal with the ornery, bucktoothed menaces!
Good work! I'm sure the people of Perion will appreciate having to fish fewer bodies out of the snow!

Even though its lava floods the plains, the volcano from which the $map:02000039$ flows is technically dormant.
However, geologists warn that the burrowing $npcNamePlural:21000255$ threaten to upset the delicate pressure system allowing for the river's steady flow.
Your job is to cull the local $npcNamePlural:21000255$ population before they set off a full-scale eruption!
Your job is to cull the local $npcNamePlural:21000255$ population before they set off a full-scale eruption!
That's one less headache for me. Nicely done, cadet.

It seems the $npcNamePlural:21000088$ have become aware of the fact they've been forgotten, and are taking out their anger on anyone who happens to pass through.
I want you to secure the $map:02000010$ and put down the $npcNamePlural:21000088$' stony tantrum.
I want you to secure the $map:02000010$ and put down the $npcNamePlural:21000088$' stony tantrum.
Another headache resolved! Excellent work, cadet.
You can't take two steps at the $map:02000048$ without running ankle-first into a $npcName:21000076$. It's become a real problem for anyone who wants to get around.
$npcName:21000076$ venom is deadly, so if we don't want to have to heap any more travelers on the corpse pile, somebody's got to clean up the dig site. Get to work!
$npcName:21000076$ venom is deadly, so if we don't want to have to heap any more travelers on the corpse pile, somebody's got to clean up the dig site. Get to work!
Good work, cadet. The corpse-shovelers are in your debt. Probably some travelers too, I guess.
$MyPCName$, I have a mission which requires your skill set.
I need you to reduce the number of $npcNamePlural:21000250$ and $npcNamePlural:21000253$ in $map:02000268$.
As you may know, geothermal energy is quickly becoming a vital source of renewable energy in Maple World.
However, the $npcNamePlural:21000250$ and $npcNamePlural:21000253$ have grown so numerous that technicians cannot safely access the local geothermal energy station.
Defeat the $npcNamePlural:21000250$ and $npcNamePlural:21000253$ so that they can resume routine maintenance of the station.
Defeat the $npcNamePlural:21000250$ and $npcNamePlural:21000253$ so the technicians can resume routine maintenance of the station.
Congratulations on a job well done.
And here...
...is your mission reward.
Use it wisely.
Our survey teams say that the $npcNamePlural:21091021$ and $npcNamePlural:21091023$ at $map:02000175$ are in danger of awakening the dormant volcano with their mining.
They say it's no longer a matter of if the volcano will go off, but when.
An eruption at $map:02000175$ could cause damage on a global scale. Unfortunately, the greedy miners won't listen to reason.
There's no choice left but for us to stop them by force, for the greater good. Your mission is to drive the $npcNamePlural:21091021$ and $npcNamePlural:21091023$ out.
There's no choice left but for us to stop them by force, for the greater good. Your mission is to drive the $npcNamePlural:21091021$ and $npcNamePlural:21091023$ out.
Mission accomplished. The survey team says that the volcano is stable for now. We'll have to keep an eye on the area to make sure our miner friends never return.
$map:02000262$ has become a battlefield, full of unusual foes... abandoned toys. It's not clear what gave them life, but they are quite bitter about being discarded.
According to reports, the... ahem... "$npcNamePlural:21000171$," have proven to be especially vicious.
I need you to defeat these $npcNamePlural:21000171$ and render $map:02000262$ safe once more.
I need you to defeat these $npcNamePlural:21000171$ and render $map:02000262$ safe once more.
Well done.
We've received a distress call from the humble tribespeople of $map:02000264$.
It seems that the $npcNamePlural:21000258$ have been burrowing into the tribespeoples' igloos to get warm, and gobbling up their precious food stores.
I want you to deal with the menacing $npcNamePlural:21000258$ before any human lives are lost.
I want you to deal with the menacing $npcNamePlural:21000258$ before any human lives are lost.
Impeccable work, as always.
The $map:03000090$ was sealed in order to keep a powerful curse from spreading. Unfortunately, our advance scouts report that the seal has sprung a leak.
The curse spreads through the $npcNamePlural:40000151$ that roam the forest. Cull their numbers to keep the curse from getting any further.
The curse spreads through the $npcNamePlural:40000151$ that roam the forest. Cull their numbers to keep the curse from getting any further.
Well done. I'll have more missions for you shortly.
Our scouts report that the cunning $npcNamePlural:40000205$ of $map:03000136$ have been raising an army of sorts for their dark schemes.
The monsters of that land have proven menace enough to our forces. We cannot allow our foes to become more organized. Disperse the $npcNamePlural:40000205$ by force.
The monsters of that land have proven menace enough to our forces. We cannot allow our foes to become more organized. Disperse the $npcNamePlural:40000205$ by force.
I appreciate your efficiency.
Our scouts report that a virus that was stored in the $map:03000145$ has somehow broken containment and begun to infect humans in the lab.
It appears the virus is carried primarily by $npcNamePlural:40000074$, and its symptoms are gruesome.
Those afflicted with the virus seem to devolve into a violent, zombie-like state. We can't take the risk of someone bringing this virus back through the Shadow Gate.
Stop the spread of the virus by destroying the $npcNamePlural:40000074$, and take great care not to become infected yourself!
Stop the spread of the virus by destroying the $npcNamePlural:40000074$, and take great care not to become infected yourself!
Good work. Report to Sky Fortress's infirmary for testing and a thorough decontamination.
We have a mission from leadership of the Maple Alliance. As you can see, the $map:03000135$ is an utterly lawless place where danger lurks around every corner.
It is also a strategically valuable location in our long-term efforts to restore the Land of Darkness. As such, it's important our agents be able to operate there unharrassed.
The $npcNamePlural:40000169$ and $npcNamePlural:40000032$ who infest the area are violent, cunning, and a threat to our efforts in the area.
Your orders are to move in thin their ranks so they no longer pose a threat to our operatives.
Your orders are to move in thin their ranks so they no longer pose a threat to our operatives.
Exemplary work. I'll send word of your success to our leaders.
Scouting missions into the Land of Darkness indicate that $npcNamePlural:40000023$ taken control of the facilities at $map:03000134$.
It seems they're preparing an array of chemical weapons. While it's unlikely they'd traverse the Shadow Gate to attack our people, I'm not comfortable taking the risk.
Deal with the $npcNamePlural:40000023$ so that they never have an opportunity to use their chemical weapons.
Deal with the $npcNamePlural:40000023$ at $map:03000134$ so that they never have an opportunity to use their chemical weapons.
One less weapon in the hands of our enemies is always a win. Well done.
As the site of a gateway between our world and the Land of Darkness, it is crucial our people be able to safely traverse the $map:03000014$.
Unfortunately, the local wildlife has become a menace to our reconnaissance teams.
Neutralize the threat presented by the $npcNamePlural:40000024$ and $npcNamePlural:40000132$ so that our access to the Land of Darkness remains unimpeded.
Neutralize the threat presented by the $npcNamePlural:40000024$ and $npcNamePlural:40000132$ so that our access to the Land of Darkness remains unimpeded.
I take no pleasure in the destruction of any creatures, but we have a duty to protect the empire. Thank you for your service.
Come in, $MyPCName$. I have an urgent mission for you.
$map:02000280$ is the primary producer of carrots in Victoria Island. However, the Moon Bunnies farmers have recently been threatened by a terrible new kind of monster.
We cannot stand idly by while one of our greatest sources of produce is threatened, and our adoptive citizens are bullied!
Drive these brutes from $map:02000280$ and bring restore the peace for our Moon Bunny farmers.
You have your mission. Stop wasting time.
Well done. The Moon Bunnies should be able to farm in peace once again.
We've got a lot to cover, so let's skip straight to the good part!
I've got a juicy report from the $map:02000043$. If you ask real, real nice, maybe I'll share it with you...
Please! I must know!
Eh, pass.
I love the desperation in your voice. All right, listen up.
I'm listening.
You can't fool me, $MyPCName$. You want a piece of this. And by this, I mean this mission.
I'm listening.
Someone's been getting in the way of the trade caravans through the $map:02000043$.
This guy wanders around aimlessly, bumping into things and knocking carts over. So... what do you think?
Beats me.
Sounds... zombie-ish...
Tsk, tsk. You'll never make a decent spy at this rate.
So what do you think it is?
I think our old friend $npcName:11000492[gender:0]$ has been raised from the dead. We never did find his body, did we? I think he's the spook that's haunting the $map:52000037$.
That sounds plausible.
I've got an agent watching the situation. Head to the $map:02000043$ and see if they have any updates for me.
What's the matter? Can't tear yourself away from my side?
How did it go?
Go on. Give me all the juicy details.
<font color="#909090">(You tell her everything you learned.)</font>
That's a shame. It looks like we still don't have any useful information. Oh well.
So I went all that way for nothing?
Cheer up, $MyPCName$. You get an A for effort!
Let's get to work, sugar.
You haven't been by the $map:02000146$ recently, have you? My agents have picked up a strange energy pattern in the area.
The wavelength, the frequency—everything about it is totally new to us. You up for a one-on-one analsys sesh with me while we figure this out?
I sure am!
Eh... Not really.
That'd be great, right? Anyway, that's not our job. So... too bad!
What do I have to do?
Spoilsport. In that case, I've got another job for you.
What do I have to do?
Meet my agent at the $map:02000146$ and get an update. Then bring it back to me. Simple, no?
All this scientific mumbo-jumbo is beyond me, honestly. Give me a mark to tail and a back to stab any day of the week.
How did it go?
Go on. Give me all the juicy details.
<font color="#909090">(You tell her everything you learned.)</font>
So we still don't know where the signal is coming from, or who's sending it. We'll just have to keep working the problem, I guess.
I wish I knew what all this code meant...
Don't you mind that, $MyPCName$. Here's your reward.
You ready to get to work? Here's the plan.
My agents have been tracking a terrorist organization that calls itself the Resistance. They have this whole anti-magic shtick, and they aren't afraid to bust some heads to make a point.
Those guys are always up to trouble.
Never heard of 'em.

It seems they've come to $map:02000270$ in search of new technology. We thought this'd be a good opportunity to nab their leaders, but it's tough to tell an undercover Resistance agent from your average scientific egg-head.
How can I help?
Oh, you have the most important job of all! Meet my agents in $map:02000270$ and see if they have any messages for me.
My agents are patient, but it's rude to make them wait.
How did it go?
Go on. Give me all the juicy details.
<font color="#909090">(You tell her everything you learned.)</font>
I knew this wouldn't be easy...
Neither of the messages had anything useful?
Nothing I was looking for. But Dark Wind doesn't give up so easily. Sooner or later, we'll get these Resistance goons!
By the way... What was with the robot?
Only the best tech for the best intelligence agency!
Impressive.
Oh, I'm just getting started, $MyPCName$. Anyway, here. You earned this.
Ready for another mission, sunshine?
It's no secret that $npcName:11000251[gender:0]$ is the boss of Blackstar. What most people don't know, however, is that Blackstar has a genius advisor who's secretly behind their success.
Ever since we learned of this advisor's existence, we've chased him tirelessly. If we put him behind bars, it could spell the end for the mob.
Who is this advisor, then?
All we have is a name: $npcName:11003182[gender:0]$. Blackstar is careful not to leak anything about their great tactician.
But you managed to track him down anyway, right?
You know it! That's where things got weird, though. Lean in close, and I'll tell you something that'll blow your mind...
Oh, yes?
Uh... That'll be a no from me.
After reaching $map:02000131$, he just... stopped. I think he realized he was being followed. He just stands around and stares at enemies all day.
Well that's... weird.
You don't want the mission, then? I thought you were a team player!
Fine, fine. I'll do it.
I've got an agent at $map:02000131$. Find her and ask if she has any new intel for me.
Listen, I'd love to blow off work, too, but this is too important. We can spend time together later, okay?
How did it go?
Go on. Give me all the juicy details.
<font color="#909090">(You tell her everything you learned.)</font>
I don't get it...
Which part didn't you get? "Apple" or "snake"?
Ah, I forgot that you don't know our code. According to my agent, he doesn't do anything special but point at the enemies from time to time.
But... but why?
I don't have enough information to even try to guess. We'll just have to keep watching him for now.
Good job, $MyPCName$. Here's your reward.
We've got a lot to cover, so let's skip straight to the good part!
You know that Dark Wind is keeping a close eye on Blackstar, right?
That's news to me.
We've covered this before.
Right, right. Anyway, we may have a breakthrough in our investigation of Blackstar.
And what might that be?
You know that hot-shot alchemist $npcName:11000264[gender:0]$, right?
Of course I do.
...Who?
He's known for being totally obsessed with his work. So... why do you think he's been making so many visits to $map:02010020$ lately?
Is he a fight fan?
Ha! Good one.
I'm serious...
An egghead like $npcName:11000264[gender:0]$ wouldn't be into the MMA scene. Trust me. Anyway, one of my agents is convinced there's something strange going on with him.
I've already got boots on the ground at $map:02010020$. Meet up with my agent and see what you can learn.
What's the matter? Can't tear yourself away from my side?
How did it go?
Go on. Give me all the juicy details.
<font color="#909090">(You tell her everything you learned.)</font>
I see. So, as soon as he gets to $map:02010020$, he goes straight to the $map:52010010$...
So that's what it all meant...
I don't know what to think. Well, we'll just have to keep a closer eye on $map:02010020$.
Good job, $MyPCName$. Here's your reward.
A beautiful day like today ought to be spent enjoying yourself with someone lithe and spirited, hm? Too bad we've got so much work to do...
What do you know about those assassins we fought earlier?
You mean the Rooks?
Yes. Their techniques were advanced, to say the least. And they're clearly very, very well informed.
I did some digging, and I found... absolutely nothing. I've never seen anything like it! The only thing we know for sure about them is that they call themselves the Rooks.
How could they vanish without a trace?
The Rooks...
Beats me. Even my agents would be hard-pressed to pull that off...
Maybe you should let this one go.
Huh? Do you know something about them?
No! Nothing at all!
Relax! No need to be so serious.
Never mind.
They slipped my grasp this time... But I'm the great $npcName:11003535[gender:1]$! I found them before, and I'll do it again.
What are you standing around here for? My agents are already in $map:02000083$, tracking down leads. Head down there and see what they've found out.
While you're wasting time here, our enemies could be making their escape!
How did it go?
Go on. Give me all the juicy details.
<font color="#909090">(You tell her everything you learned.)</font>
Oh, these guys are pros, all right...
So we still don't know anything?
Yeah. This whole "failure" thing is new to me. I don't like it.
Keep at it. I believe in you.
Look at you, trying to cheer me up! Here, cutie. This is for you.
I had a dream about you last night, you know. It felt almost... prophetic.
It's clear to me now. We're destined to be together.
W-we are?
You're cute when you blush, you know that? Anyway, settle down. I've got a mission for you.

BeyondLink has a lab in the Land of Darkness. That's shady enough as it is, but it seems they've been doing experiments on humans, trying to make the perfect soldier. These experiments... Well, they aren't pretty.
That's not good.
Right? Just when you think you've seen the worst of the worst, some crazies in the Land of Darkness have to go and outdo themselves.
Don't worry. I'll put a stop to this.

The Green Hoods have been thoroughly analyzing different items in Maple World in search of new ways these everyday items can be utilized.
Our current subject is $item:30000231$, which has rejuvenating effects.
It's used in energy tonics and tinctures as a gimmick. I want to see if it actually has rejuvenating effects!
I just need a few samples to get started.
That's all from me! I leave it to you!

Not talking to you, pretty boy.

You worked up one heck of a sweat, cadet! Looks like my lessons are finally starting to rub off on you!

The sheer amount of resources we've been pouring into reconstructing the areas she's destroyed makes me shake my darn head. It's gotten so bad, we even need to enlist your help, when you're about as useful as a baby cat.
Awww, I love kittens...
Never mind that... Listen close, because I don't like repeating myself. Right now, the city needs $itemPlural:33000064$. Got that?
I suggest you use your skills as a miner and smith to craft the $itemPlural:33000064$.

You haven't left yet? The $itemPlural:33000064$ aren't going to collect themselves. Get a move on, cadet!
This'll do. I grudgingly admit you're kind of useful to have around.
There you are, cadet.
Yes, there you are. I need you to—
Excuse me! I'm giving $MyPCName$ a mission right now! Cadet, I'm sending out to collect $itemPlural:33000065$.
Remember, you can get them with your mining and smithing skills. Now, go!
Hmph. I'm sure it was my turn to borrow $MyPCName$...
What are you doing, cadet?! Co collect $itemPlural:33000065$ for the city! Remember, you can get them with your mining and smithing skills.
This will work for now. Thanks.
After Madria's invasion, the city is facing a food shortage. The ranching infrastructure just isn't being fixed quickly enough to meet demand.
I think some $itemPlural:20000352$ could help. They double ranching production.
Amazing!
I'm full of amazing facts. You should know this by now, cadet.
What're you just gaping at me for? Go get a pair of $item:20000352$ to help the city! You know you get them from mining and smithing, right?

Our banks are failing. The whole country's going broke! Don't just stand there, cadet. You can turn this around! Donate $itemPlural:33000066$ to give the economy a kick in the pants!
Dig up the earth and smelt the $itemPlural:33000066$ yourself if you have to. The future of the empire is riding on your sweaty, overworked back!

This should be enough to launch a brand new trade ship. You're making a difference, cadet!

We've got blacksmiths and other volunteers working to fix up the city, but it's still not enough! It doesn't help that the younger blacksmiths keep whining about their legally provided 10 minute break every 4 hours.
Back in my day, blacksmiths didn't take breaks! They got the work done, no matter what! I know a few blacksmiths who didn't sleep for a week, just to get their orders ready on time.
I shudder to think about the condition of the items they made.
Nobody asked you!
Now, I'll let you in on a little secret. When I use a $item:20000358$, it increases my smithing production sixfold!
Get me a $item:20000358$ to give to the blacksmiths. That should ramp things up!
Get me a $item:20000358$ to give to the blacksmiths. That should ramp things up!
Not bad, kid. I bet you didn't take any ten-minute breaks while you completed his mission for me! BAHAHAHAHA!
Even with the Royal Guard providing its full support, our ranchers aren't pulling their weight.

In ranching, you need experienced, knowledgeable workers to get the most out of your animals and crops, but a lot of those people were badly injured in the invasion. The people they've sent as temporarily replacements are about as efficient as... as... as baby chicks!
You laugh, but baby chicks are quite effective when used as a casting medium for the obscure art of ornimancy.
I can never tell if he's joking.
Anyway, what we need now is mastery! Knowledge! Experience! And I know just the thing!
Oh, right. You! We need you!
And don't you forget it.
Get me a pair of $item:20000353$, and I'll show those ranchers how they can double their production. Mine up the ore and smith it yourself if you have to!
Quickly! Obtain some $item:20000353$!
Not bad, cadet. Not bad at all.
That Madria's a crafty one. On their way out, her army razed whole swaths of farmland.
We're facing food shortages all over the empire. Trust me, starvation is a cruel way to go.
You kids don't know hunger like my generation. I reckon we don't have long before you all give up...
If I may! The entire crew—including us "kids"—have agreed to cut our rations in half to help keep the civilian population fed.
W-what? Really? I mean, that's right! I spear-headed that measure myself, for the good of Maple World!
Anyhow, there's no life without food...
And $item:33000147$ is nutritious and cheap. If you're any good at farming or cooking, you can help scrounge some up for the hungry.
Well? What are you waiting for? Get to farming, cadet!
Use your farming and cooking skills to make $item:33000147$!
This will feed a ton of people. Thanks!
I've gotten reports that some folks who fled their homes because of Madria's attacks are suffering from food shortages and a lack of warm clothing. This is not good, cadet!
We need these folks to survive! Otherwise, what are we even fighting for?
I can withstand the harsh winter winds, thanks to my muscular frame and lush facial hair, but you can't expect that from your average civilian.
Weren't you just complaining this morning that the upper deck was too windy?
Anyway, when it comes to muscles, I prefer a build like $MyPCName$'s. Strong, but... flexible!
You don't know what you're talking about! The wind wasn't making me cold, it was ruining my coif. Do you know how much gel my single bang requires?!
Anyway, the best way to beat the cold is by eating hot food. So I thought of something simple, filling, and warm: $item:20000431$!
Make some $item:20000431$ for the hungry folks below!
You better use enough seasoning. I'll be taste-testing the $item:20000431$ myself.
You better use enough seasoning. I'll be taste-testing the $item:20000431$ myself.
Mmm, something smells delicious. You did good, cadet. Maybe you have "Condor's Personal Chef" written in your future after all of this is over.
There aren't enough cakes to go around, so some civilians have been eating $item:30000242$ by the jarful. No way that's good for you. Not that I can blame them, though. The stuff's delicious.
Wait just one moment here. Did you take food from those poor, starving people?
What?! No! It was all for the greater good! Anyway, it's obvious the people are craving sugar because they're coping with their stress...
I can't just stand idly by and let them eat poison! We should give them some nice, sweet fruit to tide them over.
Some apples should do the trick! A sweet, juicy, nutritious snack for everyone!
What're you waiting for? Make some $itemPlural:33000149$ for the hungry! You know how to farm and cook, don't you?
What're you waiting for? Make some $itemPlural:33000149$ for the hungry! You know how to farm and cook, don't you?
Hey, these look pretty tasty. Thanks!

Such a waste. I knew I should've sampled more before I sent them off to be delivered. They ended up going to complete and utter waste. What do we do now?
Hey, you! Luminknight! You got any ideas? What're you munching on right now?
What? Me? These are chips. When I keep them sealed, they stay crisp for a long time. Want one?
This is not time to be munching on—
I just got the best idea! Chips! $itemPlural:20000420$! If we prepare some of those for the people, they'll stay fresh long enough to actually reach them!
Oooh, apple chips. You're a genius, Condor. I see you in a totally different light now.
Why are you still here, $MyPCName$? Shouldn't you be making $itemPlural:20000420$ with your farming and cooking skills right about now?

Why are you still here, $MyPCName$? Shouldn't you be making $itemPlural:20000420$ with your farming and cooking skills right about now? I refuse to let anyone starve!
