Times are tough. We've sent off most of our reserve food supplies to civilians in need. Rightly so, but it means the Royal Guards are looking rather scrawny.
It's not as if I can ease up on their training. The men have to be ready to fight at any moment, after all.
But they keep giving me these puppy dog looks, as if they're starving, or sick, or dying...
I could try slicing up some pine mushroom for your men. That's pretty nutritious.
Can't say no to that, I guess. Very well. Go make some $item:33000150$ for my men!
Go fetch some $itemPlural:33000150$ for my men!
My men will be grateful for this. If they're not, it'll be a thousand more push-ups.
It's not easy rebuilding Tria. Everyone's growing weary at the slow progress.
Can you blame them? Their quality of life has corroded. I wish I could put a smile on everyone's face again.
Oooh, I know! I always smile when I eat. Why don't you try giving them some delicious food?
How am I supposed to do that? Everyone's always complaining that the food from our reserve supplies are bland.
Actually, that gives me an idea! Why don't we add $item:20000426$ to the food? That'll make it burst with flavor!
Obviously, only someone familiar with farming and cooking could provide that ingredient.
Actually, that gives me an idea! Why don't we add $item:20000426$ to the food? That'll make it burst with flavor!
Not bad, cadet.
Here to work, I hope?
We're making steady progress on Tria's reconstruction, thanks to the effort of folks like me, but I'm seeing more and more people skipping meals.
Can't say I blame them. Who cares if you're a little hungry when you're busy rebuilding lives? Still, we can't have workers passing out on the job.
Why don't I make them a snack that they can eat while they work?
That's not a bad idea. If you've got the farming and cooking chops, why don't you slice up some oranges for the workers?
Support those who work tirelessly to rebuild by preparing some $itemPlural:33000151$!
Something smells good.
Ah, the $itemPlural:33000151$! Perfect! It should be simple enough to preserve these, right?
I'll have some of my men get on it right away.
The invasion may be over, but the fight continues on...
It's a blasted embarrassment is what it is. We don't have enough medicine to go around.
Our tonics and potions go to the soldiers who were hurt the most. For everyone else... Well, they'll have to get by with $item:33000132$.
Use your harvesting and alchemy skills to make $item:33000132$ for the sick and injured.
Use your harvesting and alchemy skills to make $item:33000132$ for the sick and injured.
What took you so long? Lives are on the line here!
Hand over that $item:33000132$. The stuff is basically snake oil, but it's all we can scrounge up. Thanks.
My men still suffer from the wounds they received during the invasion...
They suffer in silence, but I know something that can help them: lavender. It's known for it's pain-relieving properties.
Now, you're supposed to give to them as an oil, but we don't have time for that. Instead, we'll light some $itemPlural:20000405$ in the bunks.
Will that really help them with their pain? Some of them are really hurt.
Of course it will! Now stop dallying and get some $itemPlural:20000405$!
Stop dallying and obtain some $itemPlural:20000405$!
Hand it over.
Mmmm, that's the stuff. With this lavender and some grit, my bath will be fabulous to—I mean, there's nothing my men can't do!
You got a minute?
I sent a squad to fight some bug monsters that were hounding a village in the boonies. Some of them were bitten, and now they itch like mad.
Worse, they can't seem to stop scratching. Say, how are your foraging and alchemy skills, kid?
Eh, they're all right.
Great! Then obtain some $item:33000134$ for my men. It should help with the itching.
Obtain some $item:33000134$ for my men. It should help with the itching.
Smells like you got what I asked for.
I'll get it to my men right away.
Hey, $MyPCName$. C'mere.
Shhh, no, don't look at me!
What's with the secrecy?
Secrecy? What? No! What're you— Never mind. You're skilled at foraging and alchemy, right? Have you heard of $item:20000408$?
I've been taking $itemPlural:20000408$, but it's hard to get enough rosemary for it on my own.
Yeah. I know that stuff! It's used to cure baldness, isn't it?
By the light, keep your voice down! Anyway, can you get me some?
Heh.
Shut it, twerp.
Now go and make me some $itemPlural:20000408$!
Ah, there you are.
Hey, this $item:20000408$ is not too shabby, not too shabby at all. Thanks, cadet. I owe you one.
Achoo!!
Sorry for sneezing on you, but it just goes to show: nobody's immune to the common cold. Let my germs be a warning to you.
I bet some $item:33000135$ would perk you right up.
$item:33000135$? You some sort of alchemist? Sure, might as well give it a shot. I mean, look at me, I'm miserable.
I'll wait here for that $item:33000135$ you promised.
That looks lemony, all right.
Thanks, kid. This should help my men as well.
Are you ready to do your duty for $map:02000001$?
Some of my men were battling toxic monsters, and a lot of them got poisoned. We need to obtain an antidote for them as quickly as we can!
Any ideas, cadet?
Perhaps some $item:20000414$ would detoxify them.
Brilliant! Let's do it!
Obtain some $itemPlural:20000414$ to detoxify my poisoned men.
Well? You got what I asked for?
I'll get this $item:20000414$ to my men right away.
Battle scars are a mark of honor!
But that doesn't mean I can let my men's wounds fester and become infected. I propose we make a cure-all tonic to treat their injuries.
Sure. Just tell me where to pick it up!
You don't already know? I figured you'd... Never mind. Of course I know. $item:33000136$ is used in plenty of potions and tonics, so I bet that stuff will do the trick.
Use your foraging and alchemy skills to bring me some $itemPlural:33000136$!
You got the tonic?
I'll get this straight to my medics. Good work.
When you look around, the devastation caused by Madria goes as far as the eye can see!
Major roads, blocked! Sea paths, in chaos! And none of it has been restored. Major you can't see it, $MyPCName$, but trust me, the effects are massive and far-reaching.

We've put up tents to help house those who've been displaced, but the fabric is starting to fray and tear. Can you use your ranching and handicraft skills to get some $item:33000076$ so we can fix up the tents?
Will you use your ranching and handicraft skills to obtain $item:33000076$ so we can repair the tents?
Every delay causes more suffering!
You've brought the $item:33000076$! Thank you. That should be enough to last for a while.
Look alive. We've got work to do.
I need $item:33000077$. It's a crucial ingredient for a lot of the everyday items you take for granted.
It used to be easy to get. Ever since the attack on the capital, however, we can't seem to get our hands on the stuff. Will you make some for the Royal Guard?
Will you obtain $item:33000077$ for the Royal Guard?
I see you got the supplies I asked for.
Perfect. My men will make good use of this. I'll let you know if we need more.
Supplies are scarce, cadet.
Lots of things are made from $item:33000078$, for example. But when's the last time you saw $item:33000078$ just lying around?
I almost never see $item:33000078$ lying around.

Let me fill you in on how we got to this sorry state of affairs. Civilians, driven from their homes by the forces of darkness, get so hungry they'll eat anything—even $item:33000078$. Nothing we can do about that, so we just have to make more.
Support the Royal Guards by obtaining $item:33000078$ for us.
I see you got the supplies I asked for.
Perfect. My men will make good use of this. I'll let you know if we need more.
I left my heart... in... beautiful $map:02000001$...
All of Maple World suffers when $map:02000001$ suffers, and $map:02000001$ is suffering right now, with its outer palace walls in complete disarray.
We're always short on materials and men, so it's slow going.
A nice $item:20000345$ would help speed things up. Why don't you make one for me?
Bring $itemPlural:20000345$ so we can fix $map:02000001$'s palace walls.
I see you got the supplies I asked for.
Perfect. My men will make good use of this. I'll let you know if we need more.
What a miserable sight...

My men are weak and scrawny. I can barely stand to look at them. The only way for them to get stronger is... $item:33000079$! Mix it in their drinks, sprinkle it on their meals, shove it down their throats... Whatever it takes!
Cadet, get me some $item:33000079$!
Why don't I just get you some milk?

I can't have guards drinking cups of milk like babies! No, $item:33000079$ is the way to go. You can mix it in their drinks, sprinkle it on their meals, shove it down their throats... Whatever it takes!
Stop the chit-chat and bring me the $item:33000079$!
I see you got the supplies I asked for.
Perfect. My men will make good use of this. I'll let you know if we need more.
Supplies have become scarce, cadet.
We've directed most of our mining resources toward repairing the city's outer walls. You never know when the enemy will attack again.
But there's been immense damage to civilian homes, as well. This got me thinking, we really need a $item:20000364$.
How is a $item:20000364$ gonna help?
You let me worry about that. Just get me one!
Stop dawdling and bring me my $item:20000364$!
I see you got the supplies I asked for.
Perfect. My men will make good use of this. I'll let you know if we need more.
I better take care of that...
Hey, cadet. You liking Sky Fortress?
Yeah, it's great!
We've got it good up here, but the same can't be said for some of my men.
They're down in the cold, working as hard as they can to help the people. Maybe you can help them out by getting some $item:33000080$ so they don't freeze to death.
Maybe you can help them out by getting some $item:33000080$ so they don't freeze to death.
I see you got the supplies I asked for.
Perfect. My men will make good use of this. I'll let you know if we need more.
I have a mission for you. $map:02000262$ is on red alert.
That means that there's some bad stuff going down. There are all kinds of alerts, like—
As I was saying, our radars are detecting an entity known as $npcName:22000045$. It seems that other monsters started inhabiting the area after it appeared.
I'm getting all kinds of spooky reports from $map:02000262$—living dolls and the like. Based on the timeline, I bet $npcName:22000045$ is behind this!
We will give these monsters no quarter. Go to $map:02000262$ and defeat $npcName:22000045$ and its minions!
<font size='20'>It's not like I was talking or anything...</font>
Go to $map:02000262$ and defeat $npcName:22000045$ and its minions!
$map:02000262$ is once again under our control. Competently executed. I'll have my analysts look into the effect $npcName:22000045$ had on its surroundings.
Don't let this go to your head. We have more work to do.
I have a mission for you. $map:02000175$ is on red alert.
$npcName:22000052$ has escaped from the Land of Darkness and is turning nearby monsters into savages.
How did $npcName:22000052$ get there?
After the $map:02000146$ opened, other secret passages and tunnels to our world opened along with it.
It's unfortunate that $npcName:11001813[gender:0]$ slipped our grasp at Henesys. If I'd been there to oversee things back then...
And what would you have done differently, exactly?

I suspect a fifth-level Faustian Binding in conjunction with a Ward of the Escutcheon's Aegis would have trapped him nicely. It certainly would have been more effective than fighting off his cronies while he made his escape.
Listen, you weren't there, man. It—
That's enough of that. Go to the $map:02000175$ and defeat $npcName:22000052$ and his minions!
Go to $map:02000146$ and defeat $npcName:22000052$ and its minions!
You've contained the threat for now, but the shadows are still clinging to the area. This is far from over.
I'll continue to monitor the situation. When you are needed, I'll call on you again. Dismissed.
This next mission is top priority. The $map:02000275$'s prototype war machine, $npcName:22090123$, is malfunctioning.
It was developed to combat evil spirits. However, it seems that it was exposed to dark magic during a performance test. It is now out of control.
$npcName:11000264[gender:0]$ has asked us to take care of this matter personally. I thought of you first when the request came in, naturally.

While you're there, I'd like you to eliminate the monsters who corrupted $npcName:22090123$ in the first place. This should also serve as a reminder that machines can't replace human soldiers and warriors.
I won't let them replace us, Ma'am!
Go to the $map:02000275$ and defeat $npcName:22090123$ and the other nearby monsters!
There you are. Don't bother filing a report…
Uh... Is something wrong?
$npcName:11000264[gender:0]$ has sent you his thanks for taking care of this.
You don't seem to happy about this.
Um... They plan to rebuild the $npcName:22090123$ and try again. It's only a matter of time before they're asking us for help again...
And when that time comes, we will come to their aid. Again. That is our duty. Dismissed.
$map:02000276$ is on red alert. $npcName:11003536[gender:1]$, brief $MyPCName$ on the situation.
What? Sorry, I was a little... Um, a horde of monsters have taken over the labs at $map:02000276$. We think that $npcName:22000023$ is their leader.

$npcName:22000023$ is a bear who powers herself by eating up electricity. At this rate, $map:02000276$ will be out of power in... wow, 24 hours! No power means no security systems, and no security systems mean... Well, bad stuff.
One of our agents was working undercover at the lab as a janitor, but we haven't heard from him in over eight hours…
That's enough. $MyPCName$, head to $map:02000276$ and dispose of $npcName:22000023$ and its minions.
Go to $map:02000276$ and defeat $npcName:22000023$ and its minions!
My scouts say that $map:02000276$ has settled down. Do you have any news of our undercover agent?
Sorry. I didn't see any janitors while I was down there.
Oh no! What could have happened to him...?
I hope he survived, but we must prepare ourselves for the possibility that he's scrubbing toilets in heaven, $npcName:11003536[gender:1]$. $MyPCName$, good work.
I have a new mission for you. $map:02000018$ is on red alert. $npcName:11003534[gender:0]$ will fill you in on the details.
That's right. Listen up, because I won't repeat myself.
Boooring! You could listen to this wind bag jabber on all day... or you could spend some time with me!
Maybe I should find out what the mission is first...?
Get your harpy claws off $male:him,female:her$! $MyPCName$ and I have got serious business to discuss.
I'm all ears, $npcName:11003534[gender:0]$!
Good choice, cadet. You'll make a fine soldier someday. Maybe. Actually, now that I look at you, you are pretty scrawny...
Um... The mission...?
Right, right, the mission. A red alert was issued at $map:02000018$. The place is falling to pieces. Literally.

There's a beast called $npcName:22000034$ that has a mean sweet tooth. Him and his lackeys are eating $map:02000018$ from the ground up. That old castle is an imperial heritage site, for light's sake!
There's no need to shout, $npcName:11003534[gender:0]$. $MyPCName$ knows what $male:he,female:she$ must do. I expect that $map:02000018$ will be free of this $npcName:22000034$ soon.
Go to $map:02000018$ and defeat $npcName:22000034$ and its minions!
Congratulations on a successful mission.
And you couldn't have done it without me!
I guess that's true.
And don't you forget it! You keep this up, $MyPCName$, and I'll even consider taking you under my wing.
Ah! That's okay. I'm good.
Don't get ahead of yourself, cadet. I said I'd consider it. But if that's going to be your attitude, maybe you don't have the right stuff, after all.
...Noted.
We have a situation at $map:02000279$. $npcName:11003535[gender:1]$ will bring you up to speed.
I'll get right to the point. A shipment of $npcName:11000264[gender:0]$'s robots was hit by some robbers not too long ago.
These robots are loaded with the latest Taliskar tech, and the robbers even managed to get their hands on a cutting-edge $npcName:22000042$. And now, those robots have shown up at $map:02000279$.
This has Blackstar's fingerprints all over it. Still, I can't quite figure out why they'd target $map:02000279$.
The stolen robots aren't responding to any known shut-down override codes. You'll need to dismantle them by hand. Make your way to $map:02000279$ and defeat $npcName:22000042$ and the other machines.
Go to $map:02000279$ and defeat $npcName:22000042$ and its minions!
I believe Agent $npcName:11003535[gender:1]$ will be pleased with your success.
I can breathe easy now, thanks to you. I don't suppose you found any clues implicating Blackstar in this whole mess?
I'm afraid not.
That's a shame. Maybe $npcName:11000264[gender:0]$'s team will come up with something when they analyze the scrap you left behind.
Anyway, you busy after this? I'd like to thank you... personally.
Ah... Ummm…
Ha! You should see your face right now!
I have a mission for you. $map:02000171$ is on red alert.
$npcName:22000053$ has long been an enemy to $map:02000051$. With the recent activities of the Inakimo Tribe, he may have been emboldened to act.
This report came from the owner of $map:02000178$ in $map:02000171$. The monsters are driving away all the tourists! And I was planning to visit there, too...
I already tried reaching out to the local experts, but they weren't available for this mission.
Local experts? Are they anyone I know?

It's not my job to keep track of who you do and do not know. But, if I have time, I'll introduce you to them later. For now, head to $map:02000171$ and defeat $npcName:22000053$, as well as any other monsters you encounter there.
Go to $map:02000171$ and defeat $npcName:22000053$ and its minions!
Good job. This should bolster the security of $map:02000051$ for now. One less thing for the war chief to worry about.
This wasn't anything $npcName:11000009[gender:0]$ couldn't handle himself.
Ah, perhaps I said too much. There are some things I need to tell you... later. For now, you're dismissed.
I have a mission for you. $map:02000132$ is on red alert.
A series of unexplained phenomena have struck the area. Many of our agents report monsters appearing from thin air.
I suspect that the monster known as $npcName:22090007$ is behind this. "Summoner" is in her name, after all.
Your first order of business is defeating $npcName:22090007$. While you're there, defeat any other monsters you encounter.
Go to $map:02000132$ and defeat $npcName:22090007$ and its minions!
Well done. I'm officially lifting the red alert from $map:02000132$.
Okay, but it seemed like $npcName:22090007$ was drawing power from her surroundings, not the other way around.
If that's true, then we've only seen the beginning of trouble at $map:02000132$... $npcName:11003536$, monitor the region and let me know the moment more monsters appear.
Yes, Ma'am!
I have a mission for you. $map:02000180$ is on red alert.
Our radar systems are picking up a huge concentration of dark magic in the area. It's especially bad around $npcName:22000007$!
We can't allow the enemy to rally their forces. Go to the $map:02000180$ and defeat $npcName:22000007$, along with any other monsters in the area.
Go to $map:02000180$ and defeat $npcName:22000007$ and its minions!
That's one crisis averted, thanks to you. $npcName:11003536$, I want a full report on how this was allowed to happen at the $map:02000180$.
Yes, Ma'am! I'll start going over the data right away.
I have a mission for you. $map:02000113$ is on red alert.
$npcName:22000059$ is on a rampage, so defea—
Not so fast, Captain. There's more to this than you think.
$npcName:22000059$ is normally harmless. My sources say that he was the victim of bullying, and that's what's driven him to the brink.
Who'd dare bully that old snail? Kids these days have no respect! I'll put the fear of the empire, all right!!
Cool your jets, grandpa.
Anyway, $npcName:22000059$ is the victim here. Can't you just... gently bring him back to his senses?
You never cease to surprise me, $npcName:11003535[gender:1]$. $MyPCName$, please take her request under advisement while you carry out this mission.
Go to $map:02000113$ and defeat $npcName:22000059$, along with any other monsters in the area.
Report.
$npcName:22000059$ is back to normal.
And that, ladies and gentlemen, is how it's done! Thanks for helping the old snail out.
And for showing those rapscallions a thing or two about respecting their elders!!
Aaaand here he goes…
The $map:02000112$ is on red alert. $npcName:11003536[gender:1]$, brief $MyPCName$ on the situation.
Yes, Captain! $npcName:22090107$, king of the slimes at the $map:02000112$, is making moves to expand his kingdom. We've spotted his troops attacking other monsters in several neighboring areas.

Now, normally we wouldn't care about monsters fighting other monsters, but slime gunk is getting into the local water supplies. If this keeps up, $map:02000023$ could lose its main source of fresh water.
On behalf of the citizens of $map:02000023$, we need to intervene. Go to the $map:02000112$, defeat $npcName:22090107$, and crush his forces.
Go to $map:02000112$ and defeat $npcName:22090107$ and its minions!
It seems like you've put an end to $npcName:22090107$'s little war. The water quality at the $map:02000112$ is already returning to normal. Well done.
I have a mission for you. $map:02000185$ is on red alert.
Monsters are flooding the area, seemingly from out of nowhere. As it happens, $npcName:22000001$ has also grown more aggressive lately.
It's unclear where they came from, but they're carrying some kind of disease that's infecting the other wildlife. We've seen instances like this throughout Maple World, of course.
This may be our opportunity to learn more about this strange phenomenon. Go to $map:02000185$, defeat $npcName:22000001$, and clear the area of monsters.
Go to $map:02000185$ and defeat $npcName:22000001$ and its minions!
I see you've been successful. I've got our analysts going over all of the data you gathered during your mission. With any luck, things will start to turn around.
Just doing our job, Ma'am! After going through all of these reports, it looks like the monsters came from the abyss—
That's enough. We don't want to say anything we haven't been able to confirm yet.
Ah! Y-yes, Ma'am!
I have a mission for you. The $map:02000173$ is on red alert.
The $map:02000173$ has always been a dark spot on Victoria Island, but ever since the $map:02000146$ opened up, the darkness has become palpable.

$npcName:22000322[gender:1]$ is feasting on this darkness. My scouts say her power has more than doubled since then. I need you to go to the $map:02000173$ and defeat both $npcName:22000322[gender:1]$ and any monsters she's won over to her side.
Go to $map:02000173$ and defeat $npcName:22000322[gender:0]$, along with any other enemies in the area.
Good job. The $map:02000173$ is pacified for now, but I doubt this peace will last long. You're dismissed.
I have a mission for you. $map:02000089$ is on red alert.

As shadow magic floods into Victoria Island, $npcName:22000038$ of $map:02000089$ is acting like an amplifier. Not only is he becoming more powerful, but he's also driving the other monsters near him into a frenzy.
$npcName:11000285[gender:0]$ is an ancient creature, and we can't afford to let his home become overrun by evil. I need you to head to $map:02000089$ and put an end to $npcName:22000038$'s madness.
Go to $map:02000089$ and defeat $npcName:22000038$ and its minions!
$map:02000023$ has returned to normal. Good job. You're dismissed.
I have a mission for you. The $map:02000087$ is on red alert.
Some time ago, Andrea Manor vanished without a trace. The empire's top scientists still don't know what happened to it.
Without the manor, there's been little to stop monsters from moving into the area. Most recently, $npcName:22000002[gender:0]$—a petty gangster from Kerning City—has taken up residence there, too.
He's terrorizing the farmers there. Digging up crops, stealing chickens, leaving crumpled-up soda cans everywhere. What a pig!

I have a hunch that he's somehow connected to the missing manor. Go to the $map:02000087$ and drive $npcName:22000002[gender:0]$ out. While you're there, see if you can find any clues about this mystery.
Go to the $map:02000087$ and defeat $npcName:22000002[gender:0]$, along with any other monsters in the area. While you're there, see if you can find any clues about the missing manor.
Any good news?
I cleared out $npcName:22000002[gender:0]$ and his goons, but I couldn't find anything about the Andrea Manor case.
That's too bad... Well, you've made the area safe again, so it wasn't a complete waste. Dismissed.
I have a mission for you. $map:02000147$ is on red alert. But this report... $npcName:11003536[gender:1]$, please explain.
Ma'am! This request came from the $map:02000209$ on $map:02000147$. They've asked us to arrest a criminal named $npcName:22090165[gender:1]$.
$npcName:11003536[gender:0]$, we are a military operation, not mercenaries for hire. You should keep that in mind before you enter frivolous missions like this into our system.
I-I tried to tell them, Captain, I really did! But this woman, $npcName:11000491[gender:1]$, she wouldn't leave me alone. I had no choice!
I can't have this $npcName:11000491[gender:1]$ interfering with my crew's job duties. $MyPCName$, take care of the situation on $map:02000147$.
Go to $map:02000147$ and defeat $npcName:22090165[gender:1]$, along with any other enemies in the area.
$npcName:11003536[gender:0]$ would like to speak to you.
Thanks, $MyPCName$. You really saved my hide! That $npcName:11000491[gender:1]$ is cranky and mean and... and... old! And she just wouldn't shut up!
Well, that's all over now. Anyway, $npcName:22090165[gender:1]$ wasn't even human. She was some kind of cursed doll.
Noted. Thank you for taking care of it.
$map:02000041$ is on red alert. $npcName:11003536[gender:1]$, brief $MyPCName$ on the situation.
Yes, Ma'am! $npcName:22000003[gender:1]$ and $npcName:22000004[gender:1]$ are fighting all over $map:02000041$. It's put all the monsters in the area into a frenzy.
They're sisters, aren't they? This must be sibling rivalry. They're lucky, in a way...
Ahem! Go to $map:02000041$ and end the chaos started by $npcName:22000003[gender:1]$ and $npcName:22000004[gender:1]$.
Go to $map:02000147$, break up the fight between $npcName:22000003[gender:1]$ and $npcName:22000004[gender:1]$, and defeat any other monsters in the area.
I hear that the fairfolk sisters have calmed down. I'm sure it's only a matter of time before they're at it again... You're dismissed.
$map:02000083$ is on red alert. $npcName:11003535[gender:1]$, brief $MyPCName$ on the situation.
You've tangled with the gangs of $map:02000083$ before, right? Back in the day, those chumps worked in the shadows, where they belong.
We still don't know how they got up the courage to strut around in broad daylight like that. But, whatever it is, it's basically shut down all of $map:02000083$.

You know how to reach me.

Some hoodlums out at the $map:02000083$ are causing trouble.
Who are these hoodlums?

The area is technically under my jurisdiction, so I'm stepping in.
I'd deal with them myself, if I had it my way. But, since the local citizens probably wouldn't appreciate my methods, I'm sending you instead.

Did you complete your mission already? You didn't get lost, did you?

Is the job done?

Wonderful! I knew I could count on you, $male:handsome,female:gorgeous$.
You probably didn't completely dismantle their organization, but they should stay quiet for a while.
And if they don't?
Then... I'll just have to step in myself.
You just sent a shiver down my spine.

Ah, you made it, $MyPCName$.

I have a question.
Yes?
What mission?
Your sense of humor tickles me, $MyPCName$.

...Really?
Really.

What?!

There you are, kitten!
It's time for drills! You ready?
Drills?
Aww, do I have to do this every time?!
You silly goose, have you forgotten already? It's a test to ensure you're still fit to carry out Dark Wind missions!
Oh, yeah...
I'm well aware of your... prowess... but rules are rules.
Okay.
Great. The test is simple, just do what I say,
Easy peasy.

The clock is ticking. If you don't hurry it up, you might not pass.
Time's up!
Now, let's take a look at your results.

Now, go complete your mission.

I appreciated how you tackled the test.

I already relayed the results to you telepathically...

You can do that?!

$MyPCName$, do you remember the dropship you used when you first arrived in Kritias? We've had some problems with a remote launch and recovery. The craft seems to be experiencing a systems malfunction.

Please hurry to the dropship before it is damaged beyond repair.

Excellent work. We will retrieve the ship as soon as repairs are complete.
Reports are coming back about the wide variety of lifeforms that call Kritias home.
While some pose no real threat at all, a great many appear hostile.
I would like you to engage these lifeforms in battle and determine if any are a threat to our operations here.
Defeat $npcNamePlural:25020005$ in $map:02020029$ , $npcNamePlural:25020105$ in $map:02020030$ , and $npcNamePlural:25020205$ in $map:02020031$.
Defeat $npcNamePlural:25020005$ in $map:02020029$ , $npcNamePlural:25020105$ in $map:02020030$ , and $npcNamePlural:25020205$ in $map:02020031$.

Hostile or not, they're nothing the Alliance can't handle!
...I see. Good job.
Kritias is a land both of great technological wonders and tremendous natural beauty. It's only natural that our crew should feel a certain sense of peace here.

Report.
The mechanical menace has been disrupted.
Excellent work as always, $MyPCName$.

Our researchers have been wanting to bring back docile lifeforms for study. With them being more the scholarly type, I need a volunteer animal wrangler to capture specimens for study.

The first creature on their list for study is the $item:61000153$ native to $map:02020029$. Please capture two and return here.

I'll head there right away.
I knew I could count on you. Go to $map:02020030$ and assist our allies by defeating $npcNamePlural:25020101[gender:0]$.

$MyPCName$, I'm glad you're here.

The Special Projects division of Sky Fortress's R&D team has been hard at work studying the mechanized soldiers of Kritias, however, their research has come to something of a standstill.

They want to harvest a particular part from the $npcNamePlural:25020201$ in $map:02020031$. That's where you come in.
I want you to go to $map:02020031$ and harvest $item:30001218$ from the $npcNamePlural:25020201$.
I want you to go to $map:02020031$ and harvest $item:30001218$ from the $npcNamePlural:25020201$.

You are to travel to $map:02020029$ immediately and destroy the $npcNamePlural:25020002$ before their work goes any further.
Hurry to $map:02020029$.

They to gather intelligence and test the town's defenses, putting all of its citizens at risk.

Our crystal thingies for their food. Sounds like a fair trade to me!

Well, it's a step in the right direction. Very well, $MyPCName$. Defeat the $npcNamePlural:25020202$ in $map:02020031$ so we can establish a local mining operation. I'll discuss terms with Marlene.
Well, it's a step in the right direction. Very well, $MyPCName$. Defeat the $npcNamePlural:25020202$ in $map:02020031$ so we can establish a local mining operation. I'll discuss terms with Marlene.

Go to $map:02020030$ and deal with the $npcNamePlural:25020103[gender:0]$.

Excellent work, $MyPCName$.

The Daemon Army has wreaked enough havoc here. As they come from our own lands, it falls to us to see them purged from Kritias. To that end, I want you to destroy as many of $npcName:11001813[gender:0]$'s hacked machines as you can manage.

Travel to $map:02020031$ as soon as you are able. Destroy the $npcNamePlural:25020203$ and collect their $itemPlural:30001220$.
Travel to $map:02020031$ as soon as you are able. Destroy the $npcNamePlural:25020203$ and collect their $itemPlural:30001220$.

In this foreign land, our routine testing is more important than ever. We must be ever ready for the call of duty.

Despite your many triumphs, you are not exempt from these tests. If anything, your performance is more important than anyone else's. The crew looks up to you. So, are you ready for your next assessment?
Bring it on.
Excellent. Then let's get started.
Your task is simply to carry out a series of missions in Kritias. It is up to you to decide which missions you will undertake. Good luck.
Another successful examination! I expected no less.
You passed your assessment with flying colors. Keep it up, $MyPCName$.
$MyPCName$, your ongoing efforts have significantly bolstered our efforts to explore Kritias. I want to thank you on behalf of the entire crew.
I was just doing my duty.
We have obtained a wealth of new information through our ever-growing expedition, but the breadth of what we don't yet know makes our work dangerous.

Speaking of danger, our scouts have run into some trouble with the $npcNamePlural:25020501$ in $map:02020001$, the $npcNamePlural:25020301$ in $map:02020006$, and the $npcNamePlural:25020401$ in $map:02020004$.
I would like you to diminish their numbers to protect our patrols.
Defeat $npcNamePlural:25020501$ in $map:02020001$, $npcNamePlural:25020301$ in $map:02020006$, and $npcNamePlural:25020401$ in $map:02020004$.

$MyPCName$, how would you say you've adjusted to operations in Kritias?
No problems here!
That's excellent to hear. And I have the perfect opportunity for you to prove it. Your regular performance evaluation!
The better prepared we are for Kritias' unique challenges, the greater our ability to avoid unnecessary casualties. Well, let's get started.
Your test begins now.
Your performance results are in…

$MyPCName$, have you been to, $map:02020001$ recently?
$map:02020001$? I don't recall.
I've heard the region's serene ambiance makes it an excellent place for meditation—or it would, if it weren't full of hostile forces.
In any case, I was thinking, the crew could really use some shore leave to take their minds off their troubles.
I'd like you to drive out these foes so that our crew can enjoy $map:02020001$.
Defeat monsters in $map:02020001$.
Excellent work. I've informed the crew that $map:02020001$ is now safe enough for shore leave.
Of course, our foes will probably return in time. But I trust you'll be ready to drive them out again!
Sigh.
What's the matter?

Much as it pains me to say, many among our crew have abandoned all sense of discipline. You see they've been charmed by an adorable local creature called the $npcName:25020301$, and they've been feeding the beast their much-needed rations. If this goes on, I worry Sky Fortress's pantries will be laid bare.
My warnings have done little to stem the problem. Only one course of action remains.
We must recover the rations by force. Go to $map:02020006$, and retrieve the $itemPlural:30001221$—from the beasts' bellies, if need be!
Go to $map:02020006$, and retrieve the $itemPlural:30001221$ from the $npcNamePlural:25020301$.
Have you recovered our rations?
I recovered what I could, but some of them were too far gone.
Thank you, $MyPCName$. I am ashamed that such a measure was even necessary.
New lands always have much to teach us. One thing I found quite surprising was that some of the machines here wield swords.
As much as I would like to test them in battle and learn from their fighting style, my duties as captain keep me here.
And it would not be acceptable to use my station to order the capture of one of these machines for my own personal gain...
Captain...
I apologize for rambling. These are not the sort of concerns I can voice to our crew. Thanks for listening.
If it's so important to you, why don't I go fight one of these robots and report back?
$MyPCName$, you would do that for me? Thank you very much.

Go to the $map:02020009$ and figure out whether the $npcNamePlural:25021606$ are taking orders from Kharon, then destroy as many as you can.

Go to $map:02020036$, defeat $npcNamePlural:25022001$, and take back what's ours! We need that $item:30001230$.

Go to $map:02020008$ and defeat the $npcName:25021801$. Once you've done that, get $itemPlural:30001231$, so our researchers can figure out how this thing grew so big in the first place.

Go to $map:02020036$ and defeat as many $npcNamePlural:25022002$ as you can. That ought to slow them down enough for our soldiers to finish them off for good.

Yes! Channel your righteous fury! Defeat these fiends before they can cause more harm!
Go to $map:02020030$ and defeat $npcNamePlural:25020104$.
I've received a report of your success on the battlefield. Well done.
I shall call upon you again soon.
You passed your last test with ease, even though the conditions were unfamiliar to you.

Go, complete your missions! But if you truly wish to impress me, you will do it while wearing a blindfold.

I cannot blame them. They've been driven from their natural habitat by Tairen's tyranny.

A mission truly worthy of your skills awaits you.
I'm pitting you against the worst that Kritias has to offer. There is no shame in giving up now if you fear for your life.

Just as I expected.

$map:02020001$ is a place of great beauty upon which the aurora shine. But this aurora has an affect on the monsters who live there.

Defeat the monsters in $map:02020006$.

Our people are under constant threat of attack. Particularly dangerous is a pack of soldiers wielding blades.
The must be defeated if we are going to gain a foothold in $map:02020004$.
The blade-wielding soldiers must be defeated if we are going to gain a foothold in $map:02020004$.

Are you done yet? Go to $map:02020001$, defeat them, and get their $itemPlural:30001237$.

I'll get it back for you!
Very good! Defeat the $npcNamePlural:25020405[gender:0]$ and retrieve the data.
Defeat the $npcNamePlural:25020405[gender:0]$ and retrieve the data.

Go to $map:02020006$ and defeat $npcNamePlural:25020304$.

Would you mind clearing out some enemies so we can conduct our studies?

Please defeat $npcNamePlural:25021503$ in the $map:02020003$, $npcNamePlural:25021303[gender:0]$ in $map:02020033$, and $npcNamePlural:25021203$ in the $map:02020017$.
Phew! We can finally research in peace. Thanks a bunch!
I don't know if you heard, but Captain $npcName:11004312[gender:1]$ changed our testing criteria to focus on fieldwork.
I think she's trying to get a better handle on each crew member's contribution to our work here.
I don't think that'll make any difference for you, though. Just keep doing what you always do.
You're going to knock it out of the park. Good luck!
You're going to knock it out of the park. Good luck!
Wonderful work, as always!

Oh, perfect! I was about to radio you. Have you heard of $map:02020003$?

We have several exploration goals for this particular area, focused on studying the magic and structures of ancient Kritias. Unfortunately, interference from the Tairen and Kharon forces has slowed... well, stopped our progress.
It seems pretty clear they've allied against us, just as we've allied with Humanitas.
If you could drive them out, the expedition team can finally make some headway. Can I count on your help, $MyPCName$?
Please head to $map:02020003$ and take out as much of the Tairen and Kharon forces as possible.
Good job, $MyPCName$! With your help, we've secured our position.
Welcome! I've got another job for you. A lot of our people have been getting sick, all because of $npcName:23001006$. That thing spews this nasty poison everywhere, and it gets into everything!
We don't have an antidote yet, because it's so hard to find pure samples of the poison. But we need one, and fast.
I need your help getting samples of the poison. Or... more like, making it possible to get samples. There're these creatures called $npcNamePlural:25021102$ that eat the poison.
I have no idea why any creature would eat poison, but... that's the situation.
We need to hurry! Please take out the $npcNamePlural:25021102$ in the $map:02020051$ so we can get those samples.
Please take out $npcNamePlural:25021102$ in the $map:02020051$ so we can get those samples.
Good job! I have to wonder... could this stuff taste good? I mean, I'm not going to try it!
Anyway, our research team tells me they're getting all the samples they need. You really did it, $MyPCName$!

$MyPCName$! We're in trouble!
Okay, okay, slow down.
Hahh... Are you familiar with the $map:02020017$?
The Green Hoods designated it as a Category One protected area, since it's full of ancient texts and records of Kritias.
But the $npcNamePlural:25021202$ are laying waste to any buildings or facilities they find.
It looks like they would rather destroy the ancient texts of Kritias than let us find them.
We can't let this happen! Who knows what hidden knowledge will be lost if they do this?
Calm down, $npcName:11004315[gender:0]$…
How can I be calm when important historical records are going to be lost? Please help, $MyPCName$!
Please go to the $map:02020017$ right now and defeat the $npcNamePlural:25021202$!
Don't worry, I'm on it!
<font color="#909090">(This is very important to $npcName:11004315[gender:0]$... Don't mess this up!)</font>
Please go to the $map:02020017$ and defeat the $npcNamePlural:25021202$!
Good job, $MyPCName$. Uh... I should apologize for getting so... worked up before.
I completely understand. It's fine.
Really? Phew, what a relief! Let's just not mention this to the Captain, okay?
$MyPCName$, just in time! Do you remember when we were talking about making an antidote for $npcName:23001006$'s poison?
Yes, has there been a breakthrough?
Yes! Sort of. The research team discovered that fluids from $npcName:25021403$ contain an enzyme that completely neutralize the poison!
So now we know exactly what we need for the antidote! And it's all thanks to you, $MyPCName$!
Our only problem is getting enough of the fluid to create all the doses we'll need.
Here we go again...
Um... Is there a problem?
No, not at all. Please continue.
Okay! All you need to do is defeat the $npcNamePlural:25021403$ in $map:02020014$ and bring as many $itemPlural:30001252$ as you can!
I'll get right on it.
Please defeat $npcNamePlural:25021403$ in $map:02020014$ and bring as many $itemPlural:30001252$ as you can!
You're back already?
(I didn't really have a choice...)
Sorry, did you say something?
Nah, it was nothing.
So, this is the $item:30001252$... Well, we definitely didn't get it for the smell, geez. I'll handle it with great care.
Thank you! You've been a huge help!
$MyPCName$... welcome…
Wow, you look beat.
Oh! You can tell? No... it's okay…
Hah, it's just that... our expedition members discovered a strange device in $map:02020003$ that plays a... unique melody.
They couldn't figure out what it was for... and the melody changed each time it played.
It's... it's driving me crazy! Why is the device there? What are the melodies? It's keeping me up at night!
Please... I beg you... solve the mystery of the melody in $map:02020003$ so I can sleep again.
Please investigate the melody device in $map:02020003$.
Did you figure it out? Is it over?
<font color="#909090">(You hum the melody.)</font>
What... is this strange music?
That's all I got from it.
Well... it's not perfect, but... close enough to ease my mind.
Thank you, $MyPCName$! I'm going to take a quick nap when you leave. Just a day or two, I promise!
$MyPCName$! We've got a bit of an emergency.
$npcNamePlural:25021503$ in $map:02020003$ have been stealing parts of the Sky Fortress! It's not serious yet, but they need to stop before they pinch something serious!
I don't think it's an attack. They seem to be competing to steal the biggest parts. It would almost be cute, if they weren't, y'know, ransacking the ship. And harming our crew!
We can always repair the ship, but hurting our comrades is unforgivable!
Please defeat the $npcNamePlural:25021503$ in $map:02020003$ before the losses mount!
Please defeat the $npcNamePlural:25021503$ in $map:02020003$!
Great job!
I still can't believe we had to deal with that, but at least it's over.
$MyPCName$, you always know just when we need you!
The second Humanitas base, $map:02020033$, is under attack by $npcNamePlural:25021303[gender:0]$. They can be formidable foes, but these have been worn down by the long battle.
If $map:02020033$ falls, that'll be a huge setback for Humanitas. We can't let our allies suffer like that!
$MyPCName$, dire situations like this are exactly what we need you for.
Please go to $map:02020033$ and stop the $npcNamePlural:25021303[gender:0]$.
Please go to $map:02020033$ and stop the $npcNamePlural:25021303[gender:0]$.
We've received a message from $npcName:11004395[gender:1]$!
It's from the garrison in $map:02020033$, explaining how $MyPCName$ arrived just in time and turned the tables on the enemy single-handedly.
They said the only reason they're still there to send this is because of you. Wow.
What did you do to earn such praise from $npcName:11004395[gender:1]$, of all people? You really are something!
Oh, $MyPCName$... I'm glad you're here. Those darned $npcNamePlural:25021203$ have been harassing our people again.
Are you okay? You sound really worried.
I can't help it. Every day there's some new crisis, and I've been working day and night to keep up…
Ahhh! I shouldn't be complaining when people like you are working so much harder!
Don't say that. We just work in different ways.
R... really? Yeah, I guess that is true! Still, I can't help but worry about how understaffed we are...
Case in point, the $npcNamePlural:25021203$ in $map:02020017$ have stolen our $itemPlural:30001253$. Again!
Losing the $itemPlural:30001253$ means losing tons of valuable research on Kritias.
I'll get the $itemPlural:30001253$ back. You relax.
Oh, thank you so much. I felt so bad about asking... But yes, find the $npcNamePlural:25021203$ in $map:02020017$ and recover the $itemPlural:30001253$!
Find the $npcNamePlural:25021203$ in $map:02020017$ and get the $itemPlural:30001253$ back!
Finally... the $itemPlural:30001253$! You have no idea what a relief this is. I just want to hug them...
$MyPCName$! Disaster! Humanitas has sent an urgent request for backup at $map:02020033$.
But we're so shorthanded... I have no idea where I can pull a unit from... But we can't afford to lose the whole $map:02020033$…
I'll take care of it.
Really? Even for you... No, I have faith in you. I know you can do this! All right, your targets are the $npcNamePlural:25021307$! Drive them out of $map:02020033$!
Find the $npcNamePlural:25021307$ and drive them out of $map:02020033$!
You did it! I got a message from $npcName:11004395[gender:1]$, and it's... Wow, they're just gushing about you.
I know $npcName:11004395[gender:1]$ can seem cold, but she seems really touched by what you did, $MyPCName$.
$MyPCName$! We're in trouble!
We keep losing probes in the $map:02020051$ to $npcNamePlural:25021103$ and their surface-to-air missiles.
They're too mobile for us to take them out with our own weapons. That means you'll have to go in and take them down one-by-one.
I really underestimated them... they may be busted, but those weapon systems still work.
$MyPCName$, I can count on you for this, right? Please go to the $map:02020051$ and take out those $npcNamePlural:25021103$!
$MyPCName$, I can count on you for this, right? Please go to the $map:02020051$ and take out those $npcNamePlural:25021103$!
Thank goodness that's over! I'm so glad I can count on you, $MyPCName$.
Captain $npcName:11004312[gender:0]$ thinks the whole evaluation system for Sky Fortress crew needs to be overhauled.
It's true, there's not much structure to the system, and we've only recently transitioned from reporting to field evaluations...
Ahh, but this shouldn't concern you! You've been taking on all our toughest missions anyway!
Just keep doing what you're doing, $MyPCName$.
Just keep doing what you're doing, $MyPCName$.
It's like I said, $MyPCName$! Just do what you always do. That's all we need!

Captain $npcName:11004312[gender:0]$ still isn't happy with our evaluations... she thinks there's too much variance between missions to evaluate people fairly.
She was so convinced, we had to stop her from going out into the field herself to try an evaluation mission!
I mean, we certainly need the manpower...
$npcName:11004315[gender:0]$! If we're still short on people, I will-
Ahh! Nope! No, we're fine! I was just, ah, speculating!
Is that so? Hmm... very well. Then I don't want to hear about missions being pushed back!
Hahh... Y-yes, Captain!
I need to start watching my back…
Listen, the overall difficulty of the evaluation missions has increased, but the purpose isn't to evaluate your qualifications or anything. Try not to stress about it.
Just do your best, as you always do!
Just do your best, as you always do!
I knew you could do it, $MyPCName$! You took that tricky mission and put it to shame!
I've got a new mission for you, $MyPCName$. Do you know about $map:02020035$? It's a large facility built by the Tairen Kingdom to produce mechanical soldiers.
The factory was built centuries ago, and somehow continues to crank out robots.
It's pretty amazing... and explains part of why this has been such a difficult struggle for us.
Now the factory has been occupied by the Daemon Army. The robots being produced are now serving them, under the command of $npcName:11001813[gender:0]$.
Perhaps that is why the mechanical soldiers have been much more aggressive towards our forces.
The feedback from Cat Sith is that it's impossible to destroy the factory itself at present due to its heavy defenses. But we do have the option to occupy the factory.
First, we need to clear out the security force so we can get our teams in to reprogram the place. Defeat as many robot forces as you can in $map:02020035$!
Defeat as many robot forces as you can in $map:02020035$!
$MyPCName$, it looks like you cleared our route into $map:02020035$. Our troops can mop up the rest.
Goodness, is there anything you can't do?
$MyPCName$, did you know large quantities of aetherine were discovered in the vines covering the $map:02020051$?
The plants there may have the ability to send their roots deep underground and absorb the aetherine directly.
If we can harvest these vines, we can collect aetherine more easily! But…
The monsters in the region are too aggressive for our people to work there at the moment.
$MyPCName$, if you can thin out the monsters in $map:02020008$, we can continue our aetherine research. Will you help us?
Of course I'll help.
Thank you so much, $MyPCName$! I hope I'm not depending on you too much...
$MyPCName$, if you can thin out the monsters in $map:02020008$, we can continue our aetherine research.
Great job!
Now we can finally establish our research camp! The expedition members will be thrilled. I'm thrilled, too!
Welcome, $MyPCName$! We've been tracking a suspicious $npcName:25021804$ in $map:02020008$.
According to our scouts, the $npcName:25021804$ is avoiding all hostiles and fighting back fiercly if cornered. It's odd for this type of foe...
Oh, that! I was absolutely taken with that one, so I had my men extend that $npcName:25021804$ a polite invitation to join us.
Say, Nainai... you haven't been misplacing things lately, have you? Important things? Important things.
Well... in all the chaos, I suppose…
Things like this?
Ah! That's $item:30001254$! $npcName:11004314[gender:1]$, how do you have this?
Oh, you know me. I'm very persuasive. That $npcName:25021804$ had it last...
What? No! If $item:30001254$ fell into the hands of the Tairen forces...
With the $item:30001254$, the Tairen forces will know exactly where to strike us!
Well, lucky for you they've split it into several pieces for transport. As long as they don't get back together, we're safe. Although, their rendezvous is coming up soon…
Why... why didn't you tell us this sooner?!
Dear, sweet Nainai... You can't rush a Shadow Walker. We take our time and do it right. certain.
Oooh...! $MyPCName$, please hurry to $map:02020008$! Find and take that $npcName:25021804$ down, and bring back that $item:30001254$ ASAP!
Wow... I've never see you fired up like this. I like it.
Please hurry to $map:02020008$! Find and take that $npcName:25021804$ down, and bring back that $item:30001254$ ASAP!
Phew! Thank goodness we've got the $item:30001254$ back. I'm going to enter this in the database and then shred this document like six different ways.
$MyPCName$, thanks for saving my bacon!
Hey! Nainai! What about me? Don't I get some of your bacon, too?
Argh! If you hadn't waited so long... Sigh. It's true... We would have been in deeper trouble if it wasn't for the Shadow Walkers.
That's what I like to hear! You can repay me later. I've got a few ideas how.

Our forces have advanced as far as $map:02020037$, which serves as a sort of gateway into the heart of Tairen's territory.
The current plan is to make our push into Tairen by slipping through $map:02020037$ with the Humanitas forces.

The problem is, since this area is of significant strategic value to Tairen, their forces are sure to have a heavy presence in the region. The knights of the Royal Guard seem especially strong. If they got involved, they could make progressing through the region difficult.
Among them, the $npcName:25022103[gender:0]$ are the most formidable, and that's not good for us.
Just leave them to me. I'll beat a trail right to Tairen's doorstep.

I feel kind of guilty, always asking you to do the missions no one else wants to do. This is really important, though, so I hope you come through like always. If you need any backup, though, I'll do my best to help!
You need to take out the $npcNamePlural:25022103[gender:0]$in the vicinity of $map:02020037$.
We did it! We've finally established a foothold right on Tairen's doorstep. From here, we can practically march right in!
Now, we just need to work with Humanitas to decide on a winning strategy to reclaim Tairen.
I don't know when that'll happen-you know how these bureaucratic processes go-but when the time comes, I'm looking forward to seeing you in action again!

$MyPCName$! I've got some good news for you! That's...less common than I wish it was, so listen up!

The Green Hoods' engineering division has concluded that if we're able to conduct a thorough analysis of the robots manufactured in the <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020035$</font>, we might uncover a security vulnerability that would let us turn these metal menaces into allies!
Even the possibility sounds amazing, right? Making those cool precision-tuned mechanical soldiers fight FOR us instead of against us!
There's one small problem, though... We need to bring in a pile of $npcName:25021903$ memory chips before the engineers can even get started.

And who's better qualified to turn robots into rubbish than you? You'll need to defeat <font color="#ffd200">$npcNamePlural:25021903$</font> in the $map:02020035$, then bring back their memory chips for the research team. How about it? Do you think you can pull it off?

And who's better qualified to turn robots into rubbish than you? You'll need to defeat <font color="#ffd200">$npcNamePlural:25021903$</font> in the $map:02020035$, then bring back their memory chips for the research team. How about it? Do you think you can pull it off?
Goodness... You're back already? Were you able to get those memory chips?
You mean these $itemPlural:30001255$? All in a day's work.

Hm. They're not exactly in pristine condition, which I suppose is to be expected when you have to beat the bolts out of them to get to the chips in the first place, but I think the researchers should still be able to work with these.
Anyway, I think we can safely cross this one off the list as 'Mission Accomplished'! I'll let you know when we've got something we need your help with again.

Oh! Your timing couldn't be better, $MyPCName$! I just received a report that our field medic stations have been inundated with a wave of sick explorers. Apparently, they lost consciousness and collapsed while scouting in $map:02020008$.
At first, we thought it was simply exhaustion from the physical demands of exploration and reconnaissance, but then the nurses caring for them started collapsing, suffering the same symptoms.

That's when the research team came in to perform a thorough examination of everyone affected and found poison in their systems! After checking it against the known toxins in Kritias, they discovered it was a fine powder from the wings of the $npcNamePlural:25021803$.

Fortunately for us, the recently established pharmaceutical team was able to develop an antidote and are currently treating everyone who was poisoned. But more are being stricken every day, and it's only a matter of time until the number being stricken is greater than the amount of antidote we can produce.

The poison powder from the wings of the $npcNamePlural:25021803$ in $map:02020008$ is especially potent. Not only is it easily spread by contact, but it requires larger doses of our antidote to counteract.

We need you to exterminate $npcNamePlural:25021803$ in $map:02020008$ to reduce the risk of our explorers and scouts getting poisoned. Swords, flames, and general-purpose explosives are not only approved for this mission, but encouraged!
You need to exterminate $npcNamePlural:25021803$ in $map:02020008$ to reduce the risk of our explorers and scouts getting poisoned.
Good work out there, $MyPCName$! The production of more antidote is ramping up, and that means we should be able to stay on top of this problem.
$MyPCName$! We're in big trouble! The agents who infiltrated $map:02020036$ to assess the strength of the Daemon Army were discovered! They're in full retreat now, but they've sustained injuries.

$map:02020036$ is an important stronghold for the Daemon Army. To stay on top of their activity, we have no choice but to risk this kind of intelligence gathering. If we didn't, there'd be no warning if and when they decided to launch a surprise attack.
The $npcNamePlural:25022005$ in $map:02020036$ are nimble, despite their size. They have especially keen senses, too. Our scouts are trained pros, but they manage to find them and give chase.

If we don't thin their numbers, our efforts to scout the enemy's base will be thwarted. That's why we need you to take out the $npcNamePlural:25022005$ at $map:02020036$. Only then can the scouts gather the vital intel we need!

If we don't thin their numbers, our efforts to scout the enemy's base will be thwarted. That's why we need you to slay <font color="#ffd200">$npcNamePlural:25022005$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020036$</font>. Only then can the scouts gather the vital intel we need!
Look! We have reports coming in from our scouts in $map:02020036$ again! And you're the one who made it possible, $MyPCName$!
$MyPCName$! It may come as no surprise to you, but we've got another mess on our hands! Do you remember the substance you brought in before that could counteract the $npcName:23001006$'s poison?
Thanks to you, our pharmaceutical team succeeded in developing an antidote! It's still in the trial phase for now, but once it's been deemed safe, it can go straight into mass production.
Or rather, it could have... You see, the $npcNamePlural:25021604$ launched a surprise raid on the research team's facilities, destroyed the research data, and stole the $item:30001256$!

Without the research data, the team would have no choice but to re-create the sample again from scratch, and that'd take time we can't afford. If we delay the mass production of the antidote, we'll have a lot of poisoned soldiers on our hands!

Who else could we turn to but you? You need to go to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020009$</font>, eliminate the <font color="#ffd200">$npcNamePlural:25021604$</font> there, and retrieve the <font color="#ffd200">$item:30001256$</font>.

We need you to go to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020009$</font>, eliminate the <font color="#ffd200">$npcNamePlural:25021604$</font> there, and retrieve the <font color="#ffd200">$item:30001256$</font>.
You really came through in a pinch, $MyPCName$! Now we can get the mass production of this antidote rolling and start treating everyone!
Greetings, $MyPCName$. Do you happen to remember me telling you about a large quantity of aetherine we detected in $map:02020018$?
Uh... Yeah, how could I possibly forget such a fascinating detail?
Hm... You say you do, but scratching your head like that makes it seem sort of like you don't... T-that's no problem, though, because I needed to brief you on the mission anyway.
The Green Hoods decided to set up a research camp in $map:02020018$ to collect large quantities of aetherine and begin research on it right away.

Unfortunately, the researchers have had their hands full dealing with attacks from $npcNamePlural:25021703$ instead. They've completely foiled every attempt the researchers have made to set up a camp.

$map:02020018$ is a key region we need to control for aetherine research and collection. But for that to happen, we need to set up a camp, and we can't do that until you send those <font color="#ffd200">$npcNamePlural:25021703$</font> packing!
We need to set up a camp, and we can't do that until you send those <font color="#ffd200">$npcNamePlural:25021703$</font> packing!
I've received a report that the research team has begun setting up their camp! It's been a long time coming, and they couldn't have done it without your expert display of applied force, $MyPCName$!
Ah, there you are, $MyPCName$. Did you receive the classified document from Humanitas?
<font color="#909090">(Oh no... That one I made into a really sweet paper airplane?)</font>
Huh? You never got it? Hmm... It must be because you're out in the field so often. Not to worry, though; giving briefings is one of the little joys I cherish.

A-ahem! 'Humanitas is planning to launch a full-scale attack on the Daemon Army's key stronghold, $map:02020036$, with the support of the allied forces of Sky Fortress. The goal of this operation is to suppress enemy activity and secure a launching point to reclaim Tairen'

'We formally request the aid of Sky Fortress, due to their exceptional capabilities in reconaissance and intelligence gathering. All data related to this operation must be encrypted and transmitted on the secure channel Badger-Mushroom-Mushroom-Slime.'

It's an underground arena where members of the criminal underworld fight for guts and glory. Fighting in a place like that would be a great way to show everybody that the Gray Wolf is just as tough as they say, right? If you're looking to make a name for yourself, that's your ticket.
I'm not interested in fame.

Heheheh. Really...? I'd heard you were a $male:man,female:woman$ of principle. You know, you caped vigilante types are a real pain in my neck. If there's one type of person I'll never trust, it's a $male:man,female:woman$ without ambition. Without greed.
See, people who want something, they're predictable. They have a set price. And as long as you can give them what they want, you can control them.

But you holier-than-thou crusaders can't be bought. And getting the one thing you really want—to be a big famous hero—is a real problem for my bottom line. Well I'll let you be the hero today. ...I've radioed ahead to let them know you're coming. Talk to $npc:11001545[gender:0]$</font>. He'll be waiting for you in the $map:63000017$. Down the stairs and to the end of the hall you'll find an elevator that will take you to there.
