Hmph. You wanna help kid? Fine. Those $npcPlural:29000098$ swallowed a bunch of $itemPlural:30000553$, and we need them back. If you think you're such hot stuff, then go and recover them for me.
If I don't get those ledgers back, the boss'll have my head. <font color="#909090">($npc:11001545[gender:0]$'s expression sours after mentioning 'the boss.')</font>
Well, big shot? Did you get my $itemPlural:30000553$ back from those $npcPlural:29000098$?
Do you have them? Did you find our ledgers?
(Hand the $itemPlural:30000553$ to $npc:11001545[gender:0]$.)
Eugh... The pages are covered in goop. Still, it's a good thing you found them. I guess you've got some fight in you after all!
Well, now that the fire is out, I guess I can leave this mess to whoever's on the next shift.
I've waited long enough.
All right, all right. Let's go then. Right this way to $map:63000020$. <font color="#909090">($npc:11001545[gender:0]$'s walkie-talkie begins to crackle noisily.)</font>
<font color="#909090">(He puts the walkie-talkie up to his ear.)</font> Yeah, whaddya want? What?! Really? Darn it. Fine, I'm on my way.
Heh... Sorry buddy but I've got another fire to put out. You'll have to find your own way. Sigh, it's always something. <font color="#909090">(He shrugs and gives you a sheepish smile.)</font>
Maybe this time you can take care of your own problems.

Hey, no need to be so snippy. I'll call my associate on the walkie-talkie and tell him to expect you. Head to the $map:63000018$ and talk to my man $npc:11001546[gender:0]$. He'll get you registered for the fight and tell you anything you want to know.
And one last thing. I don't know if you really are the infamous Gray Wolf, but…
When you take on the Champ, don't stop punching 'til he's on the ground. If you give him even a single opening, you're done for.
Head to the $map:63000018$ and talk to my man $npc:11001546[gender:0]$. He'll get you registered for the fight and tell you anything you want to know.
What are you looking at? Looking to start something?
Didn't $npc:11001545[gender:0]$ tell you I was coming?

$npc:11001545[gender:0]$...? Oh! It's you! You're the one going up against the Champ! They say you're the Gray Wolf, the $male:guy,female:lady$ who beats criminals into submission with $male:his,female:her$ bare fists...! Wait. You're the Gray Wolf...?

($npc:11001546[gender:0]$'s stares at you skeptically.) I thought you'd be taller. And a lot more muscular... But you're tiny! Are you sure you can fight? $npc:11001545[gender:0]$, you moron. You must've sent me the wrong $male:guy,female:broad$.
I'm the one who's going to take down $map:63000020$'s champion.
What? You're saying you're the right person? Hold on, I've gotta call this in... (He picks up his walkie-talkie.)

<font color="#909090">(The walkie-talkie crackles.)</font> Hey yeah, you said you were sending the Gray Wolf over, but it was some scrawny kid who showed up. Yeah! I'm staring right at 'em! What? Really? Boss's orders...? Fine.
<font color="#909090">($npc:11001546[gender:0]$ eyes you with increased skepticism.)</font> I don't believe it…
Stop staring at me and spit it out.
When's my fight going to start?
Your fight is an impromptu match. You're going to have to wait for the main event to finish, and even then, you only go on if the boss makes the call.
I don't have time to sit around waiting.
Open your eyes and look around, punk. This place is full of famous fighters, all getting ready for their match with the big guy. You don't get special treatment.

$map:63000020$ is famous for the brutality of its fights. If you have any brains in your head, you should be rooting for them to rough up the Champ a little before he gets to you, because it's the only shot you've got.

$npcName:11001547[gender:0]$ is an absolute beast! I can't believe somebody as puny as you is going to fight him. Hey I've got an idea, instead of standing here bothering me, why don't you go warm up with an opponent who's a little closer to your level, like that punching bag over there.
(Nod instead of punching him.)
There you go. You oughtta loosen up those muscles so when the Champ hits you, you don't wrench anything on the way down to the mat.
Quit bothering me. Why don't you go warm up on that punching bag over there?
Done warming up already?
I'm ready.
Well, you'll be out cold in one hit. I guess there's no need for you to work up a sweat.
I eat chumps like your "Champ" for breakfast.

Wow, check out the ego on this $male:guy,female:girl$. You're downright certifiable. But don't worry, you'll probably be talking to the head doctor anyway after $npcName:11001547[gender:0]$ wipes the floor with you.
Of course what's really crazy is that they're letting you fight the Champ in a surprise title match. That's unheard of! Did you win some kind of contest? Oh jeez, you're not dying are you?
Or maybe this is just the boss's way of taking out the trash. If that's the case, I feel sorry for you, buddy.
I can't help but wonder if you realize what you've gotten yourself into. You know what kind of place $map:63000020$ is, right?

If you're not a top notch fighter, you could be looking at spending the rest of your life in the hospital. So if you're having any second thoughts, I'm willing to turn a blind eye while you sneak out of here. No? Huh...

Is there something you're not telling me? Like, do you have some kind of special technique? Or maybe like, a cyborg arm? C'mon, you've got to show me something—anything! I'll even give you some pointers!

Is there something you're not telling me? Like, do you have some kind of special technique? Or maybe like, a cyborg arm? C'mon, you've got to show me something—anything! I'll even give you some pointers!
...Wh-what was that? I could've sworn you just shot a ball of energy from your fist... I must be imagining things.
Do you have a problem with that?
A problem? W-what? Of course not. Hahaha! Anyone can perform a technique like that... <font color="#909090">(He starts to sweat.)</font>
You're gonna need something better than that to take on the Champ. So if you've got some kind of secret technique, then show it to me.
You're gonna need something better than that to take on the Champ. So if you've got some kind of secret technique, then show it to me.
... <font color="#909090">($npc:11001546[gender:0]$ stares silently into the distance.)</font>
Would you say that technique could be performed by anyone?
...Ahh! Oh—are you talking ab-b-bout that technique?
I mean... Sure, not just anybody could pull it off... But you're, uh, still not at my level!
I would love to see your skills. Maybe I'll learn something.
<font color="#909090">($npc:11001546[gender:0]$ looks surprised and insulted at the same time.)</font> ...Of course. Just don't blink, or you might just miss it! Here I go... On the count of three!

<font color="#909090">($npc:11001546[gender:0]$ rolls his shoulder and stretches his neck.)</font> All, right. Here we go! One! Two! Two and a half! Now remember, watch carefully so you don't miss anything, all right? All right then. One! Two—
It's all right, you don't have to embarrass yourself.

Why you little! I lost my timing because you distracted me. I'll show you how it's really done! <font color="#909090">(He gets into a fighting stance and winds up for a punch, but then makes a great show of gripping his shoulder and wincing.)</font>
Aggh... It seems my injury hasn't fully healed yet... I guess I won't be able to show you my most powerful skills today. That's just too bad.
Really? But you were just stretching. How'd you injure yourself?
Hey! What's with all the questions? It's none of your damn business!
Look alive, kid. I just got a call on the walkie-talkie. Boss wants to see you. Head to the $map:63000019$.
When's my match going to start?
The match starts whenever the boss says it does! If you want to fight, you'd better go see him in the $map:63000019$.
The boss wants to see you. Go to the $map:63000019$. You're not stupid enough to make the boss wait, are you?
I hear our fighters are ready for the main event.
When's my match going to start?
Heheheh... Your match is starting real soon. There's no need to bug me about it. Now, there's someone here you should meet before your fight.
Who's that?

The one and only reigning champion, the indomitable $npcName:11001547[gender:0]$. He's got abs like steel and a punch like a two-ton truck. His foes know him as the Titanium Fist, but his adoring fans just call him the Champ. Remember that face.
An all-out rumble between the Gray Wolf and $npcName:11001547[gender:0]$! What a momentous occasion. This calls for a toast! Why don't you join me for a drink before your fight?
You're not getting soft on me, are you Wei Hong?
Hahaha... What? So we don't agree on everything, does that mean we can't share a quiet drink together? Or... are you worried I might have poisoned it?
I wouldn't put it past you.

What kind of lowly thug do you take me for? If I wanted to kill you, I would have had my guards turn you into swiss cheese back in my office. Why would I go out of my way and put on such a show? <font color="#909090">(He does have a point...)</font>
...In that case, I guess I have no reason to refuse.
That's the spirit! Go see the $npc:11001624[gender:0]$, he'll whip you up a delectable beverage. He knows just the one.
That's the spirit! Go see the $npc:11001624[gender:0]$, he'll whip you up a delectable beverage. He knows just the one.
What can I get you?
$npc:11001623[gender:0]$ said you had something special on tap.
Oh, I know just the one. It's a juice made from a medley of very rare and very expensive fruits. Wait right here and I'll pour you a glass in a jiffy.
(Wait for your drink.)

<font color="#909090">(He looks over the bottles on the wall before settling on the right one and retrieving it. He grabs an empty glass set conspicuously apart from the other glasses, and slowly and carefully begins filling it.)</font>
(Wait some more.)
Here you go. $item:20000314$. It's quite expensive, so be sure to drink it slowly and really savor the aroma.
Ah, you're finally up and about. How do you feel?
What happened?
If you're talking about your fight with $npcName:11001547[gender:0]$... You lost.
I already know that, but how?
I don't understand your question.
I think you know exactly what I mean.
Sigh... I thought your fight with $npcName:11001547[gender:0]$ reeked of foul-play. I'll have you know, I had no involvement in that.
I passed out at the beginning of the match—before I'd even broken a sweat.
Well, I can only speculate as to what happened. Did you perhaps eat or drink anything before the match?
I did drink something in the $map:63000019$.

Ah, well that would do it. I suspect there was something extra in your drink. An old trick used by fight fixers when a fighter was too self-righteous to take a dive. Still, I'm surprised you'd fall for it.
$npc:11001623[gender:0]$ made a compelling argument...
I can't blame you. Wei Hong's a smooth talker when he needs to be. Well, what's done is done. He'll want to speak with you. You should head to the $map:63000022$.
The boss is waiting for you. You should head to the $map:63000022$.
You seem upset. Well, if you have something to say, spit it out.
You should be ashamed of yourself.
Hahahaha! What do I have to be ashamed of? A win is a win, no matter how you come by it.
I came here expecting a fair fight.

A fair fight? Well there's your first mistake. This was a business transaction, plain and simple. I had something you wanted, and you had something I wanted. I may have told you what'd happen if you won, but I never said I'd let you.
Now listen up, loser. There are no rules in battle, especially here. All tactics are on the table. You lost fair and square. There is no "honor" in the arena, just victory or defeat.
That's ridiculous. You cheated, so the fight's outcome is invalid.

Tell that to the audience. They came here to watch their beloved Champ prevail over the terrible Gray Wolf, and that's what they saw. That's the only outcome that matters. If you go around running your mouth about "fairness," all they're gonna see is a sore loser.
Ah, sweet, glorious silence. That's more like it. Now, as I recall we had a deal. You said you'd take down the Champ, and you failed.
Now, I'm a generous man. So even though you failed to hold up your end up the bargain, I'll see to it those people you're looking for go free. But I expect something in return.
What do you want from me?

Let's get something straight, kid. You work for me now. You may be a big deal in $map:02000100$, but to me you're just another errand $male:boy,female:girl$. I say jump, you shut up and jump. Now, are you up for a little errand?
(Nod your head.)
You're catching on quick. Good, good. Let's talk business, shall we? Now, have you heard that Empress $npcName:11000075[gender:1]$ is throwing an event in $map:02000001$?
That's none of my concern.
Pfft... Turning a blind eye toward the rest of the world? You've got no class. Sigh, you're not worth my time.
How about I assign you some handlers? They'll tell you about the job. And maybe if you pay attention, one day you'll be worthy of taking orders from me.
Do I have a choice?
Of course not. Haven't you been paying any attention? Now get out of my sight! Your handlers will be waiting for you in the $map:63000023$.
Your handlers are waiting for you at the $map:63000023$. Now get out of my sight!
Can't you see I'm in the middle of something? Huh? Oh, it's you. I've been waiting for you, $MyPCName$.
Are you the people $npc:11001629[gender:0]$ told me to see?
"$npc:11001629[gender:0]$?" You think you two are chums? Show some respect! You'll call him "Boss" from now on.
He's not my boss.
Yeah... but he really is though. You may not be on payroll, but you're following his orders aren't you? So suck it up and call him boss.
From here on out, we'll be watching you, so no funny business. We call, you answer, no detours.
Ready for your first job? Time's a-waistin'.
What am I supposed to do?

I don't know if you're caught up on current events, but it's been ages since the Empress has held any public shindigs in $map:02000001$. And now the dame's planning to rub elbows with the commonfolk? People'll be flocking in from all over to see her. And when people get together, there's money to be made.

In his infinite wisdom, the boss has already cornered the market on all kinds of goods that will be sold during the festivities. We just need to get them to $map:02000001$ safe and sound, and the money will start flowing in.

Your mission is to escort our goods to Tria safely. We've already made arrangements for you to be part of the caravan guard. Just head to $map:02000062$, and the royal guards will fill you in on the rest.

Your muscle is the only thing standing between our extremely valuable goods and all sorts of wannabe highwaymen looking to get their little grubby mitts on our stuff. I expect you to take this assignment seriously.
This mission should be a walk in the park for the notorious Gray Wolf. Now if there's no more questions, there's a car waiting to take you to $map:02000062$. Get a move on.
I've hired a car to take you straight to $map:02000062$, hurry up and get in.
Hello! You look like an adventurer. We happen to be looking to hire caravan guards, if you're interested.
That's right.
Haha, you look pretty tough. It'll be good to have you with us. Go on inside and introduce yourself to the guy in charge.
The boss is waiting for you.
The boss is waiting for you.
How was your drink?
It was fine.
What? Fine? That's it? I have to say I'm disappointed in your reaction. That particular beverage is very hard to come by.
Heheheh. I can't tell whether you have extremely expensive taste, or you're just some country bumpkin who wouldn't know good juice if someone poured it down their gullet.
What? I'm not going to get your orb for you. I had to stash it in the showcase there when we brought you here. It's just there to the left, grab it while I mentally prepare to exert myself again.
What? I'm not going to get your orb for you. I had to stash it in the showcase there when we brought you here. It's just there to the left, grab it while I mentally prepare to exert myself again.
Maybe it's just me, but you look a little awkward handling that orb. Are you sure you're up for this?
I'm fine. Really.
I'm not so sure. We can rest a little bit more before heading out. I would prefer that…
Ahh, never mind. I know that look you get. Fine, at least take this with you. It'll perk you right up if you start fading again.

This really is the perfect day to stay in and read a couple dozen of the ancient texts... Gah, I've got to stop thinking like that. Brother $npcName:11001557[gender:0]$ would come after me eventually if I tried to hide in here.
And it seems like you've more or less regained your strength... You should start heading to <font color="#ffd200">$map:63000025$</font>.
You should start heading to <font color="#ffd200">$map:63000025$</font>. You are ready, right?

You know by now that the purpose of our training is to find unity with nature. This is a long and exhausting practice... and I begin to wonder if your frail human form will last long enough to complete it.
Then I should resume training immediately.
I think not. I'm not convinced you won't end up flat on your face again. Effort is wasted if it does not lead to growth. Now, tell me. Do you know why your mind and body are so weak?
Yes, because my animus is not my own.

So, you remember your roots. Yes, your animus was given to you by the master, a noble sacrifice to save your life. That is why you must strive to be worthy of those energies, honed over centuries of training and meditation.
Considering the incredible power of your borrowed animus, contained within your untrained body, it is clear to see where the issue lies. You are incredibly out of balance.

Should the mind or the body fall out of balance, the result is sickness and despair. You appear to be suffering from both at once. This is why diligent training is so essential, to help you find your balance.
Now, are you ready to begin?
Yes, but what should I begin with?
We shall start with the basics once more, training your sense of balance. You will balance on pillars until you find your center.
Is that really necessary? I've already-
If I could trust you to stay conscious during training, perhaps not. But your weakness demands that you master the basics before moving on.
You are weak. This exercise trains your balance, dexterity, stamina, and focus. Come, find the pillars here in the pond.
Usually we use dozens of pillars to practice moving between, but for you we have only two. Climb to the highest pillar and practice your kata without falling.
What are you staring at? If you're ready, climb up the <font color="#ffd200">tallest pillar</font>.
What's that look for? Do you think you've made some great breakthrough?
I did climb the tallest pillar, as ordered.
Yes, I can see that. You did as ordered, and no more. Were you a sturdier, more studious pupil, these basic exercises wouldn't even be necessary. You have a long path ahead of you.
Does that mean I need to climb the pillar again?
No, you've gotten what you need from that exercise, at least.
Let's see how you are with your skills at the moment. First, how confident do you feel? Be honest. I have no love for liars.
I think you have more to say about it than I do.
Can we skip the talking? I want to train.

I have less to say about you than you might think. But you've already been here for four seasons, and your power is potent, thanks to its source. In my opinion, you should have significant control of your animus already.
Clearly you do not, so once again it is necessary to return to the basics. We shall review the concept of animus once again.
So tell me, $MyPCName$! What is animus?
It's a force produced from the harmony of the individual with nature.
I used to know, but my memory's failing me at the moment.
It's an incredible power we can crush our foes with.

To break down the boundaries between the self and the wider world, and to take the powers of both and create one unified force... That is animus at its most basic. Those from the outside world draw upon similar powers and call it magic.
Animus is at the heart of our teachings. All of our techniques require command of animus to use.
I see.
Your memory has a history of failure, it seems. I wonder how much of my life has been wasted teaching you the same facts over and over and over again...

To break down the boundaries between the self and the wider world, and to take the powers of both and create one unified force... That is animus at its most basic. Those from the outside world draw upon similar powers and call it magic.
Ngh...
Crush our...? How is it that you have lived among us for so long and have learned nothing, $MyPCName$?!
Well... I just thought...
Never again will I hear such words escape your lips, do you understand? I will explain animus, and you will listen and engrave my words upon your heart!
...Fine.

To break down the boundaries between the self and the wider world, and to take the powers of both and create one unified force... That is animus at its most basic. Those from the outside world draw upon similar powers and call it magic.
All right.
Is that so? It is foolhardy to rush into training without an understanding of your abilities. I advise to you heed my words.
Fine, let's hear it.
I feel ready. Let's get to it.

Now, then... We shall begin with $skill:11100011$. It's a fine starting point for beginners, as you simply need to condense your animus into a ball and throw it. Go on, then. Show me your $skill:11100011$!
I see you've yet to reach enlightenment. Focus on your training! We'll start with <font color="#ffd200">$skill:11100011$</font>.
Are you waiting for praise? You proved you can manipulate animus in the most basic way possible. I am yet unimpressed. So, what will you show me next?
I could use $skill:11100041$.
Your $skill:11100011$ is hardly more complicated than expelling animus from your body. But $skill:11100041$ is rather different.
Drawing upon such a large quantity of animus requires great focus, not just to use but to keep from escaping or exploding.
Whereas $skill:11100011$ allows you to form and attack with animus, $skill:11100041$ is an open channelling of that power. When finesse is no longer enough, this is the skill you need to master.
Tell me more.
Right, let's move on.

The key is to sense the flow of animus as it escapes you. With a skill this powerful, you can drain yourself of animus and put yourself in danger. Never forget that you can use $skill:11100011$ to revitalize your animus should you run low.

The actual use of the skill is quite simple. Just bring forth your animus, and release it in a direction. Do not close back up, let the power flow forth until it is no longer needed. Can you remember that?
Yes.
$skill:11100041$ is not a skill to be taken lightly. Are you certain you do not wish to review?
Fine, let's hear it.
I'm ready. Let me prove it.
Then what are you waiting for? Show me your $skill:11100041$!
Then what are you waiting for? Show me your $skill:11100041$!
Hm... It would appear you have the basics down, more or less.
When can I start learning more advanced skills?
New skills? Do you think that you are ready?
I passed inspection, didn't I? I'm ready for something new.
As $npc:11001556[gender:0]$ has said, it is more important to remember what you've learned than to sacrifice it for something new.
Given your difficulties elsewhere in your training, I believe that is what you would risk doing.
$MyPCName$, you need to focus on your own tasks. The master instructed me to send you over once your training concluded. So I suggest you go and meet him immediately.
Where can I find the master?
Do you really need to ask? You'll find him at $map:63000029$, of course. You'll reach it by taking the northern path from $map:63000014$. But surely you knew that much.
You'll find $map:63000029$ once you pass $map:63000014$'s northern path. For now, head towards <font color="#ffd200">$map:63000014$</font>.
He said he would be right back. Is he testing me again?
Wait, weren't you going to go with $npcName:11001557[gender:0]$?
Ah, he said he was tired of my complaining and wanted me to wait here for a moment. But it's turning into a pretty long moment!
I really hope he didn't up and ditch me.
He wouldn't do that. You, on the other hand…
I shouldn't keep the master waiting.
Excuse me? Did I hear you correctly with my giant, infallible ears?
Surely not, I was talking about you lending a hand.
Mm hm. Well... I suppose I can't wait here forever. If you've got to meet the master, I'll just go check on the barrier stone in $map:63000014$. All by myself. With no one to help. Alone.
Yep, good luck. I'm off to see the master.

Oh, yeah! Definitely, yeah, you get going. Just scamper on off, do your own thing. I mean, we spent all morning together... You, resting in bed, and me, watching over you like a mother hen. It was no trouble, really. I'm a little winded, but I can attend to myself... someday, I guess.

I should consider it a gift, maybe, that I have so much love and attention to give others. And gifts don't need to be repaid in kind... I can just keep supporting you, and Junta, and all of Guidance forever and ever, on my own, the rock upon which everyone stands without a care in the world...
If I help you, will you stop talking?
Oh, come on! Junta wandered off and I could use a hand. You're just going to walk away in my time of need?
All right, $npcName:11001655[gender:1]$, get on with it.
Give me the short version.
You bet! And thanks for volunteering to help. I knew I could count on you.

Fine, how about if I check the barrier stone behind me, and you check the one across the bridge there? And I just want to say, it's great that you volunteered to help without me even needing to ask! You're a real pal.
Finally... I can finally catch a nap while the others are away...
Ahem.
WHA-! Hah, hoo... How are you back already? I thought...
The barrier stone is like ten feet away. I'm done.
W-well... That's right. I sent you to that one, and not the one on the other side of the mountain. Of course. Er, good job.
Considering how quickly you took care of the stone, that only makes it stranger that $npcName:11001557[gender:0]$ is nowhere to be found... Ah, but you need to meet with the master, don't you?
Do you know why the master wants to see me?
Yes. I'll be on my way.
There's no point in speculating, really. You'll find out when you meet him. Maybe he wants to talk about your training, maybe he has advice for you...
I hope it's not like $npcName:11001557[gender:0]$'s advice.
Ha! Oh, don't take $npcName:11001557[gender:0]$ so hard. You know how obsessed he is with his training. And to him, everyone else should be working just as hard.

He's so gruff and inflexible about everything... But he does it because he cares so much. Under that hardened, feathered shell is a warm heart, beating for his brothers and sisters here. I mean, t-that's just how he strikes me. When I think about him. Not that I think about him much...

Anyway! I'm sure whatever the master wants to discuss with you will be quite illuminating. You run along and have fun, and I'll join you after I finish up here and have a little sit-down. The entrance to $map:63000029$ is in $map:63000026$, so it should be easy to find.
Leaving so soon? I expected you to ask me why the master wants to see you...
Fine, I'll bite.
I will know when I see the master myself.
Goodness, how insightful of you! I guess your head's cleared from this morning. All right, the entrance to $map:63000029$ is in $map:63000026$, so it should be easy to find. I'll catch up eventually.
Goodness, how insightful of you! I guess your head's cleared from this morning. All right, the entrance to $map:63000029$ is in $map:63000026$, so it should be easy to find. I'll catch up eventually.
...Perhaps it was selfish of me to wish that things could stay like this forever...
Where are we? And... who are you?
This makes no sense, and I want to leave.
Hm? Ah, I see. You don't remember me... That's a relief. You must understand, this was not my intention. I simply... when they came…
But who are you?
Shadows... dark shadows... they will show you the light...
That doesn't answer my question in the slightest.
No slight. No answer, either. All you need for now is to survive...
That's not very helpful.
You are alive. They will hunt you as long as you are alive. Death is not helpful. Fight or run. Your choice...
We're going in circles. Did you bring me here?
Bring? How could you be brought here? When they appeared, it brought a memory to the surface...
Do you actually answer questions? At all?
I have no answers for impatience. And I will not keep you here long.
It is what you told me... But ah, we've wasted too much time. You must take this.
What is it?
If you are to remember, you will need your power. I can lend you my strength... but only if he never learns of it…
It isn't much. But you will need it. For the future...
Your sense... Who you are... Why you are here... You care not for this sense?
I suppose I do...
I don't even know what you're saying. Can I leave this place?
Yes. But take this. It is my strength, that you might remember your lost power through it. The time is coming when it will serve you well...
It was too much, I see that now. It could never stay... as it was...
What is this power you're talking about? And who are you?
I would answer if I could... But he is here. I can feel it. You must go...
I would answer if I could... But he is here. I can feel it. You must go...
I have a feeling this group we just dealt with was only the first wave. We must prepare for a larger attack. I trust that you both can find the resolve to defend all that we hold dear?
Shouldn't we be treating your wound first?
It's nothing. Our time is better spent preparing our defenses. <font color="#909090">(He's struggling to hide the pain... Something is very wrong.)</font>
What worries me most is that I have no idea what those things are. Between their numbers and their strange energy... Hmm, you…
Is there something wrong?
Perhaps. I sense... a very similar energy from you…
...No, forget I said anything. Surely I must be mistaken.
...Perhaps I'm jumping to <font color="#ffd200">conclusions</font>. Forget it.
Did you see that? More of those things, rushing in like the tide! What are they?
I don't know, but at least you were able to hold them off.
I suppose... But that just means we need to prepare for even larger assaults.
We have no time to lose. $MyPCName$, block the cave entrance with a rock. I doubt it will keep them out forever, but it'll buy us some time.
We have no time to lose. $MyPCName$, block the cave entrance with a rock. I doubt it will keep them out forever, but it'll buy us some time.
Did you get a good look at the creatures that now threaten our home?
I did, but... I've never seen them before.
Does it matter? We need to do something now.
They are shadows risen from darkness itself. Long ago, I had a passing vision of this day. And for some time, I've felt the darkness gathering around Halo Mountain.
Why didn't you tell us sooner?
...You recall that we found you breathing your last in the Land of Darkness, yes?
I do. And I wouldn't be here if you hadn't sacrificed so much to save me.
In truth, my sacrifice was not purely out of compassion. When I chanced upon you that day... I was but a single spoke in the great wheel of fate.

A very long time ago, I was plagued by a terrible nightmare. The same dark dream haunted me, night after night... Eventually I came to recognize it as an omen. And I realized that when I found you there, in the Land of Darkness.
What was your dream?

It was but a voice, repeating the same terrifying words. "The soul that falls in the cliff's skyless shadow Shall find their fate in the balance of nature. When the Lord of Death rises, the keeper of shades, The soul shall join the Seven Stars in their war."
When I found you, I realized that you were the soul spoken of in my vision. I believe you have a great destiny ahead of you... but for you to reach it, I first had to save you.
I'm not sure I can live up to those expectations.

It is natural for you to be uncertain. After all, I speak of events to come, events the likes of which you have never faced. But great trials lead to great deeds, and you will not know if you are ready for those trials until you face them. Perhaps this now is the first of your trials...

Above all, we cannot hope to reach true balance and harmony without struggle. Conflict is the test, challenging us to learn, adapt, and build in new ways. I have confidence that this threat we face will change Guidance forever, and open a new path forward for all of us.
That's great, but I need to know what to do next.
...You never were a fan of my speeches. Fine, let's have you face our unwelcome guests at last.
Afterwards... Well, that can wait. There are other matters we must discuss, you and I. <font color="#909090">(For a moment, a grim shadow passes across the master's face.)</font>
Just because the problem is apparent, does not mean the solution is similarly so. Do you really intend to rush into action without considering the consequences?
No, let's hear what you have to say.
Yes, I'm tired of talking.
...You never were a fan of my speeches, were you? Fine, let's have you face our unwelcome guests at last.
The fate of Halo Mountain and Guidance has been determined. I know what we must do.
Are you sure you don't need some time?
Can I get the short version, please?
No, the answer is clear. It's just that the road to get there is... less clear. We're going to face many hardships if we do this, and I'm not entirely sure we're ready for them.
What kind of hardships?
That's just it, I don't know. This plan... Well, let me just tell you what we're going to do. What we have to do. And then maybe it'll make sense. First, we need to go to $map:02000001$.
Why Tria?
Do you remember what $npcName:11001559[gender:0]$ and the master said? They spoke of a divine power that once passed to each Munakra. As far as I know, this power took the form of a sacred relic.
At some point, that relic was lost. Apparently the only information we have about it was passed verbally from Munakra to Munakra. And without the master...
So do you think the sacred relic is in $map:02000001$?

No, but I think we may find a lead in $map:02000001$. $map:02000001$ is the heart of the great Alliance, a coalition of heroes and mystics formed to protect the world. I've heard they've found and safeguarded all kinds of relics, so even if they don't have ours, they might have a way to find it.

I also think it's high time that Guidance rejoined the rest of the world. Isolated as we were out here made us an easy target for Kandura. I know $npcName:11001557[gender:0]$ won't be happy about it, but in $map:02000001$ we can find new allies, new resources... maybe even new students.
We can suss out the details when we get there. Right now, we need to get moving. I'll need a little time to plan our route, so check in with $npcName:11001557[gender:0]$ and see if he needs anything.
This really isn't the time for shortcuts. Are you sure you don't want to listen?
Never mind, I'll listen.
I'm sure. We need actions, not words.
Fine, I won't force you. Talk to $npcName:11001557[gender:0]$ while I plan our next move.
We can suss out the details later. Right now, we need to get moving. I'll need a little time to plan our route, so check in with $npcName:11001557[gender:0]$ and see if he needs anything.
Control your rage and find your center... That's what the master always taught me. That's what I must never forget...
Junta...
Are you ready to go?
$npcName:11001558[gender:1]$... She's planning to take us to $map:02000001$. How can she do that?
I just... I can't see the humans offering us any kind of aid. But I suppose she's considered this more carefully than I have.
Do you trust $npcName:11001558[gender:1]$'s judgment?

...Yes. She is one of the most intelligent beings I know. In her eyes I see that spark of understanding, that glimmer that means she's ten steps ahead of wherever I am. $npcName:11001558[gender:1]$ has always been better at seeing the big picture than myself.
I've seen it too.
Hm. I've always been hard on her. You know that. Because as brilliant as she is, she barely has the drive to use it.
With you, I just don't like you. But with her... I want her to use that genius she has. I want to see her excel.
She could be the greatest mind that Guidance has ever seen. I fully believe she could reach enlightenment if she only applied herself…
...And maybe I'm jealous of that. Maybe that's really why I'm so hard on her.

You know, I have no idea why I told you all of that. I suppose today has been far harder on me than I ever expected. But if you breathe a word of this to her, I think you can imagine what would happen. Right?
Oh, I suppose you're fine with $npcName:11001656[gender:1]$'s plan, then? I'm not surprised... why would you care about my opinion...
That's not what I meant. Tell me what you're thinking.
We don't have time for this fussing.
...As you say. $npcName:11001656[gender:1]$ has made her decision, and I've decided to accept it. For now.
We should hurry before more trouble comes our way. Are you ready to leave?
Yes, let's get going.
Good. There's nothing left for us here.
Good. There's nothing left for us here.
...Well, I should have known travel by cloud wouldn't be very reliable. This town it evaporated over isn't what I imagined $map:02000001$ to look like.
If only $npcName:29000104[gender:0]$ were here... $npcName:11001558[gender:1]$...
No. I can't do that to myself. I've got a mission, to head to $map:02000001$ as $npcName:11001558[gender:1]$ said. My next steps will become clear there.
I'm a disciple of Guidance, same as them. I can't always rely on others. This time, I have to do this myself.
Hello there! Are you one of the mercenaries contracted to escort the caravan?
No, I'm just trying to get to $map:02000001$.
Oh! Well, the caravan is headed to $map:02000001$. If you join the guard detail, you'll get where you want to go and provide a valuable service while you're at it!
Okay.
Great! The more people we have, the safer we'll feel.
I admit, it must have taken chops to get these back but... I have a hard time believing you've got what it takes to take on the champion of $map:63000020$.
Tell me about him.
$npcName:11001547[gender:0]$? He's a beast! There's no other way to put it. I've seen him tenderize guys twice his size like raw steaks.
Has anyone ever come close to beating him?

Well, there was one fight that wasn't absolutely one-sided. Some weird bird guy—Jun-something. He's the only person who's ever managed to hold his own against the Champ. He went off somewhere and we haven't seen him since. But if there's anybody who could give the Champ a fair fight now, it'd be the Gray Wolf.
The Gray Wolf?
...Are you kidding me? I'm talking about you, dummy. I don't believe this...

<font color="#909090">(His walkie-talkie crackles, and he picks it up with a look of disgust.)</font> This better be urgent. Uh huh? Uh huh. One sec... Hey, I've gotta take this call. Give me a minute, will you?

<font color="#909090">(His walkie-talkie crackles, and he picks it up with a look of disgust.)</font> This better be urgent. Uh huh? Uh huh. One sec... Hey, I've gotta take this call. Give me a minute, will you?

Sigh, somebody always needs me for something! It's a crime to be this talented, I tell ya. This place wouldn't run without me. As for you, no matter how I look at you, I just see some scrawny dope. How could you be the Gray Wolf, scourge of the streets? I guess the rumors are just that, rumors.
What rumors?
Oh, there's all kinds of stories. They're all nonsense. But there's one that was reaaally absurd. It was about a showdown in $map:02000138$.

There were some gold bars that were misplaced during transportation, so the boss dispatched a team to retrieve them. Long story short, the residents of $map:02000138$ were awful keen on keeping the boss's gold, and surprise, surprise, they got hurt.

Then some $male:guy,female:lady$ shows up out of nowhere and roughs up our men real good. So the boss decides to make an example of $map:02000138$ and this "Gray Wolf" protecting the town. He sends more than a hundred guys to teach that do-gooder a lesson $male:he'd,female:she'd$ never forget.
(Continue listening to $npc:11001545[gender:0]$'s story.)
And here's the craziest part of the story! They say you sent the lot of them—some 100 men—straight to the hospital! And supposedly the whole fight was over in an hour?! Ridiculous, right?
Believe whatever you want.
Right? I knew it was a load of bull.
<font color="#909090">($npc:11001545[gender:0]$ shakes his head and mutters.)</font> I don't believe it... There's no way that's $male:him,female:her$.
Don't kid yourself about being a big shot here just because you were a big fish in $map:02000100$. You're gonna need more than that if you want to make it here!
I've just received an order from the boss to help you get stronger. It's almost as if he doesn't think you have the stuff. I've got some important info to share, so listen closely!
Those with real power train without getting full of themselves. I'm going to show you how to get stronger. And you're going to do it by <font color="#ffd200">upgrading your skills</font>!

You need materials to <font color="#ffd200">upgrade skills</font>, and <font color="#ffd200">$item:40100001$</font> is the most basic material there is. The material type and amount required for upgrading varies by skill.

You can get <font color="#ffd200">$item:40100001$</font> from merchants, which are easy to find. Finding other materials, however, won't be so easy. I've heard you can occasionally get them by defeating <font color="#ffd200">powerful monsters</font>.
Here's a <font color="#ffd200">$item:40100001$</font>. Open the skill window and use it to upgrade a skill! Look for a <font color="#ffd200">General Store</font> if you need more materials!
Feel like all this dust is damaging my lungs... Should quickly finish the talk and go get some fresh air.
Diligently upgrading your skills? Boss must think your skills are lame, because he told me to show you how to get stronger.
In order to upgrade the skill above the average level, you will not only need $item:40100001$, but also <font color="#ffd200">a special crystal</font>.

It is similar to <font color="#ffd200">$item:40100002$</font> or <font color="#ffd200">$item:40100003$</font>, but it is not easy to find. It can only be earned by <font color="#ffd200">defeating elite or boss monsters</font>.
First, I will give you <font color="#ffd200">$item:40100002$</font>, so use it to <font color="#ffd200">upgrade active skills</font>.

$MyPCName$! You know that <font color="#ffd200">Brother $npcName:11001716$</font> hates those who are lazy, right? That's why I called you. Although it's a bit cumbersome, I'm sure I'll get in trouble if I don't take care of you…
Knowing this will help you get even stronger! It's very important, so listen carefully!
Have you heard about <font color="#ffd200">skill upgrades</font>? It makes the skills you can use even more powerful. This means that the same skill can be even more effective!

You need materials to <font color="#ffd200">upgrade skills</font>, and <font color="#ffd200">$item:40100001$</font> is the most basic material you can use. The type of material and the amount you need to upgrade varies by skill.

You can get <font color="#ffd200">$item:40100001$</font> from merchants, so they're relatively easy to find. But it's not so easy to find out where to get the other materials. Rumors say that they are sometimes dropped after defeating <font color="#ffd200">powerful monsters</font>.
Here's a <font color="#ffd200">$item:40100001$</font>. Open the skill window and use it to upgrade a skill! Look for a <font color="#ffd200">General Store</font> if you need more materials!
Tired from all the investigating? Just remember, you can't be lazy with your work. Brother $npcName:11001716$ is always watching. He seems to keep track of our every breath. Maybe he's clairvoyant...

Brother $npcName:11001716$ said that you, $MyPCName$, have to get better at reconnaissance, scouting, mission planning... As a result, he told me how you could get even stronger. And although he looks like he only cares about the mission, there is a gentler side to him.
In order to upgrade the skill above the average level, you will not only need $item:40100001$, but also <font color="#ffd200">a special crystal</font>.

It's similar to <font color="#ffd200">$item:40100002$</font> or <font color="#ffd200">$item:40100003$,$item:40100021$</font>, but it is difficult to find. It can only be earned by <font color="#ffd200">defeating an elite or boss monster</font>.
First, I will give you <font color="#ffd200">$item:40100002$</font>, so use it for an <font color="#ffd200">active skill upgrade</font>.
Oh my, another customer! I'm surprised you found your way to this little island.

There's no better way to relax than to cast your line while drinking in the scent of the ocean... Anyhow, welcome. Seems like this is your first time around here. Allow me to give you this fishing rod as a gift. It may be a little worn in, but it'll reel them in fine!
So many fish biting today, all you've gotta do is cast your line. What are you waiting for? Get that line in some water!
What's wrong? Are the fish not biting?
I don't own a fishing pole.
I'm just stopping to take a breather.
Listen $male:friend,female:little lady$, I like you plenty, but I'm not exactly swimming in spare gear over here. If you really don't got any fishing tackle, I'd be happy to sell you some.
Ah, I see. Can't say I blame you! Heck of a sight, isn't it? Stay as long as you like.
Well, what do you think? Satisfying, isn't it?

Hm... I just can't figure it out...
Is something wrong?
Is something wrong...? Take a look around. Can't you see the murky water full of algae? Some time ago, the water started to become polluted. Now it's all that way. Sigh...

Since then, the number of fishermen who visit the area has noticeably decreased... I was also debating whether to leave or not. That's when... I saw a peculiar thing in the muddy water that I have never seen before.
I'm still here because a part of me is determined to catch that peculiar thing and find out what exactly it is. Aren't you curious as well? What could it be... Won't you try and catch it with me?
Why are you standing there like that?
I don't have any fishing stuff.
I'm just resting for a bit.
Yeah? Is that so? I didn't pick my money off a tree, so I can't give you another one for free... But if you need one, you can purchase it at production cost. Heh...
The place isn't even worth looking at anymore... Just go and fish.
A <font color="#ffd200">Shrubberpuff</font>? What a strange looking thing... I wonder if it always looked like this.
Oh my... <font color="#ffd200">$map:52000058$</font> was...a v-volcano?
It really is.
Are you hurt?
Uhhh... How are you speaking so calmly about what just happened? A volcano exploded and we barely escaped with our lives! Are you so in shock that you don't have a sense of the situation?
Yeah, I'm pretty used to this kinda thing.
<font color="#909090">(Takes a look around.)</font> Ask if this is heaven.
Huh... Seems like you're not a normal fisherman... The lava was overflowing when the volcano exploded and you didn't even blink...
<font color="#909090">(Shows a small, relaxed smile.)</font>
Haha... Well, you are... <font color="#909090">(Appears shocked while looking towards the lava canal.)</font> What… What is that!
What's so shocking?
J-Just now... Something came out of the lava and went back in! Here... There is something in here as well!
Look here, <font color="#ffd200">$MyPCName$</font>! Look and see what's inside the lava! ...Yeah?
I am fine. What about you? Are you okay?
Yeah, I'm pretty used to this kinda thing.

<font color="#909090">(Shakes head left and right.)</font> You must have experienced a lot of shock... <font color="#909090">(Appears shocked while looking towards the lava canal.)</font> Huh…? W-What is that!
What's so shocking?
What's wrong? Worried the volcano will erupt again?
I don't have any fishing stuff.
Respond by saying you're the type of person who would bathe in lava if you had to.

Is that so? Well I didn't pick my money from a tree, so I can't give you another one for free... Luckily I was holding some of my equipment and therefore can spare a few to sell. You're free to purchase some from me.
Sigh... I didn't imagine you as a bluffer. Stop blabbing. If you aren't afraid, hurry and cast your fishing pole!
What... What's this! How hideous! A flaming fish... My goodness!
Let us hurry out of here! We should get to an expert and ask about this enormous thing!
<font color="#909090">(He looks you up and down.)</font> Hmm? Are you here for the audition?
I'd like to learn how to play an instrument.
Sorry, but class is not in session. These are the auditions for the Moonlight Ensemble, which will be performing soon.
Okay. I'm here for that, then.
<font color="#909090">(He strokes his chin and ponders silently, looking worried.)</font> Hmm... Well... Do you have any experience? Music isn't something someone can teach you with just a few words.
Don't look so disappointed... I'll loan you this instrument and music sheet to experiment with. You can practice on your own time.
Ah... Did you want to ask me something?
I don't have what I need to play.
I want to play in the Ensemble!
I thought I'd given you everything you might need, but it seems not. Oh well. You can always buy instruments and scores from $npcName:11001865[gender:0]$.

You will perform in the Moonlight Ensemble when I say you are ready, and not a moment sooner! Ah... Ahem. Excuse me. What I meant to say was... Keep practicing, and you will be on the stage in no time!
You're a little rough around the edges... But I'll be darned if there isn't a spark in you... What did you say your name was?
I'm $MyPCName$.
$MyPCName$...? I'll remember that. If you give it all you've got, eat your veggies, and practice every day, I think you just might have what it takes.
Have you been practicing your instrument?
Boast that others may lose their hearing due to your tremendous skill.
Say that performing isn't very fun.
Ha hah! Your confidence is overflowing! It's good to see you're enjoying music. Have you considered trying a different instrument? I will give an instrument as a gift.
Oh my... It would be such a waste of your natural talent to give up like this... Hmm... Have you considered trying a different instrument? I'll give you one as a gift.
Ah... Did you have any questions...?
Say that you want to perform, but you don't have the tools.
Say that you want to participate in the ensemble.
Ah... Is that so? Actually, $npc:11001865$ has come to sell new products to the people auditioning. Go and purchase the instrument and music score you need.
Ah... Is that so? There is still plenty of time before the ensemble performance, so it isn't impossible if you start practicing right away. Put in the effort, and you can accomplish anything.
Of course... You're a natural, just as expected. I hope you don't let your musical talents go to waste!
Uhhh... What's taking so long!?
Ask what's wrong.
Right now it's time for the <font color="#ffd200">Moonlight Ensemble</font> to begin... But we can't seem to get in contact with our piano player.
Ask when the ensemble audition was.

It was a few days ago... Did you not hear about it? When you didn't show up I was disappointed. I thought that you, <font color="#ffd200">$MyPCName$</font>, had lost interest in performing... Woe was me...

<font color="#909090">(Realizes something...)</font> Ah! Of course! If you had participated in the audition, the piano performance would have been yours! There is no one who compares to your level of talent!
<font color="#ffd200">$MyPCName$</font>! Please play the piano for the ensemble. Though it is a new piece...with your talent, I'm sure you will be able to perform it amazingly!
<font color="#ffd200">$MyPCName$</font>! Please play the piano for this ensemble. Though it's a new piece, with your talent I'm sure you can perform it amazingly!
Bravo! Bravo! That was an amazing performance!
I only heard the news just after the performance started. The piano player had a severe stomachache and couldn't make it.
Anyways, thanks to $MyPCName$, the performance was a success. The next time there is an ensemble, earn your way in through an audition. I'm sure I'll see you soon!
Judging from those clothes, you've obviously never been here before. Welcome. I'm sure we've got something to elevate your fashion.
I don't see anything that's really "me" here.
There's no accounting for taste. Have you any idea how much love and care goes into each of my pieces?
I bet I could do better!

<font color="#909090">(She scoffs at you.)</font> Is that confidence I hear? Or arrogance? Fine, I'll humor you. There's nothing I enjoy more than watching the fashion-impaired make fools of themselves.

You simply can't design anything without a fashion template. If you're determined to embarrass yourself, you can buy one at the workshop. You know, the little button on the bottom-right corner of your screen?
<font color="#909090">(For the briefest moment, her eyes widen.)</font> That... Hm. That isn't half-bad.

This design looks perfectly adequate... at a glance. But how does it hang off the body? Does it even fit you properly? No, no, the true test of a designer is on the runway. Put this on and I will show you what I mean.
Have you lost your nerve? Very well. I shall accept your defeat.
Well... It fit you... because you're the one who made it. That's the only reason that outfit looks even half-passable on you.
You insist on playing at fashion design? Fine. Even I have to admit that you have some small, small kernel of talent.
Allow me to introduce you to the League of Fashionistas. But first, I insist that you take a new profile picture to show off your outfit. We don't want to make a bad first impression, now, do we?
Allow me to introduce you to the League of Fashionistas. But first, I insist that you take a new profile picture to show off your new outfit. We don't want to make a bad first impression, now, do we?
Ha. You look better in photographs than you do in real life. Perhaps... perhaps we could work together, after all.
Hey! It's $MyPCName$! Don't say a word, you beautiful dummy. I know exactly what you're here for.
(Stare at her in silence.)
There's no need to get flustered. I'll teach you the basics. First, take these materials. Let's try making something simple!
What was what? Is there a problem?
Umm... I lost the materials.
What's the deal with this place?

What!? How could you lose them? Did you think because I gave them to you for free, that they were worthless, and safe to throw out? Well I've got news for you, $male:mister,female:lady$. From now on, you're paying for your own materials.
Hmm? You don't know? It's a handicraft workshop. Aren't you here to learn how to handicraft?
Actually, I was just sort of wandering around.
What? (Her eyebrow twitches with subdued rage.)
<font color="#909090">(She clears her throat, then smiles.)</font> No matter! What's important is that you are here. What you learn today will be just as useful tomorrow.
A ring! Wow! You shouldn't have. I think you deserve another lesson.
Your timing is perfect. I could use a hand!
Uh... Okay?
I came to gather materials for a special order that just came into the shop. I have no problem getting my hands dirty, but I can only mine so much on my own!
There's a material found primarily here in $map:63000046$ known as $item:33000023$. I need a lot of it. How would you like to help me mine them? You'll be rewarded, of course.
There's a material found primarily here in $map:63000046$ known as $itemPlural:33000023$. I need a large number of them. How would you like to help me mine them? You'll be rewarded, of course.
Thank you so much for your help! You should swing by the workshop again some time. I'll teach you all about handicrafting!
Oh my! Where has the time gone? $MyPCName$, I'd love to teach you more of my wondrous handicraft techniques... But I'm afraid I have an appointment to make.
My older sister is a famous blacksmith at $map:02000203$. I was on my way to ask her to enchant one of my items when you stopped by...
Hey, this is a great chance for you to try enchanting something. I could sell you something to enchant, if you want!
Well? What do you think? It's only been enchanted once, but it looks good, right?
Anyway, we can't stop here. Let's enchant something else!
Anyway, we can't stop here. Let's enchant something else!
Not bad, huh? You know, this place isn't half bad. I should move the forge here! Ha!
<font color="#ffd200">$MyPCName$</font>, we meet again!
Ask the reason for being here.

Why, what other reason do I have to leave the workshop and come here? I'm here to grab reforging materials, of course. This time I came to get a special material needed to decorate a piece of my own handiwork.

$map:63000046$ isn't very big; however, geographically, there is a variety of soil. In $map:02000076$ it can be difficult to purchase materials only found in <font color="#ffd200">deep forests like $map:02000023$</font> and <font color="#ffd200">beaches like $map:02000062$</font>. Even for a premium…

Luckily, although there isn't much variety here, you can purchase materials that can't be easily found in the $map:02000076$ meadow. <font color="#ffd200">$MyPCName$</font>, won't you help me find the materials? At least for the sake of experience?

If you go <font color="#ffd200">downward</font>, you''ll come across a <font color="#ffd200">small forest</font> containing a mysterious energy. Further down you'll find a <font color="#ffd200">cozy little beach</font>. Will you collect <font color="#ffd200">$item:33000024$</font> in the forest and <font color="#ffd200">$item:33000025$</font> on the beach for me?
Wow! Thank you very much. You have helped me countless times...
Hmm... I can't leave the workshop empty for so long. That would be quite a problem.
Ask if there is any reason to not return to the workshop.

The thing is...I have received more reforging orders than I can handle. I do not have enough materials. To meet the requests, I'll need to gather a lot more materials, and quickly. <font color="#ffd200">$MyPCName$</font>, think you have it in you to help me again?

The thing is...I have received more reforging orders than I can handle. I do not have enough materials. To meet the requests, I'll need to gather a lot more materials, and quickly. <font color="#ffd200">$MyPCName$</font>, think you have it in you to help me again?
Is it too difficult? Ha... At this speed, nothing will get done.

This won't do. $MyPCName$, I will stay here and continue mining. Will you go to <font color="#ffd200">Nerman Barn</font> on the <font color="#ffd200">eastern side of the mine</font> and ask if <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11001870$</font> has any <font color="#ffd200">$item:20000343$</font>? If so, please bring some back.

If so, please bring some back.
Huhuh. Look here, young friend! Be careful, for there is cow poop scattered about like landmines. Huhuhuh.
Okay, young friend. What is the reason you have passed through the cow poop to be here?
Ask if there are leftover $item:20000343$.
Haha, what's there to do? There aren't any left... Our only choice is to make more...
Say that materials will need gathered before they can be made.

Hmm, so materials need to be gathered... See the cows at that barn? Go and bring back a few <font color="#ffd200">$item:33000041$</font>. If you have raised livestock at your home before, you will find this to be similar.

Hmm, if that's the case materials need to be gathered. See the cows at that barn? Go and bring back a few <font color="#ffd200">$item:33000041$</font>. If you have raised livestock at your home before, you will find this to be similar.
Not that difficult, huh? They need to get haircuts every once in a while, but it's for their own good.
Now it's time to take <font color="#ffd200">$item:33000041$</font> and <font color="#ffd200">create</font> <font color="#ffd200">$item:20000343$</font>. It isn't difficult. Give it a try.
Now it's time to take <font color="#ffd200">$item:33000041$</font> and <font color="#ffd200">create</font> <font color="#ffd200">$item:20000343$</font>. It isn't difficult. Give it a try.
Ah, you have finally arrived. I've been waiting!
Hand over the $item:20000343$.

You see... The truth is after $MyPCName$ went to the barn, a passing guild member handed me the $item:20000343$ they had with them. Thanks to that generous passerby, I was able to collect this much material in a short amount of time.
You have worked hard; however, this is how it turned out... You can take that $item:20000343$ and use it as needed.
Ah! $MyPCName$. That $item:20000343$, how about trying it out here? You will be able to feel your mining speed increase immensely.
Ah! $MyPCName$. That $item:20000343$, how about trying it out here? You will be able to feel your mining speed increase immensely.
What you think? Makes mining much easier, right? I didn't decide to build a barn and raise cattle by this mine for no reason. Ha!
Hey...$MyPCName$. What are you going to do with the <font color="#ffd200">$item:33000023$</font>? If you don't have a specific use for it...maybe you can sell it to me? I will give you a fair price.
Say you understand.
Say no.
Wow! <font color="#ffd200">$MyPCName$</font>, you're the best! Thank you so much!
Look, I really need this... Please help me out one more time. I will buy it at a really good price. Please?
Nod yes as if there's no other choice.
Hey, you with the face! Are you here to participate in the rally, or just to watch?
I came here to win!
I like to watch.

Is that so? Good, good! Well, unless you're planning to race on foot, you're going to need a vehicle. How would you like to burn rubber in my brand new, souped-up super car? It hardly ever explodes anymore. What do you say?

Listen, I'd drive it myself if I could... But let's face it, I'm old. I could break a hip if I fall out of bed. To think what the G-force of speeding down the raceway would do to my bones... All I can picture is a crushed bag of chips.

What do you say, kiddo? Won't you test my magnificent, high-tech super-engine? Once you start racing, you'll feel it: the need for speed coursing through your veins! Just, uhh... keep that gauge there out of the red. <font size="20">You know, experimental radioactive fuel and all.</font>

<font color="#909090">(He sighs.)</font> How could you come all this way just to watch? Wouldn't you rather race? You could be burning rubber in my new souped-up super car! It hardly ever explodes anymore. What do you say?

Listen, I'd drive it myself if I could... But let's face it, I'm old. I could break a hip if I fall out of bed. To think what the G-force of speeding down the raceway would do to my bones... All I can picture is a crushed bag of chips.

What do you say, kiddo? Won't you test my magnificent, high-tech super-engine? Once you start racing, you'll feel it: the need for speed coursing through your veins! Just, uhh... keep that gauge there out of the red. <font size="20">You know, experimental radioactive fuel and all.</font>
Go, go... Keep it up! Just don't go TOO fast. You wouldn't want what's in that engine overheating, trust me. Moderation is key.
Don't get mad but I, uhh, lost your car...
Don't worry, pops. I've got this race in the bag.
Y-you... lost my car!? Do you have ANY idea how many hours, how many mesos I spent...

There's the research and development costs, my assistant's monthly salary, hush money for my previous assistant's family... I'm not made of mesos, you know! The best I can do is sell you a new car at cost. If you're interested, perhaps we can make a trade.
Excellent! And if you manage to adequately test the performance of my engine, you can keep that prototype super-car. How do you like them apples?

Hahaha, yes! The car made it through the lap without so much as a mild explosion! Well, what do you think? How did it feel to be speeding along, listening to the roar of the engine with the wind whipping through your hair?
Wooo! Gotta go fast!
To be honest, I've driven more impressive super-cars.

It seems the reactor is stable after all. I'd like you to keep the prototype as thanks for your help. You shouldn't need to swap fuel rods for the next century or so. They're a bit radioactive, but, uhh... you weren't planning on procreating, right?
R-really? To fail after having worked so hard... Alas... I suppose there's no point in returning the car... <font color="#909090">(He lowers his head in disappointment.)</font>
Hm? Oh goodness, it's you! You're the young adventurer who helped me stress-test my race car super-engine before!
You know it!
Uhh... I guess so...
What a pleasant surprise! Are you still driving that car I gave you?
That's right.
Actually, I've moved on to shinier, fancier vehicles.
Oh, is that so? Still cruising around with your wheels on the ground, eh? Hahaha... Well then, you've come at the perfect time! What would you say to the chance to rule the skies?

Pending the results of a lawsuit, I've taken a break from my engine research and started looking into making flight more accessible to all. This is my first invention, a $item:40400001$. I believe I've perfectly counterbalanced the balloons for your weight, so you should be able to soar the skies without getting lost in the stratosphere. Give it a try!

Ah, is that so? Already on to a new and exciting mode of transport? Hahaha... Well, what would you say if I offered you an opportunity to slip the surly bonds of the earth entirely? Oh no, not death... I mean flight of course!

Pending the results of a lawsuit, I've taken a break from my engine research and started looking into making flight more accessible to all. This is my first invention, a $item:40400001$. I believe I've perfectly counterbalanced the balloons for your weight, so you should be able to soar the skies without getting lost in the stratosphere. Give it a try!
All you have to do is grab on tight to this balloon, and you'll float away! Follow the rainbow and fly to that other building way over there.
Hey, uhh... That wasn't the only balloon you made, right?
Do you have something else I can fly in?

Well of course I made more than one, any good scienti— Hey, wait a second! Did you lose my balloon? Sigh... Well, there's no use being angry. You can purchase another from $npcName:11001875[gender:1]$ for a marginal fee.

Err... Well, I came here to test my $item:40400001$</font>, which is why I gave it to you... But ultimately you can fly with whatever vehicle strikes your fancy. Just look at the other people flying around the rainbow.
Ahhh... Was this your first time flying?
Yep!
Nope!

Well, you've demonstrated marvelous control... You're a natural aviator! I'll report the results of the test to Doctor $npcName:11001873[gender:0]$. Feel free to keep that $item:40400001$ as a souvenir. Really they're just store-bought balloons filled with an experimental gas.
It shows! I'll tell $npcName:11001873[gender:0]$ how the test went. Feel free to keep that $item:40400001$. Really they're just store-bought balloons filled with an experimental gas.
Ah! Perfect timing. As a complimentary service, Goldus Real Estate is providing our customers with interior design assistance.
One of my dearest, trendiest friends will be coming by to help you with your interior design. I trust you'll give him a warm welcome.
And here he is. I'm going to head back to the office... Good luck to the both of you!
Hello there. $npc:11001876[gender:0]$'s the name, and interior design's my game! I'm here to help you make your house look amazing.
Hm... Let's start with the basics, and take it step-by-step.
If you head over to your home now, you'll discover one of our associates waiting eagerly to tutor you in the basics of interior design.
Ah, very nice. You may just have an eye for this.
Hmm... There must be a furnishing better suited to your home's aesthetic. Shall we pick one out together?
You can purchase whatever you like, and it will be transported here auto-magically in an instant! Why don't you purchase a furnishing and see for yourself?
You can purchase whatever you like, and it will be transported here auto-magically in an instant! Why don't you purchase a furnishing and see for yourself?
Hmm… The vibe in here is definitely improving. I have to hand it to you, you do seem to have a sense for interior decorating.
You can change the feel of a home drastically with the right furniture. Work hard to make your house a place you can be proud of!
Hmm... The place is... looking a little drab...
I'd like to give you a gift. It's a $item:50200299$. It's got a very practical and clean design, a nice starter-bed. Why don't you place it somewhere? It would really class up the place.
I'd like to give you a gift. It's a $item:50200299$. It's got a very practical and clean design, a nice starter-bed. Why don't you place it somewhere? It would really class up the place.

It's easy to tell a neglectful homeowner from a caring one by the care $male:he,female:she$ puts into decorating. There are certain furnishings which are especially good indicators of this, and thus, increase your home's decoration score. Take that $item:50200299$, for example.
You may have noticed that the moment you placed $item:50200299$, your decoration score increased. Your decoration score is a representation of how any tasteful observer would assess your home.
Decorate your home however you wish, but if you have any interest in maintaining a sensibly arranged home, you should pay attention to your decoration score.
The atmosphere in here is all off. I know! How about a new table and sofa?
This room... It's just not working.
Swapping out a piece of furniture here and there can drastically change the ambiance of a home. It's far easier than changing the wallpaper, and just as satisfying.
I have to admit, you're not half bad. Perhaps you don't need my help after all. Well, I'll be off then.
Ah, hello...? Is anyone home? I brought over a little housewarming present. This cuddly little chickie is yours to raise.
A little young to own a home aren't you? I like it! It shows forward thinking and dedication.

My name's $npcName:11001877$ and I run the farm up the way. I was passing by when I couldn't help but peep through your windows and notice how empty your house looked! So, I thought I'd do the neighborly thing and bring you a housewarming gift. It's a chicken!
Here, take it. If I had my way, there'd be a hen in every home! Really makes the place feel cozy. I hope you'll look after it.
Here, take it. If I had my way, there'd be a hen in every home! Really makes the place feel cozy. I hope you'll look after it.
I raised that there little gal ever since she hatched from her egg. Take good care of her!

Greetings! Welcome to the Guild Registry HQ. I'm the chairwoman of the registry, and I'm in charge of overseeing all guild-related activities in Maple World!
$MyPCName$, have you joined a guild yet?
I wouldn't join any guild that would have me as a member.
Hmm... I guess I could apply to one of those.
Don't be silly! Guilds are a wonderful place to meet new friends, and besides, you get benefits just for being a member!
Just remember, if you can't find a guild you're interested in, you can always start your own!

That's the spirit, $MyPCName$! In addition to friendship and comradery, you'll receive all kinds of benefits as a member of a guild! Just remember, if you can't find a guild you're interested in, you can always start your own!
You can view information about your guild from the Guild window.
$MyPCName$! How does it feel to be a part of something bigger than yourself? Seeking out and interacting with like-minded guild members is the key to a fun and happy Maple World for everyone!
Here's to the continued success and growth of all guilds in Maple World! I hope I'll see you again real soon!
Welcome to our garden. Here, we grow ancient and endangered herbs. Just breathe in that smell! Isn't it magical?

Hm... Judging by that vacant stare, you weren't listening to my very important suggestion. Allow me to repeat myself. Go collect a flower from the garden and give it a good sniff! One hit will relax you, body and mind.
