Hold it. We're not done yet. Well, I am, but if you want to use that weapon you most definitely are not.
Geez, what is it now?

Look at it! That thing is completely worn down from years of battle and seething evil. You try to swing it around without reforging it and it's going to snap in half or explode or something. And for a weapon like that, you'll need to travel to $map:02000203$ to reforge it. That's the only way.
You know what you need to do, right? I did the hard part, now you need to head off to $map:02000203$ and get that weapon reforged.
Good to see you, $MyPCName$! How are you doing?
Pretty good. Hey, do you think you could help me reforge this $item:15500064$?
This...! Holey moley, did you break the curse? Are you... okay? Didn't that take some harrowing deeds and descents into madness?
Nothing too mad or harrowing. Anyway, about reforging...?
Everything's cool, it's just $npcName:11001242[gender:0]$ said I should reforge it before it explodes or something.

It's not that simple... not with a weapon like this, anyway. You gotta understand, what makes that thing so powerful is the limitless life force of $npcName:23090005[gender:0]$ within it. Once it passes to another, it'll begin to draw on their life force instead. And unless they're more powerful than $npcName:23090005[gender:0]$... well, I'm sure you can see the issue.
Wait... is this the weapon that exploded after I infused it? I think I'd like an explanation here!
Okay, but there's a lotta darkness involved...

You... actually forced out the evil using a more concentrated form of evil? That's absurdly clever. And you did end up with something you could use, just not something as useful as you were expecting.
Exactly! So... how do I make it useful again?

Lucky for you, my ancestors studied the mechanics of enchanted weapons and left exhaustive notes. They explain that the power that makes these weapons so potent is actually sourced from the wielder. That means this weapon was so incredible because $npcName:23090005[gender:0]$ was using it. And that means we'll need a different method.

$npcName:23090005[gender:0]$ is both powerful and immortal, and we still don't fully understand how either of those things came to be true. If we could uncover the secrets behind that power, we might find a way to empower this weapon again.

The day I tried to infuse it, I checked every note, journal, and record I could find to understand why. I'm getting closer to the answer, especially after what you've told me... but I'm not there yet. Bear with me, and I promise you we can make this weapon legendary!

Aren't you $MyPCName$? Could I have a moment? I heard something strange not long ago and thought I should let you know.
Is it about $npcName:23090005[gender:0]$'s weapon?

It's a little vague... But it's still interesting. A shaman from a faraway land passed through here recently. He explained he was researching demons and asked if I heard the rumors of a powerful fire demon the blacksmiths of this place had been talking about.

I remembered the demon called $npcName:23090005[gender:0]$ that you defeated and told him of that. He was very interested, so I told him about the way into $npcName:23090005[gender:0]$'s lair somewhere in $map:02000200$.
He was really happy to hear that, and left for $map:02000200$ straightaway. As he was leaving, he said something I won't soon forget. He said he would remove the curse from within the demon.
What in the world are you talking about?

Look, according to the ancient records, you can enter the consciousness of a demon in moments when their power wanes. In those moments their defenses falter, and you can learn their darkest secrets. Their desires, their weaknesses, and of course, how to break their curses.
This might be the chance you need to break that curse on your weapon! What do you have to lose?
Besides my life? Fine, how do I get into a demon's head?
Huh? How should I know? The shaman said it, I didn't! He left for $map:02000200$ not so long ago, so perhaps you can catch him if you hurry. His name's $npcName:11001485[gender:0]$.
The shaman called $npcName:11001485[gender:0]$ left for $map:02000200$ not long ago. You should be able to find him around there... he has a very peculiar aura.
I'm sure I heard a sound. It seems like something has changed. Ahh, if only it wasn't so dark here! On top of all my troubles, I still have this accursed night blindness…
This demon, $npcName:23090005[gender:0]$... If he really is responsible for my misfortunes, I can't go back until I've settled the score!

No way! I just want to break the curse on this here $item:15500064$.
My goodness, that is a dreadful curse. Tell me, was it placed by the demon known as $npcName:23090005[gender:0]$? The one who resides here?
Is it possible to enter $npcName:23090005[gender:0]$'s consciousness to break the curse?

I... um... Well, yes. In theory, anyway. The ancient texts describe the process of entering the consciousness and unraveling their true nature, giving the visitor power over the demon. But wait, where did you even hear about this?
No time for that now. I need to get into $npcName:23090005[gender:0]$'s head.

You could hardly have picked a trickier target. A demon that powerful isn't going to be easy to subdue, which is the first step to opening the path. You may find an advantage if you battle it during a lunar eclipse, during a ritual, or on a white night. Or you can just pound on it super hard and force open the path to its consciousness.
If you can lay $npcName:23090005[gender:0]$ low, search the area for a portal. A lot has changed about this place since I first came here, so don't assume it will be easy to find.

Now, if you do manage to enter $npcName:23090005[gender:0]$'s consciousness, I want to hear all the details. During my studies I was also cursed, leaving me in this sorry state you see before you. It's possible my nemesis is the same demon you seek to battle, and if so... well, that would be terribly convenient.

You might also want to take the cursed weapon with you. I don't know what exactly you'll need to break the curse but having the actual cursed item certainly can't hirt. Oh, and I recommend you take that weapon. You don't know what form the clues to break the demon's curse will take on. You may regret it if you don't take it.
If you enter $npcName:23090005[gender:0]$'s consciousness, keep that weapon close. You don't know what form the clues to break the demon's curse will take on.
You're back! And you're alive! Tell me, what did you see in $npcName:23090005[gender:0]$'s consciousness?
Hoo boy, where do I start...
The eternal flame... So, you broke the curse with intense heat? That's ingenius, $MyPCName$! You look like you've been through a lot, but at least it was worth it!
Speaking of which, do you think your curse is connected to $npcName:23090005[gender:0]$?

No, I'm afraid not. My curse chills me to my very bones, and it's clear that $npcName:23090005[gender:0]$'s power is rooted in fire. But I'm happy to have learned more about demonkind from your exploits.
Thank you, $MyPCName$! Be sure to fill me in on any other demons you get up close and personal with.
Why would you come to this dark place? And how did you know my name? Do you serve the demon?
No way! I just want to break the curse on this here $item:15600064$.
My goodness, that is a dreadful curse. Tell me, was it placed by the demon known as $npcName:23090005[gender:0]$? The one who resides here?
Is it possible to enter $npcName:23090005[gender:0]$'s consciousness to break the curse?

I... um... Well, yes. In theory, anyway. The ancient texts describe the process of entering the consciousness and unraveling their true nature, giving the visitor power over the demon. But wait, where did you even hear about this?
No time for that now. I need to get into $npcName:23090005[gender:0]$'s head.

You could hardly have picked a trickier target. A demon that powerful isn't going to be easy to subdue, which is the first step to opening the path. You may find an advantage if you battle it during a lunar eclipse, during a ritual, or on a white night. Or you can just pound on it super hard and force open the path to its consciousness.
If you can lay $npcName:23090005[gender:0]$ low, search the area for a portal. A lot has changed about this place since I first came here, so don't assume it will be easy to find.

Now, if you do manage to enter $npcName:23090005[gender:0]$'s consciousness, I want to hear all the details. During my studies I was also cursed, leaving me in this sorry state you see before you. It's possible my nemesis is the same demon you seek to battle, and if so... well, that would be terribly convenient.

You might also want to take the cursed weapon with you. I don't know what exactly you'll need to break the curse but having the actual cursed item certainly can't hirt. Oh, and I recommend you take that weapon. You don't know what form the clues to break the demon's curse will take on. You may regret it if you don't take it.
If you enter $npcName:23090005[gender:0]$'s consciousness, keep that weapon close. You don't know what form the clues to break the demon's curse will take on.
You're back! And you're alive! Tell me, what did you see in $npcName:23090005[gender:0]$'s consciousness?
Hoo boy, where do I start...
The eternal flame... So, you broke the curse with intense heat? That's ingenius, $MyPCName$! You look like you've been through a lot, but at least it was worth it!
Speaking of which, do you think your curse is connected to $npcName:23090005[gender:0]$?

No, I'm afraid not. My curse chills me to my very bones, and it's clear that $npcName:23090005[gender:0]$'s power is rooted in fire. But I'm happy to have learned more about demonkind from your exploits.
Thank you, $MyPCName$! Be sure to fill me in on any other demons you get up close and personal with.
The $item:30000419$ of $npcName:23190005[gender:0]$ himself... There's definitely something ominous about this blood.
After touching it for just a moment, I felt my vitality drain away. They say that $npcName:23190005[gender:0]$ devoured the life force of anything that came near him...
This isn't exactly something you should keep in your pocket. I will be returning to the $map:2000173$ for now. Find me when you get there and we can discuss this in greater detail.
This isn't exactly something you should keep in your pocket. I will be returning to the $map:2000173$ for now. Find me when you get there and we can discuss this in greater detail.
So, tell me. Did you notice anything strange about the $item:30000419$?
Define "strange."
Did you feel any weakness? Sudden bouts of despair? Terror at the horrors that will doubtless befall you?
Well, now I do!
Just as I expected! When I saw the $item:30000419$, I felt indescribable dread in the very pit of my stomach. But there's something more to it. Something beneath the evil...
Can you be a little more precise?
I wish I could. All I can tell you is that this $item:30000419$ isn't normal.
This is all beyond my area of expertise, you see. I can speculate, if you really want me to, but if you want answers, then... I'm going to have to refer you to someone else.
Who should I ask for advice?
I haven't met him personally, but there's one of the fairfolk who's made a name for himself in the field of life magic. I believe he may be able to solve the mysteries of this $item:30000419$.
Where can I find that fairfolk?
$map:2000023$ is a place of wise men and sages. I'm certain you will be able to find $npcName:11001210[gender:0]$ there.
I thought you'd be in more of a hurry to see $npcName:11001210[gender:0]$. I wouldn't hold onto that blood any longer than you have to.
I sense a vile presence. What have you brought me?
(Show him the $item:30000419$.)
$item:30000419$...? Is this the evil presence I detected?
This is the blood of $npcName:23190005[gender:0]$.
Incredible... All life must return to nature. That is the law of mortality that binds us all. But somehow this blood exists in defiance of that law...
Eternal life that rejects the laws of mortality...? No. No, there's something very wrong with this…
You don't say.
I am beginning to understand. The $item:30000419$ is infused with the life force of many different creatures. Somehow, that's allowing it to resist the laws of nature and mortality.
But that's not all. There is also an intense malice in the very core of the blood. Enough malice to shatter a normal human mind.
But there's... there's something else, buried even deeper. It's barely perceptible, but it's powerful. Frighteningly powerful...

May I hold onto this for a moment? The power at the very core of the blood is powerful, but I sense no evil in it. If I can purify this blood of its malice, we may be able to learn the nature of this power.

May I hold onto this for a moment? The power at the very core of the blood is powerful, but I sense no evil in it. If I can purify this blood of its malice, we may be able to learn the nature of this power.
May I attempt to purify the $item:30000420$?
(Hand the $item:30000420$ to him.)
It is said that $npcName:23190005[gender:0]$ never stops beating. I can certainly see why. The $item:30000420$ within this blood is what powers it...
So the source of his power... isn't evil?
That's right. Even in this small particle of $item:30000420$, I see a wonder I've never before encountered.
If one were to gather enough of these fragments, to merge them into a complete form... Well, anything could happen. You may have the $item:30000420$ now.

One concern I should warn you about. This $item:30000420$ is but a fragment. But were you to perfect it, it would become a whirling source of endless magic. It would be powerful, yes, but it would break the laws of nature. Would that make it good... or evil?
What matters is how it's used.

Hmm... When a new life is born, an old life returns to the earth. This is the balance of nature. Something like $item:30000420$, which only creates power and never consumes it... That would be like a world of birth without death. Such a thing cannot be sustained.
Excess leads to imbalance. An ever-expanding power may be useful at first, but it could well go out of control and consume us all.
So there's no way to safely use it?
I don't think... Wait. Yes, perhaps Harcha could do it...
Harcha who?

He is a blacksmith at $map:2000203$. A friend of mine. I met him while I was researching the possibility of life regeneration through mineral... That is neither here nor there. His family has a special smithing technique that is of particular interest to us.
I'm listening.

He said he was studying to use this technique to imbue a weapon with potent magic. Magic more powerful than anything the enchanters of the day had. The secret was balance... His ancestors had a method of balancing powerful magic so that it wouldn't run rampant.
We could use that balance to control this power!
Presumably we could, but he hadn't yet perfected the technique when I last spoke to him. It seems there was a certain mineral that he couldn't find anywhere.

That was some time ago. Maybe he's figured it out by now. Either way, I believe Harcha is your best bet at turning the $item:30000420$ to a useful purpose. Why don't you seek him out at $map:2000203$?
I believe Harcha is your best bet at turning the $item:30000420$ to a useful purpose. Why don't you seek him out at $map:2000203$?
Sorry. I don't do custom orders.
Do you know where I can find Harcha?
Do I? Harcha was my great-granddad!
I wonder why someone'd send you to find Harcha. It's been decades since he quit smithing...
Did he ever figure out how to balance magic in a weapon?
Not many people knew about his research. He had theories, but the old man never did manage to make such a weapon. I've got some ideas of my own, and I even have some leads...
Such as...?
There's a mineral called $item:30000421$ that's supposedly sops up unstable magic like a sponge. I hear they use it to clean curses off the land and such.
If I had some of that, I bet I could finish my great-grandad's work.

Problem is, you can't get it anywhere in Victoria Island. There just aren't any deposits here. And even if I did have it, $item:30000421$ is just the stabilizing agent. Without a source of power to stabilize, it's not much good.
(Show him the infinite essence.)
Wh-what is that...?
It's the purified blood of $npcName:23190005[gender:0]$.
$npcName:23190005[gender:0]$?! W-wow! Yes, this'll... this'll do the trick!
Wherever you got that, we need more. And the $item:30000421$, too. I need enough of both to refine and recombine into a stable form... No... No, it couldn't work, could it?
What's the problem?
Huh? Oh, right. So, I have good news... and twice as much bad news. What do you want first?
Good news first.
Let's get the bad news out of the way.
The good news is that the power of the $item:30000420$ should be compatible with $item:30000421$. Together, they'll make a weapon unlike anything Maple World has ever seen.
And the bad news?
What's our next step?
First, the $item:30000420$ you brought me is impressive... but it's just one fragment. We'll need more if we want to show its true power.

Second, remember how I said you can't get $item:30000421$ anywhere in Victoria Island? Without that ore, we're dead in the water. Unless the Allicari brought some with them from across the sea, but what are the odds of that?
Is it possible they did bring some? No, no, I'm just getting my hopes up at this point. There's no way we'll get our hands on any $item:30000421$...
What's the good news?
What's our next step?
I'm glad your eager, but don't get your hopes up! First, I need more $itemPlural:30000420$. There's no point in doing this in half-steps. We want a weapon that will go down in legend.
Then, we need to get our hands on $item:30000421$ somehow. The Allicari merchants in $map:2000064$ might have some, but that's a long shot.
If, against all odds, you can get the materials I need, I'll take care of the rest.
Once again, I need two materials. First, I need more $itemPlural:30000420$. There's no point in doing this in half-steps. We want a weapon that will go down in legend.
Then, we need to get our hands on $item:30000421$ somehow. The Allicari merchants in $map:2000064$ might have some, but that's a long shot.
If, against all odds, you can get the materials I need, I'll take care of the rest.
You actually did it! Well... Luckily for you, I already prepared a weapon mold. Give me some time to synthesize the materials you brought me...
(Wait several moments.)
<font color="#909090">($npcName:11001211[gender:0]$ is deep in concentration.)</font>
(Wait several more moments.)
<font color="#909090">(He's concentrating harder than you've ever seen anyone concentrate before. It's making you a little uncomfortable.)</font>
(Wait a whole heap of moments.)
N-no... I infused the weapon with the $itemPlural:30000420$ and $item:30000421$, but something went wrong. Some sort of dark magic flared up from within the essences. I'm sorry…
The weapon's a bust, then?
It's as powerful as they come, but it's basically cursed. It's not safe to use in this state.
I've shamed my great-granddad. No matter what it takes, I swear I'll find a way to make this weapon usable!

Hi, $MyPCName$, I'm $npc:11003870[gender:0]$, from Berg Island. We've finished reviewing your application, and your 50,000,000 meso payment has been processed. I've got your authorization forms right here, and I'm happy to welcome to the Berg Mining Collective.
Um... I think there's been a mix-up. I didn't sign up for anything.

Hahaha. Very funny. In any case, after a year-long vetting process, and a substantial investment, I'm sure you're quite eager to begin taking advantage of your exclusive access to one of the world's richest, and most varied mineral deposits ever discovered.
But, I didn't pay for any of that...

Uhh... You are $MyPCName$, are you not...? It's unlikely our accountants transposed an identification number, but I'd be mortified to mistakenly hand over access to hundreds of millions of mesos worth of minerals to someone who wasn't a member of the collective...
H-hundreds... of millions...? Why yes, I am $MyPCName$, and I'm ready to visit Whats-Its-Name Island right away.
Oh, excellent! For a moment I thought one of our employees had made a terrible, career-ending mistake. Anywho, come meet me at $map:02000424$ and I'll get you all set up!
Go and meet $npc:11000454[gender:0]$ in $map:02000062$. He'll arrange your voyage.
<font color="#909090">(Is this really happening? You should go to $map:02000062$ for now.)</font>
Nice day for some weather, huh?
So there I was in a world of trouble. Me in a leaky lifeboat bailing fast as I could, against the stormy fury of the sea... I've had smoother journeys.
Speaking of... You know, I almost married a mermaid once! I think I dodged a bullet there, but sometimes I think of those poor mermaids who missed out.
<font color="#909090">(Across the room, $npcName:11000453$ rolls her eyes in disbelief.)</font>
And? And? What happened next?
Oh, you know, cultural differences. We were from different worlds, after all!
No... The boat! What happened with the boat?
Ahem!
Oh, ahoy there. Did you need something?
I'm just looking for a ride to $map:02000424$.
Ohh, I bet you're the one $npcName:11003870[gender:0]$ was talking about! The lucky new member of the Berg Mining Collective!
I've already set everything up with $npc:11000981[gender:0]$ over in $map:02000062$'s southern quay. He'll book your passage to $map:02000424$.
Mister, please finish your story!
Ahaha, right! Where was I? I guess I'll start over...
NO! Um, you stopped at the part where you arrived on $map:02000424$!
Well then! So there I was lying on the shores of $map:02000424$, barely breathing, and without a ship to my name.
Stranded on that island, all I could do was wait. But as $map:02000062$'s greatest fisherman, I at least wouldn't have to worry about going hungry.
<font color="#909090">($npcName:11000455$ seems a little skeptical, but otherwise enraptured.)</font>
Oh!
In between wild bouts of fishing, I explored the secrets of $map:02000424$. Turns out... it's full of rocks! And not just any rocks, but minerals as far as the eye can see!
Yes, I conquered $map:02000424$ all on my own, thanks to my perseverance and wit! If only I'd been the first to stake a claim, I'd be rich.
You really are amazing!
Ahaha! If I had a meso for every time I heard that...
$npc:11000454[gender:0]$ sent me here.
Oh, you're the mining enthusiast $npc:11000454[gender:0]$ talked about. Well, it sounds like no one could appreciate $map:02000424$ like you.
You'll need to take a Berg Mining Collective boat to $map:02000424$. I'll handle all the paperwork, I've got a few copies I half filled out earlier.
That boat'll take you straight to $map:02000424$, no stops or layovers. Then you can find $npcName:11003870[gender:0]$, who I'm sure you can't wait to meet.
Fortunately, the seas are calm today. Safe voyage!
Fortunately, the seas are calm today. Safe voyage!

Welcome to $map:02000424$. This island belongs to the Berg Mining Collective, and now you can count yourself a proud member. As long as you don't go over your daily allotment, you can mine as much as you like.
You're lucky the weather is clear and the sea is calm. Boat rides can be perilous.
After $map:02000424$ was purchased by the Berg Mining Collective, a geological survey revealed it to be one of the most mineral-diverse places on the planet.
And now you, and a handful of other carefully selected individuals, can share in the profit.
Anytime you need to mine some precious rocks, this is the place to do it.
What makes this island so special is that there are veins of just about every ore and mineral found in Maple World right here. It's like an everything bagel, but with rocks!
Hey, since you're here... You think you could help me out?
It's just a small favor. Literally, it's a small object I want you to deliver. Since my job here is as the island's caretaker, it would be weird if I did it myself. So... here.
<font color="#909090">(How is that weird...?)</font>
Deliver this $item:30001128$ to a $npcTitle:11003871$ named $npcName:11003871[gender:0]$</font>. If you head up those steps and follow the path, you'll run into him sooner or later.
I know you just got here, but to be fair this is a GREAT way to learn the lay of the land!
Deliver this $item:30001128$ to a $npcTitle:11003871$ named $npcName:11003871[gender:0]$</font>. If you head up those steps and follow the path, you'll run into him sooner or later.
I lost the $item:30001128$...
How could you be so clumsy and lose it? Go get another one!
Huh? Don't you have it already? Snap out of it!
Your bag is full. Clear out your bag first.
Hm? Can I help you?
<font color="#909090">(You hand the $item:30001128$ to $npc:11003871[gender:0]$.)</font>
Why are you giving this to me? Where is $npcName:11003870[gender:0]$?
This isn't even what I asked for. I bet $npcName:11003870[gender:0]$ couldn't get the right item and sent you so he wouldn't have to deal with it. You poor sap.
Well, it's not your fault. Thanks for trying, anyway. Maybe I can find something to do with this $item:30001128$.
Welp, I guess I'll head back to $npcName:11003870[gender:0]$ now...
Oh, hang on! Can you help me with something since you're here?
Ooh, I'd love to but I'm pretty busy...
Ooh, I'd love to...
Oh, okay. That's fine. Yeah, no problem, I'll just keep working while my daughter grows up without her father, and my wife grows more distant by the day.
Really, it's no trouble at all. Gives me more time to figure out what I'll tell my daughter when she's grown and asks what her dad has been doing with his life.
That's just being a father for you. Yep, I don't need any help or anything, really. You go about your urgent business. I'm sure it's very important. Very. Important.
Ooh, I'd love to...
Oh, really? Thanks!
Gather up the minerals you find around here and take them to $npcName:11003872[gender:0]$.
Thanks for helping!
Gather up the minerals you find around here and take them to $npcName:11003872[gender:0]$.
Who are you, and why are you bringing me minerals? Are you licensed to be moving those around?
I'm doing a favor for $npc:11003871[gender:0]$.
Oh, $npc:11003871[gender:0]$ asked you to do it! I'm not surprised he's trying to pawn his work off like that... Anyway, thanks.
So hey, if you're here in $map:02000424$, that must mean you're in good with the collective. You must be trustworthy. Diligent.
If that's the case, I look forward to seeing you around here.
Uh, yeah! Totally the case. Let's be buddies!
Well said! It's been a pleasure... buddy!
I'd better head back to $npcName:11003870[gender:0]$...
Fine folks like you are always welcome!
Yikes, you look exhausted. How's $map:02000424$ treating you?
Oh, it's great. Lots of rocks, and lots of people who... need things.
Ha! Yeah, I heard you've been running all over the island. The collective definitely picked you for a reason.
Well you're certainly welcome anytime! I'm convinced, and that's good enough for anyone.
Come visit $map:02000424$ any time!
Hello, how are you?
Although most know me as $npcName:11000005[gender:1]$, the Head Librarian of $map:02000031$, I'm also a member of the Alkimi Guild!
I've contacted you because the guild has been looking for you. Don't worry, that's a good thing!
The guild has recognized your incredible talent for foraging, $MyPCName$, and so they would like to invite you to $map:02000425$.
Go to $map:02000069$ in $map:02000062$ and speak to a $npcTitle:11003876$ named $npcName:11003876[gender:1]$. She will arrange your voyage to $map:02000425$.
That's all! I think they wanted me to tell you in person so you wouldn't think the offer was junk mail.
<font color="#909090">(You should go to $map:02000062$ and meet $npc:11003876[gender:1]$ at $map:02000069$.)</font>
...I really wish books didn't get so dusty.
Oh hey, you're here! $MyPCName$ right?
That's me. So who are these Alkimi Guild people, and why do they want me to come to their island?
You don't know? The Alkimi Guild is super into alchemy. I thought they invited you because you're some kind of herb-gathering hotshot?
Not just anybody can charter a boat to $map:02000425$, y'know. It's a real honor to be invited!
And it's supposed to be so beautiful there. I'm so jealous you get to go!
In any case, I think they're expecting me to help you arrange a ship to get there. I don't mind, of course. I'm at home around ships!
Time's wasting, $MyPCName$! To the boat!
We're burning daylight! Hustle!
Alright, we'll be launching from here for $map:02000425$. Just give us a second to get the ship ship-shape!
You all set? We're ready to set sail!
You can take the ship to $map:02000425$ whenever you want!
Farewell! And bring back some pictures or something!
I want to see that beautiful $map:02000425$ scenery!
Farewell! And bring back some pictures or something! I want to see that beautiful scenery of $map:02000425$!
Hello, and welcome to $map:02000425$.
I'm $npcName:11003878[gender:1]$, the caretaker of $map:02000425$. I hope the journey here was no trouble for you.
This island belongs to the Alkimi Guild, and is used as an herb sanctuary. We maintain the peace and integrity of this place by limiting who may visit.
You were chosen, $MyPCName$, because of your extraordinary talent and appreciation for handling such herbs.
Oh, goodness, I just remembered. I was supposed to dispatch lunch to our $npcTitle:11003879$, $npcName:11003879[gender:0]$, but I'm afraid I lost track of the time.
Perhaps we can help each other, then? If you deliver the packed lunch, you can tour the island while correcting my terrible oversight.
This sounds a lot like busywork...
Oh, dear! I would never dream of wasting your time! Let me assure you, I never ask random tasks of my associates. Ever! What favors I ask always have a clear purpose.
Please deliver $item:30001130$ to $npcName:11003879[gender:0]$. I would be forever grateful!
Please deliver $item:30001130$ to $npcName:11003879[gender:0]$. I would be forever grateful!
Can I get another $item:30001130$?
Don't tell me you lost it! Do you think it's easy making a packed lunch? Don't lose it this time!
Isn't that the packed lunch in your hand? You must be really exhausted.
You should check your bag first. I think it's full.
How may I help you?
Hey, I've got this packed lunch for a guy named $npcName:11003879[gender:0]$?
Sigh... $npcName:11003878[gender:1]$ forgot about our lunches again, didn't she?
Thank you. I was getting hungry and losing faith in ever seeing this lunch. What's your name?
I'm $MyPCName$.
$MyPCName$. Nice.
$MyPCName$. You've obviously got a good heart. Mind doing me a favor?
Since I'm on my lunch break, could you pull the <font color="#ffd200">weeds</font> around here while I eat?
Couldn't you just do it after lunch?
I could. If I wolf it down as quick as I can.
But you saw this lunch, right? Surely you can appreciate its delectable flavors and aromas. I want to savor it while I can.
Fine, fine, just stop talking. You're making me hungry.

It's likely that when <font color="#ffd200">$MyPCName$</font> defeated $npc:23190005[gender:0]$, the <font color="#ffd200">core</font> of the undying heart shattered into <font color="#ffd200">fragments</font>.

That's correct. However, the <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000420$</font> is literally a concentration of pure energy with only pure energy remaining. Even though it's merely a fragment, it contains an energy I've never seen before.

But if by any chance all these fragments were to gather and form a <font color="#ffd200">complete form</font>... Something remarkable would happen. I'll return the <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000420$</font> to you.

Where there is life born, there must also be life that returns to the earth. That is the <font color="#ffd200">truth and balance of nature</font>. The <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000420$</font>, on the other hand, endlessly generates power... In other words, there is only birth and no death. This is the problem.

There is one concern, however. While the <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000420$</font> is merely a fragment and not whole, it does contain an energy I've never seen before. ...What do you think about the ceaseless cycle of magical power swirling inside the essence? Since it continuously generates powerful energy, should we take that as a good thing?
Says if the power can be used properly, it's naturally a good thing.

An excessive imbalance of power that ignores the laws of nature. If you attempt to combine them while leaving the ceaseless cycle of magical power unchecked... it's not certain, but... The <font color="#ffd200">expanding energy</font> could become uncontrollable and <font color="#ffd200">go berserk</font>.
Asks if there's no way to use the Essence of Infinity.
Come to think of it... there's <font color="#ffd200">Harchya</font>.
Harchya? Asks who that is.

A blacksmith from <font color="#ffd200">$map:2000203$</font>. I met him in the past while investigating the connection between life and minerals. He told me about a special <font color="#ffd200">weapon crafting technique</font> that was passed down orally from his ancestors to a single successor.

He called them magic weapons that infuse magical power into weapons, and what was interesting... The core of the technique was precisely <font color="#ffd200">balance</font>. Also, he said that following the technique passed down by his ancestors, he was searching for a <font color="#ffd200">power of balance</font> that would help control powerful magical power from going berserk.
Asks about the secret weapon crafting technique.
Asks what the power of balance he was seeking is.

I asked him the same question, but <font color="#ffd200">Harchya</font> himself didn't seem to know exactly what kind of power of balance he was looking for. However, it could be another form of magical power to suppress expanding magic, and since his technique is based on weapon crafting... he might have had a specific <font color="#ffd200">mineral</font> or material in mind.

If he did find the power of balance he spoke of... its use isn't set in stone, but you could entrust the <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000420$</font> to him and have it crafted into a <font color="#ffd200">weapon</font>. How about visiting <font color="#ffd200">Harchya</font> at <font color="#ffd200">$map:2000203$</font> first?

If he found the power of balance... though the outcome isn't certain, you could entrust the <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000420$</font> to him and have it crafted into a <font color="#ffd200">weapon</font>. How about visiting <font color="#ffd200">Harchya</font> at <font color="#ffd200">$map:2000203$</font> first?
Did you come to commission a weapon? I don't just make any weapon.
Asks if he knows a blacksmith named Harchya.
Blacksmith Harchya? Of course I know! How could I possibly not know my own <font color="#ffd200">great-grandfather</font>'s name?
My great-grandfather's name was Harchya. But how do you know that name? I'm more curious about that.

Hmm... You're right. He certainly was. Unfortunately, my great-grandfather never found the <font color="#ffd200">power of balance</font>. But fortunately, I was able to find a clue. About that <font color="#ffd200">power of balance</font> he had been searching for.
Says they heard he was searching for something called the power of balance.

Given that it's also known as the <font color="#ffd200">Magical Harmony Stone, or Balance Stone</font>, it must certainly be the very <font color="#ffd200">power of balance</font> my great-grandfather had been searching for.
Asks what it is.

It's a mineral called <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000421$</font>. They say it's a mineral that channels unstable, expanding intangible energy into one place and constantly seeks <font color="#ffd200">balance</font>.
Shows the Essence of Infinity to $npc:11001211[gender:0]$.

The problem was that even though I knew this ore existed, I couldn't obtain it. Moreover, even if I found this mineral, the <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000421$</font> merely serves to balance powerful forces. If there's no power to balance in the first place, it's useless, isn't it?
...?!! What kind of mineral is this?
Says it's not a mineral, but a purified essence obtained from $npc:23190005[gender:0]$'s blood.

Y-You got this from $npc:23190005[gender:0]$? Ha! You just keep saying the most surprising things... In any case, this is power that came from the infamous $npc:23190005[gender:0]$, right? Yes... yes. This is it, this is it!

It's a bit concerning that it's a shattered fragment and unstable... No wait, no. Fragments can be joined back together anyway... But would that make it take a complete form? However, if I could smelt the <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000421$</font> with the <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000420$</font>... Then I'd need the <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000421$</font>... This is troublesome.
Asks what the problem is.
Says they want to hear the good news first.

Ah! Sorry. I forgot you were even here for a moment. I have <font color="#ffd200">one piece of good news</font> and <font color="#ffd200">two pieces of bad news</font>. Which would you like to hear first?

The good news is that if we can properly combine the power of the <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000420$</font> with the balancing power of the <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000421$</font>, I believe we could create a weapon the world has never seen before. The weapon my ancestors so desperately wanted.
Asks what the bad news is then.
Says that enough has been explained, and asks to just tell them what needs to be done.

Second, naturally, a <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000421$</font> is needed. Until now, I only knew of its existence but couldn't obtain one since I didn't know where to find it... Recently, a group called the <font color="#ffd200">Arikari Trading Company</font> arrived at <font color="#ffd200">$map:2000064$</font> from across the sea.

There are two problems. First, the <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000420$</font> you brought, as you well know... is ultimately just a fragment, isn't it? It holds unstable power. To unleash its full potential, <font color="#ffd200">more fragments are needed</font>.

It's an ore that couldn't be found anywhere on Victoria Island... Perhaps those traders might know something about it? You'll need to seek out the <font color="#ffd200">Arikari Trading Company</font> at <font color="#ffd200">$map:2000064$</font> and obtain a <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000421$</font>.

My, what an impatient one! To put it simply... here's the key point. The <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000420$</font> you brought is merely a fragment, but if we had more essence, I believe I could refine it into its complete form and forge it into a weapon.

And a <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000421$</font> is absolutely essential to suppress and control the power held within the <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000420$</font>. You probably know better how to obtain more <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000420$</font>... As for the $item:30000421$, you'll need to visit the <font color="#ffd200">Arikari Trading Company</font> at <font color="#ffd200">$map:2000064$</font> and look into it. Do you understand what I'm saying?
Says that enough has been explained, and asks to just tell them what needs to be done.

Let me say it once more... I need two materials. As you know, the <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000420$</font> is merely a fragment, so more essence is required. Only then can I attempt to refine it into its complete form.

In any case, if you gather both materials as I've described... then I'll be able to do what needs to be done, won't I? In the meantime, I'll have the shape of your weapon <font color="#ffd200">prepared</font> in advance.

Oho! At last... you've truly worked hard! While you were gathering the materials, I've already <font color="#ffd200">crafted</font> the weapon you'll be using. But in this state, it's no different from any other weapon. Now I'll infuse these materials to <font color="#ffd200">complete</font> the real weapon, so would you wait just a moment?

And a <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000421$</font> is absolutely essential to suppress and control the power held within the <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000420$</font>. You probably know better how to obtain more <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000420$</font>... As for the $item:30000421$, you'll need to visit the <font color="#ffd200">Arikari Trading Company</font> at <font color="#ffd200">$map:2000064$</font> and look into it. Do you understand what I'm saying?

In any case, if you gather both materials as I've described... then I'll be able to do what needs to be done, won't I? In the meantime, I'll have the shape of your weapon <font color="#ffd200">prepared</font> in advance.
Says they will wait.
... ... <font color="#909090">(It would be best to keep waiting so $npc:11001211[gender:0]$ can concentrate.)</font>

Waits a little longer.
... ... <font color="#909090">(Let's wait just a little longer so $npc:11001211[gender:0]$ can concentrate.)</font>

Ugh... h-how can this be... I managed to infuse all the power of the <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000420$</font> and <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000421$</font> into the weapon, but the essence's power expanded at an explosive rate. On top of that, the energy I originally sensed from the $item:30000420$ vanished somewhere... and an <font color="#ffd200">ominous magical power</font> enveloped the weapon... How did things turn out like this…
I'm truly ashamed to face you. But please trust me. I will find a way to <font color="#ffd200">restore the weapon</font>, no matter what!
In its current state... as you can see, it can't be used. To think I poured such powerful energy into it and still made a weapon that can't be used…
By the way, may I ask how you know <font color="#ffd200">that guest</font>? I'm afraid I can't share <font color="#ffd200">guest information</font> with just anyone…
Says they are that person's apprentice.
Ah, I see! Well then... let me take a look. Guest registry... $npc:11001246[gender:0]$... $npc:11001246[gender:0]$…
You've arrived? <font color="#ffd200">$MyPCName$.</font> This must have been your first time experiencing <font color="#ffd200">long-distance teleportation</font>. Well done getting here.
The $npc:11001246[gender:0]$ you're looking for is staying in <font color="#ffd200">Room 215</font>. From where you are, take the stairs on the left and it'll be right there.
Here it is! $npc:11001246[gender:0]$ is staying in <font color="#ffd200">Room 215</font>. From where you are, take the stairs on the left and it'll be right there.
Hmm... if things had gone according to plan... I would have been meeting with <font color="#ffd200">officials from $map:2000001$'s royal court</font> by now, but things went awry.

According to those accounts, the knowledge left by the ancestors remains intact <font color="#ffd200">somewhere on Victoria Island</font>. In Teruncaleb, this knowledge is collectively known as the <font color="#ffd200">Wisdom of Baz</font>.

Yes. According to oral traditions passed down in Teruncaleb, long ago, <font color="#ffd200">the ancient ancestors left behind knowledge for future generations</font> somewhere on Victoria Island. But when the forces of darkness known as the <font color="#ffd200">Shadow Legion</font> engulfed Victoria Island... the ancestors cast a <font color="#ffd200">Runic Veil</font> to hide the knowledge from prying eyes.

But for us Rune Bladers, whose homeland is Calibre Island, finding the Wisdom of Baz on Victoria Island is no easy task. On top of that, the <font color="#ffd200">Runic Veil</font> cast by the ancestors to evade the forces of evil makes the location of the Wisdom of Baz even harder to discern.
Asks if that's why an ally is needed.
Asks if it wasn't $npc:11001231[gender:0]$ we were pursuing.

$MyPCName$, you're right. We seek the Wisdom of Baz <font color="#ffd200">in order to pursue Holstadt</font>. Judging by his actions on Calibre Island, what he's after is believed to be the Wisdom of Baz. Specifically, the legendary knowledge said to contain the <font color="#ffd200">ultimate secret technique</font>.

I thought the $npcTitle:11000075[gender:1]$, who rules Victoria Island, could be of great help to us. But upon arriving here, I found that <font color="#ffd200">the $npcTitle:11000075[gender:1]$'s audience</font> had been cancelled and things were in an uproar. As a result, I couldn't even meet a single high-ranking official, let alone the $npcTitle:11000075[gender:1]$. Given the situation, we'll try to find the <font color="#ffd200">Wisdom of Baz</font> with our own strength.

You see it clearly. That is your master's plan. That's why we must find the <font color="#ffd200">location of the Wisdom of Baz</font> as quickly as possible. What we need in this unfamiliar land is <font color="#ffd200">information</font>. According to oral tradition, the Wisdom of Baz can be considered a type of ruin.
Says that means if we search for the Wisdom of Baz, we might encounter $npc:11001231[gender:0]$.

From what I've learned, the <font color="#ffd200">$map:2000031$</font> in $map:2000001$ boasts a long history despite its modest appearance. The woman known as <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000005[gender:1]$</font> is said to be quite a capable librarian, so I believe we can find <font color="#ffd200">any information</font> we need there.
What brings you here?

From what I've learned, the <font color="#ffd200">$map:2000031$</font> in $map:2000001$ boasts a long history despite its modest appearance. The woman known as <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000005[gender:1]$</font> is said to be quite a capable librarian, so I believe we can find <font color="#ffd200">any information</font> we need there.
The Wisdom of Baz? ...How curious. Someone else asked about that name earlier today…
Says they are looking for documents about a ruin called the Wisdom of Baz.

He was a man with an extremely cold demeanor. I remember him because of his flowing sky-blue hair and the unusual mask he wore.
Hm? You don't look well. Is something the matter?
Says it's nothing.

In any case, when that man asked earlier, there was <font color="#ffd200">a commotion</font> throughout $map:2000001$... and I couldn't find any related information, so I had to send him away. But after some time passed, I looked through the old librarian records and found something similar.

That's not difficult at all. Though I've only found the <font color="#ffd200">document with the most similar records</font>... Whether this is actually the <font color="#ffd200">Wisdom of Baz</font> you're looking for, even I can't say for certain. And this is the most important part…

It's an old <font color="#ffd200">ancient document</font>, so its condition is quite poor. The written characters are barely legible, and there are <font color="#ffd200">decayed sections</font> throughout. In short, reading this document and extracting any information from it is <font color="#ffd200">impossible</font> in its current state.

There are <font color="#ffd200">specialists</font> for this kind of work, so don't worry too much. If you leave it to <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11001261[gender:0]$</font>, there shouldn't be any major issues.
Asks where to go to find $npc:11001261[gender:0]$.

How many documents do you think are piled up in this library? There are many documents that need preserving, and many that get damaged every year. We can't just incinerate precious documents whenever that happens, can we?

I believe $npc:11001261[gender:0]$ recently went to <font color="#ffd200">$map:52000019$</font> located in <font color="#ffd200">$map:2000014$</font>. If you head there, you should be able to find him.

He travels frequently in search of special materials, so he doesn't have a fixed location. I believe I heard recently that he went to <font color="#ffd200">$map:52000019$</font> located in <font color="#ffd200">$map:2000014$</font>... If you head there, you should be able to find him.

I'm collecting special materials. My line of work involves <font color="#ffd200">restoring worn items to look like new</font> — things like old documents or tarnished accessories. I often use the <font color="#ffd200">secretions</font> of larvae like $npc:21000074$ as an important material for my work.
Asks what on earth he's doing here.
Shh, shh! Quietly, quietly! Be careful not to wake the $npc:21000074$!
Says that sounds like it could be quite dangerous work.

I wouldn't call it extremely dangerous, but I can't say it's safe either. Those $npc:21000074$ creatures <font color="#ffd200">get violent quickly</font> if you disturb their nests. Hmm~ now that I look at it, you've got quite a fine weapon there, don't you?
If you could assist me with my work, things would go much more smoothly... Oh, right! I found some <font color="#ffd200">items</font> while gathering materials nearby!
If you're going to help me, you'll need to wear at least this much. Here, take it!

The work is relatively simple. We'll walk around this pit and <font color="#ffd200">collect secretions</font> from the $npc:21000074$' nests. Hopefully it won't come to this, but if the critters pop out and <font color="#ffd200">attack</font>... you just need to swing that fine weapon of yours around! Swoosh, swoosh!
Says there's a favor to ask once this is done.
Hm? What kind of favor?
Says there's an ancient document that needs to be restored.

An <font color="#ffd200">ancient document</font>? Heh, quite the impatient one, aren't you. ...Well, fine, fine! My work comes first, so let's save that conversation for later. Anyway... shall we <font color="#ffd200">get to work</font> then?
Anyway... shall we <font color="#ffd200">get to work</font> then?
Asks him to restore the ancient document.
Whew... thanks to you, the material gathering wrapped up safely. Now what was it you said earlier...? Something about a document or something…
Says they came on $npc:11000005[gender:1]$'s recommendation.
Ah, right! The ancient document. But you know... have we met before? I was so focused on my work earlier that I didn't notice, but now that I think about it, I don't think I've seen you before.
Of course, of course, I figured as much. I could tell right away when you asked me to restore an ancient document. I was certain I didn't know you...
In any case, since you helped me out, I should naturally <font color="#ffd200">return the favor</font>. So, where is this ancient document you want restored?
The fact that you came all the way here to ask me told me everything I needed to know.
Then I'll need to go there and check it out in person first. Leave it to me. I'll take care of it.
Says it's at the $map:2000031$.
Asks how long the restoration will take.

It's all because I travel around gathering materials needed for restoration. If you want to see a fully restored document, it will take <font color="#ffd200">quite some time</font>. Well, I am a seasoned expert, so I'll try to work as fast as I can…

Document restoration depends on the document's material and age — different conditions mean different levels of restoration. Restoration itself, even at its best, only achieves about 7 or 8 out of 10 compared to the original. On top of that, the restoration process requires special materials. That's why I'm not stationed in $map:2000001$ but wandering around in the field.
You're later than expected. Was there some problem finding information at the $map:2000031$?
I'll head to the $map:2000031$ soon and start working on it, so don't worry too much. Once the document restoration is finished, I'll <font color="#ffd200">contact</font> you.
I'll head to the $map:2000031$ soon and start working on it, so don't worry too much. Once the document restoration is finished, I'll contact you.

It'll take some time to restore the document... but still, well done. Good work. What concerns me more is that $npc:11001231[gender:0]$ visited the <font color="#ffd200">$map:2000031$</font>. At least it means he didn't obtain any information, right?
Explains everything that happened to their master.
Says that according to $npc:11000005[gender:1]$, no information was given to him.

From what I've learned, the peddler organization known as the Barota Trading Company is so vast that a considerable number of peddlers are spread across <font color="#ffd200">all parts of Victoria Island</font>. Since they travel around doing business, they would naturally <font color="#ffd200">see and hear</font> a great deal…
Hmm... now that we know $npc:11001231[gender:0]$ is making moves on his own... we can't just sit idly by either.
Asks them to repeat what they just said.
We can't just wait around for the document to be restored. If we could borrow the Barota Trading Company's <font color="#ffd200">intelligence network</font>, that would be ideal. What do you think?

Ugh... were you spacing out again?! Forget it, forget it. Just follow my decision on this. I noticed a Barota Trading Company merchant named <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000484[gender:0]$</font> here in $map:2000033$. Go to him and find out whether the Barota Trading Company has the kind of <font color="#ffd200">intelligence</font> worth seeking their cooperation.
Enthusiastically agrees that their master is absolutely right.
Says they agree with their master's idea.

I asked for your opinion and you just gave a half-hearted answer... Forget it, forget it. Just follow my decision on this. I noticed a Barota Trading Company merchant named <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000484[gender:0]$</font> here in $map:2000033$. Go to him and find out whether the Barota Trading Company has the kind of <font color="#ffd200">intelligence</font> worth seeking their cooperation.

Right. If we can get their cooperation, we should find every means possible. I noticed a Barota Trading Company merchant named <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000484[gender:0]$</font> here in $map:2000033$. Go to him and find out whether the Barota Trading Company has the kind of <font color="#ffd200">intelligence</font> worth seeking their cooperation. Your judgment will be important.
Is there something I can help you with?

You haven't gone yet? <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000484[gender:0]$</font> was here in $map:2000033$. Go to him and find out whether the Barota Trading Company has the kind of <font color="#ffd200">intelligence</font> worth seeking their cooperation.

The Barota Trading Company is the largest <font color="#ffd200">peddler organization</font> on Victoria Island. We have such diverse manpower and trade goods that you can find whatever you need through our peddlers at any time.
Says that an organization of that scale must see and hear quite a lot.
Asks how he knew they were looking for information.

Hmm... customers who deal with the trading company generally fall into <font color="#ffd200">three categories</font>. The first are ordinary people who trade to find things they need. The second are those who buy goods in bulk through the company to turn a profit.
The third category of customers is a bit special... They're <font color="#ffd200">people who want information</font>, just like you.
Would you believe me if I said I can tell exactly what a customer wants just from their facial expression and way of speaking?
Hahaha! I don't know how I might look to you, but... I am a proud veteran peddler of the Barota Trading Company.

Hmm~ so you're looking for ruins. Unfortunately that's not my area of expertise, but I can <font color="#ffd200">recommend</font> a place where you can get information. All peddlers regularly <font color="#ffd200">report</font> local terrain, specialty goods, and other information from the areas they travel through <font color="#ffd200">back to the company</font>.
May I ask what kind of information you're looking for? I might be able to provide some within what I know.
Says they are looking for information about ancient ruins.

The place where all that information gathers is the <font color="#ffd200">$map:52000020$</font> located in <font color="#ffd200">$map:2000139$</font>. If you go there, you should be able to find most any information you need.
Thanks them for being so helpful.

Is there anything else you'd like to ask? You can find the <font color="#ffd200">$map:52000020$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:2000139$</font>. Once you meet <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11001262[gender:0]$</font>, you should be able to get most any information you need.

Haha! Not at all. Just remember, when you get to the <font color="#ffd200">$map:52000020$</font>, be sure to tell the person in charge, <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11001262[gender:0]$</font>, that you were <font color="#ffd200">referred by $npcName:11000484[gender:0]$</font>. That'll be enough.
What? Can't you see I'm busy? What do you want?

Ahh~ so you're a valued cus-to-mer referred by $npc:11000484[gender:0]$. Ahem! Since you say you came on his referral, you probably have a general idea already, but... The information gathered at the $map:52000020$ is strictly considered one of the <font color="#ffd200">products handled by the company</font>.
Says they were referred by $npc:11000484[gender:0]$.
Hmm... if it's about ruins, we have a separate <font color="#ffd200">catalog</font> that's managed for that, so I'll need to check. Ruins, ruins... that document was around here somewhere…

The <font color="#ffd200">compensation</font> varies depending on what kind of information you want. Not all information is classified at the same grade, after all. So, what kind of information is our dear customer looking for? Let's hear it.
Says they are looking for a ruin called the Wisdom of Baz.
Asks what he means by "gone."
...Damn... it's gone again…
The entire document with the recorded information has gone missing. Damn, how many times has this been <font color="#ffd200">now</font>…
Asks if it wasn't simply lost... but rather stolen.
Hmm... that's right. Recently, the number of <font color="#ffd200">stolen documents</font> has been far from small.

The VIP customer list for the Barota Trading Company was also stolen recently... And high-grade information classified as A-rank or even S-rank has been disappearing <font color="#ffd200">frequently</font>.

They are... Hm?! I just heard a strange sound from the <font color="#ffd200">entrance</font>…
Asks who it might be.
As the Barota Trading Company has grown, we've inevitably made many enemies without even realizing it. ...There's no shortage of suspects. It's not that I have no idea at all, but…
Asks what sound he's talking about.
I heard some kind of eerie sound just now... Maybe I'm just on edge because of all the thefts... Just in case, could you check the area near the <font color="#ffd200">entrance</font>?
I heard some kind of eerie sound just now... Maybe I'm just on edge because of all the thefts... Just in case, could you check the area near the entrance?
Among the intruders, there was a <font color="#ffd200">face I recognized</font>.
Assassins... the previous disappearance of the customer list and S-rank information must all be connected to them.
A man named Gieph. Everyone who knows him called him Gieph the Mighty. I had known him as someone unaffiliated with any organization... Apparently I was mistaken.

Come to think of it, since the <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11001231[gender:0]$ incident</font>, I haven't had any <font color="#ffd200">time to mentor</font> you. This works out well. It's been a while since I've given you some guidance — care to listen?

$MyPCName$, you little... saying that with a straight face. Forget it, forget it. You don't have to force yourself to <font color="#ffd200">humor your master</font>. I can tell from your expression alone that you're already bored…

But just as all things in nature have different properties... the level of skills each Rune Blader has mastered can never be exactly the same.

In other words, the <font color="#ffd200">type and quantity</font> of upgrade materials needed for each skill varies <font color="#ffd200">enormously</font>. Keep that in mind. The basic material, <font color="#ffd200">$item:40100001$</font>, was rarely seen back on Calibre Island. But here on Victoria Island, the situation seems to be somewhat different.

Here, you can mainly obtain them from <font color="#ffd200">general goods merchants</font>... so compared to back on Calibre Island, <font color="#ffd200">skill upgrades</font> should be relatively easier. However, that only applies to $item:40100001$. Other materials are said to occasionally drop from defeating <font color="#ffd200">powerful monsters</font>.
Says that whatever monster it is, this apprentice can cut it down in a single strike.

Says they will exercise restraint as their master advises.
Listen well. I don't want to see you in danger again. Every master feels the <font color="#ffd200">same way</font>. Ahem! A-anyway, just keep that in mind for now.
Hmm... $MyPCName$. You haven't forgotten about the skill upgrades I told you about last time, have you? You've been keeping up with them diligently, right?
If you're short on materials, visiting a <font color="#ffd200">general goods shop</font> would be one option. $MyPCName$, always devote yourself to training, again and again.

Haah... as I've always warned you, you're constantly lacking in <font color="#ffd200">patience</font>. Remember — a truly strong person doesn't rashly boast about their strength. For now, I'll give you the <font color="#ffd200">$item:40100001$</font> I obtained — try <font color="#ffd200">opening the skill window and upgrading</font>.

To upgrade skills beyond a certain level, you'll need special crystals in addition to the $item:40100001$ I mentioned before. Those called <font color="#ffd200">$item:40100002$</font> and <font color="#ffd200">$item:40100003$</font> are exactly that... Hm?! This kid, you're zoning out with that bored look again!

Haha! Answers with certainty: it was definitely Soul Crystal.
Confidently answers: Rune Crystal.
Answers: they think it was... Red Crystal.
Grr... $MyPCName$, you brat! Didn't I say <font color="#ffd200">$item:40100002$ and $item:40100003$</font>?!
S-says they'll make sure to remember next time.
S-says they'll make sure to remember next time.
You fool! "With certainty" — Soul Crystal? Really?! Didn't I say <font color="#ffd200">$item:40100002$ and $item:40100003$</font>?! Grr... what a headache…

Right... crystals like Red and Blue are highly rare. But because they're so special, they're not easy to obtain — you can only get them by defeating <font color="#ffd200">extremely powerful-grade monsters</font>. Absolutely do NOT try to face them <font color="#ffd200">a-lo-ne</font>, $MyPCName$.

...Right. Even someone as wild as you should understand by now. By the way, I had something to give you but can't remember where I put it... Wait just a moment.

Here it is. <font color="#ffd200">$item:40100002$.</font> I received this from Master Arazad long ago and had been meaning to give it to you. It'll be very useful when you <font color="#ffd200">upgrade active skills</font>, so remember that.

Haah... $MyPCName$. I know well that the path of learning is not an easy one, having walked it myself. But you must cultivate the <font color="#ffd200">habit of always being vigilant with yourself</font>. After all, your master cannot be <font color="#ffd200">with you</font> forever…
Says they will keep seeking their master's teachings even if told not to.
This kid... always running their mouth... In any case, I say this because I recognize the effort you've put in, fighting hard in this unfamiliar land to follow me. Please take it to heart.

Finally! Professor Makan poured so much effort into this... The test results are an incomparable <font color="#ffd200">huge success</font> compared to before. Let's see... the last time Bomar rode Dungdungi was <font color="#ffd200">data set #812</font>... And the results just now are <font color="#ffd200">data set #815</font>…
...Wind controller loss rate 11%... Directional tracking guidance system operating rate 88%... Main detector accuracy... <font color="#ffd200">99</font>%?!
Heh, based on this data... Both $npcName:11001405[gender:0]$ and Dungdungi have undoubtedly arrived safely on Karkar Island.

Of course. According to this data, it should be possible anytime from now on. Since you said you're looking for $npcName:11001405[gender:0]$, if you talk to <font color="#ffd200">Professor $npcName:11001276[gender:0]$</font>, you'll be able to <font color="#ffd200">use</font> <font color="#ffd200">Dungdungi</font>. ...! Oh! Right, right! Hold on a moment!

When $npcName:11001405[gender:0]$ departed, Professor $npcName:11001276[gender:0]$'s other assistant <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11001403[gender:0]$</font> went along too. The last destination recorded was <font color="#ffd200">$map:02010043$</font>, so... you should be able to find Lakaphoni there.

$npcName:11001403[gender:0]$... a careless and willful fellow, but... still, as Professor $npcName:11001276[gender:0]$'s assistant, he should be preparing the settings for Dungdungi's return trip to $map:02000183$.
Asks what's the matter.
Hm? Is something wrong?
When you meet him, please deliver this <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000486$</font>. It's a manual with the latest data recorded... it should help with Dungdungi's fine-tuning.
Hmm... you should have been more careful with it. Here, I'll give you another one, so don't lose it this time!
Says it's nothing.
Says they lost the $item:30000486$.
That can't be... check again. You definitely took it earlier.
Oh dear... your bag is that full... sigh... that's a lot of junk. Please organize it first.
Hey, I just saw you get off Dungdungi... You definitely came from $map:02000183$, right?
Heh... how dull... If you're interested in me, you can just come right out and say it... heh.
Says yes.
Ooh!! If you arrived here safely, that means this was another perfect flight! I think we can stop the flight tests for Dungdungi now. Heheh…
Says $npcName:11001275[gender:1]$ asked them to deliver the $item:30000486$.
$item:30000486$? Hmm~ if that fastidious $npcName:11001275[gender:1]$ asked you to deliver it... it must be a manual reflecting the latest Dungdungi flight test results.

I was actually in the middle of setting things up for the return trip to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000183$</font>, so this works out great. I don't think there are any major issues right now, but... shall I reinforce the safety a bit more?
Oh, right. So why are you here anyway?
Asks if he knows $npcName:11001405[gender:0]$.
$npcName:11001405[gender:0]$? Of course I know him. With how many flight tests $npcName:11001405[gender:0]$ and I did on Dungdungi to get here to Karkar Island, there's no way I could forget.
Asks if he heard where he went.
Asks where he is now.
Hmm~ looks like you came looking for $npcName:11001405[gender:0]$? Oh man, this is awkward... $npcName:11001405[gender:0]$ already left here…
I'm sure I heard the name... ugh... I just can't seem to remember. What was it... it was a really unusual name…
I didn't hear the details either, but... He said he was going to meet <font color="#ffd200">someone</font> who lives in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02010084$</font>.
Anyway, that's all I heard. If you're looking for $npcName:11001405[gender:0]$, try meeting <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11001404[gender:1]$</font> in $map:02010084$ first.

It was something like chi... something or other... Puchi... Uchi... no, no. That wasn't it... Ttu... Ah! Ah! I remember now. Ttu! The name was <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11001404[gender:1]$</font>.
Tells him to think harder.
You look like you're traveling? You seem quite tired — how about resting at our guest house?
If you're looking for $npcName:11001405[gender:0]$, try meeting <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11001404[gender:1]$</font> in $map:02010084$ first.

Well... while $npcName:11001405[gender:0]$ was staying here briefly, he received a <font color="#ffd200">letter</font>... I don't know what was written in it, but he turned <font color="#ffd200">pale</font> and left in a rush.

It hasn't been long since he left, so he can't have gone far... If you meet $npcName:11001405[gender:0]$ at $map:02010002$, please tell him I'm worried and send my <font color="#ffd200">regards</font>.

Please forget what I just said. No — let's just say we never met today... Once this is over, I'll definitely go back for $npcName:11001274[gender:0]$ myself.

As patients began appearing in the village one by one, the villagers' <font color="#ffd200">anxiety</font> grew... so we gathered them together and had them stay at $map:02010005$. It's essentially a form of <font color="#ffd200">quarantine</font>.

Hmm... says they'd like to see the patients in person.
Says they didn't sense such a serious atmosphere in the village.
They're just keeping it quiet and hushing things up. Some people have done <font color="#ffd200">terrible things</font> to the people at $map:02010005$, but... everyone just looks the other way.
I don't think you'd have any <font color="#ffd200">clever solution</font>, but... meeting the patients shouldn't be a particular problem. $map:02010005$ is located north of Minar.
I don't think you'd have any <font color="#ffd200">clever solution</font>, but... meeting the patients shouldn't be a particular problem. $map:02010005$ is located north of Minar.
Says they're not here to bully anyone.
Wh-what are you here for? We're not sick anymore! ...So please don't bully us…
Th-then...? This is a place nobody wants to come near…
Says they came after hearing about a strange disease going around the village.
I see... I thought you came to bully us too…
Asks if the villagers were the ones who trashed this place.

People came and smashed the furniture in this hut, threw garbage, and screamed at us... They say we're cursed... So everyone was afraid to come here, but <font color="#ffd200">that older sister</font> was different.
$npcName:11001396[gender:1]$. She even linked pinkies with me and made a <font color="#ffd200">promise</font>. She said she would absolutely find a way to cure the disease!

That's not true! $npcName:11001396[gender:1]$ is known as the <font color="#ffd200">$npcTitle:11001396[gender:1]$</font> in the village! Someone like her made a <font color="#ffd200">promise</font>…
...Asks where $npcName:11001396[gender:1]$ is right now.
That... I don't know either. She definitely said she'd come back after just two nights... ...She didn't abandon us, did she...?

Her father, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11001390[gender:0]$</font>, lives in <font color="#ffd200">Minar</font>. If you ask him about <font color="#ffd200">her whereabouts</font>... maybe he would know?

Her father, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11001390[gender:0]$</font>, lives in <font color="#ffd200">Minar</font>. If you ask him about <font color="#ffd200">her whereabouts</font>... maybe he would know?

$npcName:11001396[gender:1]$ is my <font color="#ffd200">daughter</font>... What business do you have with her...?

$npcName:11001396[gender:1]$ already left $map:02010063$. She's always loved observing and researching ruins... I thought this was just another one of those trips, but to think she promised to find a cure…

Of course, she doesn't have a bad habit of being arrogant, but... she tends to take all the burden onto herself. Since she's never faced a problem she couldn't solve until now, it hasn't been an issue per se... but I'm always <font color="#ffd200">worried</font>. Someday when she faces an insurmountable <font color="#ffd200">wall</font>…
My daughter said she was heading to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02010023$</font>, so you should be able to find her there.

Hm...I see. The <font color="#ffd200">promised date</font> with $npcName:11001392[gender:1]$ has already passed. It's taking longer than I expected because finding clues hasn't been easy.

After steadily observing the vast ruins spread across $map:02010023$, I noticed that <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:21000674$</font> appearing near the ruins were carrying suspicious tablet fragments. It's not easy for me, but... I think it would be simple for you. Retrieve the <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000503$</font> that <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:21000674$</font> are carrying and bring them to me. Can you do it?

Retrieve the <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000503$</font> from <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:21000674$</font> and bring them to me. They appear all over $map:02010023$, so they shouldn't be hard to find.

So this is the <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000503$</font> that $npcName:21000674$ were carrying. I expected as much, but sure enough... the language written on this tablet is <font color="#ffd200">unfamiliar</font>.
It's not a language I can read. ...But if it's <font color="#ffd200">that person</font>…

Have you heard of the <font color="#ffd200">Moropapa Tribe</font> that resides here in $map:02010023$? The Moropapa Tribe is renowned for having many members with extensive knowledge in various fields. If we ask them, I believe we can decipher the contents of this tablet.
I don't know how much progress his research has yielded... But I'm convinced this $item:30000503$ could be a <font color="#ffd200">clue</font>.

<font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11001397[gender:0]$</font>, a Moropapa tribe member I met while investigating the ruins of $map:02010023$. I once had a brief conversation with him about the disease $npcName:11001392[gender:1]$ is suffering from... After hearing the situation, he said he would conduct his own research.
When you find him, please ask him to decipher what's written on the <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000503$</font>.
Asks where to find $npcName:11001397[gender:0]$.
He should be somewhere in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02010023$</font>... Since he dislikes crowded places, he's probably in a secluded area.
Haven't you left yet? Did you forget something?
Says that they lost the $item:30000503$.
Good thing I kept a spare tablet fragment. Here, take it.
I should have already given you the $item:30000503$. Please check again.
Says they just wanted to talk.

Surely you haven't already forgotten what I asked? $npcName:11001397[gender:0]$ must be somewhere in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02010023$</font>. I'm certain he can decipher what's written on the $item:30000503$.
Do you have room for the $item:30000503$? Have you organized your bag?
Really?! That's... an unexpected breakthrough!
You're back already! Did you meet with $npcName:11001397[gender:0]$?
Tells her about the elixir received from $npcName:11001397[gender:0]$.
Says she looks happy.

Indeed, that $item:30000503$ was the clue after all. If it's an elixir that $npcName:11001397[gender:0]$ made based on it, we can trust it. Finally, I can keep my <font color="#ffd200">promise</font> to $npcName:11001392[gender:1]$.

Of course, right?! Could you deliver this <font color="#ffd200">good news</font> and the <font color="#ffd200">elixir</font> to $npcName:11001392[gender:1]$ in $map:02010005$? I need to organize some records about the ruins, so I can't leave right away.
Says that $npcName:11001392[gender:1]$ will surely be overjoyed to hear this news.
Do I? Thinking that I can finally keep my promise to $npcName:11001392[gender:1]$... I can't help but…
Thank you. Once I'm finished here, I'll come visit $npcName:11001392[gender:1]$ too.
Says they will go see $npcName:11001392[gender:1]$.
Says they lost the $item:30000504$.
Says it's nothing.
Did you forget something again?
I should have already given you the $item:30000504$. Please check again.
It's an important elixir, so don't lose it again. Here, take it.
Do you have room for the $item:30000504$? Have you organized your bag?
Did you find $npcName:11001396[gender:1]$?

Then please hurry and deliver this <font color="#ffd200">good news</font> and the <font color="#ffd200">elixir</font> to $npcName:11001392[gender:1]$ in $map:02010005$. Once I'm finished here, I'll come visit $npcName:11001392[gender:1]$ too.
Says they not only found $npcName:11001396[gender:1]$, but also brought medicine to cure the disease.
Really?! I knew it, she didn't break her promise! I didn't even realize... I <font color="#ffd200">doubted</font> her…
Says she'll definitely be able to run and play like before she got sick.
Is this the medicine from $npcName:11001396[gender:1]$? If I drink this, will I feel energetic like before?
Thank you. I'll drink it now.

*gulp*...*gulp*...

...Ahh! I finished it all! I just drank the medicine, but I already feel like I'll get better soon!
No. Since it's from her, I can tru...trus... My...my throat…
... ... <font color="#909090">($npcName:11001392[gender:1]$ looks like she's trying to say something urgently, but no sound can be heard)</font>
?! Asks what's wrong.
Liar! That's a lie! If that was really medicine to cure the disease, then why can't my sister speak?!
Says they gave her the medicine received from $npcName:11001396[gender:1]$.
Wh-what on earth did you give $npcName:11001392[gender:1]$?!
Says they're...not sure.

I knew it, all <font color="#ffd200">promises</font> people make are <font color="#ffd200">lies</font>! When we got sick, Mom and Dad said they'd be back after one night then <font color="#ffd200">ran away</font>... People <font color="#ffd200">pointed fingers</font> at us, saying we were cursed.
And now the one person my sister trusted gives her <font color="#ffd200">fake medicine</font>... stealing my sister's voice... What did we do so <font color="#ffd200">wrong</font>?! Tell me!
Apologizes, saying they're sorry about what happened.

I don't need your apology... Just go away... Tell $npcName:11001396[gender:1]$ this: we will never <font color="#ffd200">forgive</font> her... *sob*...$npcName:11001392[gender:1]$...big brother is sorry...please say something...*sob*…
How is $npcName:11001392[gender:1]$ doing? Has the disease improved?
