The <font color="#ffd200">Ramestone</font> must be inside <font color="#ffd200">$map:02010055$</font> somewhere within Nazkar Temple. What worries me... is that the power of light illuminating the temple is very unstable. Chaotic and turbulent light... it means some powerful being is threatening the remaining power of light here.
The monsters currently occupying Nazkar Temple along with the deep darkness... It's most likely that one of them has this map.

Right now, recovering the <font color="#ffd200">Ramestone</font> is the most urgent priority—for the Lumieragons, for $npcName:11000735[gender:1]$, and for us. The Dragon Knights have gone to search for the Nazkar Temple map to locate <font color="#ffd200">$map:02010055$</font> where the <font color="#ffd200">Ramestone</font> should be. Please lend your strength too, $MyPCName$.
Asks where to find the Nazkar Temple map.
Oh... dear... it's been torn... Can we find <font color="#ffd200">$map:02010055$</font> with this alone...
Hands over the $item:30000513$.
Ah... I saw them!! I saw them rush through that door up ahead like lightning! I thought they were ghosts!
Asks if Moor has seen $npcName:11001216[gender:0]$, $npcName:11001217[gender:0]$, and $npcName:11001218[gender:1]$ nearby.
Confirms it.

And... if the fate of light is guiding $npcName:11000735[gender:1]$... Just as the ancient Lumieragons did, may that child also be reborn as a true <font color="#ffd200">Heir of Light</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:52010007$</font>...
Then... you should help your friends... You can't just abandon them because you're scared and run away...
Let us hope that $npcName:11000735[gender:1]$ recovers her strength and regains the power of light soon. May the light of the Lumieragons protect that child...!
The... Nazkar Temple goes rumble rumble rumble... crash... and collapses, and in its place a massive black vortex swirls... And inside it, a huge black dragon is spreading its wings wide...
Asks what kind of nightmares they're having.

Nazkar Temple was a sacred temple of golden dragons a very, very long time ago... Surely the terrible things in grandfather's dream won't actually happen, right? No... but what if there really is a black dragon awakening deep inside that temple?
I'm so scared... and anxious... I feel like I'll start having nightmares too... $MyPCName$, could you please look into whether something has really happened inside that temple?
Tells Moor about $npcName:11001215[gender:1]$'s story.
Tells Moor that the Dark Kargons are after the Ramestone.
Ooh... that dream... seems half right... and half not... I'm not sure...

<font color="#ffd200">Ramestone</font>? The stone of light... I think I've heard of it! Creatures called Kargons are after it? Uwaaah... This is urgent intel! I need to tell my comrades as soon as they come looking for me!
The Moropapa Tribe needs to know too! Our scouts will relay the message to $npcName:11001215[gender:1]$ as well...!
Asks if it's about $npc:23090005[gender:0]$'s weapon.
Oh, isn't that $MyPCName$! Come see me for a moment. I heard a <font color="#ffd200">strange story</font> recently and I thought I absolutely had to tell you.

It's a bit ambiguous, but... it's definitely an interesting story. A <font color="#ffd200">shaman</font> who said he came from <font color="#ffd200">another continent</font> visited here recently. Introducing himself as someone who researches demons, he asked the blacksmiths here if they'd heard rumors of a <font color="#ffd200">powerful demon surrounded by scorching heat</font>.

He left for $map:02000200$ looking quite pleased. And he left behind some very intriguing words: <font color="#ffd200">"I will enter the demon's consciousness and find a way to break the curse."</font>

That <font color="#ffd200">$npc:23090005[gender:0]$</font> you defeated came to mind, so I told him what I heard from you. He showed tremendous interest. So I told him you can reach $npcName:23090005[gender:0]$'s lair from somewhere in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000200$</font>.
If that shaman's story is true, then the <font color="#ffd200">bizarre curse</font> on your weapon could also be lifted. What do you say? Nothing to lose... worth a try, isn't it?

According to ancient records, to defeat demons with great power, you must <font color="#ffd200">enter the demon's consciousness</font> during the brief moment when its power weakens. If you identify the essence of that being deep within its consciousness, you can not only discover its weakness but also find <font color="#ffd200">a way to break its curse</font>.
Asks what all that means.

You'd be better off asking the shaman directly. He only left for <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000200$</font> recently, so hurry and go. His name was <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11001485[gender:0]$</font>.
Asks how to enter the demon's consciousness.

That shaman called <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11001485[gender:0]$</font> left for <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000200$</font>. He wore his cloak pulled low, and there was a strange aura about him. Go to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000200$</font> and find him.
...I definitely heard a sound. Something seems to have changed. Damn. If only it weren't so dark in here...! This cursed <font color="#ffd200">night blindness</font> persists even in monster form…

This demon... <font color="#ffd200">$npc:23090005[gender:0]$</font>... Perhaps this thing is what made me look like <font color="#ffd200">this</font>... I can't go back like this. This isn't right...!
Huh? Someone's there? No, more importantly—how do you know <font color="#ffd200">my name</font>?
Calls out $npc:11001485[gender:0]$'s name.
What brings you all the way to a place this dark? Actually, before that—how do you know my name? Are you a <font color="#ffd200">minion of the demon</font>?
Holds out the $item:13200043$ and asks for help breaking the curse.
No...! What is this terrible curse?! Could this be connected to that demon called <font color="#ffd200">$npc:23090005[gender:0]$</font>? The one that lives here?

I don't know where you heard that, but... yes. That's correct. Ancient records say that if you enter the consciousness of the demon that cast a curse and discover the essence of that being, you can easily break the <font color="#ffd200">demon's curse</font>.
Asks if it's possible to enter $npc:23090005[gender:0]$'s consciousness and break this weapon's curse.

Lately, space-time has been distorting and rifts have been appearing throughout the world... Somewhere around here, a passage seems to have opened into that thing's psyche. Of course, whether you can survive in there is another matter entirely…

We're dealing with a demon of great power. It won't easily let someone infiltrate its consciousness. Normally you'd have to wait for the <font color="#ffd200">moment its power weakens</font>. It differs for each demon— a lunar eclipse, sharing power with a successor, extended midnight sun—you'd have to strike it down during those moments, but...
Asks how to enter $npc:23090005[gender:0]$'s consciousness.

If you still plan to enter $npc:23090005[gender:0]$'s consciousness, I'd like you to describe what you see in detail. Truth is, I was investigating ancient ruins when I suddenly turned into this grotesque form. I think it's because of a <font color="#ffd200">demon's curse</font>, but I have no idea which demon did it. I crossed continents to find out, but... I just keep finding more to research with no answers.
Oh, and you should keep that weapon safe. There's no telling what form the clue to breaking a demon's curse might take. If you don't bring the weapon, you might regret it.
Tells him what happened in $map:52000014$.

If you do enter $npc:23090005[gender:0]$'s consciousness, keep it safe. That weapon, I mean. There's no telling what form the clue to breaking a demon's curse might take. If you don't bring the weapon, you might regret it.
Looks like you made it back in one piece! What was it like inside $npc:23090005[gender:0]$'s consciousness?
The Immortal Flame...! You broke the curse with that scorching heat? To have gone to such a dangerous place and back... <font color="#ffd200">$MyPCName$</font>, well done.
Asks if the curse on $npcName:11001485[gender:0]$ might be related to $npc:23090005[gender:0]$.
Anyway, thanks, $MyPCName$! If you learn of another powerful demon, please come tell me about it.

No, I don't think so. Ever since I became like this, my whole body has been constantly cold. So my curse is probably unrelated to the power of fire. Though it's certainly good to have learned more about the interesting being called $npc:23090005[gender:0]$.

We're dealing with a demon of great power. It won't easily let someone infiltrate its consciousness. Normally you'd have to wait for the <font color="#ffd200">moment its power weakens</font>. It differs for each demon— a lunar eclipse, sharing power with a successor, extended midnight sun—you'd have to strike it down during those moments, but...

Oh, and you should keep that weapon safe. There's no telling what form the clue to breaking a demon's curse might take. If you don't bring the weapon, you might regret it.

I just keep finding more to research with no answers.

Our little kitten is impressive! Captain, can we close the <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:23090006[gender:0]$</font> case now?
It's too early to relax. I can't help feeling <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:23090006[gender:0]$</font> was subdued too easily.
If <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:23090006[gender:0]$</font> is here, <font color="#ffd200">other dangers</font> may exist as well.
Captain, you don't mean...?
You felt it too, didn't you? Familiar yet unfamiliar... an 'alien dark power'…

(You ask them to explain more specifically.)
I can't be certain about this alien dark power. But my 'White Flame Dragon of the Left Hand' tells me this dark power is a crisis that cannot be overlooked.
Heh, still modest as always, $MyPCName$.

If you find out by acting on your own, I won't need to reveal L-class confidential information. First, as my White Flame Dragon of the Left Hand guides... let's start with <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020030$</font>.
I'll be here protecting the world. Don't worry about me and head to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020030$</font>.
Did you arrive safely at <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020030$</font>? Then shall we try installing the 'amplifier'?

Let's use the amplifier capable of detecting dark power, newly developed by the Green Hood technical division.
Anyway... According to the development log, it's described as a 'high-performance amplifier capable of detecting even faint traces of dark power.'
Now, it's time to move.
Please install the amplifiers throughout <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020030$</font>.
Please install the amplifiers throughout <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020030$</font>.

This energy... it's not magic. Now I understand why it felt alien.
Uploading data detected through Green Flower to 'Kate Seed'... analyzing…
My White Flame Dragon of the Left Hand... No, according to my deduction, the machine soldiers should be under the influence of this power right about now.
Please go to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020031$</font> and verify my deduction.
Please go to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020031$</font> and verify my deduction.
Please go to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020031$</font> and verify my deduction.
(You say you investigated the machine soldiers but found no special power influencing them.)
Ah~ ah~ mic test... ah! Ah! $MyPCName$, do you copy?

Oho... defying my deduction? I don't know who's behind this, but it's <font color="#ffd200">quite an elaborate setup</font>. But it's still not time to deploy the 'Book of Causality'—a privilege reserved for high-ranking priest-knights. When that time comes... the world won't be whole.
That said, a power targeting machines rather than living beings... the forces of darkness are quite capable. In a place like 'Kritias,' that would be the more efficient approach.
For a matter like this, there's no one more suited than <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004315[gender:0]$</font>, wouldn't you agree?
For a matter like this, there's no one more suited than <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004315[gender:0]$</font>, wouldn't you agree?
Ahem! It's my turn! I anticipated this and started the energy analysis in advance. When it comes to technical matters, just leave it to me!
$npcName:11004316[gender:0]$'s observation makes sense. In my experience, this looks like a neural network cluster.
Take a look at this. It's a visualization of information collected through Green Flower.
What if we assume they're not human?

Incredible... to process such complex data in an instant. Using any existing processor in Maple World, it would take days... no, years. What kind of being controls such 'highly advanced dark power' alone?

Oh! The data was so fascinating that I couldn't help... This appears to be advanced technology capable of controlling numerous machines simultaneously. Based on a high-density network modeled after biological neural pathways.
This is a highly advanced network. No matter how brilliant a human may be, they can't control such complex power alone.
This is a highly advanced network. No matter how brilliant a human may be, they can't control such complex power alone.

We need more specific information about the being operating this 'highly advanced dark power' that even the first officer finds astonishing. I believe <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004395[gender:1]$</font> can help us.
Well done, $MyPCName$. Let's rendezvous with her together at $map:02020041$.

According to Georg's intelligence, the 'Tyren Kingdom' is a force that uses tremendous scientific and magical power. So we can also suggest the possibility that they're controlled by an 'artificial intelligence entity' that rules over them.
Return for now, $MyPCName$.
Return for now, $MyPCName$.
Your timing is perfect. I was just in communication with <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004395[gender:1]$</font>. About the 'highly advanced dark power' you investigated.
You received my telepathy? $MyPCName$.

Ah, yes... <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004395[gender:1]$</font>, as I explained, we believe this power we discovered is a technology capable of controlling massive numbers of machines simultaneously.

I received the encrypted code you sent. According to our analysis, this signal is 'part' of a network system that controls all machine soldiers in the Tyren Kingdom. Including the machine soldiers here in Kydel.
Based on a high-density network. We expect there must be an entity in Kritias capable of designing and controlling such complex power...
Regardless, we found a common word in the analyzed encrypted code.
The Tyren Kingdom's information should have been thoroughly blocked by firewalls... To intercept their signal... Maple World's technology is not to be underestimated.
The Tyren Kingdom... no, the powerful artificial intelligence that controls everything in Kritias. That's right, it's our primary enemy.
Wait... do you feel that? Another dark energy has been detected... Let me stop what I'm doing and track this power.
You should have no problem, right? Please go confirm what's in that pit.
That crew member was searching for information about monster breeding and nests when they discovered an unidentified pit. However, they were too scared to go inside.
(Says they discovered a cave with Ener ore.)
Ener ore... I'll inform the exploration crew to investigate further.
Good work checking it out.
(Asks what the changed operation is.)
We're going to destroy their eggs.
We're going to enter their habitat and take drastic measures. That is…

It may sound cruel, but it's necessary for the safety of our scouts. Enter the <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020302$</font> habitat in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020006$</font> and destroy their eggs.

We don't have the manpower to dispatch agents right now either, but an alliance is an alliance. We need to help them in some other way.
I heard on the radio that the cannons outside the fortress are malfunctioning. How about checking on the cannons and helping get them operational again?
Right. What matters to me is the safety of our crew, nothing else.
That kind of thing is a piece of cake for my subordinate! Hahaha!
<font color="#909090">(They must be talking about me...)</font>
Can you handle it? Swiftly move to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020033$</font> and check the condition of their cannons, then repair them to working order.

It was worth putting my trust in you. I'll be counting on you going forward as well.
This place, Kritias. I sense something ominous.

In particular, I sense an especially sinister energy from <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020029$</font>, <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020030$</font>, and <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020031$</font>. We can't leave this alone.
Of course, this peace won't last long. When the time comes, I'll be counting on you again.

Please defeat <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020005$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020029$</font>, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020104$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020030$</font>, and <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020202$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020031$</font> to reduce this ominous energy.

<font color="#909090">(Can I really trust this...?)</font>
I received an oracle's prophecy yesterday, and the divine one said... The dark energy monsters existing here in Kritias must be dealt with as soon as possible.
When I hear new voices, I'll ask for your help again.

Now now, hurry and defeat <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020105$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020030$</font> and <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020004$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020029$</font> to reduce the dark energy.

Sigh... You really don't know anything, do you. I'm talking about monsters whose souls have been corrupted, unwillingly engulfed by dark energy. Can you not hear their voices?
I will pray that they may rest in peace.
I heard from an exploration crew member about the monsters in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020006$</font>, and their appearance is quite…

We can't leave them like this. Grant peaceful rest to <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020306$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020006$</font>, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020402$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020004$</font>, and <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020503$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020001$</font>.
<font color="#909090">(Why do I have a bad feeling about this?)</font>
Fascinating.
That's not quite the level of observation I was hoping for. I suppose my expectations were too high.
(Describes what they saw in as much detail as possible.)

I'd like to learn more about them in detail. Could you go to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020006$</font> and closely observe <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020307$</font> and <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020305$</font>?
Good work. Next time, I'd appreciate more detailed observations, please.
(Asks what they're talking about.)
Ah, $MyPCName$. It's just that the situation is getting frustrating. Simply defeating the endless waves of monsters won't change anything.

But you, whom I've acknowledged, are different. Subdue <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020606[gender:0]$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020010$</font>, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020806$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020034$</font>, and <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021006$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020016$</font> to show my faith in you wasn't misplaced.
Recently, I heard rumors that a monster resembling a leader has appeared among them... Our crew alone can't handle it. And I shouldn't use my power recklessly.
(Says it was tough, but manageable.)
As expected of someone I've acknowledged. I never doubted you for a moment.
<font size='45'>?!</font>
While monitoring recent suspicious movements from the Kerbes, I discovered evidence that the Kerbes and the Dark Legion are exchanging information.
<font color="#909090">(Is this something important?)</font>
They are in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020032$</font> and <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020010$</font>.

Improper relationships must be severed quickly. Subdue <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020603$</font>, who appears to be a key informant for the Kerbes, and reduce the numbers of <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020703$</font> who appear to be training in combat with them.
(Says they've taken care of everything.)
It's fortunate we caught their collusion early.
Aren't you curious whether what the researchers said is true?

I thought you'd say that. The monsters that need verification are <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021101$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020051$</font>, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021204$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020017$</font>, and <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021501$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020003$</font>.
(Says they're curious, for now.)
Hmm, so it's just a hypothesis after all. But we should keep investigating.
(Says they're not really sure.)
Get close to observe them, and check whether Ener comes out when they're defeated.
I'm not particularly fond of them, but there are many gun-wielding monsters here, so research on them seems necessary. Know your enemy and know yourself, and you'll win every battle. Heh.

We don't need to examine every monster... Just <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021103$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020051$</font> and <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021407[gender:0]$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020014$</font> should suffice.
(Says it's impossible with their eyes closed.)
Hm? Why are you still here? Get moving.
My, your training is still lacking. No worries, we have plenty of time here.
We need to take a more aggressive approach as well.

Defeat <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021904$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020035$</font>, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25022005$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020036$</font>, and <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021602$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020009$</font> to cut off their lifeline.

Quickly subdue <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021903$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020035$</font> and <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25022001$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020036$</font> to weaken the Dark Legion's forces and make this place safe.
Please go to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020029$</font> and find out who made the mechanical insects, whether they possess life, and if they were made, what their purpose is.
Thanks to your skills and my insight, peace will come to this place sooner than later.
Among them, I'd like to request an investigation of the most conspicuous mechanical insects. Is that alright? These mechanical insects are only found in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020029$</font>.

...No. I'll leave the hands-on inspection to you.
That's an entirely unhelpful opinion for an ecological survey. Well, I'll note it down anyway.
(Says they don't know who made them, but they're cute.)
<font color="#909090">Wh-What?! This black mass...!</font>

We should look into it. Go to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020030$</font> and investigate the dark crystals scattered around, then collect their fragments.
According to a scout, there's a crystal in that area continuously injecting dark power into them. Could that be the cause?
Analyzing this might reveal a way to weaken the Dark Legion's forces. Good work, $MyPCName$.
(Asks what they want.)
We haven't even finished surveying this area yet. But we can't ignore their difficulties, so you'll need to step in again.
The transmission tower in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020030$</font> is being attacked by surrounding monsters. It seems the fences around it were destroyed by monsters. Repairs are needed.
Good work, $MyPCName$. If I need help again, I'll ask.
I wouldn't make such a mistake myself, but well, we must be understanding. I'd like to ease their burden, but I worry they'd feel pressured if I did it personally.
As I thought, $MyPCName$ should help with this. Please assist the researchers and look into the ore in the <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020031$</font> area.
(Asks why they can't just do it themselves.)
Have you considered that if I went, the investigation would end too quickly and the researchers might feel discouraged? Let's preserve the pride of the expedition members exploring unknown lands.
There wasn't any specific explanation of how exactly you helped but... As long as the result is good, that's all that matters. Good work.
Water is said to be the source of life, after all. Though I'm sure you already knew that.
<font color="#909090">(Feels like they're subtly teasing me...)</font>
The Sky Fortress research team is studying the composition and microorganisms of Kritias's emerald-colored water. Analyzing the water's composition can tell us many things about this place.
(Says the water was sparkling and shiny.)

They placed research plant models in the water at <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020001$</font>, and say the data should be collected by now. Please check the research plant models floating in the water at <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020001$</font> and see if there's any reportable data.
You just observed it with your eyes? ...Never mind. Good work, $MyPCName$.

We attempted a trial flight last time, but detected missiles approaching rapidly. It seems they're trying to prevent us from quickly reaching the deeper parts of Kritias through the sky.
(Says there was some dust, but no malfunctions.)
That said, we can't just leave the Sky Fortress sitting idle. It needs to be kept in peak condition so it can move again at any time.
$MyPCName$, please perform regular inspections to ensure the Sky Fortress stays in top condition.
Through continuous experimentation, the Sky Fortress research team has successfully hacked some machine soldiers and turned them into allies.
That's a relief. Please continue checking in the future.
However, the hack doesn't seem to be perfect, so they say these units need to be checked daily for errors.
<font size='45'>!!</font>
How about it, $MyPCName$? Would you go talk to them and check if there are any abnormal signs?
I see. Continuous monitoring will be needed.
(...Says they looked a bit strained, but seemed fine.)
(Senses a suspicious presence.)
It's about... those red berries. The <font color="#ffd200">'thing'</font> you've been collecting often in Maple World.
(Asks if they mean <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000232$</font>.)
Huh? <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000232$</font>?!
What are you talking about, Chief? It seems you've lost not only your eyesight but your hearing as well.
Shh, quietly. Lower your voice. According to the researchers, <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000232$</font> exists here too. They say the taste and 'performance' are identical.

It's not that I need them personally — I'm just curious why <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000232$</font> exists here. For research purposes, could you collect some <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000232$</font>?
Did I hear that wrong...
...Of course I mean it will be used for research purposes. Why are you looking at me like that?

Investigate the sleeping <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020705$</font> scattered throughout <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020032$</font> and secure some <font color="#ffd200">$item:30001299$</font>.
<font color="#ffd200">$item:30001299$</font> can only be obtained when <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020705$</font> is sleeping.
But medicine is always better to have in abundance, so I'll ask again next time.
Go to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020013$</font> and calm the angry Poings until they become docile.
As a holy knight, I cannot simply stand by watching monsters suffer from stress. They must be relieved of their pain.
They seem to be the type that doesn't show much expression. Well, it's the thought that counts. Thank you, $MyPCName$.
A cherry tree in a place full of machines... I really want to secure the cherry blossoms from that tree. Would that be possible?
(Says they might have changed subtly.)
Please, I'm counting on you.
<font color="#909090">(<font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004316[gender:0]$</font> wants flowers?!)</font>
(Teasingly asks who it's for.)
(Says to leave it to them.)
Thank you so much. Please secure the <font color="#ffd200">$item:30001300$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020014$</font>.
That would be…
Myself, heh. Those who shine need beautiful things by their side, after all.
So the Sky Fortress has been regularly dispatching researchers, but one day contact was suddenly lost. I'm worried something might have happened.
(Debates whether to tell the truth, then says everyone's safe and researching hard.)
Could you go to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020014$</font> and check if the researchers are safe?
I think I've heard enough. I'll receive the dispatched researchers' reports personally.

The habitat's location is reportedly near the back of <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020017$</font>. We need to investigate the environment and the <font color="#ffd200">baby Nolraju</font> there, but safety hasn't been secured yet, so it's difficult to send researchers.
$MyPCName$, could you go to the habitat yourself and check if it's safe?
(Says they're not sure, but it seems safe enough for researchers.)
Is that so? Hmm... Let's try sending them on a trial run with combat personnel. Thank you.
Perhaps due to its location, the influence of mechanical civilization is relatively low here. Instead, a very unique plant grows here. It's called the <font color="#ffd200">Tiaman Sky Grass</font>.
Fascinating. The researchers will find these very interesting. I'll let you know if any intriguing research results come up.

I heard the <font color="#ffd200">$item:30001301$</font> that forms on the Tiaman Sky Grass is very rare. Would you be able to get some for me?
The investigator is naturally... you, $MyPCName$.
Ener is the source of power here. If we investigate high-concentration Ener plants and discover how to extract it, it could be very useful.

Ugh, what has Blackbean done this time? Do you know about Blackbean, Maple World's biggest troublemaker lately? Apparently it made balloons that look like itself and scattered them all over Maple World.
Go to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020037$</font> and collect plants that appear to be related to Ener.
We may need a large quantity for accurate analysis. I'll ask again when the time comes.
A magic hat containing Blackbean's gifts — how exciting! Every Friday, Saturday, and Sunday! Want to try finding the Blackbean-shaped balloons?

Did you know Blackbean balloons only appear on Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays? Even Blackbean, who supposedly plays all day, seems to prefer weekends. Oh, and finding those balloons gives you a magic hat, and people are going crazy because amazing items come out of it!

Blackbean balloons are scattered all across Maple World. You can only find them on Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays, and you can receive up to 10 magic hats per day from the balloons, so get searching!
We'll be investigating the nearby areas first. Isn't it exciting already?!
First, to ensure the stability of our exploration, I'd like to start by gathering information on the surrounding monsters.
Ugh, at this rate the monsters might disappear entirely!
But don't let your guard down! We still have an endless lack of data, so I'll be counting on you next time too.

Really?! The reported monsters are <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020101[gender:0]$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020030$</font> and <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020201$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020031$</font>!
(Asks if they need help.)
Observe them with your own eyes, fight them directly, and identify any differences from other monsters! I'm so glad $MyPCName$ is here!
(Says they were just ordinary monsters.)
Was the report wrong? Hmm... It's too early to give up, so I'll need to investigate again. Thank you, $MyPCName$.

We need $MyPCName$'s help! Please defeat <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020405[gender:0]$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020004$</font>, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020502$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020001$</font>, and <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020303$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020006$</font>!

It's just that the agents dispatched to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020004$</font>, <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020001$</font>, and <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020006$</font> are getting injured frequently, and I'm worried. We're already short on time, manpower, and supplies, and we can't keep sending our crew out knowing they'll get hurt…
(Asks what's going on.)
We don't know when the monsters will appear again, but I'll be counting on you then too.
(Asks what it is.)
Since arriving in Kritias, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004316[gender:0]$</font> keeps encroaching on my research territory!

Now that I have a hypothesis, what I need is proof, right? Please investigate <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020302$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020006$</font> and <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020505$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020001$</font>!

So I felt like I needed to show something, and I investigated all night. Finally, I came up with a meaningful hypothesis! It's that 'among Kritias monsters, the ones with blue bodies might have something in common'!
(Says they're not sure if there's really a common trait.)
Ugh, there's no way! I'll formulate another hypothesis, so please check again for sure!
For now, I'd like to start by investigating the uniquely shaped mechanical monsters. You can help, right?
(Says each one had distinct characteristics.)

To find out how they move and how they fight, please battle <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020605$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020010$</font>, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020807$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020034$</font>, and <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021001$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020016$</font>.
Each one had unique traits?! Was this approach wrong too...?
But I'm not giving up!
Especially that <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004342[gender:0]$</font>! I heard many different types live here. Don't you think there might be regional differences?

Now it's time to prove it! <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020704$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020032$</font> and <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020905$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020013$</font>. Please check if there are differences between these two!
(Says they were different colors.)
(Says to just say the word.)
I knew it! I knew there would be differences. Great, now I'll begin the investigation based on this!

I was reviewing the Kritias monster list recently, and some monsters had insufficient information. They're ones I didn't investigate thoroughly at first because they seemed unremarkable, but I should properly collect data on them.

<font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021102$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020051$</font>, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021203$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020017$</font>, and <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021401$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020014$</font>. Please gather data on them.
Thank you! I'll upload the data you secured to the monster list!
I was reviewing the ecological monster data we've collected so far, and discovered evidence that the Kerbes and Tyren soldiers are planning to use Kritias's ecological monsters as military forces!
(Tells them to slow down.)
If Kritias's ecological monsters become their military force, Georg and the Sky Fortress will face serious defensive setbacks!
(Says they just need to eliminate them first.)

Thank you so much! Please defeat <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021801$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020008$</font>, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021603$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020009$</font>, and <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25022101$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020037$</font>!
Wow, really?! Thank you so much, $MyPCName$. I'll be asking for your help again!
(Says they taught them all a lesson.)

Could you activate the drill and send me the soil analysis data?

Please remove the balloons that look like Blackbean.

If I hadn't volunteered for this Kritias expedition... It's a terrible thing, unimaginable to even contemplate.

The Undying Monarch, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font>, has awakened.

So the God of Light and my ancestors decided to divide and seal the <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003818$</font> separately. I'd like to tell you in detail how the soul was divided, but...
Starting is half the battle! Great work, $MyPCName$!
The part about there being no chance of a complete resurrection— could you explain that in more detail?
Due to time constraints, I'll tell you about this part later.
I feel the same way, sweetie.
<font color="#909090">(Please just stick to the important parts...)</font>
I mentioned earlier that the <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003818$</font> were divided, right? Splitting the soul was partly to hide the traces, but... there's actually one more reason.
<font size='40'>?! </font> (Asks how she knew.)
It was written all over your face, you know? You're not good at managing your expressions, are you? Want to practice with me?

It was to weaken <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font>'s power. When the God of Light divided the <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003818$</font>, he placed a spell so that without a complete soul, only half their power could be used.
(Says they're really fine.)
So, what's the other reason for splitting the soul?
I don't know why He cast such a spell. Perhaps... He foresaw that someday <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font> might be resurrected.
Hahaha! I never thought I'd be the one to end the duty that's been passed down through my family for so long.
I can't believe I might get to vanquish <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font> with my own hands!
Ah, of course, if it were the complete <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font>, that would be true. But right now it's in an incomplete state, so we might be able to kill it.
(Asks isn't <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font> an undying being?)
You're all listening, right? Even this time spent talking is too precious to waste. <font size='40'>We have to go right now!</font>

$MyPCName$! We just got word from $npcName:11001216[gender:0]$'s group. $npcName:11000735[gender:1]$ has awakened and is heading to <font color="#ffd200">$map:52010017$</font> to find the ancient Lumieragon's holy stone. They said they'll come to $map:52010007$ as soon as they find it.
Oh, the entrance connecting to <font color="#ffd200">$map:52010017$</font> is also near the $map:02010055$ entrance in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02010029$</font>. Hurry there and look carefully!
Oh! $MyPCName$! Did the Empress send you?
The power of me and the Dragon Knights alone might not be enough. Help us too!
The power of me and the Dragon Knights alone might not be enough. Help us too!
$MyPCName$! Why did you come back alone? What about $npcName:11000735[gender:1]$ and friends...?

<font color="#ffd200">Before the path guided by the Heir of Light, your existence too shall become light...</font> I... I think I understand now. The meaning of these words that $npcName:11001216[gender:0]$ and friends always recited... And now I think I can do it. My destiny as the Heir of Light, to dispel the darkness...
Wait here with me... Oh! They're coming right now!
Wait here with me... Oh! They're coming right now!
Someday, when a star shining with a bright, grand light rises in that sky... I'll come back. The day Drachenheim shines bright! Wait for me.

Thank you so much for helping me get this far. You... the Empress... and my friends... $npcName:11001216[gender:0]$, $npcName:11001217[gender:0]$, $npcName:11001218[gender:1]$...! Now I have to go back to <font color="#ffd200">Drachenheim</font> to wake up my mom and save the Lumieragons.
We have to go right now!
Anyway, since I'm safely keeping part of the soul, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font> should only be able to use half its power right now.

Long ago... The day $npcName:11000735[gender:1]$'s mother Layla left for Drachenheim with Ramestone comes to mind... $npcName:11000735[gender:1]$'s retreating figure looks so much like Layla's did that day. After overcoming so many trials, a true <font color="#ffd200">Heir of Light</font> has been born... I believe the darkness of Drachenheim and the Lumieragons will soon vanish.
Come, Captain <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003533[gender:0]$</font>. Let's depart to vanquish <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font> at once!
<font size='40'>Permission denied.</font>
What... do you mean? You're going to just leave <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font> alone?
No, of course we will vanquish <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font>.
However... I'm saying we cannot depart immediately.

I understand <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000144[gender:0]$</font>'s statement that <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font> is currently in an incomplete state. However, aside from that, we know nothing else about <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font>.
No, no... We can kill it!
<font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000144[gender:0]$</font>, do you currently have any idea where <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font> might be located?
No... I don't.
Do you know what kind of power <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font> uses?

Right now, we know nothing about <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$'s Descent Point</font>—its location, its power, whether it has weaknesses, or the scale of its subordinate forces. We have no solid information on any of it.
I want nothing more than to eliminate the enemy threatening our skies right now. However, the lives of countless crew members rest on my shoulders.

In our current state of knowing nothing, I cannot issue a sortie order. If, as you say, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font> is in an incomplete state, then all the more reason to prepare thoroughly and strike decisively in one blow.
Thorough preparation is what leads to the perfect success of any operation.
Thorough preparation is what leads to the perfect success of any operation. <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000144[gender:0]$</font>, I ask for your understanding.
Since it's not direct data, the margin of error will be significant, but still— it should provide better reliability than making inferences with no data at all.

Yes sir! Green Hood intends to use the data we've gathered on <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003781[gender:0]$</font> so far to analyze the traits of <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font>.
For now, everyone will gather intelligence on <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font> and identify what we can prepare for at this stage.
This isn't the time for that...
Good. What about Dark Wind?

Dark Wind will be focusing on intelligence this time. We'll dig deeper into the reports about those strange monsters from before and confirm whether there's a space in Maple World where <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font> could be hiding.
Permission granted. <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003786[gender:0]$</font>, how about the Luminaites?
We need to go right now!
I will...
We will analyze the evil traits that <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font> possesses. If we can analyze those traits, we may be able to find its weaknesses.
The $map:02000001$ Royal Guard—I'll ask you to handle the defense around <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000001$</font> again this time. We don't know what might happen, so I can't rest easy.
Ah... Y-Yeah! Of course! We'll protect <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000001$</font>, so don't you worry!
I see. I trusted you with this information, but it was all for nothing.
Was that guy... always like that? So hot-blooded and impatient…
Hmm…….
That's you, Chief.
Right! That's me— wait, no! You little...!

Actually, I've been sensing faint traces of <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003792[gender:0]$</font>'s traits from <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000144[gender:0]$</font> since earlier. I was just thinking I should ask about it privately later... but they've already left.
(Ask why <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003792[gender:0]$</font>'s traits can be sensed from <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000144[gender:0]$</font>.)
I don't know the details either. All I can say with certainty is that I'm never wrong about this...
<font size='45'>Whaaat???</font>
You startled me. What's wrong, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003536[gender:0]$</font>?
(Ask what results came out.)
Just in case, I analyzed the saliva that dropped when <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000144[gender:0]$</font> was passionately speaking earlier...
<font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003792[gender:0]$</font>'s traits are definitely present. <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000144[gender:0]$</font> is currently…
Traces of <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003792[gender:0]$</font>... inside their body?
Traces of <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003792[gender:0]$</font>... inside their body?
We have far too little data. At this point, all we can do is speculate.
Why the hell is that inside their body?
<font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003536[gender:0]$</font>, can you determine the reason?
This is just my theory, but... <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000144[gender:0]$</font>... could they have consumed <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003818$</font>?
Even speculation is fine. Tell me what you suspect.
(Ask what that means.)
No matter how thoughtless someone is, surely they wouldn't eat that? <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003536[gender:0]$</font>, what do you think of that guy?
It's not an impossible theory.

Considering our current situation and forces, locating <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003818$</font> and protecting that soul is the method with the highest chance of defending Maple World from <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font>.
Yet <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000144[gender:0]$</font> has only been saying that <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003818$</font> is somewhere safe, without ever telling us where that is.
What if the reason for that is because <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003818$</font> is inside <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000144[gender:0]$</font>'s body?
No way?

Could it be that <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000144[gender:0]$</font> is confident it's safe because <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003818$</font> is inside their own body, and that's why they suggested a different way to protect Maple World?
They're being influenced by <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003818$</font>?
Moreover, if <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000144[gender:0]$</font> truly consumed the soul... that would also explain the changes we've seen in them.
Wait, what does that have to do with anything?
Yes, that's correct. However, if this is true... <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000144[gender:0]$</font> is in grave danger right now.
<font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003781[gender:0]$</font> will target the <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003818$</font> inside <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000144[gender:0]$</font>'s body.

How do we find someone who left on their own? Hey! <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003536[gender:0]$</font>, you know that analysis tool you're always bragging about? Use it to figure out where <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000144[gender:0]$</font> went.
Exactly, Captain. We need to find <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000144[gender:0]$</font> immediately.

Chief, do you think this thing is omnipotent? For a proper search, we need baseline data first! Don't you remember all the data entry we did last time to find <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003781[gender:0]$</font>?
(Suggest that if we find <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003781[gender:0]$</font>, we might also find traces of <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000144[gender:0]$</font>.)
<font color="#909090">(I didn't think that far ahead, but I'll just stay quiet.)</font>

Oh, quite clever, $MyPCName$. <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000144[gender:0]$</font> has <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003818$</font> inside them, and <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003781[gender:0]$</font> and <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font> should be able to sense it—so to find <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000144[gender:0]$</font>, we track <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003781[gender:0]$</font> instead…
That's a good idea.

Indeed, a good idea. Everyone, from now on we track <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003781[gender:0]$</font> in order to find <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000144[gender:0]$</font>. To your positions!
But that was only the first test. You'd better prepare yourself for the next one.
Making an impact even on a new continent... As expected of you, $MyPCName$.
I'm looking forward to the next test.
This test won't be easy. Not even for someone like you.
It must have been tough taking on two factions at once... Did the elimination of the machine soldiers and the Dark Legion go smoothly?
(Say it was no problem at all.)
(Say you already know.)
I hear a monster called <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020004$</font> has been causing significant interference.
Heh... As expected of the one I chose. Well done.
Please help make the recovery of the descent line go more smoothly.
Well done, $MyPCName$. We should be able to recover the descent line soon.
Well done. We'll have the Luminaites research this.
(Say that this dropped from defeating $npcName:25020104$.)
<font color="#ffd200">$item:30001233$</font>, hm... What an interesting object.
I'll be counting on you again next time. Well done.
You're here. Did you find out the reason?
(Say you'll go.)
$MyPCName$, you're here. I was just waiting for you.
(Give up on telepathy and ask what's going on.)
(Say there were no problems.)
(Ask what's going on.)
(Ask what's the matter.)
A monster called <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020205$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020031$</font> apparently stole the survey data from our exploration team.
As expected of $MyPCName$. I'll be counting on you again next time.
(Say you don't see any tears.)
Is the stolen data intact?
That's a relief. The crew can rest easy now.
(Say it's safe.)
(Say it looks like something's bothering them.)
As you might have guessed, we need their energy source.
(Ask what's going on.)
Did you bring their energy source?
(Show the secured Ener crystals.)
Among them, please eliminate the particularly ferocious <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020001$</font> and secure their energy source.
So the Dark Legion's machine soldiers were also running on Ener. This requires further investigation.
!!! This is…
(Say to leave it to you.)

The radio waves emitted by <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020201$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020031$</font> are interfering with our scouts' communications. I believe my telepathy is being affected as well.
(Ask what the reason is.)
Well done, $MyPCName$. We shouldn't have to worry about radio interference for a while.
Then I'll leave it to you.
(Say you already know.)
(Say you already know that too.)
Well done, $MyPCName$. If we need help again, I'll be sure to ask.
(Mention that there seem to be a lot of medics around today.)

<font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020104$</font> has been attacking the exploration team deployed to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020030$</font>, causing severe casualties. Injured crew members just arrived moments ago.
Thank you. I'll count on you again next time.
(Say you'll eliminate them all.)
For the next test, I'll be giving it my all as well. You'd better prepare yourself.
Good luck.
You know that the Tyren Kingdom has been taking land from the native monsters by building military facilities here in Kydel, right?
And the only one who can resolve this problem is you, $MyPCName$. Please take care of them so our exploration team can investigate in peace.
(Say that on the way here, you noticed the monsters were acting differently than usual.)
Great work, $MyPCName$.
Then, I'll leave it to you.
Well done, $MyPCName$. I was able to get at least a small measure of your abilities.
There have been reports of a monster called <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020504$</font> absorbing the auroras here. Apparently, aurora energy has even condensed inside its body.
<font color="#ffd200">$map:02020001$</font> is a beautiful place where mystical auroras bloom. However, these auroras have apparently affected certain monsters in the area.
(Show the secured $item:30001236$.)
How did it go?
There have been reports of a mysterious light emanating from the necklaces they wear.
A mysterious light seeps out of it... The researchers will find this fascinating. Well done.
The crew has nothing but praise for you. I'll continue to count on you.
(Show the secured <font color="#ffd200">$item:30001237$</font>.)
I'd like to investigate the gemstone attached to these necklaces... Could you procure some for us?
Truly mystifying... Great work, $MyPCName$.
(Mention that the crew seems busy with something.)
Ah... the crew was ambushed by <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020405[gender:0]$</font> while exploring <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020004$</font>, and their survey data was stolen.
(Say you'll get it back right away.)
If something like this happens again, I'll be sure to ask for your help.
I'm worried that our Ener research hasn't been making any progress. The research team has also requested more Ener samples…
(...Say you'll be back.)
Great work, $MyPCName$. I'll count on you again next time.
$MyPCName$, have you ever seen a monster called <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020505$</font>? Apparently, ore that appears to be Ener grows on its back.
We tried to secure the ore through our crew, but... its violent temperament has caused repeated failures.
Great work. I'll count on you again next time.
Then, I'll be waiting.
(Mention that the medics look busy.)
I expect this will happen again, so I'd like them eliminated…
<font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020304$</font> ambushed the scouts, causing several of them serious injuries. Apparently they approached because it looked cute.
Sometimes you have to be cold-hearted. Great work.
We're still worried about the lack of progress on Ener research. The research team keeps requesting more Ener samples.
(Say you went soft because they were cute, but you handled it.)
(Say you understand.)
Still, great work. I'll count on you again next time.
Great work. I'll count on you again next time.

The Ener research still hasn't produced any results. It's frustrating. The research team says they need more Ener. Specifically, they need Ener from the <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020006$</font> area…
(Say you saw a crew member who was poisoned by something.)
Not only the crew, but there are also reports of the surrounding nature being damaged. I think we should head to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020006$</font> and eliminate them.
Ah, you noticed. The number of explorers poisoned by <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020305$</font>'s toxin is growing daily.
Allow me to express gratitude on behalf of the Luminaites. Great work.
(Say something seems different today.)
You noticed? The White Flame Dragon is being unruly today. Heh, surely you don't think I can't control it?
Please do your best until the next test. Well done.
Great work. I hope you'll keep it up next time.
<font color="#ffd200">$map:02020010$</font> is a base the Tyren Kingdom established to drive out Georg and occupy Kydel. I'm sure you've already heard about it…
Thanks to you, the surprise attack was a brilliant success. On behalf of the Luminaites, thank you.
I'll count on you again next time.
Then, I'll be waiting.
Great work, $MyPCName$.
(Say it should be quiet for a while.)
The investigation needs to progress quickly, but... certain monsters in the area are getting in the way.
Radio communication is the only means of contact between distant crew members, so this is a very serious issue.
As expected of you, $MyPCName$. I was counting on you.
I hear Kerbes has expanded its forces all the way to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020010$</font>.
As expected... Regular elimination will be essential going forward. Great work.
(Say they really were as violent as the rumors suggested.)
The Luminaites will research this thoroughly. Thank you, $MyPCName$.

Crew members attacking <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020034$</font> suffered heavy casualties from <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020803$</font>'s attacks. Since it uses a bow... they had no way to counter it.
(Say you saw crew members being carried to the infirmary.)
(Say it should be fine for a while.)
Well done, $MyPCName$. We'll analyze it thoroughly.
That's quite a relief. Thank you, $MyPCName$.
The Luminaites will research this thoroughly. Thank you, $MyPCName$.
(Say the ruins seem a bit more peaceful now.)
That's the result we wanted. Great work.
Now there shouldn't be any issues with crew communications.
Thank you for your help. On behalf of the Luminaites, I express our gratitude.
Thank you, $MyPCName$. As thanks, allow me to share some of my energy with you.
(Say the medics seem particularly busy today.)
As expected, you dealt with <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:23001006$</font> cleanly. You're the reliable $MyPCName$ I can always count on.
(Say you'll go handle it right away.)

I happen to have a nice item, but it's only useful for adventurers with great power. If you conquer $dungeonTitle:23037002$ or $dungeonTitle:23038002$ and come back, I'll give you a gift!

Translation process is running, please wait a moment.
Let me upload the image to my pad and run the <font color="#ffd200">GH Translator</font>.
Translation complete! Let's see what it says, shall we?
(Ask if those scratch marks really said something that complex.)
…In a place where the hellfire of karma blazes... Our true king who burns all shall awaken... Everyone, prepare to receive him...?
<font color="#909090">(Did she even breathe while saying all that?)</font>
Hehe, of course not! This is the greatness of the <font color="#ffd200">GH Translator</font>!

The GH Translator searches its entire database of hieroglyphs and ancient languages for patterns similar to these marks, identifies their meaning, converts them into our language, connects the contextual information, then references the speaker's data to form sentences. Impressive, right?
Ah, I got too excited there.
We went through the trouble of sending you out and you're just standing around here? Hurry up and find out!
(Ask what came up.)
What on earth...?
That must have been a difficult mission. As expected. I'll count on you again next time.
Therefore, I've decided to increase the difficulty.
This is a prime opportunity to assess the capabilities of the monsters here. It would be good if we could learn what makes these machines different.
If you don't put in the effort, passing the regular evaluation will be difficult.
$MyPCName$, that goes for you too. If you become complacent from past glory and show a negligent attitude, you'll have to leave this place immediately.
Faithfully carry out your assigned missions and prove your worth as a crew member.
(Say the one thing they had in common was being defeated by your hand.)
(Say they won't be targeting the descent line again.)
… I see. Well done.
(Say you taught them a lesson so they can't destroy the forest anymore.)
(Say you merely fulfilled your duty as an ally.)
So this is the part the research team wanted so badly. Well done, $MyPCName$.
Georg says they'll support us with supplies in return. Thanks to crew member $MyPCName$, we'll be comfortable for a while. Thank you.
(Say you'll depart immediately.)
(Say it looks like something's bothering them.)
This should give us peace of mind for a while. Great work, $MyPCName$.
The day you become not just a hero of Maple World but a hero of Georg doesn't seem far off.
We barely know this place—how are we supposed to find the resources they want!?
I have to admit it. That was a good idea, Chief <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004313[gender:0]$</font>.
Hahaha! What did I tell you? I said it would work!

As expected. Assigning this mission to you was the right call. Great work, crew member $MyPCName$.

Thanks to you, information about the new region is accumulating quickly. Good work, $MyPCName$.
<font color="#909090">(I get nervous every time.)</font>
I'm raising the difficulty of the regular evaluation to check how well the crew has adapted to Kritias. Now then, let's begin the evaluation.
It seems my worries were unfounded. I'm counting on you going forward.
We never know when chaos might return to that area. When it does, I'll ask you to clean it up again.
<font color="#ffd200">$map:02020001$</font>?
I'm sorry to ask this of you. Truly, thank you, $MyPCName$.

Go to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020004$</font> and learn swordsmanship through direct combat with <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020401$</font>. I'm counting on you.

It should be safe for a while.

Would you? Head to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020006$</font> and subdue <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020302$</font>—that would be a big help.

To secure the Tyren Kingdom's <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020034$</font>, we first need to weaken the machine soldiers guarding it. Infiltrate <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020034$</font> and subdue <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020802$</font>.

Well done, $MyPCName$.

Then 'the place where hellfire of karma blazes' must refer to <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font>'s Descent Point! If it's <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font>'s Descent Point, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000144[gender:0]$</font> must be there!

Hey kid, come here. Times like this call for fieldwork!
Hahaha, this much is basic!

Chief! I can hear everything, you know?

If you understand, then hurry up and go. It's urgent, so don't get sidetracked!
<font color="#909090">(Surprisingly observant...)</font>
Hello~ $MyPCName$... (sniffling) I prepared chocolates for the upcoming Valentine's Day, but... While investigating around Tria, I got attacked by monsters and lost them all!

If you don't mind, could you defeat monsters in $map:02000014$, $map:02000092$, and $map:02000017$ and deliver 10 $item:30001052$ to $npc:11000012[gender:0]$? I'll definitely repay you, so please help~

Please defeat monsters in $map:02000014$, $map:02000092$, and $map:02000017$ and deliver 10 $item:30001052$ to $npc:11000012[gender:0]$~ Please!

Hey~ $MyPCName$~ Our cute little Neilin is making such a sad face because she lost something~ She was investigating $map:02000014$ and $map:02000092$... and where was it, $map:02000017$! Got ambushed by monsters and lost all her chocolates?
Before she actually starts crying, would you find 10 $item:30001052$ and deliver them to $npc:11000012[gender:0]$ for me, sweetie?

Defeat monsters in $map:02000014$, $map:02000092$, and $map:02000017$ and deliver 10 $item:30001052$ to $npc:11000012[gender:0]$~ I'll have plenty of fun teasing Neilin in the meantime~
$MyPCName$! Welcome. Tactical adjutant Neilin carelessly lost something she was preparing. I'm sorry to ask this of you, but it can't be helped…
It shouldn't be too difficult for you, $MyPCName$... right? Please deliver 10 $item:30001052$ to $npc:11000012[gender:0]$ in $map:02000001$. I trust you can handle it.

So I was hoping to ask... Could you teach them a lesson, $MyPCName$? If they get a good beating, they won't dare come near the camp again!

Wow! Thank you so much! Then please eliminate the $npcName:25020302$ living in $map:02020006$ and recover the <font color="#ffd200">$item:30001245$</font>.
The exploration team discovered this phenomenon and tried to study the platforms that appeared in the sky, but they vanished like a mirage.

N-No! Of course not! You think the great $npcName:11004313[gender:0]$ would be scared of ghosts that even kids don't believe in? Ahem! Kids these days and their jokes are really hard to play along with! Hrm!

$MyPCName$! Please investigate this phenomenon! Go to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020001$</font>, investigate it, and make sure to report back!
