The recently discovered $map:02020001$ is a key area that supplies clean drinking water to $map:02020041$ and surrounding bases, and since the water contains dissolved Ener, it's also very important for research.
Anyway, great job on this investigation mission too! I'm counting on you for the next one as well!
$npcName:25020504$ keeps stealing our research equipment, delaying our exploration! And those devices... every single one is expensive equipment, so the losses are enormous.
Our surveillance cameras confirmed that <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020303$</font> keeps stealing parts from the Sky Fortress.

If you teach them a lesson, they won't dare touch our facilities again! Please go to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020001$</font> and punish the <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020504$</font> that keep stealing our equipment!
We need to act before the problem gets worse. Please eliminate <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020303$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020006$</font>.
According to exploration team reports, our supplies have become a symbol of power among them.
So keep your spirits up! I believe you'll do great, just like you always have!

The areas currently being intensively explored for pioneering are <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020032$</font>, <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020034$</font>, and <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020013$</font>.
Someone strong like you, $MyPCName$! Yes, I mean we desperately need your help.
On the bright side, the evaluation has shifted from results-focused to process-focused... But the downside is that the difficulty has gone up.
If you could subdue the aggressive monsters in the exploration areas, it would be an enormous help!

The <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020701$</font>, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020805$</font>, and <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020905$</font> in these three areas are especially aggressive, preventing the exploration team from continuing and causing a stream of injuries.
The recently pioneered <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020013$</font> is an important route for receiving supplies from Georg. However
And of course, the best of all is you, $MyPCName$! Great work again this time!
The outpost guards keep getting wounded and evacuated because of these endless local skirmishes. There are more wounded soldiers being evacuated than troops recovering from their injuries!

Because the giant mechanical beast <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:23001006$</font> is causing earthquakes and destruction all over the place, more and more expedition members are getting hurt, and the Sky Fortress equipment damaged by the tremors is piling up too. Things are serious.
If you could uncover what this ring really is, $MyPCName$, I could finally sleep soundly.
Just as the deputy chief said. We're short on troops, and the enemy advance never ends…
The expedition members found a strange device in $map:02020010$ and activated it, and a huge ring appeared in the air. But it vanished soon after.
Geez, you're teasing me again... Ahem! Anyway, I'll continue the mission briefing.
(Explain in detail what the Mystery Ring really is.)
But thanks to you, my questions are answered. Now I can sleep soundly!

But since it's unexplored territory, the interference is no joke. We're trying to build a camp to study the energy found in $map:02020016$, but $npcName:25021004[gender:0]$'s attacks are so fierce that research can't move forward.
(Say you will find out what the ring really is.)
This large-scale attack by the Black Legion is a devastating blow to our development of Kritias.
The Green Hoods are continuing their research into the connection between Ener and mana. But there are so many monsters interfering with the expedition that they're having a hard time.
Because the $npcName:25020102$ in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020030$</font> have claimed the Ener first, the amount we can gather is shrinking more and more.
(Say you will be back, and that Nairin should not worry too much.)
(Say you will help.)
(Say that a cave in <font color="#ffd200">Orbis</font> seems suspicious.)
On top of that, their strategies and tactics are completely different from what we saw in Maple World, so the methods we've used until now are useless. We can't let the damage keep growing.
Recently, traces of $npcName:11001813[gender:0]$ have reportedly been found in almost every Kidel area.
The Green Hoods believe that to uncover <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11001813[gender:0]$</font>'s objective, the fastest method would be to interrogate the subordinates directly.
A cave in <font color="#ffd200">Orbis</font>? All right! Then let's tell the captain right now and move out.
We know nothing about <font color="#ffd200">Orbis</font>, and more importantly, we don't know how long we can move around in that intense heat.
If it's not urgent, let's talk another time. Every second counts right now.
Deputy chief, wait a moment.
It is very urgent, so please hear me out for a moment.
The captain said it before, didn't he? Only thorough preparation leads to a perfect operation. The same applies now.
(Ask what they mean.)
(Ask who that is.)
As it happens, I know the perfect person and training method.
Even if we set aside information about <font color="#ffd200">Orbis</font>, we absolutely need to confirm and train our ability to adapt to the heat.
I understand how badly the deputy chief wants to sortie straight to <font color="#ffd200">Orbis</font>, but we can't go without preparing.
What are you talking about? You'll get yourself hurt! You've never tried moving your body in extreme heat, honey. If you go without any preparation, your heart could stop.
Good choice! I'd like to put you through a proper course, but we don't have much time, so I shortened the training course as much as possible.
(Ask what the training course is.)
(...Say you will receive the training.)
(Say you appreciate the concern, but decline.)
(Say your whole body feels hot.)
(...Say that's not why you're red.)
Still, I'm glad you don't have any major external injuries, honey. Now I can feel at ease about moving to <font color="#ffd200">Orbis</font>.
If you can move freely in this heat, you won't collapse the moment you arrive in <font color="#ffd200">Orbis</font>. It will be hard, but I believe in you, $MyPCName$.

You'll endure the heat of <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000268$</font> and defeat monsters. I don't know how intense the heat in <font color="#ffd200">Orbis</font> will be... But it should still be better than going with no preparation at all.
I'm not sure about the details. They've been staring this way for a while, so why not go ask?
I have been waiting. You are slightly late.
(Ask what it is about.)
It would be terrible if our little kitten got hurt after moving out unprepared, wouldn't it? Since we don't know what's in <font color="#ffd200">Orbis</font>, we need to prepare thoroughly.
<font size='40'>Going to <font color="#ffd200">Orbis</font> right now is impossible.</font>
(Say that <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000144[gender:0]$</font> may be there as well.)
I see... I think the same.
Listening to the voice of your heart, it seems you have already made up your mind. You intend to go to <font color="#ffd200">Orbis</font>, no matter what danger awaits... Is that right?
I heard that <font color="#ffd200">Orbis</font> is the likely site where <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font> will descend.

If the place where <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font> descends is <font color="#ffd200">Orbis</font>, that would explain the strange phenomena <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003781[gender:0]$</font> has shown until now.
Now, come closer.
For someone like you, I have prepared something as well. Now, come closer.
<font color="#909090">(This feels unsettling.)</font>
There is no need to worry. I will not send you anywhere strange.
(Say that is right.)
Close your eyes and listen to the voice of your heart.
I have cast a 6th-circle Luminite protection spell on you. A protection spell of this level should be able to block most heat.
(Ask what they are doing.)
All you need to do is stand still in front of me.
(Close your eyes and focus.)
Ah, there is no need to thank me.
I said there was no need to thank me... Your feelings are enough.
I have heard the details from the crew.
To think the place where <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font> will descend is <font color="#ffd200">Orbis</font> of all places... That is not good.
Now that all preparations are complete, let us report to the captain.

However, if we launch a single-seat unmanned autopilot capsule meant for escape, it seems possible to control the capsule to the location we want. <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003536[gender:0]$</font>, please explain the details.
Yes! The Sky Fortress currently has one single-seat escape capsule. Normally, there should be several... But because of the emergency takeoff, we could only load one onto the ship.
Because of the intense heat, the Sky Fortress cannot land in <font color="#ffd200">Orbis</font>. Even with the ship's shields at maximum, we can only wait nearby.
(Ask if that is all right.)
Still, there is no problem with its performance! Not only are its shield specs comparable to the ship's, but its maximum speed greatly exceeds the Sky Fortress's maximum speed.
If we can only send one crew member, then it must be our very best.

Thank you for the explanation, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003536[gender:0]$</font>. Crew member $MyPCName$, as you just heard, the only thing we can do now is use the escape capsule to send one crew member to <font color="#ffd200">Orbis</font>.
Apart from that, judging from everything you have shown us so far, there is no doubt that you are the right person, $MyPCName$.

I am sorry to place such a heavy burden on you, but since you were trained by <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003535[gender:1]$</font> and have the Luminite protection spell cast on you, I believe you can complete the mission safely.
That means it can move through the heat while minimizing shield damage! With this capsule, we can send $MyPCName$ safely to <font color="#ffd200">Orbis</font>.
Good. <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003536[gender:0]$</font>, inspect the capsule's autopilot function.
Thank you. Then, are you ready?
(Say the captain is not asking a crew member for a favor.)
(Say you can go right now.)
No abnormalities detected.
Ugh...

After I was captured by <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003781[gender:0]$</font>, I came to and found myself here. It seems they were after the <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003818$</font>$pp:를,을$ inside my body.
I never thought it would come to this... I am sorry.
I would like to ask you to handle this.
(Ask if they are all right.)
Cough, I am... sorry. I do not know why I acted that way earlier.
Urgh. I did not think I would see you again here.
Actually, there is one thing I did not tell you earlier... About <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003818$</font>... The truth is, it was inside my body.
(Ask why.)
And I would like to ask you to handle this.
(Say you knew.)

Perhaps because I absorbed <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003818$</font>, my personality was also influenced by <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font>. This is the first time I have experienced anything like this, except when I first felt <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003792[gender:0]$</font>'s energy.
So you noticed. After I ate <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003818$</font>$pp:를,을$, my whole body became hot and it was difficult to stay calm.
This is the first time I have experienced anything like this, except when I first felt <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003792[gender:0]$</font>'s energy.
It was like today back then, too.
(Say they should recover their strength first, then discuss a way to defeat <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font>$pp:를,을$.)

While I was on duty as usual, I was startled by an unknown energy I suddenly felt. <font size='10'> My heart pounded like mad, and I suddenly began to break out in a cold sweat. Then came endless anxiety and fear... It was very hard to endure. Looking back now, it is a wonder I did not run away then.
(Ask what that means.)
It is already too late.
<font size='40'>It is over now.</font>

I hope our support reaches the expedition members. Here, I will give you a special coin made to commemorate the expedition. Collect Expedition Commemorative Coins and bring them to Bobby to purchase special items.
Our jumps are filled with our support for the Infernog Expedition. If everyone jumps and jumps, Queenstown might start shaking!

<font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font>$pp:가,이$ took the soul that was inside my body... Now that all the souls have been recovered, there is no way left to kill <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font>$pp:를,을$.
Hello, $MyPCName$! Our festival to cheer on the Infernog Expedition has begun. Today, let us cheer them on in our own way.
Shall we <font color="#ffd200">run with excitement</font> until the winter wind runs away? And shall we shout it? Go, Infernog Expedition! This will be a truly energetic day.
To tell the truth, I wanted to join the Infernog Expedition too. But... I was told to come back after improving my skills... Well, it's fine! I plan to support the Infernog Expedition in my own way.
Let us <font color="#ffd200">run with excitement</font> until our support reaches the Infernog Expedition members! I just finished running myself. You know how healthy it is to run every day, right?

I will remember the support you showed while running with all your might, $MyPCName$. I will give you an Expedition Commemorative Coin. You can buy various items from Bobby's shop celebrating the Infernog Expedition's departure.
Hello, $MyPCName$! With the wishes of all Maple World, we cheer on the Infernog Expedition as it sets out. Let us spend today full of energy and cheer them on together.

Maple World's crops insist on being completely pesticide-free and organic. Fresh crops are truly good for our bodies. Today, shall we <font color="#ffd200">harvest livestock and crops</font> as a show of support?

Anything is fine! <font color="#ffd200">Try harvesting livestock and crops.</font> Harvesting something is truly joyful. Just as crops bear fruit, may victory bloom in the expedition's challenge. Heave-ho, heave-ho!

Oh? $MyPCName$, it looks like you have gained some muscle in your arms. Gathering and mining really are good strength training! As thanks for helping with today's support event, I will give you an Expedition Commemorative Coin.
What did you harvest, $MyPCName$? Just as your harvest bore fruit, did the expedition members win as well? We have Expedition Commemorative Coins prepared for those who cheered them on.

Anything is fine! <font color="#ffd200">Try gathering or mining.</font> And cheer yourself on while mining, wishing in your heart for our expedition's victory. Getting minerals and cheering them on too. Isn't that really rewarding?
People often think fishing is a quiet hobby. But we know the thrill of fishing, don't we? That thrill when you catch a big one. Would winning the battle against Infernog feel like that?

Go, Infernog Expedition! Splash! Splash! Let us <font color="#ffd200">swim with excitement!</font> Swimming is truly great exercise. Let us improve our health while cheering on the expedition members' challenge.

Some people stay indoors these days because the weather is chilly. But anyone cheering on our brave Infernog Expedition members should never do that, right? How about cheering on the Infernog Expedition by swimming today?

While wishing for the expedition's victory in the battle against Infernog, <font color="#ffd200">how about doing some fishing?</font> I have chosen fishing as today's support mission. Let us reel in a big one!

Your body is soaked with water. Do not worry, you will dry quickly in comfortable Maple World. As a reward for participating in today's support event, I will give you an Expedition Commemorative Coin. You know how to use it, right? Just purchase various items from Bobby.
No, he must have absorbed all the souls already. Now we cannot stop <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font>'s complete resurrection.
(Say you will chase them even now.)
Earlier, they took <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003818$</font>$pp:를,을$ from inside my body.
Did you enjoy fishing? I wonder if Maple World's brave warriors won the battle against Infernog. I will give you an Expedition Commemorative Coin made to support them.

Just as we wish for the expedition's victory in the battle against Infernog, let us wish for a big catch and <font color="#ffd200">go fishing.</font> You get to fish, cheer them on, and receive an Expedition Commemorative Coin as a reward. How wonderful is that?
This is all my fault.
<font color="#909090">(Is it all over...?)</font>
I have ruined everything. This is all my fault.
Yes, we may be able to stop him.
Heh... Hahaha! That reckless way of thinking of his is useful sometimes.
And by absorbing <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003818$</font>$pp:를,을$, I realized something new.
(Ask what that is.)
It is that <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font> is not an absolutely perfect being either.

Fortunately, it seems not all of the souls have been taken yet. <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font>$pp:는,은$ seems confident that this much is enough for a complete resurrection... But a little carelessness can ruin everything.
(Ask if there is a way.)
(Say it was because everyone worked together.)
Yes. If we only had a powerful weapon, it may be possible to stop him!
You did well in <font color="#ffd200">Orbis</font>. Thanks to you, we were able to rescue <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000144[gender:0]$</font> safely.
That means physical attacks, or other kinds of attacks, can all affect him. Then, what if we could push him away to a place where he cannot influence Maple World?

Until now, we focused too much on the fact that <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font>$pp:가,이$ cannot die. Of course, he is an undying being, but that does not mean he is <font color="#ffd200">a being who cannot be struck</font>.
Now we must discuss our own task. About <font color="#ffd200">that weapon</font>.
I'm glad they were not badly hurt.
That is...
They do not appear to have any major injuries, but they are said to need absolute rest. They are resting in the infirmary now.
(Ask what that weapon is.)
(Ask if that weapon is currently inside the ship.)
We intend to use this weapon against <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font> and push him out of Maple World. Well, it will need some adjustments, but it is not unusable right now.
Yes! With just a few adjustments, the princess can join the front line immediately.
...Yes. <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003536[gender:0]$</font>$pp:가,이$ will explain.

These drawbacks can also be improved enough if we only have the schedule and budget. Honestly, I would like to present the princess after she is a bit more stabilized, rather than bringing her into the world now, but with the timing as it is, we have no choice.
It is a place familiar to you as well, $MyPCName$. Hear the details there, and move out for now.
(Ask where that location is.)

We successfully did what we had to do. Something even our parents could not do.
You came. It felt empty here without you. We are celebrating the successful completion of our mission.

We were born with the fate of dragon knights, but I never thought we would actually do it. Besides, before all this happened, we did not know each other. Ah, of course, you two already knew each other before.
<font color="#909090">(With an awkward smile)</font> Maybe it is the emptiness after all the commotion ended, but everyone is quiet.
I never thought I would actually do it.
Ask what happened.

It has not been that long since I came to know $npcName:11001294[gender:0]$$pp:를,을$ either. If that incident had never happened, we would still be a restaurant owner who cannot remember customers' faces well and a customer who only has eyes for the food.
<font color="#909090">(They gaze into the distance with a nostalgic expression.)</font>
Of course, even if that had not happened, fate probably would have tried to bind us together. Just as it led me to meet you, <font color="#ffd200">$MyPCName$</font>.
But the good time I spent monopolizing $npcName:11001292[gender:0]$'s cooking only lasted until that guy appeared.
Actually, it is not a pleasant memory. Haha.
As for me, since $npcName:11001292[gender:0]$$pp:가,이$ was only making my food, I liked that I never had to stop eating and wait.
I was busy dealing with $npcName:11001294[gender:0]$'s order. Then a huge shadow suddenly fell across the restaurant entrance.
I was the only customer that day, but $npcName:11001292[gender:0]$$pp:는,은$ seemed completely unworried, not even glancing toward the customer tables and only cooking.
Then, with a bright expression, they said it was truly delicious. It was such a sweet greeting that the day's fatigue vanished at once. I watched the customer leave.
In that moment, I felt my heart shrink without realizing it, and my hair stood on end. After that, well…
From the very first day of business, I took a huge loss, and I had no choice but to kick out two customers under the excuse that business hours were over.
The customer turned around, raised a hand, and greeted me once more. At that moment, moonlight seeping through the window fell upon them, and the pattern engraved on their wrist shone brightly.
But after one customer left first, the remaining customer finished paying and came to the kitchen to find me.
<font color="#909090">(Laughing loudly)</font> $npcName:11001294[gender:0]$ has had an incredible appetite for a long time.
It was the same pattern engraved on my arm. He was also a dragon knight.
Ask how they met Statz.
$npcName:11001292[gender:0]$$pp:와,과$ I met at the hospital. The pain was severe, but I did not know the cause, so I was frustrated.
I never thought I would find a dragon knight that way.
But when I went to the hospital, there was a patient with the same symptoms as me. It was $npcName:11001292[gender:0]$.
I think it might be on the bookshelf... Could you find $item:30000515$$pp:를,을$ for me?
After confirming there was someone else with the same symptoms as me, I suddenly remembered something I had read in $item:30000515$.
There should be other things in $item:30000515$ that we have forgotten... If you go to $map:52010022$, the guidebook should be there.
When $npcName:11001292[gender:0]$$pp:는,은$ heard my symptoms, they grabbed my arm without warning and dragged me to a lake lit by moonlight. Then they checked the pattern engraved on my wrist.
It has been so long since I organized the bookshelf that I do not know what else is there.
Seeing $item:30000515$$pp:를,을$ reminds me of one phrase inside it... Before the path guided by the Successor of Light, your existence shall also become light... It is my favorite passage.
I did not think we would have to use the princess this urgently.
(Say that is right.)
Since the emergency takeoff, we have been using this place to test various new technologies for upgrading the Sky Fortress. It is such a good base, so it would be a waste to do nothing with it.
(Say that is true, and ask about the ultra-high-density particle accelerator.)
To prevent stored energy from leaking out and affecting other places, I want to use ore that gathers energy. It is not an ideal method because it increases the weight, though.
(Ask what the crash course is.)

Normally, in its current state, we would keep running data simulations to find the charging time and amount of energy that can maintain the optimal state... But we do not have time now, so I want to take the crash course.
It is currently almost complete. However, its stability is not secured yet, so I think additional work will be needed.
(Say you understand.)
Please gather ore from <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000104$</font>.
There is <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000104$</font> near <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000076$</font>, and the ore there has the property of storing energy.
I will research how to process this ore, so I would appreciate it if you could gather ore in the meantime.
Thank you, $MyPCName$. I will contact the ship to provide transport support.
You returned just in time.
This amount should be enough.

It is simple processing, so anyone should be able to do it, but hearing you say that makes me uneasy. $MyPCName$, could you please check whether <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003535[gender:1]$</font> is doing well? I still have things to discuss here, so I cannot leave.
I also found a method for processing the ore and delivered it to <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003535[gender:1]$</font>.
(Ask if <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003535[gender:1]$</font> knows how to do that kind of thing.)
(Ask what happened.)
(Say you understand.)
Thank you! <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003535[gender:1]$</font> is inside.
Well, I have nothing to say either, so I am trying hard, but ever since earlier, the parts break whenever I touch them...
<font color="#909090">(They seem to have absolutely no talent for this kind of thing.)</font>
I will deliver this part to <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003536[gender:0]$</font>. $MyPCName$, you know that you helping me is... a secret, right?
(Say you understand.)
Please process the parts over there.
Hehe, thank you~ I will definitely repay this favor twice over later.
(It seems there is no other way to finish it.)
Hahaha, that was a nice, clear answer.
Yes, my back is precious, so a youngster like you should do this kind of thing.
(It is hard to see, but answer that you can see it for now.)
Yes, yes, those parts. We need to move them now…
Now, it is time to work, kid.
(Say you will do that.)
Oh, yes, yes. I was watching everything from here.
Come back to me when you are done. I need to check.
Move those parts for me.
Still, they are heavy, so do not carry them too far. They said some mechanical arm or whatever will come move them if you put them over there, so just set them down and come back.
Completed parts must be inspected by human hands at least once. If the machine moves and assembles just anything, our princess will be finished!
You moved them well. Ah, that mechanical arm was fascinating too. When you move the parts over, it picks them up right away.
Right? I mean, if there is a mechanical arm like that, there is no need to use strength.
(Say it would be nice if moving them were automatic too.)
No, that is not what I...
(Say they look tired.)
(Say you never said that.)
No, no, I am not busy. <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003536[gender:0]$</font>, I have something to discuss with this kid... I will go first!
No... I am fine...
Good grief, that kid... Anyway, good work.
(Ask what they are talking about.)
(Say you will at least hear them out.)
There will be priest knights alongside me as well... But still, we should have at least one safeguard. After all, I do not know where <font color="#ffd200">this power</font> may go.
It is a little far, but at this distance, it should not be a problem.
$MyPCName$? Did you sense my difficulty? Your instincts are getting better.
Someone like me... Heh.
The magic stone used at this time is the anti-darkness magic storage provided by the Luminites. It is a magic stone processed once more with the power of the Luminites.
Therefore, for it to unleash its full power, a high-ranking knight must perform the unsealing process.
That is right. Just like...
It is you.
(Ask who the perfect person is.)
The unsealing process is not difficult, but because I will be using my full power during it, there is a possibility that this power may affect other places.
It is you.
While I release the seal, I need someone who can properly stop my power from heading elsewhere... And as it happens, there is a perfect person for the job.
You must stop the power from heading elsewhere.
There is no time, so I will release the seal immediately.
Of course, that will not happen. Now, here I go!
If I go berserk... attack me.
(Ask how you are supposed to do that.)
It is done. Whew, controlling power is not easy after all. I am glad nothing happened.
(Ask what changed.)
(Say that, now that you think about it, you may have felt something.)
That is a relief. I nearly became disappointed in you.
You did not notice at all? To think you failed to notice such a great change in energy... I am disappointed.
I suppose I cannot say all of them...
Let us make a deal. I will get you the highest-grade <font color="#ffd200">$item:20000408$</font>...
I hear you clearly. But it seems we do not have time for this discussion right now.
It is nothing, Nei Nei. Now, we should continue talking about our princess, right?
...Deal.
Ah-ah. This is Squirrel One. White Tiger, do you read me?
Yes, the princess is ready to board the ship. I will contact the captain.
The Sky Fortress is currently engaged with <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003781[gender:0]$</font>. All crew, return to the ship quickly.

It seems the <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003781[gender:0]$</font> who sensed <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font>'s energy are targeting <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000144[gender:0]$</font>. At this rate, both the ship and <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000144[gender:0]$</font> are in danger.
Detailed adjustments can wait. Bring the ultra-high-density particle accelerator online. End transmission.
Understood.
It seems the situation is settled now.
I just received word from the medic, and they say <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000144[gender:0]$</font> is not in the infirmary.
Everyone, despite the sudden situation, you all performed admirably.
Th-that is...
Check the surveillance cameras inside and outside the fleet immediately and find traces of <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000144[gender:0]$</font>.
Fortunately, the ship did not suffer major damage either. $MyPCName$ deserves much of the credit.
Now that things have come to this, we will quickly stabilize the ultra-high-density particle accelerator, then fire it at <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font>.
I do not know where <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000144[gender:0]$</font> went.
Checking surveillance camera footage. Tracking <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000144[gender:0]$</font>'s movement route.
They left the infirmary... moved to the hangar, and boarded a small ship.
Let us watch the footage together.
We need at least 15 minutes. Also, for a stable shot, we need the proper distance.
(Say you will buy time.)
(Say you cannot let <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000144[gender:0]$</font>$pp:를,을$ be put in danger again.)
Firing right now is impossible.
Denied. $MyPCName$, it is too dangerous.
(Beg them to send you.)
Is there no suitable way...
Crew member $MyPCName$, if it seems dangerous, return immediately with <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000144[gender:0]$</font>.

Crew member $MyPCName$ will move to the small ship where <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000144[gender:0]$</font> is and buy time together. Meanwhile, all crew will focus every effort on stabilizing the ultra-high-density particle accelerator.
Understood.
I am sorry that I always leave tasks like this to you.
(Say the captain should not apologize to a crew member.)
(Say you understand.)
I wish you good fortune in battle.
Heh, yes.
The possibility of protecting the sky from an immortal being.
I wish you good fortune in battle.
Still reckless as ever. Well, I do not dislike that side of you.
We succeeded. Through this battle, we saw a possibility.
Thinking about things like that will only give us headaches. If that thing comes back, we just need to take it down like we did this time.
Protecting the peace of the sky is reason enough for the Sky Fortress to act. Please do not worry too much about it.
(Say you only did what had to be done.)
Captain, I sincerely thank you and your crew for your cooperation.
Thanks to you, we were able to repel <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font>$pp:를,을$. Everyone... You went through so much because of me.
As crew member $MyPCName$ said, we only did what had to be done. We cannot hand the sky over to anyone.
(Say you are glad they are safe.)
<font size='40'>And we will always protect the sky.</font>
It will be the same from now on. If anyone comes for the sky, we will face them at any time.
$MyPCName$, I wanted to make sure I thanked you.
That is remarkable spirit.
Thank you very much.

This is all thanks to you. I am sorry to say this when I owe you every time, but... If <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font>$pp:가,이$ comes again next time, will you help me as you did today?
It seems it would be difficult without you.
Thank you very much.
(Say that of course you will join them, since it is about protecting Maple World.)

Actually, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font> was not the only being sealed during the Age of Light and Darkness. I saw in an ancient book passed down through my family that various beings were sealed.

On top of that, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font>$pp:는,은$ can influence many monsters and divine beasts with his energy alone... It would not be a bad idea to prepare in advance.
By the way, I am worried.
Now that <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font>$pp:가,이$ has awakened, I think this kind of thing will happen quite often from now on.
(Ask what they mean.)
I certainly will. Then... this is farewell for now, $MyPCName$.
(Say they must tell you.)
There is nothing concrete yet, so it is difficult to explain in detail. Once things are more organized, I will tell you then.
(Ask if they are leaving already.)
(Say you do not really understand what they mean.)
Hahaha, yes. See you again. I wish all your endeavors full of fortune.
(Say you will see them again.)
I have already imposed on everyone here too much. I have things to prepare, so it is about time I left.
But this is not goodbye forever. When <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font>$pp:가,이$ returns, we will see each other again whether we like it or not, so do not worry.
A shallow trick.
To think you believed something of this level could stop <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11001811[gender:0]$</font>... How unfortunate, O <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003822[gender:0]$</font>.
Guh...

Say you only remember $npcName:11000735[gender:1]$ saying they would open the path of light.

Ahh~ What a relief. It seems $npcName:11000735[gender:1]$$pp:가,이$ opened the path of light before they could fully control the power dwelling in the holy stone. Because of that, the path of light seems to have guided each of you to different places...
I have not fully recovered the power of light yet. Before the vanished $npcName:23000068[gender:0]$$pp:가,이$ returns, we need to find the <font color="#ffd200">Shard of Light</font> and get out!

Ah, I see! When I was poisoned by shadow poison and my mind was hazy, I heard my mother's voice. She told me to find the ancient Lumieragon holy stone sealed in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02010055$</font>... the <font color="#ffd200">Shard of Light</font>... She said it would open the path to finding my destiny!
Seeing that you returned safely like this, $MyPCName$, I think $npcName:11000735[gender:1]$$pp:와,과$ their friends are probably fine too.

No... Your help ends here...! From now on, I have to do this. Only Lumieragon can clear away the darkness covering Lumieragon. With the power of light I possess, I will restore it to the Drakenheim of old.

Say goodbye.
Someday, when a very large, bright star rises in that sky... I will return. On the day Drakenheim shines brightly! Wait for me.
Once Drakenheim regains its bright light, I will return. Then let us eat and play at $map:02010053$ until our bellies burst! All right?
$MyPCName$, and the dragon knights as well... Everyone worked so hard. Someday... May Lumieragon's bright light clear even the darkness of Shadow World...!

When <font color="#ffd200">White Day</font> comes, I take <font color="#00a2ed">$item:30001380$</font>$pp:를,을$ and go out to a sunny, green field. My heart tickles because I want to confess my love to someone. At a time like this, how about making <font color="#00a2ed">$item:30001380$</font>$pp:를,을$ and running through the green field? Along with <font color="#00a2ed">$item:30001380$</font>$pp:와,과$, your ticklish feelings will spin around with excitement.
You gathered all 3 ingredients! Now your ticklish feelings of love will spin around with excitement.

If you succeed in making <font color="#ffd200">15 $item:30001380$</font>, I will give you <font color="#00a2ed">$item:20200101$</font>$pp:를,을$ to cheer on your feelings so they are delivered well. I will cheer for those feelings to reach them too!

Oh my! <font color="#ffd200">15 $item:30001380$</font>! With this much effort, your feelings of love will surely be delivered. Here, I will give you <font color="#00a2ed">$item:20200101$</font>$pp:를,을$! Good work.
If you have a lot of <font color="#ffd200">$item:30001380$</font>$pp:가,이가$, your feelings of love might fly off somewhere. Just imagining it makes my heart tickle.

Would making around <font color="#ffd200">15 $item:30001380$</font> be enough? It will not be easy, but I think that much would be enough to convey your feelings... The Purple Heart Balloon will deliver your love, $MyPCName$. Purple Heart Balloons appear throughout the field every 10 minutes, starting on the hour. They only appear for 5 minutes after spawning, so you must send the balloon up during that time.
To the one you love, or to the one you may love someday... Send a <font color="#ffd200">Purple Heart Balloon</font> into the sky with your feelings of love.
Purple Heart Balloons appear throughout the field every 10 minutes, starting on the hour. They only appear for 5 minutes after spawning, so you must send the balloon up during that time.
Your feelings of love should have been delivered well.
Because the breath of the White Flame Dragon is flowing from this $npcName:11004316[gender:0]$'s mouth.
We Luminites are working hard to track <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004430[gender:0]$</font>$pp:를,을$, but we have not found much yet, so it is quite frustrating.
(Ask if they think a clue will appear if you defeat the Black Legion.)
They are the ones holding the key, after all. Could it be... $MyPCName$, you intend to go defeat them yourself?

You both know that recently someone has been <font color="#ffd200">hacking</font> the <font color="#ffd200">mechanical soldiers</font> and taking them as subordinates, right, $npcName:11004316[gender:0]$$pp:와,과$ my little kitten?
That is all! That was the opinion of an intelligence expert. Well, the choice is yours.

For some reason, I think <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004430[gender:0]$</font> may be behind it. Instead of defeating the Black Legion, it might be better to deal with the mechanical soldiers and get information…
(Say that is right.)
...Hmm.
$MyPCName$, please move to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020017$</font> for now.
...I hate to admit it, but that seems to make sense. I heard the <font color="#ffd200">hacked mechanical soldiers</font> are in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020017$</font>.
(Say that is right.)
The data processing speed and volume... They are on a level that cannot even be compared to Maple World.
I am identifying the network signal from here now. To generate a communication signal, please hurry and defeat <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021202$</font>!
Seeing your face... I feel as though I can finally clearly understand who I am.
The target at the specified point is still moving. We need to hurry!
Please defeat <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021205$</font>$pp:를,을$ there and try to generate a signal. With data processing speed at this level, results are only a matter of time.
Now I am curious whether a signal is generated when other monsters are defeated as well.
Their skill in handling magic is also very impressive. This really is an interesting region.
...What do you mean? What exactly are you plotting? Answer me now!
The AI here is already wrong. Soon everything will fall under my control.

In any case, thanks to you, my plan to rule this place through the contract between <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:23000301$</font>$pp:와,과$ <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:23000073$</font> has all gone awry, so I should thank you for that.
...I have kept my guest standing for too long.
Then, I hope you like the gift.
(Say you are safe.)
It seems communication was cut off by someone's deliberate interference. Are you safe?
(Say you will go to $map:02020041$ for now.)
That is a relief. We are tracking the cause of the interference.
(Say you can hear them.)
(Say it was somewhat different from what you had seen until now.)
(Explain everything that happened in $map:02020033$.)
Anyway, something is strange. For him to say something so incomprehensible...
<font color="#ffd200">I feel as though I can clearly understand who I am</font>, was it?
...I will be waiting.
...The Luminites' investigation results on the being called <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:23000073$</font> have finally come out.
I knew you would agree. For now, good work today. Let us speak again when all preparations are complete.
To stop <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004430[gender:0]$</font>$pp:를,을$, tracking <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:23000073$</font>$pp:를,을$ is our priority right now.
For now, I think it may be a scheme to confuse us. At times like this, we must not let go of our suspicion.
(Nod.)
(Say you have arrived.)
<font color="#ffd200">$npcName:23000073$</font>$pp:는,은$ is in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020034$</font>. Please move there.

I heard that <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020034$</font>$pp:는,은$ is guarded by <font color="#ffd200">mechanical soldiers</font>. I think they may influence the battle against <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:23000073$</font>$pp:와의,과의$…

We performed an analysis based on the <font color="#ffd200">altar ritual</font> at the place where he <font color="#ffd200">descended</font> in the past, and as a result... we succeeded in identifying <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:23000073$</font>'s true location.

<font color="#ffd200">$npcName:23000073$</font>$pp:는,은$ is said to be an <font color="#ffd200">ancient demon</font>, a <font color="#ffd200">being sealed together with Kritias</font>. We also discovered information about a <font color="#ffd200">specific ritual</font> that can summon <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:23000073$</font>$pp:를,을$.
...$MyPCName$, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:23000073$</font>$pp:는,은$ is not such an easy opponent. Therefore, thorough <font color="#ffd200">preparation</font> against him is necessary.
(Ask if you can now go defeat <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:23000073$</font>$pp:를,을$.)

If you look around, there should be <font color="#ffd200">mysterious totems</font>. They are said to be <font color="#ffd200">totems with a ritual placed on them</font> that lends power to <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:23000073$</font>.
Please quickly defeat <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020801$, $npcName:25020803$, $npcName:25020805$</font>$pp:를,을$. I leave it to you.
Please destroy them all.
Please take care of yourself.
(Say it seems all preparations are complete now.)
No matter how much you struggle to interfere with me, it is useless. You are only hastening the day of your death. How amusing.
...Understood. Then please defeat <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:23000073$</font>, that demon.
(Say you understand.)
(Say you will return to $map:02020041$ for now.)
I will be waiting. Please come back safely.
(Say it seems to have succeeded.)
It is a shame I cannot watch you struggle so desperately. Farewell.
...But there is no need for me to concern myself with battles between vermin like this. I have more important matters.
(Say you only did what had to be done.)
And that power of darkness seems to have a network-like form... It concerns me greatly.

It is not an issue we need to worry about right now, but... the results show that the <font color="#ffd200">power of darkness</font> felt from <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:23000301$$pp:와,과$ $npcName:11004430[gender:0]$</font> is <font color="#ffd200">similar to the power of darkness</font> here in Kritias.
(Ask what happened.)
To think you succeeded in defeating that ancient demon... As expected of you, $MyPCName$.
You have not used 30 Five-Color Pouches yet.
We have stopped $npcName:11004430[gender:0]$'s plot for now, but many secrets still seem to remain. They are matters we will surely uncover, and that will surely be revealed someday.

Hello, $MyPCName$! Do you know about Five-Color Pouches? Five-Color Pouches contain various items. You can only obtain Five-Color Pouches between 2/4 and 2/25, so do not miss this chance and be sure to use them.
Hello, $MyPCName$! Wow! You used 30 Five-Color Pouches. $MyPCName$, I am impressed by your effort.
In any case, good work. I have once again learned your true strength, $MyPCName$.
Yes, connection complete. This is the Sky Fortress. <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004555[gender:0]$</font>, do you hear us?
Hello, $MyPCName$! Go visit $npc:11000001[gender:0]$$pp:를,을$ in $map:02000076$. They say they have prepared a special gift for the Lunar New Year holiday.

Normally, we should begin the briefing after <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004555[gender:0]$</font> arrives here, but every second counts. For now, I will brief you by radio. <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004315[gender:0]$</font>, please connect us.
Hello, $MyPCName$! Go visit $npc:11000001[gender:0]$$pp:를,을$ in $map:02000076$. They say they have prepared a special gift for the Lunar New Year holiday.
$MyPCName$, did you come to greet me? What a polite young person. Since you came all this way, I cannot send you back empty-handed. Here, take this.

Ah, is this how I do it? How fascinating. When I fought alone in the old days, I never imagined technology like this. By the way, can you hear me now? Why is no one answering? Ah, is it not connected yet? Well, even if technology has advanced, something like this could not connect that quickly.
<font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004555[gender:0]$</font> is connected. You have not changed...
We can hear everything. First, thank you for coming quickly despite the sudden summons.
Not at all. If that thing is here, of course I should come. By the way, this place is truly fascinating. The energy I feel is very unusual.
(Say that is really true.)
That does not mean we will sit still. $MyPCName$, can you provide support?

Ah, I suppose I should explain this energy. <font size='10'>It is a passage written in a book passed down in my family, 'Daywalker's Adventure.' For reference, Daywalker is a very distant ancestor of our family. He probably acted alongside the Sages when they were alive. This is not important right now, so I will explain it again later. Let us return to the original topic. 'Daywalker's Adventure' contains this passage: 'It felt as though all common sense I knew had shattered. A power that does not exist in our world. I realized the world is vast, and there is still much to learn.</font>
Because of the foreign energy here, it is difficult to accurately detect <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:23000150[gender:0]$</font>'s energy. It seems I will need time to adapt to this place.

After arriving at <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020041$</font> and walking around the area, I think I will be able to say more clearly. I would like to check every corner myself. That should be all right, yes?

I share Deputy Chief <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004313[gender:0]$</font>'s opinion. Acting alone is not permitted. <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004555[gender:0]$</font> still does not know what kind of place this is.

Move while watching the detector's signal, narrow down the places where <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:23000150[gender:0]$</font>$pp:가,이$ might be, and then confirm it with <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004555[gender:0]$</font>. Any questions?
(Say you have none.)
Good. First, move to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020003$</font>$pp2:로,으로$ as shown on the detector.

Good. While <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004555[gender:0]$</font> was coming here, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004315[gender:0]$</font>$pp:는,은$ was making a portable detector based on data from when we tracked <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:23000150[gender:0]$</font>$pp:를,을$ in the past.
Of course.
(Ask what that is.)
(Ask if that is not surveillance.)
We are also monitoring the detector's data here. If an abnormality occurs, I will tell you immediately, so please respond quickly!
It is not far from here. Based on the data analysis, it is estimated to be in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020018$</font>.

Oh? I am only checking whether there are any problems with the data. Now, I can already see an anomaly in the detector data. It seems the detector is malfunctioning because of the Ener carried by nearby Tyren soldiers and Kerves crew members.
You are right. $MyPCName$, return for now…
(Ask what that is.)
I see.

I just secured one of the Ener that <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004315[gender:0]$</font>$pp:가,이$ was storing. I tried eating it just in case, and I could feel a new power flowing through my whole body. I am certain. With this power, I can kill that thing!

Captain, should we not be satisfied with simply finding the location? This is <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:23000150[gender:0]$</font>, whom we could not kill even with the Sky Fortress last time. Entering recklessly is dangerous.
Understood. I order the subjugation of <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:23000150[gender:0]$</font>. Be sure... Be sure to return safely.
(Say you will know whether it works by testing it.)
This is too reckless. <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004555[gender:0]$</font>, $MyPCName$. I order you to return immediately.
Please trust the captain's crew member. I will return without fail.
Yes. I promise.

They probably want to confirm whether <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:23000150[gender:0]$</font>$pp:가,이$ is truly dead. It was a mission passed down through that family for generations, so I doubt it feels real that it is over.
(Say both of you are safe and <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:23000150[gender:0]$</font> has been defeated.)
That is truly a relief. I will receive the detailed report at <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020041$</font>. Return as quickly as possible.
(Say they refused to return.)
(Say you can hear clearly.)
Is that so? Well, they must need time to settle their feelings too. Just as we need time to celebrate our victory.
Enjoy this joy together with everyone.
You worked truly hard, $MyPCName$. There is still work left for us here, but it would be good to enjoy the afterglow of victory for a while.
Without a doubt, they are checking nearby to see whether it is really over. That is just how they are.
(Say it is as the deputy chief said.)
Heh, is that so? Now that the forces interfering with us seem mostly dealt with, I intend to proceed with exploring deep inside Kritias.
But before that, there is another force we must deal with thoroughly.
(Say you only carried out the mission.)
The Kerves and the soldiers of the Tyren Kingdom. They are continually interfering with our attempt to explore Kritias's core region.
(Ask what that is.)
We cannot be pushed around by them any longer. So we plan to launch a preemptive strike against them. Georg also said he wants to join this mission.
While you were fighting the mysterious beast, Georg was continuously gathering information about the Tyren Kingdom.
We are working together because our goal is the same, so there is no need to worry.
(Say it is possible.)
Understood. Then move to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020009$</font>$pp2:로,으로$ for now and wait for orders.
That is why the Tyren Kingdom joined hands with them. They make Georg and Kerves fight while continuing to preserve their own forces. It is not a bad deal for Kerves either.

I will break this vicious cycle. If we take down the Kerves crew members colluding with the Tyren Kingdom, both forces will stay crouched down for a while to protect themselves, without making any major moves.

Now it is time to counterattack. First, let us start with <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021601$</font>, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021602$</font>, and <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021603$</font>, who have been constantly harassing Georg's camp!
Tyren soldiers undergo long training, so it takes a lot of time before they can be deployed to battle. But Kerves crew members are different. They gather exiles and constantly expand their forces.
And we learned that Kerves crew members colluding with the Tyren Kingdom are stationed here in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020009$</font>. If we strike this place, we can deal them major damage!
Thanks to you, we were able to strike both Kerves and the Tyren Kingdom. Now that their military strength has weakened, let us occupy their major facilities!
If we secure that code, Sky Fortress crew members and Georg soldiers will infiltrate the Tyren Kingdom's facilities, break devices or obtain information, and interfere with the Tyren Kingdom.
While you were active, we were scanning all of <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020009$</font>. During that, we discovered something interesting.
$MyPCName$, please move to the huge drill and secure the Tyren Kingdom's communication code. When you approach, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004315[gender:0]$</font>$pp:가,이$ will support you.

Have you seen the huge drill there? Georg was concerned that Kerves was managing the huge drill, so we were watching it closely. Then, while checking the Sky Fortress's regional scan results, we confirmed that a Tyren Kingdom signal was detected from the huge drill.
That is reassuring. Then defeat <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021604$</font> and secure <font color="#ffd200">$item:30001257$</font>$pp:를,을$.

<font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021604$</font> have <font color="#ffd200">$item:30001257$</font>$pp:를,을$. If we take it from them, Kerves will suffer from a shortage of supplies for a while and will not be able to attack other regions.
If Kerves takes a blow, the Sky Fortress crew can explore Kritias more safely. Can you provide support?
I trust your skills and ask this of you. Could you secure <font color="#ffd200">$item:30001257$</font>$pp:를,을$?
(Say of course.)
It is to seize complete control of this place. Now that the enemy forces have been reduced, this is our chance.
(Ask what the final mission is.)

<font color="#ffd200">$map:52100108$</font>$pp:는,은$ could not be scanned even by the Sky Fortress radar. In other words, we do not know what dangers may be there. I would not give this mission to another crew member, but I believe you can do it.

There should be a control room beneath <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020009$</font>. If we take control of the main control device there, <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020009$</font>$pp:는,은$ will be in our hands.

Once again, on behalf of Georg, I should thank the Sky Fortress and you. Thanks to your efforts, moving beyond <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020013$</font>$pp:를,을$ into the depths of Kritias is no longer just a dream.
I order all Sky Fortress crew members. Prepare to cross <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020013$</font>$pp:를,을$!
(Ask what is in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020013$</font>.)

I think we are getting a little used to exploring Kritias now. But we still cannot let our guard down!
I will send you the coordinates for $map:02020003$. I will radio you again when you arrive!

The expedition members tried to explore the ruins, but failed. But you will be different, right, $MyPCName$?! I will send you the coordinates for <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020003$</font>. I will radio you again when you arrive!

This time, I want to conduct a detailed investigation of Kritias's old ruins. According to the expedition members' reports, the Kritias ruins have an architectural style similar to the ancient ruins of Victoria Island.
Ah! Right... We were watching this place with the Cat's Eye Satellite... Sorry, it is hard to know the situation on-site from the table, so I...

I will send the camera installation location to your navigation. When you arrive at the marked location, please take a picture of the ruins and send it!
Oh no... They are hostile to us, so they are sure to interfere with the ruins investigation.

I will send the camera installation location to your navigation. When you arrive at the marked location, please take a picture of the ruins and send it!

I will send the camera installation location to your navigation. When you arrive at the marked location, please take a picture of the ruins and send it!

(Send the photo to Nairin.)

Could this really be a coincidence? There are too many matching details to call it a coincidence. Especially the arches connecting these pillars... even the way they are connected…
(Ask if your communication will be cut off if you enter the ruins.)
I wonder what is written in it. Please bring it back to $map:02020041$$pp2:로,으로$!
Firefly position correction, plus or minus 1.2 points... Confirmed amplification of $MyPCName$'s location information! Judging by the signal strength, it should be fine even fairly deep underground.
I wonder what is written in it. Please bring it back to $map:02020041$$pp2:로,으로$!

If there is a device that detects intruders, I think this old book may contain truly important information.

Ahem! Ahem! Anyway, these are important ruins, so I will investigate them thoroughly.
Whew... Please forget what $npcName:11004314[gender:1]$$pp:가,이$ just said.

The interpretation rate is low because our data library for Kritias characters is insufficient, but it should rise as more data accumulates.
First, we need to determine whether the contents written in this book are true. This place described in the book as... <font color="#ffd200">white, shining, beautiful islands in the sky</font>…
After analyzing the contents interpreted so far, this book appears to be 'someone's' diary.
We still do not know who that 'someone' is, but many things about Kritias were written in detail.

First, please go to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020018$</font>. We will proceed with the next exploration plan there.

I analyzed the composition of this diary and sent the data to your navigation. Please investigate the places where the diary's composition is detected.
I analyzed the composition of this ancient diary and sent the data to your navigation. Please investigate the places where the diary's composition is detected.

If Vangenheim was a 'pioneer-like being' of Maple World, then it makes sense why the old ruins have the same style.

You failed to revive <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003795[gender:0]$</font>, and you failed to make me the <font color="#ffd200">king of the race</font> again.

I will not let this stand.

I cannot stand to see that, so we will need to tighten discipline with regular tests. Of course... it will not be easy.
The hostile monsters throughout the map... They attack our crew tirelessly, so it is giving me a headache.
(Say you will go defeat them.)
