Good work. I will ask for your help again next time.
The crew members sent their thanks, saying that thanks to you they can proceed with the investigation comfortably.
Please defeat <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021105$, $npcName:25021405$, $npcName:25021505$</font>$pp:를,을$ in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020051$, $map:02020014$, $map:02020003$</font>.
(Say this is the first you have heard of it.)
In that sense, let us begin the crew evaluation. This time may be easier than usual.
<font color="#909090">(The conclusion seems strange...)</font>
We believed it had been thoroughly suppressed, but it has appeared again, so the crew members are trembling in fear.
It would be good to proceed this way from time to time in the future... You worked hard.

...It is said that <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:23000301$</font>$pp:가,이$, a subordinate of <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11001813[gender:0]$</font> whom we defeated last time, is still corroding the surrounding nature and creatures with the power of darkness.
(Say the crew seems more tense than usual.)
According to reports from the expedition members sent to resolve the problem, the investigation is already very difficult because of attacks from monsters made ferocious by the foul odor.
It looks like the crew are not as anxious as before. Good work.
<font color="#ffd200">$map:02020051$</font>$pp:는,은$ is quite a troublesome area. The surrounding ecosystem is being destroyed by the appearance of bizarre monsters and the foul odor.
I will ask for your help again next time.
(Say you will go once more.)
Good work.
But because of the foul odor in $map:02020051$... we will need to postpone the investigation. If the same problem happens again then, I will ask for your help once more.
Sturdy armor and a huge weapon. It is the one guarding <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020017$</font>$pp:를,을$ with tremendous power.
(Ask what happened.)
As expected, you are different, $MyPCName$. I will be waiting here.
If something like this happens again, I will ask for your help. Good work.
Please defeat <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021504$</font> so the crew can proceed with the investigation.
However... Recently, it is said to be acting strangely. As if there were a problem with its system, it is attacking the investigators there indiscriminately.
<font color="#ffd200">$map:02020017$</font>$pp:는,은$ is a place well worth investigating. Please defeat it so the crew members can proceed with the investigation smoothly.

But... The soldiers of the Tyren Kingdom guarding that place are not leaving the investigating crew members alone. In particular, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021504$</font>'s interference is said to be the worst.

Would you really do that? It would certainly be an easy matter for you. After defeating <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021304$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020033$</font>, please uncover the secret of the hat.
This is all thanks to you. Good work.

It is about their <font color="#ffd200">special hats</font>. There was a report that a <font color="#ffd200">mysterious light</font> comes from the hats whenever they attack... The crew members are no match for them, so there is much discussion underway.
(Say you will go get one.)
(Show the secured $item:30001240$$pp:를,을$.)
So I have a request. Please defeat <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021407[gender:0]$</font>$pp:를,을$ in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020014$</font> and preserve nature.
You can move right now.
A battery with condensed Ener. This is an unexpected result. I will deliver it to the research team immediately.

I heard many crew members used to rest while looking at the nature of <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020014$</font>, but recently a monster called <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021407[gender:0]$</font> has been <font color="#ffd200">destroying the nature</font> there.
Because of that, the crew's motivation has dropped a lot.

In any case, it seems the problem can be resolved by reducing the number of <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021204$</font> a little. Please defeat <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021204$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020017$</font>.
Since they say the nature there is so beautiful, I plan to visit it myself as well.
(Ask if $npcName:11004314[gender:1]$'s anger has cooled.)
Good work. I will ask for your help again next time.
...Please ignore what I just said.
...Sigh. Fortunately, they seem to have calmed down. Good work, $MyPCName$.
Go to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020051$</font> and defeat <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021104$</font>$pp:를,을$.
It is an area we are always keeping a close eye on... But this time, it seems best to handle it directly.
According to the engineers, the parts from <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021105$</font> seem usable.
Recently, the number of injured crew members attacked by $npcName:25021104$ has decreased greatly. As expected, $MyPCName$ is someone we can trust with the job.
...Good idea. Then I leave it to you.
With this, we should be able to rest easy for a while. I will ask for your help again next time.
(Say that after scouting ahead, you think the Ener in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020017$</font> is suitable, and you plan to go there right now.)
(Say you agree that collecting Ener to analyze Kritias's energy seems like a good approach.)
Please defeat <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021105$</font>$pp:를,을$ in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020051$</font> and collect the parts.
I will send it to the research team immediately. Good work.
It is no exaggeration to say this is all thanks to $MyPCName$. Thank you.
Please defeat <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021505$</font>, which is attacking the crew members in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020003$</font>.
I will ask for your help again next time.
(Say you remember.)
I will believe in $MyPCName$$pp:를,을$.
I wonder whether you can accomplish it.
Today is the day of the regular test, but... This mission may be a little difficult.
At this level, I do not think we need to worry too much about what will happen from now on either.
(Ask what happened.)
If something like this happens again, I will ask for your help.
Today, the White Flame Dragon is unusually wild, so I am tired. It seems to be reacting to the power of darkness.
...I cannot tell you right now, but you will know soon.
The White Flame Dragon has calmed down quite a bit. Now I can meditate in peace.
Because of that, it seems we need to defeat it again. I leave it to you.
Crew members investigating nearby reported that security in $map:02020037$ has become lax.
I think the security in $map:02020036$ has loosened considerably. It seems the operation's success is within reach.
You completed this mission successfully as well. It is just as I expected.
At this rate, entering the Tyren Kingdom's mainland seems to be only a matter of time.
Now there should be nothing for you to fear, $MyPCName$.
(Say you will bring it.)
Now we can have some expectations. I will share the results when they come out.

I was troubled because there has been no progress at all in Ener research. Meanwhile, requests for Ener procurement keep coming from the research team... Well, it seems we are now at the stage of deeper analysis.
This time, we need to secure Ener from specific areas again. They said they need Ener samples from <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020009$, $map:02020008$, $map:02020018$</font>.
I am glad $MyPCName$$pp:가,이$ is here. Then I leave it to you.
You worked hard.
...Even at a glance, I can see a lot of important content. The Luminites will investigate this thoroughly. Good work.
(Show the secured notebook.)
You performed the task perfectly this time as well. Good work.
It will certainly be a great help in research and in understanding the Tyren Kingdom's military strength. Please secure this notebook.
Please go to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020035$</font> now and defeat <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021906$</font>.
(Say it went down in one punch.)

There is a rumor that among mechanical robots, it is a <font color="#ffd200">strong one</font> that makes people click their tongues in disbelief. More than a few elite crew members have been defeated by it.
As expected, even $npcName:25021906$ is nothing more than a tiny bug to you. This was the expected result.
In the end, I thought you were the only one who could face it. It may also be good to analyze which of you is stronger.

The bigger problem is that a specific monster there is said to have been severely <font color="#ffd200">poisoned</font> by the <font color="#ffd200">pollen</font>. It has become extremely violent. More crew members are being poisoned because of that <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021802$</font> as well.
(Ask what should be done.)
Even I am not safe from the pollen when receiving their reports.

...It is not a major issue, but the influence of <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004548[gender:0]$</font>'s pollen has spread as far as <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020008$</font>. Because of that, crew members are being poisoned…
I think you already know the method. Then I leave it to you.
It is a creature called <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021702$</font>... I think we need to investigate its memory.
(Ask if $npcName:11004316[gender:0]$$pp:는,은$ is all right.)
Please defeat it and secure its <font color="#ffd200">memory</font>.
(Hand over the secured $item:30001243$$pp:를,을$.)
...I am fine. So, that will be all.
It is certainly very different from the memory chips of the machines we have seen so far. I will investigate it in detail. Good work.

As you know, the nature of <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020009$</font> was very well preserved, but recently it has begun to be destroyed by <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021603$</font>, one of the Kerves crew members there.
I ask for your help this time as well. Now the end is truly in sight.
Thank you. I will ask for your help again next time.
We cannot let such beautiful nature and precious samples be damaged like this. Defeat that one and preserve nature.
I will ask for your help again next time.
That must mean nature is being well preserved. It is all thanks to you.
Now all that remains is to wait. You worked hard.
I will transmit it to the research team right away. When the research is complete, I will tell you first.
I am really looking forward to it.
...Heh. I knew you would say that. Then I leave it to you.
I will ask for your help again next time.
It must be because the number of $npcName:25022003$ controlling them has decreased. I am truly glad you are here, $MyPCName$.
(...Say you will defeat <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25022003$</font>$pp:를,을$.)

A monster called <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25022003$</font> is <font color="#ffd200">controlling</font> the guard dogs and making them attack the crew recklessly. Because of that, we brought in some of Maple World's renowned trainers.
So I have a mission for you. Could you go to the two areas in advance and defeat the boss-class <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021205$$pp:와,과$ $npcName:25021305[gender:0]$</font>$pp:를,을$?
Then I will be waiting.
I am glad you are here.
I will hear your answer later. I leave it to you.

They say those two, especially <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021904$$pp:와,과$ $npcName:25022104$</font>, are causing trouble. Please go to the two areas and determine what changes have occurred in them.
You received my letter, right? If you stop by $map:02000111$, please be sure to plant the seeds. Around next week, something wonderful is sure to happen.
You received my letter, right? If you stop by $map:02000115$, please be sure to plant the seeds. Around next week, something wonderful is sure to happen.
(Say you could not find anything unusual.)
...I see. We Luminites will look into this further. Good work.
You received my letter, right? If you stop by $map:02000088$, please be sure to plant the seeds. Around next week, something wonderful is sure to happen.

Here, I will give you <font color="#00a2ed">$item:30001380$,$item:20302533$</font>$pp:를,을$. If you <font color="#ffd200">make 15 $item:30001380$, you can obtain an 'Action Voucher'</font> as an extra reward, and <font color="#ffd200">'$item:20302533$' can be used in 'Check Check All Bingo'</font>!
You received my letter, right? If you stop by $map:02000103$, please be sure to plant the seeds. Around next week, something wonderful is sure to happen.
(Say there was nothing especially notable.)

Good. Since we are investigating anyway, I want to identify as many different battle patterns as possible. Fight <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021205$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020017$</font>, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021305[gender:0]$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020033$</font>, and <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021104$</font>$pp:와,과$ in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020051$</font>, then determine their battle patterns.
(Say it seems an investigation is needed.)
I see. But it is too early to jump to conclusions. It seems we must continue observing the monsters here. I will ask for your help again then.
You pass. There was nothing to criticize.
I think so too, but rumors of <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:23090006[gender:0]$</font> are still spreading among the crew. It seems the crew's fear is considerable.
Good thinking. This time, I will watch especially closely.
However, do not forget to approach regular evaluations with an active attitude from now on as well. I will be watching.

Crew member $MyPCName$, if you move to the source of the rumors and return unharmed, I think we can stop the false rumors from spreading. First, please move to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020017$</font>$pp2:로,으로$ and check if anything is suspicious.
Hmm, whatever it is, we only need to eliminate anything that threatens the Sky Fortress's safety. If the rumors keep spreading, I will defeat it as many times as necessary.

But it is said that the soldiers of the Tyren Kingdom learned this and rushed in to seize <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020033$</font>$pp:를,을$. Georg has only recently settled in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020033$</font>, so they lack defensive equipment and seem to be in danger.
(Say you think you saw an illusion of <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:23090006[gender:0]$</font> there.)
(Say you do not know the details.)
I think the same. The Tyren Kingdom will not give up. To them, Georg is a target that must be eliminated.
Good idea, $MyPCName$. I will ask you regularly.
May I ask you to clear that area to help Georg? Move to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020033$</font>$pp2:로,으로$ and defeat everyone threatening that place.
(Say you do not think this is over.)
(Ask about supporting Georg regularly.)
Move to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020014$</font>$pp2:로,으로$ and defeat all <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021401$</font>$pp:를,을$ showing abnormal behavior.

Many crew members like <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020014$</font>$pp:를,을$, so it would be a problem if the trees were pulled out. We must stop <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021401$</font>'s abnormal behavior.
(Ask how to stop it.)
You worked hard, $MyPCName$. I will take responsibility and send <font color="#ffd200">this</font> to the laboratory.
(Say some were injured, but most are safe.)
Of course.
It is fortunate that we were able to act early. I will send scouts separately to confirm the cause of the abnormal phenomenon.
That is true. But when that happens, you can defeat them again. You will do that, yes?
(Say you do not know when they may rush in again.)
I will deliver it to the research team immediately. Thank you, $MyPCName$.
That is reassuring. Rest and stand by until the next mission.
(Ask about driving out one of the Tyren soldier units in that area.)
That is good. Since the front line has shrunk, Georg soldiers should be enough for a while. I will observe the situation and let you know if a problem arises.
(Say you did your best.)
There is only one way to protect the crew's health. Move to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020051$</font>$pp2:로,으로$ and eliminate <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021101$</font>$pp:를,을$!
Excellent. Georg should be able to hold out for a while. I will keep watching the situation in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020033$</font> and contact you if anything unusual happens.

Perhaps because of that, they say the stench in that area is unbearable. Crew members near <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020051$</font> are complaining of headaches, so I asked the research team if there was any method, and they told me one way to reduce the stench.
(Say you drove them all out.)

That is to eliminate <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021101$</font>$pp:를,을$ in that area. They say that whenever <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021101$</font>$pp:가,이$ digs through the ground and comes out, pollutants underground rise up and make the stench worse.
Good, you completed the mission safely. You worked hard. Rest for a while until the next mission.
(Ask what they are thinking about.)
It is all thanks to you. I will ask again next time.
(Say you taught the troublesome monster a lesson.)

We cannot let that happen. $MyPCName$, move to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020014$</font>$pp2:로,으로$ right now and teach the troublesome <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021402$</font>$pp:를,을$ a lesson.
A mission. Move to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020003$</font>$pp2:로,으로$, eliminate <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021502$</font>$pp:를,을$, and secure their documents!
(Say you absolutely cannot tolerate it.)
It seems support will be needed for a while. I will count on you then as well.
This is perfect information for determining the scale of their forces. You worked hard. I will begin analysis immediately.
(Show the secured <font color="#ffd200">$item:30001229$</font>$pp:를,을$.)
It is to faithfully carry out the captain's mission.
Then I will be on my way.
No matter how many times they appear, we will eliminate them. In the end, we will be the ones who win.
(Say that is right.)
Good. We will also prepare a regular evaluation just for you. Next time will not be as easy as this!
It is all right. I did not think we could clear them all out at once. We will need to keep reducing their numbers. You worked hard.
(Say of course.)
(Say you did your best, but there were too many enemies.)
I will be counting on you from now on, $MyPCName$.
Thank you. Then move to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020018$</font>$pp2:로,으로$ right away and eliminate all the soldiers there!
(Say the enemies are not gone, but it should be all right to send scouts.)
The number of forces we need to clear has increased, but it is fortunate that those two are not allies. We can defeat them separately from now on. Thank you for confirming it.
I will trust your judgment. I should tell the scouts to begin exploration.
Ah! I will look for a docile monster for the research.
(Say it does not seem that way.)
(Say you checked thoroughly but could not find it.)
(Say you taught <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25022001$</font>$pp:를,을$ a lesson and recovered the emergency rations.)
As expected of crew member $MyPCName$. We will redistribute the recovered emergency rations through the supply officer.
We may not be able to reduce their numbers all at once, but we cannot sit around doing nothing. I will ask for your help again next time.
It certainly looks docile. I truly appreciate you thinking of me, $MyPCName$.

Since other Dreamtrees might also grow larger, we want to find out why they grew and how to prevent it, but this <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021801$</font>$pp:가,이$ is much stronger and more dangerous than the other Dreamtrees, so the expedition members cannot approach easily.
The research team will begin analysis with the sample you secured. I hope we get results.
So it cannot be found easily after all. Good work, $MyPCName$. We will need to look for another method.
I will request analysis from the research team immediately. Thank you, $MyPCName$.
Thanks to you, the expedition members should be able to enter the factory. I will share any new information with you again.
An expected result. Good work. Rest and stand by until the next mission.
(Say they now know how frightening the Sky Fortress is.)
If we keep reducing their numbers, we should be able to secure <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020036$</font> too. I hope that day comes soon.
It is great fortune for us that you came with us. Rest until the next mission.
I hear it is famous for being beautiful, so once the expedition is over, I would like to visit it myself. When that time comes, I will ask you to guide me.
According to Battle Projection's tactical advice, it strongly recommended forced reconnaissance.
$MyPCName$, I have issued field missions to the areas where abnormal signs have occurred. Move immediately, check the site, and take any necessary measures.
No matter how much technology advances, tactics ultimately end with people.
Analysis does not lie, so dispatching reconnaissance forces to the abnormal areas seems to be the most effective option.
There are quite a few more areas where abnormal signs have been detected. It is difficult to understand the local situation through radar readings alone.
If you use the sortie system, you should be able to minimize travel time.
I look forward to steady reconnaissance missions, $MyPCName$.
$MyPCName$, I have issued field missions to the areas where abnormal signs have occurred. Move immediately, check the site, and take any necessary measures.
Lately, we have been doing so many intelligence missions and serious operations that I think we neglected checking our important jurisdiction.
You worked hard, everyone. At least today should be quiet, but in the fleet's jurisdiction, you never know what may happen.
Great work~ As expected, nothing is as effective for crime prevention as investigation on foot.
The mission is simple! Deploy to the jurisdiction, and if there is a problem, resolve it on-site.
Dark Wind's jurisdiction has a higher crime rate than other areas~ If we neglect managing it even a little, it can become a serious problem.
This just occurred to me, but Dark Wind's jurisdiction is just like our Nei Nei.
Now, shall we start moving too? Deploy to the jurisdiction, and if there is a problem, resolve it on-site.
The Luminites' long-cherished wish is... to reclaim the lost land of humanity. In other words, to set out on an expedition to recover the Land of Darkness.
The biggest reason I joined the fleet is also for this expedition. There is no better place than the Sky Fortress for investigating and analyzing the Land of Darkness.
Actually, if I really had two bodies, I would want one to cling tightly to our tactical adjutant. There would be no sulking about not getting attention, and it would be so, so nice! Right?
$MyPCName$, there is something I would like to ask of you.
Sometimes, even without separate orders, I will ask you to handle the jurisdiction. These days, even if I had two bodies, I would still be short on time.
Use the sortie system. In the Land of Darkness, physical methods should be safer than magical movement.
(Say you will become their eyes.)
I pay my respects, $MyPCName$. Then I leave it to you.
Please carry out the field missions currently issued in the Land of Darkness and gain various experiences. I will see that place through you.
However, there are limits to the investigations that can be done from the ship. In the end, someone needs to see and experience the Land of Darkness directly and build experience.
That is a patrol mission.
Please carry out the field missions currently issued in the Land of Darkness and gain various experiences. I will see that place through you.
That, too, is a future I look forward to, $MyPCName$.
Someday... Perhaps you may become the eyes of the entire order.
I see, that is good information. Thanks to you, I was able to learn quite a lot.
That is how much patrol means to us, beyond just a mission. It is like a wish and prayer that everything will be safe.

After what happened with <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11001392[gender:1]$</font>, I thought for a long time and then went to <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11001397[gender:0]$</font>$pp:를,을$. I told them everything that happened and asked what on earth was going on. Then $npcName:11001397[gender:0]$$pp:가,이$ shouted at me.
Ask if it is related to <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11001392[gender:1]$</font>$pp:와,과$.
Hello, $MyPCName$. You came at just the right time. There was something I wanted to tell you...!
It would not be an exaggeration to say that the history of the vigilantes began with patrol missions by the residents of the Henesys region.
Comfort $npcName:11001396[gender:1]$$pp:를,을$.
Ask if that is true.

Yes, it makes sense. Doctors also check <font color="#ffd200">a patient's condition</font> first when using medicine. I missed that. I was so happy that I thought I might be able to keep my promise... And because of me, $npcName:11001392[gender:1]$$pp:는,은$... sob...
Ask what they mean by shouted.

They said the medicine was mixed <font color="#ffd200">based on a healthy adult man</font>. They asked if I was out of my mind for using it on a child patient whose body was already so weakened, and said that for the medicine to work, <font color="#ffd200">the patient's physical condition</font> must support it.

I heard a detailed explanation from $npcName:11001397[gender:0]$, improved it a little, and made it together. It is a <font color="#ffd200">mild medicine</font> for <font color="#ffd200">young patients</font> weakened like $npcName:11001392[gender:1]$. But before giving this to $npcName:11001392[gender:1]$... I think we need <font color="#ffd200">confirmation</font>.

...But it is true that my mistake caused $npcName:11001392[gender:1]$ pain. So this time, I really want to be <font color="#ffd200">careful</font>. For $npcName:11001392[gender:1]$$pp:를,을$ as well. Please take this.
Take the <font color="#ffd200">small medicine bottle</font> that $npcName:11001396[gender:1]$$pp:가,이$ took out.

Could you take this medicine to <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11001443[gender:0]$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02010063$</font>? They have a wide range of experience and have seen the patients in $map:02010005$ until recently, so I think they can examine it best. If you ask, they will surely help.
Ask how they will confirm it.
Say you lost <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000520$</font>$pp:를,을$.
Please organize your bag first. If it is that full, there will be no room for the medicine.
Here, I will give you the one I had kept for research. It may become hope for $npcName:11001392[gender:1]$$pp:와,과$ the people inside $map:02010005$, so please handle it carefully this time.
$MyPCName$... Look in your bag. <font color="#ffd200">It looks like you have it.</font> Please take it to $npc:11001443[gender:0]$. That should be enough.
Ask if they have calmed down a little.

I examined the medicine you brought. There was nothing special about its color or taste, but it had a unique, bitter aroma. It seems to contain <font color="#ffd200">Moromoro Herb</font>. It is the Moropapa tribe's cure-all herb, known for its excellent calming effect and regenerative ability. As for known <font color="#ffd200">side effects</font>, there are currently <font color="#ffd200">none at all.</font>

I do not know what the previous medicine was like, but I do not think you need to worry about side effects from <font color="#ffd200">this medicine</font>. In fact, the patients in $map:02010005$ said they had no discomfort other than their skin color changing and itching.
Hold out $item:30000520$$pp:를,을$ and convey <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11001396[gender:1]$'s request</font>.
Ah... So that happened. Shall I take a look?
I cannot keep sitting around and only worrying. I will find a way, verify it properly, and make sure $npcName:11001392[gender:1]$ gets better. So that kind of pain never happens again...!
Ask why the villagers are wary of the patients, then.

Some sensitive villagers become very angry and stop me when they see me going toward the huts. They say the living must survive, at least. So I was in a very difficult situation too... But knowing there are <font color="#ffd200">people trying so hard</font> like this is truly something to be grateful for. I think it would be good to use this medicine on $npcName:11001392[gender:1]$.

Truly... I do not know either. It is a simple skin disease with no contagiousness at all. The curse people talk about... Those are stories that did not exist before. Because of such <font color="#ffd200">groundless, frightening rumors</font>, more people are simply <font color="#ffd200">leaving the desert</font>. That makes me feel even more responsible as a doctor and want to treat the patients, but...

However... The child patient who suffered side effects and the child's guardian who watched it happen <font color="#ffd200">will not try to take the medicine or give it to them.</font> They will be very afraid that the terrible thing might happen again. They are also exhausted, so it will be difficult...
Suggest mixing the medicine into food and having them eat it.
Say you lost <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000520$</font>$pp:를,을$.
The blue-roofed house near the exit to $map:02010036$$pp2:로,으로$ is $npcName:11001388[gender:1]$'s house. You can probably meet them in front of the house. Now, please take this medicine too.

That is a good idea. As it happens, this medicine has no color or taste and only a weak smell. In that case, would you discuss it with <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11001388[gender:1]$</font>, the best cook in this village? They are very kind and often worry about the patients inside $map:02010005$.
Ask about the recent atmosphere in the village.
Ask where <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11001388[gender:1]$</font> is.
Please organize your bag a bit. If it is that full, there will be no room for the medicine.
You are less thorough than I expected. It seems to be safely in your bag. Now, stop that and go consult with <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11001388[gender:1]$</font>, the best cook in our village.
Nothing has changed much. Other than the people isolated in $map:02010005$, no one else has contracted that disease. At least, no villager has come to me saying they seem to have symptoms.
Explain what has happened so far and ask for help.
It looked like you dropped something, and I was right. Here it is. Please carry it carefully.
Oh my, goodness. To think something like that happened...! Yes, if there is anything I can do, I must help somehow.

You waited, right? Here, take this. I packed some snakehead soup and a few rice balls. Snakehead soup is the best food for people recovering after losing their strength. <font color="#ffd200">Those children</font> will probably feel warmer and regain some strength if they eat this.

To think the doctor had such circumstances too... I did not know that, and I just thought an educated person was being heartless. Actually, I had gone to $map:02010005$ a few times after hearing patients were isolated there. When I saw two children there by themselves, I wondered what their story was and felt sorry for them…

Tell those children that I will visit them once again soon. I want to be family for those lonely, struggling children, if nothing else. Family is not only connected by blood. If hearts are connected, that is family.

Sigh, really... The more I think about it, the sadder it is. The people of this village were not originally so heartless. For days, there was only daylight without night, monsters suddenly increased, a drought came... and once <font color="#ffd200">rumors of development</font> started spreading, people's hearts dried up too.
Hohoho, you are so silly. Look in your bag. <font color="#ffd200">You have it!</font> That should be enough, so hurry and go to the children.

Still, $MyPCName$, it is truly fortunate that there are good people like you. I hope those feelings reach them and that <font color="#ffd200">the children surely recover</font>. Then I leave it to you.
Good grief! You really are careless. You left it here. Here it is. Make sure you take care of it this time, all right?
Say you lost <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000521$</font>$pp:를,을$.
Thank them and say they seem like a very good person.
Call out to $npcName:11001391[gender:0]$$pp:를,을$, who is muttering with eyes half closed.
If you are carrying that much luggage, you cannot take the lunchbox. Organize your bag first and come back.
Oh my, what are you saying? No one is helping so readily as you are, $MyPCName$. I hope those children eat well and recover in both body and heart. I leave it to you.
Cold... Hungry... $npcName:11001392[gender:1]$... I'm sorry, little sister... I couldn't protect you...
Hand over $item:30000521$$pp:를,을$, saying $npcName:11001388[gender:1]$ made it.
$npcName:11001392[gender:1]$... This seems okay. Hurry and eat. It really must have been made by $npcName:11001388[gender:1]$... It is delicious.
<font color="#909090">($npcName:11001391[gender:0]$'s face, which had been full of anger, seems to soften.)</font>
Are you sure? That lady $npcName:11001388[gender:1]$ made it... Then... I should try it first... and give some to $npcName:11001392[gender:1]$ too... I need to make sure it is safe to eat…
<font color="#909090">(Tears well up in $npcName:11001391[gender:0]$'s eyes as they try eating $item:30000521$$pp:를,을$.)</font>
If it is from $npcName:11001388[gender:1]$... Ah. That lady... packed it for us?
You hear a voice saying, "Brother..." It is $npcName:11001392[gender:1]$'s voice.
Massage $npcName:11001392[gender:1]$'s body together with $npcName:11001391[gender:0]$$pp:와,과$.
<font color="#909090">($npcName:11001391[gender:0]$$pp:가,이$ is feeding $item:30000521$$pp:를,을$ to $npcName:11001392[gender:1]$.)</font>
Say you are glad they seem to have regained their voice.
$npcName:11001392[gender:1]$, is it good? Do you feel a little stronger? <font color="#909090">($npcName:11001392[gender:1]$ nods and coughs slightly. Their body seems to tremble a little.)</font>
Thank you, $MyPCName$. The lunchbox... was really delicious.

Yes, that lady... I remember her. She is someone I am really grateful to. It is strange... I feel like I am gradually getting stronger. My body also seems a little less itchy. I want to go take a bath. Hehe…
Ask if anything else hurts.
Yes, actually I feel a little lighter. Almost as if I took medicine...!
Tell them it was made by $npcName:11001388[gender:1]$.
Ask if it is all right, since the medicine $npcName:11001396[gender:1]$$pp:가,이$ gave first caused them to lose their voice.
Tell them that the medicine <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11001396[gender:1]$</font>$pp:가,이$ gave was actually in the food.

Of course. It is all right...! I can speak again like this now. It is thanks to everyone worrying about me and trying to help...! I want to get better quickly and repay big sister $npcName:11001396[gender:1]$ and Auntie $npcName:11001388[gender:1]$…
Really...? Big sister $npcName:11001396[gender:1]$...! So she really <font color="#ffd200">kept her promise</font>... I... believed in her. I believed she would help me...!
Tell them that $npcName:11001396[gender:1]$$pp:가,이$ suffered a lot.

Big sister said this was a secret, but... she said the reason she researches alone where no one is around is actually because she does not want other people to see her weak side. Please tell her that I am really all right...!
Oh, gods. Thank you...! Truly... I am so relieved.
Tell them what $npcName:11001392[gender:1]$$pp:가,이$ asked you to pass along.

Big sister $npcName:11001396[gender:1]$ looks smart and cool, but her heart is fragile. But... Please be sure to tell her she does not need to suffer anymore. Tell her that I kept believing in her, and that I really am all right now...!
Tell them that they could speak and that their body seemed to be getting better.
<font color="#909090">($npcName:11001396[gender:1]$'s eyes seem to grow moist.)</font>

Yes. I will stay strong, keep researching, and ask $npc:11001443[gender:0]$$pp:나,이나$ <font color="#ffd200">Auntie $npcName:11001388[gender:1]$ for help</font> so we can persuade the villagers and take good care of the patients. Thank you so much, $MyPCName$.
Encourage them to stay strong.

I need to keep researching so that $npcName:11001392[gender:1]$$pp:와,과$ $npcName:11001391[gender:0]$$pp:는,은$, of course... and everyone else, no longer suffer. And from now on, I will never be overconfident or rush. I will approach carefully... and check thoroughly.
$npcName:11001392[gender:1]$... I am truly... grateful... sorry... and ashamed. That young child is far more mature than I am. To think she believed in me…
Through the data gained from exploration, we are discovering new energies and creatures every day. Is that not the fun of exploring unknown territory?
But do not worry, $MyPCName$! With the way you have been carrying out missions, there should be no problems.
The captain will be very satisfied with these results. You really worked hard!
Please eliminate $npcName:25021503$ in $map:02020003$, $npcName:25021303[gender:0]$ in $map:02020033$, and $npcName:25021203$$pp:를,을$ in $map:02020017$. I leave it to you!

The earthquakes are not only injuring expedition members, but also damaging Sky Fortress equipment. Forget securing battle data on $npcName:23001006$; the entire Kritias expedition is going to run into trouble at this rate.
Just as we formed an alliance with Georg, it seems they also formed an alliance to interfere with us.
We need to hurry! Please suppress <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021102$</font>$pp:를,을$ in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020051$</font> so we can secure pollutants for antidote research.
I think we can respond if we figure out what pattern it is acting on. Like a weather forecast.
The research team says they can make an antidote only if we secure as many pollutant samples as possible, but to make matters worse... $npcName:25021102$$pp:가,이$ is eating the pollutants we secured.
In any case, we received communication from the field that collecting pollutant samples has become easier! It is thanks to you, $MyPCName$.
But it appears and disappears so unpredictably that its actions are difficult to predict. First, we have far too little data on it.
(Tell them to calm down first.)
It stores ancient documents of Kritias, so we Green Hoods designated it a Grade 1 protected area.
But $npcName:25021202$$pp:가,이$ is destroying the documents and facilities there indiscriminately.
I know this is a difficult and dangerous request... but I cannot think of any crew member other than you who can complete this mission safely, $MyPCName$.
(Say it is nothing.)
Haha, it is just... The expedition members found a strange device in $map:02020003$ and activated it, and a peculiar melody played.
(Say they somehow look very tired.)
Ah... No! Please continue the mission briefing.
(Say you understand.)
(Hum the melody as best you remember.)
Well... It is not perfect, but... Now we can roughly understand what the melody is.
They could not tell what the melody meant, and they say the melody was different each time they activated it.
(Say this is the only melody you remember for now.)
Please investigate the melody device in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020003$</font>. Then I think I will finally be able to sleep soundly.
According to the message... <font size='40''>'Thanks to $MyPCName$ arriving on time, the enemy forces were swept away at once, playing a major role in turning the tide of battle.'</font size>
(Ask if they are worried about something.)

Georg's second base, $map:02020033$$pp:가,이$, is reportedly under attack by $npcName:25021303[gender:0]$. Even before that, $npcName:25021303[gender:0]$$pp:는,은$ did not have sufficient defenses due to a shortage of troops and energy.
Go to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020033$</font>$pp2:로,으로$ and stop <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021303[gender:0]$</font>'s attack.
Ah! I am sorry! To complain like this when everyone is having a hard time...
I am so grateful that you think so! Actually, with the exploration personnel also lacking, I was worried because there was no suitable crew member to send into the field.
(Say you will go.)
(Say you will recover $item:30001253$$pp:를,을$.)
$npcName:25021203$$pp:가,이$ keeps stealing $item:30001253$$pp:를,을$ in $map:02020017$.
(Say $npcName:11004315[gender:0]$$pp:가,이$ must be having a harder time than anyone.)
(Ask if the previous battle data was insufficient.)
The previous battle data was not insufficient. We suspect $npcName:23001006$$pp:는,은$ is adding battle patterns suited to its opponents through combat.
Please! After fighting <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:23001006$</font>$pp:와,과$ in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020051$</font>, please collect as much battle data as possible.
Those things... I underestimated them because they were broken, but it seems their firing function was still working properly.
Welcome, $MyPCName$. We compared the battle patterns of $npcName:23001006$ that you sent last time with its recent patterns, and found changes in many areas.
If that is true, such an old facility has been producing robots without any problems until now... Honestly, I cannot believe it.
Is that so... If you find a cat, I plan to interview it alone, so bring it to this captain immediately.
Honestly, we are so short on explorers that I would take any help I could get.
According to the discovered records, this factory was built a very long time ago. Whether that is true needs more detailed verification, but the records say it was built several centuries ago.
This work evaluation has become more difficult overall, but its purpose is not to evaluate whether you qualify as a Sky Fortress crew member, so you do not need to feel burdened by this evaluation.
<font color="#909090">(Seeing $npcName:11004315[gender:0]$'s sparkling eyes, you cannot refuse.)</font> Of course I will help.
It likely has the ability to root itself deep underground and absorb Ener directly.

First, to understand and hack the factory facilities, we need to defeat the factory's robot forces. Please defeat as many <font color="#ffd200">robot forces</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020035$</font> as possible!
The problem is that the monsters here are so aggressive toward us that the expedition members cannot even begin serious research activities.
Now we can finally build a proper research camp! The expedition members will be truly delighted.
Ah~ That! Some of my younger ones had brought in a suspicious-looking $npcName:25021804$$pp:를,을$, so I asked what it was doing 'in a very gentlemanly and kind way.'
Neeei Nei~ You should not take Shadow Wind's movements too lightly~ We simply do not move until we are certain.
Welcome, $MyPCName$! Recently, suspicious movements by $npcName:25021804$ in $map:02020008$ have often been detected.
I knew that Nei Nei had obtained this from a Kritias soldier. And I also knew that $npcName:25021804$ recently stole it.

The fortunate thing is that they also seem to think moving it all at once is too risky, so they plan to split it into several deliveries. The problem is that the contact date for delivering it is Co-op…
Among them, resistance from the gatekeepers, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25022103[gender:0]$</font>, is fierce.
Geez! You certainly told us quickly! Still... Without Shadow Wind's information, something much worse would have happened.
The analysis shows that the battle pattern changes are far too random and varied, making them difficult to predict.
The research team suggested finding an internal access vulnerability in <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:23001006$</font> and hacking the AI itself.
But do not be too disappointed. We will find the answer. Just as we always have!
But to do that, they say we need $npcName:25021903$'s memory chip.
They say that if we analyze this special metal, the Sky Fortress can fire its atomic vibration cannon from the sky, outside $npcName:23001006$'s attack range, and create cracks in the special metal.
From now on, we must create a sure-win strategy to retake the Tyren Kingdom together with Georg.
We analyzed the battle data on $npcName:23001006$ you brought before... but in the end, we could not find any vulnerability accessible from outside.
It was a mechanical beast made far more meticulously than expected. But we Green Hoods are not the type to give up! We will dig and dig until we eventually find its flaw and turn it into scrap!
(Hand over the recovered $item:30001255$$pp:를,을$.)
Good work on this mission as well. I look forward to your help on the next mission too!

Fortunately, the poisoned expedition members are being treated because the new drug development team succeeded in creating an antidote, but the problem is that the number of poisoned people is increasing faster than the amount of new medicine being developed.

After the research team performed detailed examinations on the collapsed patients, it turned out to be poisoning from a toxic substance. They also discovered that the poison was wing powder from $npcName:25021803$.
We thought it was exhaustion from excessive exploration work and had them rest, but the nurses caring for them also collapsed with the same symptoms.
Despite its large size, $npcName:25022005$$pp:는,은$ in $map:02020036$ is agile and sharp enough to find and drive off scouts no matter how well they hide.

$map:02020036$$pp:는,은$ is an important forward base of the Black Legion, so we must understand the situation in real time through reconnaissance. Otherwise, we cannot know when or how they will ambush us.
(Ah... Say of course you remember.)

Thanks to you, we succeeded in developing a new antidote! It was still only a sample and not yet in mass production, though. Once safety testing for the new medicine was complete, we could move straight into mass production, but…

In particular, the poison from the wing powder of $npcName:25021803$ living in $map:02020008$ is far stronger than the others, so it spreads quickly and requires a lot of antidote, making it a headache.

$map:02020018$$pp:는,은$ is an area we absolutely must secure for Ener research and gathering. Please drive <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021703$</font> out of <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020018$</font> so we can build the camp!
Eh? You still have not received it? That makes sense. You are always out in the field. Then I will brief you directly!
But because of $npcName:25021703$'s interference, the researchers are too busy fleeing to even set up the research camp.

No. That does not mean I intend to sit by and do nothing. <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003535[gender:1]$</font>, gather information on this matter separately.
Rest and stand by until the next mission. That is all.
Lately, there is a group in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000083$</font> that is terrorizing the residents.
(Ask what kind of group it is.)
Hello, honey. Are you all ready to help me?
They are a gang that goes around wearing masks, and apparently they not only say nasty things to passing residents, but steal their money and valuables too.
Welcome back, $MyPCName$.
I am counting on you, honey. Clean up all the arrogant pups running wild in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000083$</font>.
Residents keep complaining and asking for public order to be maintained... But surprisingly, their force seems large, so they have not been wiped out.
Well, we cannot completely destroy the organization with just this one time, but they should behave for a while.
(Say you even took care of the vicious dogs they had with them.)
Welcome, $MyPCName$.
Then... I suppose I will have to step in.
(Ask what happens if they do not behave.)
They do not seem quite that clueless, so it should be fine. Good work, honey.
(Say you have a question.)
That concludes the mission briefing.
(Say you never received the mission briefing.)
<font color="#909090">(They seem lost in thought.)</font>
It seems my explanation was insufficient. Please speak.
If you do not want to help me, you could just say so honestly, but to make an excuse like this. I am disappointed, $MyPCName$.
(Say you really never heard it.)
Sigh... I will play along with that act.
The Luminights do not normally act in ways that reveal our true form, but now that Q-grade security has been lifted, we cannot simply watch the darkness spread.
Ah, it would be best to eliminate the other monsters as well before they are tainted by darkness.
Fortunately, nothing like that has happened yet. But since we cannot guarantee it will never happen, would you go to that area and deal with the forces tainted by darkness?

You probably know this from visiting several times already, but <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000146$</font>$pp:는,은$ is a place where the power of darkness is extremely strong. Recently, the number of monsters affected by the power of darkness there has reportedly been increasing each day.
At this rate, those monsters may carry the power of darkness to other areas. If that happens... Maple World will be in danger.
(Ask if there is anything you can do.)
Even as you stand here now, darkness threatens Maple World. Hurry and deal with the forces tainted by darkness.
(Say you heard clearly.)
That is a relief. Then, since every moment counts, let us move immediately.
I can feel that the aura of darkness has diminished.
As expected, my choice to ask you was not wrong.
...I know. It must be because darkness has already spread throughout that area.
$MyPCName$, you will become busy.
(Ask what happens if the number of monsters increases.)

<font color="#ffd200">$map:02000146$</font>$pp:는,은$ is an area of concern for the Luminights, so we are monitoring it closely. We will definitely know if the number of monsters surges, so please do not worry too much.
(Say you reduced their numbers as much as possible, but monsters appear in that area too quickly.)
(Tell them to say it.)
Um... $MyPCName$. May I ask you for one favor?
I look forward to your help again this time, $MyPCName$.
Thank you, $MyPCName$. Thanks to you, we were able to stop the darkness from spreading.
Seeing my comrades struggling makes me want to help somehow.
I will support your movement right away, so please wait a moment.
(Say your heart has always been with the vigilantes.)
Ah, it is just that <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000038$</font>$pp:는,은$ is originally an area where the Green Hood vigilantes maintain public order.

A little while ago, I heard from a vigilante in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000076$</font> that the number of monsters around <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000076$</font> has recently increased, so it is difficult for them to care for the relatively distant <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000038$</font>.
How is <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000038$</font>$pp:는,은$? Please hurry and check.
Nothing? Not at all! You were truly a great help.
You are back. Are you hurt anywhere?
I received a report from the vigilantes. Everyone was full of praise, saying $MyPCName$ was amazing.
(Say it was nothing.)
Hey, rookie. Get moving already.
You are already helping us so much that I do not want to burden you, but...
Is that so...? Well, that is not what matters.
Um... So, $MyPCName$.
(Ask what it is.)
Right? So I want you to go and give those monsters a stern scolding so they stop fooling around.
(Say you are no match for the chief's skill, but you can at least protect yourself.)
(Say there is not.)

Our guards are working day and night to protect <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000001$</font>, but recently they have been suffering because the monsters' mischief in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000088$</font> has gotten especially bad.
Hahaha, you know a thing or two. I have been worried about something lately, and I think you are perfect for solving it, rookie.
Oh, that is a relief! Now I can worry a little less.
I am worried because they only recently recovered from the aftermath of the invasion. Of course, you were on the scene too, rookie, but you are a bit sturdier, so do me this favor.
(Say you understand, considering the chief's concern for his subordinates.)
Yes, good choice. I will tell them to support your movement.
(Say you faithfully completed the task the chief assigned.)
Even among the Royal Guard, there are many scatterbrained ones, so I worry. Still, they all seem to take courage from watching you.
(Say you know.)
Movement to the captain is complete.
Crew member $MyPCName$, see me for a moment.
(Ask if you did not receive it last time.)
(Ask how to take the regular test.)
Even if you passed the crew evaluation procedure, you cannot remain aboard this ship if you do not pass the regular test.
Everyone is subject to the regular test, and of course you are no exception, $MyPCName$.
The previous evaluation proved whether you were worthy of becoming a crew member, and is different from the regular test. Sky Fortress periodically evaluates crew members through regular tests.
You simply need to carry out the mission I give you and prove you are worthy of boarding this ship.
(Say you understand.)
Is the mission not done yet? The test time is not unlimited.
Carry out the mission I give you and prove your worth. Begin.
If you know, there is no need to explain. The season for regular testing has returned.
(Say you are confident.)
The result is...
Then I will tell you the result of the regular test right now.
You completed the mission.
<font size='40'>Passed.</font>
<font color="#909090">(Whew, what a relief.)</font>
(Ask how long you have to keep taking this test.)
Continue to take tests regularly from now on. That is all.
Today is our little kitten's regular test day. Are you ready?
Until crew member $MyPCName$ disembarks from the ship.
It has been proven that this crew member is worthy of boarding the ship. You worked hard.
(Ask what the regular test is.)
(Ask if you have to take the test every time.)
(Say you understand.)
Huh? Did you forget already? The test that checks whether our little kitten is properly carrying out Dark Wind missions and keeping secrets.
(Say you think you may have heard about it.)
Great! The test is simple. Just do the favor I ask of you. How about it? Easy as pie, right?
Time is passing. If you fail at this rate, do not blame me, okay?
(Say it seems so.)
Test complete. You worked hard.
Why do you look so nervous? Of course our little kitten passed.
Do not tease the rookie too much.
He left. I will tell you about that nice thing and the chief next time when it is just the two of us. You worked hard.
Good work taking the test. Instead of spending time on a pointless test like this, you should be doing <font color="#ffd200">something nice</font> with me.
Oh no, right, I had urgent business. I am going first, all right?
It is surprising to hear you say that, Chief. Why, back when you once teased a new Royal Guard recruit...
I was waiting for you, $MyPCName$.
(Ask what that means.)
(Ask if it could be that.)
Did you not know about the regular test? The test that checks whether you have the skill to speak with me.
Regular confirmation is always a good thing.
Come to think of it, the Luminights do something similar. The shrine knights' regular...
(Ask what the regular test is, then.)
Ah, I cannot tell you this until the confidentiality grade is lowered further.
<font color="#909090">(Maybe it is fine if I just fail...)</font>
Correct. It is time for the regular test.
Hmm, I have been sensing your presence the whole time.
(Ask what you have to do this time.)
Judging by the waves around you, it seems you completed the mission.
You only need to complete one mission I assign. For me, this much could be done with my eyes closed.
I am very strict about tests. I will not go easy on you, so hurry and carry out the mission.
(Ask them to tell you the test result.)
<font color="#909090">(I need to hear the test result for now, so I should stay quiet.)</font>
You passed. I am glad I do not have to erase your memories.
(Ask if they erase your memories if you fail.)
I already told you earlier, but if you insist on hearing it in my own voice.
You came this early. You truly are diligent.
It seems my connection with you will continue for a while. ...I am not saying I dislike that.
(Say you want to take the test right away.)
Of course. I cannot leave just anyone with memories of speaking with me, can I?
(Ask what the test is.)
Hehe, I knew you would say that, so I have finished all the preparations.
(Say that is right.)
Honestly, $MyPCName$. You startled me.
(Say ah, you knew that.)
(Ask what you should do.)
The test is simple. If you complete one task I ask of you, you pass safely. Then, good luck!
You are not skipping the test because it is too simple, are you? Do not forget that you will fail if you do not complete it within the time limit.
(Ask if there is no option to skip the test.)
As expected of you, $MyPCName$. I did not know you would finish this quickly.
Test complete. Thank you for your hard work!
Of course, the same goes for me. So please do not forget to take the next test as well.
Oh my, you must follow the manual. You know very well that special treatment does not exist for our captain, don't you?
(Say you do not really know.)
(Ask what they mean.)
(Ask them to let it slide just once.)
I will make a special exception. But you prepared thoroughly, right?
(Say you prepared thoroughly, since it is the chief's test.)
(Say those words are absolutely right.)
(Say just give the order.)
Now I like that better. All right, then hurry and complete one of my missions.
I thought you had lost your senses, but your skills have not rusted.
If you do not do it properly, I will fail you immediately even midway through, so always stay alert.
(Say it is an honor to serve the chief.)
You pass. You may carry out duties under this <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003534[gender:0]$</font>.
Of course it is! There are not many people I personally give missions to.
Yes, yes. Then hurry up and do the next mission. What are you doing?
(Say you will keep the chief's words in mind, again and again.)
You succeeded in finding $MyPCName$'s partner! Here is the promised <font color="#ffd200">$item:20001302$</font>. I hope you have a day full of love and happiness.

Welcome, $MyPCName$! To celebrate the upcoming White Day, I prepared a very fun game. A game of tag to find $MyPCName$'s partner! What do you think? If you find today's partner and come to me, I will give you <font color="#ffd200">$item:20001302$</font>.

Then I will tell you the mission to find today's partner! Look for an <font color="#ffd200">opposite-sex friend</font> level 10 or higher wearing the <font color="#ffd200">'Lovely Heart Ribbon'</font>. They are surely somewhere in Maple World.

Are you $MyPCName$? Her Majesty is calling for you. Go to $map:52000087$$pp2:로,으로$ and have an audience with Her Majesty.
Are you $MyPCName$? Her Majesty is calling for you. Go to $map:52000087$$pp2:로,으로$ and have an audience with Her Majesty.

Then I will tell you the mission to find today's partner! Look for an <font color="#ffd200">opposite-sex friend</font> level 10 or higher wearing <font color="#ffd200">'Fanfare Baby Angel'</font>. They are surely somewhere in Maple World.

Explorers...! If they <font color="#ffd200">explore all over Maple World</font>, there is a high chance they know of mysterious places others have never reached, or rumors no one has heard before. That sounds like a good idea.
Say you will go meet the explorers at $map:02000062$.
Good. Then $MyPCName$, I will be counting on you again.
$MyPCName$! I have been waiting for you.
$MyPCName$, that is a very good idea. Please meet the explorers at $map:02000062$, then return and tell me what you heard.
Say you came because you have something to ask.
Oh, what happened to you in the meantime? You look a bit cooler. We could even make you an honorary member of our Adventurers' Association.
Make a joke that you do not have money to pay the membership fee.
Oh, who is this? $MyPCName$! It feels like only yesterday you came here with the $map:63000001$ delegation, but it has been quite a while! Good to see you again!
Sure, if it is something I know, I will answer anything. What is going on?
Tap $npc:11000019[gender:0]$$pp:를,을$ and say you have something to ask.
Oh, what happened to you in the meantime? You look a bit cooler. We could even appoint you as an honorary member of our Adventurers' Association.
Say you came because you have something to ask.
Ah, sorry. I was thinking about something, so I did not even notice you came. Ahem. What is it?
My goodness. You must have met a lot of people. So smooth... You are on the level of old captain uncles who have sailed for a good twenty years. Anyway, what brings you here?
Briefly explain what has happened so far and tell them about $npc:11001851[gender:1]$.
Ask if anyone has seen the forces of darkness or any clues about them.

Ah, wait! Still, it is too early to be disappointed. The adventure genius who has been everywhere in Maple World! The Adventure King! <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11003080[gender:0]$</font> is right here. Maybe that person knows something.
Quite a lot of rumors gather here. Many people who explore all over the world pass through, after all. All right, tell me what you want to ask.

My goodness... That is truly terrifying. And to think they even appeared near here. It gives me chills. But I... do not think I have heard the name $npc:11001851[gender:1]$$pp:라는,이라는$, or anything about those forces, from the people who come here.
Shake $npc:11003080[gender:0]$$pp:를,을$ awake.
Say you want to meet $npc:11003080[gender:0]$$pp:를,을$.

They are in <font color="#ffd200">$map:52000095$</font>, the room right next door, so of course you can meet them... I would like to say that, but you may have to wait a bit. Not long ago, their <font color="#ffd200">ship sank</font> after a <font color="#ffd200">pirate</font> attack, and they were badly injured. They are recovering, so they are often asleep... but go in and check anyway.

<font color="#ffd200">$npc:11003080[gender:0]$</font> is in <font color="#ffd200">$map:52000095$</font>, the room right next door, so of course you can meet them... I would like to say that, but you may have to wait a bit. Not long ago, their <font color="#ffd200">ship sank</font> after a <font color="#ffd200">pirate</font> attack, and they were badly injured. They are recovering, so they are often asleep... but go in and check anyway.
Thank you for waking me. It felt like I was having sleep paralysis... Thanks to you, I opened my eyes. Did you have something to say to me...?

$npc:11001851[gender:1]$$pp:라,이라$... Even when I search my memory, nothing comes to mind right now. I am sorry, but I do not think I can tell you anything about her. Ah... but maybe... would this story help...?
Tell them what has happened so far and about $npc:11001851[gender:1]$.
Ask them to tell you what it is.
Ask if they have ever heard of the forces of darkness during their adventures.
Say you want to meet $npc:24003002[gender:1]$$pp:를,을$.

The sea route to $map:02000391$ is quite difficult, so it is not easy to get there. On top of that, sirens tend to reject humans, so they are hard to meet. I wish I could go with you... but boarding a ship in my current condition is impossible...

They say sirens have a mysterious power to hear the stories of the sea. Could the <font color="#ffd200">forces of darkness</font> you mentioned... what they are plotting, and the <font color="#ffd200">world disaster</font> $npc:24003002[gender:1]$$pp:가,이$ spoke of be connected?

There is a young lady called <font color="#ffd200">$npc:24003002[gender:1]$</font>$pp:라는,이라는$ whom I met during my adventures. She is a beautiful <font color="#ffd200">siren</font> living in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000391$</font>. I passed nearby while sailing not long ago and met her briefly, and she told me that <font color="#ffd200">a great disaster would soon befall the world</font>.

It sounded important, so I wanted to hear more, but because of my sailing schedule, we parted after agreeing to meet again soon. But the very next day, we were attacked by <font color="#ffd200">pirates</font>, and the ship sank. When I came to, I was here, and my whole body was a wreck, so I cannot board a ship again...
No. I have also been wondering what $npc:24003002[gender:1]$$pp:가,이$ was trying to say. I hope you can get the information you want. Have a safe trip, and be sure to come back and tell me too.
Say thank you for helping.
Ask if there is any way, because you really want to meet her.

$npc:11003082[gender:0]$$pp:는,은$ was <font color="#ffd200">$npc:23000015$'s navigator</font>... but now he has quit pirate life and is living hidden <font color="#ffd200">somewhere in $map:02000182$</font>. Tell him I sent you and ask him to take you to $map:02000391$; he will help.

In that case... take this compass first. When you meet $npc:24003002[gender:1]$$pp:를,을$, tell her I sent you and show this to her. Sirens are cautious and sensitive, so they do not easily trust strangers. And to reach $map:02000391$... you will need help from <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11003082[gender:0]$</font>.

It would be best to go inside the cabin and check. You might be able to meet the navigator <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11003082[gender:0]$</font>$pp:를,을$ that $npc:11003080[gender:0]$$pp:가,이$ mentioned...

$npc:11003082[gender:0]$$pp:는,은$ is living hidden <font color="#ffd200">somewhere in $map:02000182$</font>. Tell him I sent you and ask him to take you to $map:02000391$. If it is $npc:11003082[gender:0]$$pp:라면,이라면$, he will definitely help.

It would be best to go inside the cabin and check. You might be able to meet the navigator <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11003082[gender:0]$</font>$pp:를,을$ that $npc:11003080[gender:0]$$pp:가,이$ mentioned...
A wooden cabin that somehow feels suspicious... When you listen quietly, you seem to hear sounds of a scuffle.
Ugh... hic... hiccup. Th-thank you for saving me, chorong!
I am... but... <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11003082[gender:0]$</font> knows nothing, knows absolutely nothing. No money either. Poor, chorong. Yes.
Say $npc:11003080[gender:0]$$pp:가,이$ sent you.
Ask who that is.

$npc:11003082[gender:0]$ knows who the pirate was that attacked <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003080[gender:0]$</font>. Heard it all. It was because they were <font color="#ffd200">jealous</font> that $npcName:11003080[gender:0]$$pp:랑,이랑$ and $npc:24003002[gender:1]$$pp:랑,이랑$ got along well, chorong. She would not accept his feelings, but when she met $npcName:11003080[gender:0]$, she smiled so brightly…
Ask if they are $npc:11003082[gender:0]$$pp:가,이$.

<font color="#ffd200">$npc:23000015$...!</font> A pirate more brutal than any other, chorong. He is sending subordinates to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000391$</font> to drag $npc:24003002[gender:1]$ away...!

Are you out of your mind?! Pirates are no joke! There are piles of guys like the ones you just met in $map:02000391$, chorong! And $npc:24003002[gender:1]$ is not an easy woman. She has a <font color="#ffd200">scary big sister</font>, too... She should be fine...

On behalf of $npcName:11003080[gender:0]$? Ugh... then I have to help... Actually... I went to $map:02000391$ to tell $npc:24003002[gender:1]$ that $npcName:11003080[gender:0]$ had been attacked, but I got caught by subordinates of <font color="#ffd200">$npc:24003011$</font> from $npc:23000015$'s crew... and barely escaped, chorong. When I fled, I handled the ship roughly, so the ship is in terrible condition too, chorong... sob sob.
Say you have something to hear from $npc:24003002[gender:1]$$pp:를,을$ on behalf of $npcName:11003080[gender:0]$.
Say you should quickly go to $map:02000391$$pp2:로,으로$ and help $npc:24003002[gender:1]$$pp:를,을$.

Then... please also gather the <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000725$</font> carried by the $npc:21000232[gender:0]$ here. It is absolutely necessary to repair the steering gear, and what is on the ship now is not enough. I think we need more.

Then... $MyPCName$! Please <font color="#ffd200">defeat the pirates</font> in $map:02000182$ and gather <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000725$</font> too. I am counting only on you, $MyPCName$, chorong!

Then... $MyPCName$! Please <font color="#ffd200">defeat the pirates</font> in $map:02000182$ and gather <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000725$</font> too. I am counting only on you, $MyPCName$, chorong!

And there are normally many pirates here, so if a ship tries to leave, they will obviously attack right away. That is why $npc:11003082[gender:0]$$pp:는,은$ <font color="#ffd200">secretly set sail at night</font>, chorong.
Say there is no time to wait, and that you will deal with the pirates, so prepare to set sail.
Tell me when you are ready. We will depart. To $map:02000391$.
Ask if $npc:11003082[gender:0]$$pp:는,은$ is not going with you.
When you arrive at $map:02000391$, there will be many pirates... I pray you meet $npc:24003002[gender:1]$$pp:를,을$ safely, chorong.
$npc:11003082[gender:0]$$pp:는,은$ only drives the ship. The rest is up to $MyPCName$. Now, hurry! Meet $npcName:24003002[gender:1]$, come back, and we will talk again, chorong!
$MyPCName$, you came! Let's see, let's see... One, two, three, four... Puhehe. Done. This should be enough, chorong. While $MyPCName$ was away, I roughly fixed the ship, so we can go now.
Say you do not know where to board the ship.
Tell them not to worry and to say it.
The ship is right outside this cabin, chorong. You just need to enter the black door on the ship... but you cannot find it... I will shove you over there, chorong!
Well... she says to come to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000388$</font>$pp2:로,으로$, which is swarming with pirates. You saw that nasty-looking first mate, right? She wants to steal his ship, chorong!
Ask if you cannot go on $npc:11003082[gender:0]$'s ship.
Say it is not a bad plan.

The sea where <font color="#ffd200">$npc:24002931$</font>$pp:가,이$ is located is rough, so my ship will not do. We need a <font color="#ffd200">bigger ship</font>. Even so, this is too reckless, but $npc:24003001[gender:1]$$pp:는,은$ was happy, saying it was perfect for getting revenge on the pirates who flirted with $npc:24003002[gender:1]$, chorong...!
It is in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000063$</font>. They said it is inside a cave shaped like a waterfall. Go carefully... Good luck, chorong.
...You are a frightening human, chorong. To agree with <font color="#ffd200">$npc:24003001[gender:1]$</font>'s thinking. Then hurry and go. $npc:11003082[gender:0]$$pp:는,은$ is not going, chorong.
Ask where $map:02000388$$pp:가,이$ is.
Then... shall we talk calmly? Please speak to me when you are ready.
Say you are ready.
$npc:24002931$... is still agitated, but thanks to $MyPCName$, they seem to have calmed down a little. Thank you.
<font color="#ffd200">$map:02000388$</font>$pp:는,은$ is in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000063$</font>. They said it is inside a cave shaped like a waterfall. Go carefully... Good luck, chorong.
Ask if there is still something left to do.
Say you are ready.
La~ lalala~ Waves, please lend us your power. Clear away the murky energy so that only we remain and can speak...
Then... shall we talk calmly? Please speak to me when you are ready.
I will borrow the power of the waves to drive away all the murky energy around here. After that, we can calmly speak with $npc:24002931$ without any interference. Then... shall we begin?
Say you are ready.
Ask if there is still something left to do.
La~ lalala~ Waves, please lend us your power. Clear away the murky energy so that only we remain and can speak...
$MyPCName$! You returned safely without injuries. Did the search produce any results?
Say you are ready.
I will borrow the power of the waves to drive away all the murky energy around here. After that, we can calmly speak with $npc:24002931$ without any interference. Then... shall we begin?
Apologize and ask how $npcName:11003080[gender:0]$$pp:는,은$ is doing.
Say you met the person $npcName:11003080[gender:0]$$pp:가,이$ told you about.
What were you thinking about that left you staring blankly even when I called you like that? Honestly, what in the world happened...?
Ah, they seem a little better now. They still cannot leave the bed, though. They are still in <font color="#ffd200">$map:52000095$</font>, so go meet them yourself.
<font color="#909090">(My head is complicated... There is too much to think about.)</font>

$npc:24002931$...? Wow, my goodness. $npc:24002931$! You actually met the $npc:24002931$$pp:를,을$ that sailors call <font color="#ffd200">the sacred guardian deity of the ocean</font>. I am so jealous! I wanted to meet them too...!
Tell $npcName:11003080[gender:0]$$pp:를,을$ to ask slowly and calm them down.
Say that thanks to $npc:24003002[gender:1]$$pp:와,과$ and her sister $npc:24003001[gender:1]$, you met the divine beast $npc:24002931$$pp:를,을$.

Ah, sorry. I had so many questions that I... I should take a deep breath. Hoo~ hoo~ Lying here injured makes it so frustrating that I cannot go see for myself. All right. I am ready to listen now. Tell me slowly.
$npcName:11003080[gender:0]$ seems a little better now. They still cannot leave the bed, though. They are still in $map:52000095$, so go meet them yourself.
I see... That is very unfortunate. You should have asked for the winning Goldus lottery numbers...
Say that $npc:24003002[gender:1]$$pp:가,이$ told them to get well soon and meet again before long.
Answer that you could not get the information you wanted.

Right, I want to meet her too. $npc:24003002[gender:1]$$pp:는,은$ is a really good friend...! But how big is $npc:24002931$$pp:는,은$? How many times bigger than a person? Ah, what a shame! I will ask $npc:24003002[gender:1]$ to let me meet them too!
What did you talk about with $npc:24002931$$pp:와,과$? Did you get the information you wanted? Rumor says $npc:24002931$$pp:는,은$ knows everything.
Whew... But before that, recovering my body should come first. Thank you for telling me the story, $MyPCName$.
<font color="#909090">(A good friend... $npc:24003002[gender:1]$$pp:가,이$ might be a little sad to hear that.)</font>
Say goodbye and tell them to take care.

As I lie here doing nothing, I find myself looking back on the past... and I feel regret. $MyPCName$, I think that if I had <font color="#ffd200">a strong companion like you</font>, I could have gone to more mysterious and new places.
Say that if there is ever a chance, you should go on an adventure together.
Briefly report that you could not obtain information about the forces of darkness.
Ah... right. You need to return to Her Majesty. I do not think I was much help... but I hope you can find the information you want soon!
$MyPCName$, thank you for your hard work. Did you discover anything new where you went?
I see... That is unfortunate, but it cannot be helped. Here as well, we are focused only on recovering from the damage.
Ah... right. You need to return to Her Majesty. I do not think I was much help... but I hope you can find the information you want soon!
If we hear any new information... $MyPCName$, I will let you know as well.
<font color="#909090">(But that was only a vision... I should think carefully.)</font>
<font color="#909090">(In the vision $npc:24002931$$pp:가,이$ showed me... Her Majesty was definitely there...)</font>
But even amid these difficulties, those dispatched to various places are working hard... I believe a clue will emerge soon.
<font color="#909090">(For now, I should not tell anyone. Especially not Her Majesty...)</font>
Thank you for always working so hard for us, $MyPCName$.
Answer that of course you will go.

<font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000076[gender:0]$</font>$pp:가,이$ sent word that the forces of darkness were discovered in the snowy field. Because the matter is serious, there are almost no people who can serve as <font color="#ffd200">reinforcements</font>... but $npcName:11000076[gender:0]$$pp:는,은$ named you, $MyPCName$.
$MyPCName$, I called you because there is something I would like to ask of you. I am sorry, but... could you help?
I also believe you would be a great help to $npcName:11000076[gender:0]$. $MyPCName$, will you <font color="#ffd200">track the forces of darkness</font> with $npcName:11000076[gender:0]$$pp:와,과$?
Ask back if the information is certain.

<font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000076[gender:0]$</font>$pp:는,은$ will be waiting for you at <font color="#ffd200">$map:52000080$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000261$</font>. Please lend your strength to <font color="#ffd200">tracking the forces of darkness</font>.
Say you will hurry there and help $npcName:11000076[gender:0]$$pp:를,을$.
Thank you very much, $MyPCName$. $npcName:11000076[gender:0]$$pp:는,은$ will be waiting for you at <font color="#ffd200">$map:52000080$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000261$</font>.
The report says $npcName:11000076[gender:0]$$pp:가,이$ <font color="#ffd200">saw it directly</font>. It seems they are having a hard time in the snow. It is an unfamiliar place, after all…
You really do have sharp eyes... You found it already. My wound is nothing serious. Anyway, thank you for coming.
$MyPCName$! I was waiting for you.

Maybe because this place is unfamiliar, there were more <font color="#ffd200">injured people</font> than expected. We need to reorganize the unit, but we cannot stop the pursuit... I needed help from <font color="#ffd200">someone I can trust</font>, and I thought of you. Haha.
Ask them to explain in detail what happened.
Ask if they are all right, since it looks like there is a long wound on their arm.

After hearing that suspicious rumbling could be heard in the snow, I was searching <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000260$</font>$pp:를,을$ with a few Royal Guard members when we found monsters from the forces of darkness inside a cave hidden behind the trees. Just as we were about to track them, we encountered that man.
Ask if $npcName:11000076[gender:0]$ was injured then as well.

He used powerful swordsmanship... but we could not identify him. He attacked both the monsters of darkness and our members who were confronting them. He said <font color="#ffd200">not to interfere with his fight</font>.

...Yes. On top of that, the wind here is quite fierce, so I cannot leave the wound untreated. While being treated, I have no choice but to stay here. The same goes for the Royal Guard members. But during that time, we cannot lose the <font color="#ffd200">clue we barely found</font>.

At first, I thought he too belonged to the <font color="#ffd200">forces of darkness</font>. But he attacked everyone without distinguishing friend from foe, and none of our members were seriously wounded... so that does not seem to be the case.

I believed you would do that, $MyPCName$. Midway up <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000260$</font>, if you look <font color="#ffd200">behind the frozen trees</font>, there is an <font color="#ffd200">ice cave entrance</font>. Investigate carefully to see if any clues remain there, and tell me the results.

I believed you would do that, $MyPCName$. Midway up <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000260$</font>, if you look <font color="#ffd200">behind the frozen trees</font>, there is an <font color="#ffd200">ice cave entrance</font>. Investigate carefully to see if any clues remain there, and tell me the results.
$npcName:11000076[gender:0]$$pp:는,은$ said there is an ice cave entrance here. As he said, let us investigate behind the trees.
Say you will go there.
The cold wind coming from behind the trees seems to blow from quite far away. It seems you found the place $npcName:11000076[gender:0]$$pp:가,이$ mentioned.
Say that, as $npcName:11000076[gender:0]$ said, you saw monsters from the forces of darkness.
Say you encountered that man.
You have returned. Did you discover anything?
