As expected, it seems there are traces that the <font color="#ffd200">forces of darkness</font> stayed there. Was there anything else?
Let us enter the ice cave along the path opened behind the trees.
He saved you... Then it seems he too is opposed to the forces of darkness. Perhaps he has a <font color="#ffd200">clue</font> we do not.

Yes... It is unfortunate, but it cannot be helped. Then back to the main issue. Did you perhaps go all the way <font color="#ffd200">inside the ice cave</font>? We could not go deep, so we were unable to search it at all.
Say you were trapped in a barrier and almost attacked by monsters, but he saved you.
By that man... do you mean <font color="#ffd200">that unidentified swordsman</font>? ...Hmm, fortunately it seems you did not fight him. Judging by the lack of wounds.
Say it seems difficult, since he appears to act alone.
Say there was a narrow valley, but you could not advance because of the severe cold.
How could I not think of this? The cold must have numbed my head. If we ask <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11003060[gender:0]$</font> over there, he should know!

Correct. He is here temporarily because of supply provisioning. In the past, he was a citizen of the Snow Kingdom that existed in this region. If it is $npc:11003060[gender:0]$$pp:라면,이라면$, he may know about <font color="#ffd200">that valley</font> or <font color="#ffd200">how to endure the severe cold</font>.
Ask if $npc:11003060[gender:0]$... is not the <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000001$ weapon merchant</font>.

Hmm... Is that the <font color="#ffd200">snowfield's severe cold</font> I have only heard about? They say it is a cold with thick snowstorms and biting winds that ordinary people can never pass through. Only the <font color="#ffd200">people of the Snow Kingdom</font> know how to overcome it... Ah!
Oh, I think I have seen you in $map:02000001$. Good to see you, mae.
Yes, I think that would be best. Then I will leave it to you.
Say you will ask for advice and search further.
It would be best to ask $npc:11003060[gender:0]$ for advice and continue the investigation. Then I will leave it to you.
Tell them what happened here and ask for help.
Tell them what happened here and ask for help.
Say you have never seen them.
<font color="#909090">($npcName:11003060[gender:0]$'s face suddenly darkened. They look very sad.)</font>

...That place is the path leading to <font color="#ffd200">$map:52000083$</font>$pp2:로,으로$. That abnormal cold and snowstorm called the snowfield's severe cold is the magic of <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11003069[gender:1]$</font> there…
Come on, that is a lie. I saw you wandering around $map:02000001$, mae. Do not underestimate a merchant's eye. Hehe.

The supply provisioning was actually an excuse. I came here to meet our queen, mae. But when I saw that snowstorm, my heart ached... I could not go any farther. It seemed like the tears of <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003069[gender:1]$</font>, who fell into despair after losing the <font color="#ffd200">kingdom</font> and <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003075[gender:0]$</font>...

$MyPCName$. Do you really have to go in there? The reason $npcName:11003069[gender:1]$ is using such magic to keep outsiders away is because she <font color="#ffd200">does not want anyone to disturb her</font>... Leave the queen alone.
Say that is exactly why you must go in.
Then... then there is a need to confirm it. $MyPCName$, may I ask this of you?
Say that if the forces of darkness are there, $npcName:11003069[gender:1]$ will be in danger too.
Ask where you can meet him.

We yetis have weak senses of smell, so finding medicinal herbs is difficult, mae. But $npcName:11003063[gender:0]$ is different. That one finds herbs skillfully by the sense in his fingertips and makes medicine.

To overcome $npcName:11003069[gender:1]$'s magic, you would need magical power on her level. But that is realistically impossible... With a <font color="#ffd200">special medicine</font>, however, it may be possible to give you temporary immunity, mae.
Say that if you can break through the snowstorm, you will go check right away.
$npc:11003063[gender:0]$... Go meet $npcName:11003063[gender:0]$$pp:를,을$.
Cold. Annoying. Do not talk to me.

<font color="#ffd200">$map:02000263$.</font> There should be a small yeti there. That is <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003063[gender:0]$</font>$pp:다,이다$. Ask him to make <font color="#ffd200">$item:20000451$</font>...

<font color="#ffd200">$map:02000263$.</font> There should be a small yeti there. That is <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003063[gender:0]$</font>$pp:다,이다$. Ask him to make <font color="#ffd200">$item:20000451$</font>...
Wh-what? Who are you? What is your purpose? Do you even know what that is, asking me to make…
Say you want them to make $item:20000451$$pp:를,을$.

In the happy days of the past, I only thought she was a good ruler. But when the kingdom disappeared, the queen disappeared too. No fence remained. It was harder to bear than the bitter cold... and so we scattered.
Say it is not for $npcName:11003069[gender:1]$$pp:가,이$, but for Maple World as it is now.
Say you need to pass through $npcName:11003069[gender:1]$'s snowstorm and confirm her safety.
Are you telling me to help a <font color="#ffd200">pathetic person who hid herself away</font>, as if she alone carried all the sorrow in the world? What kind of queen is that?
Say that $npc:11003060[gender:0]$$pp:는,은$ is worried $npcName:11003069[gender:1]$$pp:가,이$ may be in danger.
Say the forces of darkness are threatening not only $npcName:11003069[gender:1]$, but all of Maple World.
Forget it. I am not interested. And that medicine is not easy to make. The ingredients are hard to obtain, mae.
Ask one more time for them to make $item:20000451$$pp:를,을$.

<font color="#ffd200">$item:30000723$.</font> Search the ice flowers growing all around $map:02000263$ and gather it. <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000724$.</font> Hunt $npc:21000256$ living in $map:02000264$. You heard me. Those are the ingredients. Bring them, and I will make it.

They threaten the entire world...? Why would people like that appear on the grounds of this kingdom that has already fallen? <font color="#909090">($npcName:11003063[gender:0]$$pp:가,이$ is gripping a hammer tightly and thinking about something.)</font>
Everything is correct. Then... stand over there and wait a moment.

<font color="#ffd200">$item:30000723$.</font> Search the ice flowers growing all around $map:02000263$ and gather it. <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000724$.</font> Hunt $npc:21000256$ living in $map:02000264$. You heard me. Those are the ingredients. Bring them, and I will make it.
The monsters are vicious, so it will not be easy... but hurry back. Before I change my mind.
If you had been a little later, I was going to leave somewhere else. Give me what you gathered.
Hand over the ingredients you gathered.
Ask how long the medicine's effect lasts.
Good thing I made plenty... Here. Take this. Keep track of it this time. And be careful, the effect does not last long.
Say you lost <font color="#ffd200">$item:20000451$</font>$pp:를,을$.

It is complete. Take it, <font color="#ffd200">$item:20000451$.</font> If you drink this, you should be able to endure even inside the snowstorm, mae. But you are only borrowing the medicine's power... and only for a <font color="#ffd200">short time</font>.
So make sure to drink it <font color="#ffd200">right before entering $map:52000082$</font>. Again, without this you absolutely cannot pass through that place, so keep that in mind.
$MyPCName$, you... <font color="#ffd200">already have it.</font> One is enough. But... be careful, the effect does not last long.
It is hard to give a definite answer. In any case, it is short. Drink it <font color="#ffd200">right before entering $map:52000082$</font>. That will be best.
Organize your bag first. If it is that full, I cannot give you anything.
Answer that you received help from the yetis.
I received unexpected help. From you, and from that swordsman... I will never forget this favor, or your name. But how... did you make it all the way here through the thick snowstorm?

I need to hurry and meet $npc:11003060[gender:0]$ to go to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000381$</font>$pp2:로,으로$... $MyPCName$, I am sorry, but could you help me? Because of the wound I received earlier... it is a little hard to walk.
But... this concerns <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003069[gender:1]$</font>. It is too much to ask...
Say they look like they can barely move, so you will deliver the message instead.
If you would do that, $MyPCName$, it would be a great help... but I feel like I am shamelessly asking you to do something that may be difficult.
Say you plan to go to $map:02000381$$pp2:로,으로$ with $npc:11003060[gender:0]$$pp:와,과$.
In that case... I will open a path so you can meet $npc:11003060[gender:0]$ quickly. I hope it helps, even a little.
Say you intend to investigate the ghost-like person.
Thank you very much. Then... tell me when you are ready. I will open the path for you.
Say you are ready.
Tell them to rest easy and focus on recovering.
Say you are ready.
I will open a path so you can meet $npc:11003060[gender:0]$ quickly. Please tell me when you are ready.
Winds of the snowfield, permit the path of the sky and guide us.
Say to wait a little.
Yes, since it is magical movement, you may feel dizzy for a moment. It is a shame I cannot go with you, since I can only move one person... Tell me when you are ready.
Say you are ready.
Yes, since it is magical movement, you may feel dizzy for a moment. It is a shame I cannot go with you, since I can only move one person... Tell me when you are ready.
Winds of the snowfield, permit the path of the sky and guide us.
Say you are ready.
Say to wait a little.

$map:02000382$$pp:는,은$ is the only place that leads to $map:52000086$$pp2:로,으로$, mae. The Snow Kingdom has disappeared, but the kingdom's secret treasure remains bound there. Our wise ancestors thought it was best that a great power that could threaten the world never emerge into the world, so they sealed it away firmly.
Say there is no time, so let us quickly go to $map:02000381$$pp2:로,으로$.

<font color="#ffd200">The Frozen Crystal...</font> That treasure, a tremendous crystal of cold, was sealed in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000383$</font> by the power of the kingdom's two rulers, the king and queen. The sturdy temple built by yeti engineers and offered to the king was sealed with it. The only path leading there is <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000382$</font>, which only the queen can open.
Then we need to hurry. Something truly serious may happen, mae.
Briefly explain what has happened so far.

Thanks to a thorough <font color="#ffd200">double mechanism</font>, the seal was firm. It could never be undone unless the wills of the two rulers came together, and under the teachings of the ancestors, they would never undo it...

But now that the kingdom and king have vanished, a crisis has come. The ghost-like person who appeared before $npcName:11003069[gender:1]$ promised, of all things, <font color="#ffd200">a reunion with $npcName:11003075[gender:0]$</font>, whom we thought had shared the kingdom's fate…

Yes... So we must stop $npcName:11003069[gender:1]$ from <font color="#ffd200">opening the path</font> as that person wishes. But right now, $npcName:11003069[gender:1]$ probably has nothing except the <font color="#ffd200">hope that she can meet $npcName:11003075[gender:0]$ again</font>... so it will be difficult.
Point out that this is too irresponsible an attitude for a ruler.
Ask if the seal can be undone if $npcName:11003075[gender:0]$$pp:가,이$ is alive.
Say you do not know exactly where the place they are talking about is.

As with every king and queen of the kingdom, they were <font color="#ffd200">each other's other half</font> <font color="#ffd200">from the moment of birth</font>. Separation could not exist, not even in imagination. Even if it had been $npcName:11003075[gender:0]$, he would have made a choice <font color="#ffd200">no different</font> from $npcName:11003069[gender:1]$'s...
It cannot be helped... Close your eyes for a moment. The winds of the snowfield will guide you before it.

That is exactly why we must protect her. We cannot let her lose even more and fall into deeper regret because of a <font color="#ffd200">misjudgment</font> made while she still cannot escape the grief of losing her kingdom and partner.

On the slope above $map:02000260$, there is a path leading to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000381$</font>$pp2:로,으로$. <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000382$</font>$pp:는,은$ has an entrance somewhere in the huge $map:02000381$. Since $npcName:11003069[gender:1]$ must have gone ahead now... I should be able to find it. Let us meet inside $map:02000381$.
It was not unexpected... but in the end, it has come to this. But we cannot give up like this, mae.
Say you do not know the way, so ask them to take you there.
Ask them to explain the location again.

There are narrow, steep ice stairs all the way to the top of $map:02000260$. Halfway up the peak... around where the stairs begin to connect, there are many frozen trees. If you examine the snow wall around them, there is a small cave. It will glow blue, so enter there.
It cannot be helped... Close your eyes for a moment. The winds of the snowfield will guide you before it.
<font color="#909090">$npc:11003060[gender:0]$$pp:는,은$ is muttering something with a focused expression.</font>

Now that the path to $map:02000383$$pp2:로,으로$ has already opened... we must confirm whether the Frozen Crystal is in danger, and what <font color="#ffd200">the being $npcName:11003069[gender:1]$ will meet there</font> truly is...

$map:52000086$... That place is hidden beyond the shining ice of <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000263$</font> by the power of transparent frost. But... since $npcName:11003069[gender:1]$ opened the path, the door should have appeared.
From now on, I will concentrate and find the door. Please wait a moment.
$MyPCName$... Tell me when you are ready to depart.
Say you do not know the way, so ask them to take you there.
Ask them to explain the location again.
Wait a little longer.
The entrance to $map:02000383$ is in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000263$...</font> You need to enter beside the tallest and steepest ice wall. Let us meet inside.
It cannot be helped... Close your eyes for a moment. The winds of the snowfield will guide you before it.

Yes... I heard the general story from $npc:11003060[gender:0]$ as well. I thought <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11003075[gender:0]$</font>$pp:와,과$ <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11003069[gender:1]$</font>$pp:는,은$ were names that vanished completely after the Snow Kingdom disappeared... To think I would encounter them here.
It cannot be helped... Close your eyes for a moment. The winds of the snowfield will guide you before it.
You looked quite busy, and I am sorry I could not help. In truth, I did not even have time to speak to you. I was busy the whole time reorganizing the unit and tracking incoming reports.
Say it is all right, and report what happened during that time.
You have returned, $MyPCName$. You worked hard.

Ah, and. Orders came down from <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000001$</font>. They say to conclude the investigation here and <font color="#ffd200">return</font>. I have also ordered our unit members to withdraw. We will depart soon.

Suddenly... seeing <font color="#ffd200">powerful people appearing who could not be seen before</font>, I felt as if pieces were gathering on a huge chessboard. When the board is completely filled, what will happen...?
Say you do not know what happened to the vanished $npc:11003062[gender:0]$$pp:가,이$.

Also, that <font color="#ffd200">ghost-like being...</font> is probably one of the <font color="#ffd200">forces of darkness</font>. There is that one who uses wicked words and schemes whose depths we cannot know, and even <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11003062[gender:0]$</font>, whom we met. He had remarkable skill...

You and I both crossed blades with him. He is not someone who would fall easily. After encountering him a few times, did you grow attached? You seem to be <font color="#ffd200">worried</font> about him.
Ask how their body is doing.
Before departing, meet $npc:11003060[gender:0]$$pp:를,을$. It seemed he had something to tell you.
Before departing, meet <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11003060[gender:0]$</font>$pp:를,을$. It seemed he had something to tell you.
I am all right now. <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003069[gender:1]$</font> <font color="#ffd200">healed</font> me…

The queen was silent for a while. She only stared endlessly into the distance... Then she said, <font color="#ffd200">thank you for protecting me.</font> She asked me to be sure to tell <font color="#ffd200">$MyPCName$</font> as well... I could not... say anything.

What happened to the king... whether the person I met was truly $npcName:11003075[gender:0]$, even I am confused, so how must the queen feel? The queen's eyes... definitely held <font color="#ffd200">tears</font>. My heart aches.
Tell them $npcName:11003063[gender:0]$ and $npcName:11003066[gender:1]$ must feel the same way.
Thank you, $MyPCName$... I will not forget your help or your heart. And I will help the queen recover her strength.
Yes, that is right. I am not alone. Instead of grieving that we lost the kingdom... we must live even harder. The <font color="#ffd200">ones who remain</font> must unite even more.
Comfort them by saying they are a fine knight who protected $npc:11003069[gender:1]$$pp:를,을$.
Ask if they are going back to $map:02000001$$pp2:로,으로$.
Say you will cheer them on.
I will cheer for $MyPCName$ too. Let us meet often from now on. Of course, in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000001$</font> too.
<font color="#909090">(I should return to $map:02000001$$pp2:로,으로$ and meet Her Majesty too.)</font>
Of course. I have many regular customers. I need money too. I will work hard at business, mae.

It was not information about $npc:11001851[gender:1]$$pp:나,이나$ or the stronghold where the forces of darkness are based, but I believe it was <font color="#ffd200">a sufficiently meaningful investigation</font>. They... are trying to use everything throughout Maple World.
We must investigate in more detail so we do not miss even the smallest thing. If any <font color="#ffd200">new information</font> comes in from now on, $MyPCName$, I will let you know as well.

The story of <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11003075[gender:0]$</font>, who was thought to have disappeared with the kingdom... is surprising. He was a benevolent king who loved his kingdom and people. The disappearance of the Snow Kingdom may also be related to the <font color="#ffd200">forces of darkness</font>.
$MyPCName$, you have returned. I heard from <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000076[gender:0]$</font> that your <font color="#ffd200">performance</font> was excellent this time as well.
Briefly report what happened during that time.
$MyPCName$!! I was looking for you. It seems Her Majesty has something to say regarding the founding of the Alliance Guard. She is waiting inside the palace, so hurry and go see her.
It seems $npcName:11004846[gender:1]$ has lost the glass slipper again. They formally asked our guild for help.
I will not forget your hard work in helping us so much this time as well. Thank you, $MyPCName$.
It still seems insufficient. Please find more $item:30001102$.
It will be hard to recognize the fairy's shoe at a glance, so if you bring me $item:30001102$, I will appraise it for you.
It seems everyone else has arrived as well, so let us go to $map:52000087$$pp2:로,으로$ and discuss the details. I will come down shortly, so please greet those who arrived first.
$MyPCName$, you have come! I was waiting for you. It seems the time has come for all of us to join forces and stand against the forces of darkness.

Through this investigation, we may be able to find a clue for counterattacking Madria and the forces of darkness. For that reason, this is a very important mission for the Guard, and we would like to entrust it to someone equally reliable.
Her Majesty is waiting inside the palace, so hurry and go see her.
I will come down shortly as well, so please greet those who arrived first.

First, go to the temporary Guard headquarters set up at $map:02010002$ on <font color="#ffd200">Karkar Island</font>. There, you can receive a report on the information gathered so far from a soldier called $npcName:11001311[gender:0]$$pp:라는,이라는$.
Ask how to start the mission.
Thank you very much! I believed you would certainly take on the mission. You can hear the details of the mission from $npcName:11000076[gender:0]$.
$MyPCName$, I am sorry that it feels like we always make you handle difficult things alone... I hope you will take it positively, as meaning that all of us trust and rely on you that much.

What we know for certain now is that something related to the Lumeragon is happening on <font color="#ffd200">Karkar Island</font>. Considering that <font color="#ffd200">Karkar Island</font> was once the sacred ground of the Lumeragons, you could say it is only natural.
Ask what Lumiwind is.
I pray you return with good news.
If you tell $npcName:11001276[gender:0]$ at $map:02000183$ about the mission, he will take you to <font color="#ffd200">Karkar Island</font> on a mysterious ship.
Ask to be taken to Karkar Island because you need to carry out a Guard mission.

Also, the waters leading to Karkar Island have rough currents, so no ships sail there. But do not worry. It is not that there is no way to go. If you tell $npcName:11001276[gender:0]$ at $map:02000183$ about the mission, he will take you there on a mysterious ship.
Say you understand, and ask them to take you to $map:02010002$.
As I said earlier, it broke down because I forced it to operate for you Guard people, so it cannot sail until it is repaired. If only that $npcName:11001011[gender:0]$ fellow were here…
Before the story becomes dangerous, ask once more what Lumiwind is.

What else! You are looking at a historic invention right before your eyes and still do not know? It is unfinished, but <font color="#ffd200">Lumiwind</font> is a work of art that made a dream reality, a masterpiece for the ages. It reminds me of Emma, who looked at me like a child when I said I would fly through the vast sky. That passionate night I spent with her…

Ahem! In any case, <font color="#ffd200">Lumiwind</font> is a large transport ship that can fly through the sky. It is an airship, on a completely different level from common sailing ships. Anyway, with this, there is nowhere in the world we cannot go!

<font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11001011[gender:0]$</font>$pp:는,은$ is a fairly useful engineer who invented Lumiwind with me. But not long ago, he left, saying there was no meaning in making a junk airship like this. Well, we had a huge fight as a farewell, too…
Ask why <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11001011[gender:0]$</font>$pp:가,이$ suddenly changed.
Hoo... It is a tiresome connection, but he is still a friend.
Ask who $npc:11001011[gender:0]$$pp:는,은$ is.

Who knows... It is probably because of the rapidly advancing scientific technology. I got angry at him, but I know it too. I know inventions like this lag behind the times. But chasing something with all your strength even when you know it is unrealistic, is that not what a dream is?
You should be able to find <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11001011[gender:0]$</font>$pp:은,는$ in $map:02000182$. I am not sure whether that stubborn mule will listen to your request.
He did not go very far, so you should be able to find him easily. I heard he signed a house contract in $map:02000182$ not long ago, so go there and look for him.
Ask if repairing Lumiwind would be possible if <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11001011[gender:0]$</font>$pp:가,이$ were here.
Ask where you can go to meet <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11001011[gender:0]$</font>$pp:는,은$.
If it is that fool, he should be able to do it. If you can persuade that stubborn mule to repair Lumiwind, I will take you wherever you want to go.
That is true... No one besides me properly understands Lumiwind's structure. Still, that changes nothing. I cannot help.
Persuade them that without $npcName:11001011[gender:0]$'s help, Lumiwind will remain broken.
To think the Lumiwind I devoted my youth to ended up like that... But I have given up life as an inventor and engineer. You should go back.
Ask them to repair the broken Lumiwind.
Ask why they are doing this.

The family who should have shared that joyful moment had already turned their backs on me. I was so frantic chasing my dream that I did not even notice my family leaving my side. That is why I left Lumiwind behind.
Hoo... It will be meaningless even if I tell you... I devoted my life to inventing Lumiwind. Day and night, without even weekends.

After clinging to it for over ten years, I created an airship that could fly without that supposedly great scientific technology: Lumiwind. But when completion was right before my eyes, I realized something.
I promised never to touch inventions again, and I do not want to give up the life I have now, where I can be with the family I belatedly regained.

The family who should have shared that joyful moment had already turned their backs on me. I was so frantic chasing my dream that I did not even notice my family leaving my side. That is why I left Lumiwind behind.
No words will change my mind, so give up and go back. I am sorry I cannot help.
<font color="#909090">(He took the bait...)</font> Say it may even be possible to complete the unfinished Lumiwind.
Provoke them by saying that if scientific technology is so great, it should be able to repair Lumiwind, so there is no need to worry.

Wait!!! H-hold on. I will help! I said I would never touch it again... but this is an unavoidable situation, so it should be fine. But if I do not deal with the surrounding noise my wife told me to handle, she will definitely ask what I have been doing all this time…
Say the situation is urgent, so you will ask anyone who can help.
Hm? You will do that? If I were ten years younger, they would not even be worth a single punch... Ahem! Anyway, then I leave the pirates to you. Leave Lumiwind to me!
Ask what the problem is with the surrounding noise.
Ask them to repair Lumiwind, saying you will wipe out the pirates.
I leave the pirates to you. Leave Lumiwind to me!

We moved here not long ago, and the real estate agent said it was a quiet place with only the sound of waves, but no such luck! There are pirates crawling all around! It seems those fellows are the cause of the noise, but I was wondering what to do about it.
Say thank you for helping, since it must have been a difficult decision.
Hehe... Do not worry. I showed my skills for the first time in a while and fixed it cleanly. I could not work on the unfinished parts, but there should be no problem operating it normally again.
Ask how the Lumiwind repairs went.
If you talk to that $npcName:11001276[gender:0]$ fellow, he will let you board Lumiwind. You are going to Karkar Island for the Guard mission, right? Anyway, good luck!
Haha... What a thing to say. I should be thanking you for letting me dream again, even if only for a moment.

So that was what happened... He really is a fool... Still, judging by his expression while repairing Lumiwind, he may come back someday. A dream never disappears as long as a person does not abandon it.
Tell them about $npcName:11001011[gender:0]$'s circumstances.
Ask when departure is possible.
You have returned! Honestly, I am surprised. To think you persuaded that stubborn mule.
If you talk to that $npcName:11001276[gender:0]$ fellow, he will let you board Lumiwind. You are going to Karkar Island for the Guard mission, right? Anyway, good luck!
It is possible anytime now! Tell me when you are ready.

Ah, you must mean the lodging for the soldiers who came with Allon. I think they said they would stay at <font color="#ffd200">$map:02010002$</font>. You should see <font color="#ffd200">$map:02010002$</font> after passing through Tiares Desert over there.
Ask where the temporary Guard headquarters is.
Arrived~ This is Karkar Island, known as the desert land. The atmosphere is very different from Victoria Island, right?
If you go to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02010002$</font> beyond Tiares Desert over there, you should be able to meet the Guard.
Ask if there is some kind of problem.
$MyPCName$! You have arrived! Thank you for coming such a long way. When I heard that $MyPCName$ would be taking charge of the investigation here, I felt so relieved…
If you go to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02010002$</font> beyond Tiares Desert over there, you should be able to meet the Guard.
Hoo... Exactly. I never imagined it would be such a difficult mission…
The story will be long to explain here, so please hear the details from $npcName:11001311[gender:0]$ inside the temporary headquarters.

To be honest... ever since the Tria invasion, everyone has been gripped by fear. At first, they were excited because it was the Guard's first mission, but when it came time to begin the investigation, everyone hesitated. They feared they might lose comrades like back then, and lose their own lives as well…
Please hear the details from that $npcName:11001311[gender:0]$ fellow inside the temporary headquarters.
Ask if some problem occurred with the investigation.

When we actually arrived, not only had a strange person appeared, but problems were breaking out everywhere, and the situation was impossible for us to handle alone. That is why we were waiting for $MyPCName$ to arrive.
Encourage them by saying Tria was protected because of everyone's efforts.

We want to help $MyPCName$, but right now, I think we would only be a burden. Everyone is trapped by the fear of death and is unwilling to step forward... I am sorry, but could you give us time to collect ourselves?
Ask if there is any information gathered so far.
Say it is fine to investigate alone, so they should not overdo it.
I wish that were true... But we could not save our comrades as they fell before our eyes, and had to watch helplessly. Someone as strong and brave as $MyPCName$ would not understand how we feel…

All we have are a few things heard from the villagers, and they are not much help. At least we heard Wei Hong of the Black Star Society happened to be here, and thought he might know something... He said he had information, but that we did not have what he wanted, and drove us away.
Huh? You are not thinking of meeting him, are you? There is no way that thug will listen, but if you still want to go... you should be able to meet him at $map:52010010$ inside $map:02010020$.

You should be able to meet Wei Hong at $map:52010010$ inside $map:02010020$. His subordinates are probably camped there in large numbers, so an ordinary person would not even think of entering, but with $MyPCName$'s skill, if you rough them up a little, they will lower their tails on their own.

His subordinates are probably camped there in large numbers, so an ordinary person would not even think of entering, but with $MyPCName$'s skill, if you rough them up a little, they will lower their tails on their own.
Ask where Wei Hong is now.
Wait!!! I understand your skill, so c-calm down. I do not know what you want, but first let us talk, solve this through talking.
Ah... no~ Why so hasty~ You should hear people out to the end. Because he is such an important person, I have to contact him first... Wait a moment.
Say that if talking will not work, you will use another method.
Lord Wei Hong? Hahahaha! You must think Lord Wei Hong is some friend of yours who you can meet whenever you want. Does the boss of the Black Star Society look that easy to you?
It seems we were a bit rude to our guest, so I apologize. All right, it looks like you came because you want something, so why not tell me?
Say you will meet Wei Hong.
You see the door behind me? Lord Wei Hong, whom you were looking for, is waiting inside, so go in.
Say you are surprised they remember.
......Yes, understood. You are lucky. He happened to be here, and he says he wants to see the face of the one causing the disturbance. You see the door behind me? He is waiting inside, so go in.
There are not many reckless people like you. Hehe... So what business brought you here? Not many people know I came here.
I wondered what fearless fool was making a fuss... It has been a while, rookie.
There happens to be one matter that would be suitable for you to handle. It is something my subordinates could do well enough, but it is a little troublesome for that.
Ah, this must be about those proud Guard fellows. I kindly talked them down and sent them away, and they sent you? From the look of it, you must be running around as their lackey.
Ask about the strange person in the form of a dragon.
Tell him to just answer the question.

Keke... You are not in a position to talk to me like that, are you? I do have information. That is the power of the Black Star Society. But you know, right? If you want information, you need to have what I want.
That is how it should be~ You do not have a choice anyway, do you? You had better hurry. If you cannot recover the train, your chance to obtain the information will disappear with it. Keke…

You should be able to chase the Blacknov by taking another train at $map:02010009$. Oh, and the foolish subordinates who lost the train are named $npcName:11003124[gender:0]$ and $npcName:11003125[gender:0]$. Bring them back to me alive. Until I punish them, even death will not be allowed.
Say you will hear what it is.
Say to stop joking, and that you will accept if he gives the information you need.

Our Black Star Society has a high-speed freight train known as the Blacknov. This time, I assigned my subordinates to escort that train, but those fools failed to handle the job properly. According to current reports, an unidentified organization attacked and hijacked the train.
Hm! Honestly, I did not think you would really pull it off. You are a rookie, but more useful than I expected.
Ask for the information about the strange person, as promised.

Now then, as promised, I will give you the information you want. First, the strange person in the form of a dragon that you are looking for is targeting the vanished dragon race, the Lumeragons. Perhaps he has the same goal as you Guard fellows pursuing the Lumeragons' whereabouts.
Do not worry. This Wei Hong is a man who keeps his promises.
!!!... Ask how he knows about the Lumeragon investigation.
Children? Ask what children he means.

It is not as if I am asking for anything that big. You just need to handle another annoying matter. In truth, Karkar Island is a place where the Black Star Society invested a tremendous amount of capital. The fact that the surrounding region could prosper around Ludari City in such a short time is all thanks to our Black Star Society's investment.
...Ask what he wants.

Well~ It seems the deal is over for now. What I agreed to tell you was information about the strange person, and this is all I know about that strange person. If you need other information, should you not give me something else too? Hehe...
Except for the children the Dragon Master tried to protect even at the risk of death.

Hmph, using your head, are you? If you complete the job well, I will give you all the related information. The business is at $map:02010019$. Go there and speak to a fellow called $npcName:11001342[gender:0]$$pp:라는,이라는$, and he will tell you what to do. I will contact them in advance and say you are coming.

Anyway, recently insects appeared at one of our businesses and are interfering with operations. What you need to do is go there and clean up the insects. Well, for the price of high-grade information, it is a very cheap job. Whether you choose to do it or not is up to you, though.

The business is at $map:02010019$. Go there and speak to a fellow called $npcName:11001342[gender:0]$$pp:라는,이라는$, and he will tell you what to do. I will contact them in advance and say you are coming.
Say you will do it if he gives you all information related to the Lumeragons and the strange person.

For some reason, insect monsters appeared in swarms not long ago, and now they are occupying the surrounding area. We called various pest control companies, but perhaps because they are not ordinary insects, it was useless. At this rate, Liddis Waterpia may have to close. Please help us!
I think the first priority is to defeat the insect monsters around here. I would like to help too, but someone like me cannot even get close... Please! You must exterminate them!
I think the first priority is to defeat the insect monsters around here. Please! You must exterminate them!

Yes, it is a more hideous one, different from the ones you defeated. Like a general leading an army, it is the one who brought the insects here. It has occupied the inside of Liddis Waterpia and seems to be rummaging around the water park searching for something.
Ask what should be handled first.
Thanks to you, it seems things have been cleaned up a bit for now. If we can just deal with their leader now, I think reopening Liddis Waterpia might somehow be possible.
Oh, headquarters said to come receive the promised reward. They said you would know where…

I was anxious that I might lose my job at a time when work is so hard to find... Now people can gather here again. It is all thanks to you, expert. Thank you once again! Oh, headquarters said to come receive the promised reward. They said you would know where…
If you go straight up Rainbow Hill above here, you should see it. It will not be easy, but I ask for your help again!
Ask where the inside of Liddis Waterpia is.
If you go straight up Rainbow Hill, you should see the inside of Liddis Waterpia.
Hehe... It seems you have a temper as nasty as mine. All right, where should I begin?

The final Dragon Master, Biset, is said to have died while protecting children who had lost their parents and were wandering amid fierce battle on the battlefield. But if that were all, one could not say those children were connected to the Lumeragons.
There were four children saved thanks to the Dragon Master. All four are said to have grown up here on Karkar Island…

Some of their whereabouts are unclear. They are clever little rats hiding so thoroughly that even the Black Star Society struggles to find them. But I liked the little performance you have shown so far, so I will give you an extra reward. Two of those children are already in the Black Star Society's hands.
Ask what that means.

$npc:11001294[gender:0]$$pp:는,은$ may be difficult due to circumstances, but if it is $npc:11001297[gender:1]$$pp:라면,이라면$, I can let you meet her. Go to $map:02010064$$pp:로,으로$ in $map:02010016$ and you should see her.

Do not get strange ideas with that barely working head of yours. The champions of the Ludari Arena fighting matches and motorcycle tournament hosted by our Black Star Society, $npc:11001294[gender:0]$$pp:와,과$ and $npc:11001297[gender:1]$$pp:가,이$, just happen to be those children Biset saved. Hmph, from the look of you, you want to meet them…
You tiresome people... How many times do I have to say it before you understand? Please just get lost.
You can see $npc:11001297[gender:1]$$pp:은,는$ by going to $map:02010064$$pp:로,으로$ in $map:02010016$.
You came to spout nonsense about telling you the whereabouts of the Lumeragons too, right? No matter how much you people threaten me, I do not know anything, so you are wasting your time.
Ask where that friend is now.
Ask what it would take for them to believe you.
Aha~ Is that so? Did you think that if you said you were with the Guard, I would fawn over you and say, oh my~ welcome, brave hero~? I can spot frauds like you instantly.
Say you are not with the Black Star Society, but the Guard.
Hmm... If you are really with the Guard, you would not ignore something unjust, would you? One of my friends is in danger right now. If you save that friend, I will trust you a little.
Say $npc:11001294[gender:0]$? You heard $npc:11001294[gender:0]$ could not be met due to circumstances.

I do not know the details because I am trapped here too. I learned it by overhearing the ones who tried to extract information from me whispering, and they said they would make him fight someone called Basara Chen at $map:52010004$ in $map:02010020$. Go there.

I do not know where or from whom you heard what, but those circumstances mean my friend was dragged away by the Black Star Society. Even if he is a champion, his opponent is the Black Star Society. Save my friend from them.
Ask where $npc:11001294[gender:0]$ is now.
He has a gentle face but a large build. His name is $npcName:11001294[gender:0]$. Even if it does not suit him, he is the current champion of Ludari Arena.
I... have nothing to say, so do whatever you want... I will never sell out my friends.
Say there seems to be a misunderstanding, so calm down.

Hm? You... were not a member of the Black Star Society? Now that I look... your outfit is different too... Sorry, I must have been confused because I fainted because of the Black Star Society and then suddenly saw you.
Say it is all right, briefly introduce yourself, and say you came at $npc:11001297[gender:1]$'s request.
They said they would make $npc:11001294[gender:0]$$pp:를,을$ fight someone called Basara Chen at $map:52010004$ in $map:02010020$. Go there.
Say the Black Star Society has not found them yet, but you do not know whether they are safe.
Explain the Guard's situation and the information you heard from Wei Hong.
Say not to worry, since the Guard mission is the same thing anyway.

So that is what happened... I thought this was because I refused the last request to fix a match. And not only the Black Star Society, but even a strange person in the form of a dragon is looking for us... Are my f-friends okay? They have not been captured by that strange person, have they?

I am sorry, but please help! Please just check whether my other friends are safe. Since my sister $npc:11001297[gender:1]$ and I are being watched by the Black Star Society, it will be hard for us to move. If you go find $npc:11001292[gender:0]$$pp:를,을$ at $map:02010053$, you should be able to meet the people you are looking for.

You are saying $npc:11001294[gender:0]$$pp:가,이$ sent you to ask how we are doing? Customer, do you want to get hit? What kind of trick is this? When that guy asks how we are doing, it always means something has happened to him. What on earth happened?
Customer, please sit down. You can order at the table. Stop getting in the way while I cook.
If you go find $npc:11001292[gender:0]$$pp:를,을$ at $map:02010053$, you should be able to meet the remaining children. Please check whether my friends are safe and well.

And one more thing. That $npc:11001292[gender:0]$ fellow acts cool on the outside, but he is very hot-blooded. If he learns about my and Tara's situation, he is sure to do something reckless, so just tell him we are doing well.
Say $npc:11001294[gender:0]$ sent you.
Package the story nicely, as $npc:11001294[gender:0]$ asked.
I am not exactly the patient type. It will be better for your health if you talk quickly.

So... what you are saying is that you left my friends behind and came to me. In a place crawling with Black Star Society members. Are you out of your mind? How could you leave them there when you know what those bastards might do!
Tell the truth.

That is ridiculous. It is not as if I have only known him for a day or two. Do you think I do not know him? Something serious clearly happened, and he is trying to take it all on himself. You had better spill it while I am asking nicely. Otherwise I will fry you in oil…
Ask if they have any idea.
Shut up... Tell me where my friends are right now. I will smash the Black Star Society or whatever Society it is.
<font color="#909090">(It is just as Dunba said...)</font> Tell them to calm down for now.
Ask where the friend named Mika is now.
Say the Black Star Society cannot do anything until they find the Lamestone.
Ask if they have seen a girl named Mika.
What is it, mi? The Meerkat Scouts are busy, yung.

That girl wanders around so much she sometimes does not come home for days. There is a place she often goes because it calms her mind, but it is a little far from here, so I cannot leave the others behind and go now. Why does she have to wander around at a time like this…
Say you will look for Mika, so they should go to their friends.

Go to the village called $map:02010063$$pp:라는,이라는$ and meet a meerkat called $npc:11001313[gender:0]$$pp:라는,이라는$. If it is the meerkats, they will definitely know where Mika is. Remember this. If anything happens to Mika, you are finished too.
I can tell you, yung. But can you help us too, mi?
Snow Kingdom? Ask if they know where she went.
Ask if you just need to eliminate those dead.

Here on Karkar Island, there was once a kingdom called Merzid, mi. It was originally a human kingdom that served the Lumeragons, but one day it was stained by darkness, yung. In the end, it was destroyed by heroes, and now only a few ruins remain and it has been forgotten, but recently the dead have awakened at those ruins, mi!
Mika? A girl? Do you mean a girl who carries something sparkly, mi? I saw a girl talking about the vanished Snow Kingdom not long ago, yung.

Rather than that, I want you to investigate inside the pyramid where the dead are awakening, yung. It is the pyramid in $map:02010023$. A few of our Meerkat Scouts went there, but they all came back out of their minds, mi... Please find out what on earth is happening inside, mi!

So those things happened, mi... An uneasy feeling is coming over me, yung. It seems what is happening now is only the beginning, mi... Anyway, thank you, mi. Our Meerkat Scouts will investigate further too, yung!
Look for the girl you are searching for in $map:02010026$, yung. She said she needed a new home and went to the abandoned temple there, mi.
Look for the girl you are searching for in $map:02010026$, yung. She said she needed a new home and went to the abandoned temple there, mi.
Say you cannot guarantee the result, but you will do your best.
If you bring 10 sugarcane to Natalie in Tria, you will learn about my perfect candy recipe. I should emphasize that opportunities like this are rare.
Have you still not departed? You need to obtain sugarcane from candy balloons. I expect it will not be difficult, but…
Candy balloons have appeared all over Maple World. Your task is very simple. Inspect the candy balloons and obtain sugarcane.
Of course, the recipe is also perfectly prepared. $MyPCName$. If you gather the sugarcane that will become the ingredient for my candy recipe, this will become very easy.
They say that on White Day, people give candy to express their feelings. But I have discovered a way to use this candy more efficiently.
What are you dawdling for? Find 10 sugarcane from candy balloons! Natalie should be waiting in Tria.

Mason gave me a crumpled note and asked me to evaluate candy made with the sugarcane $MyPCName$ brings. Following the recipe, I was able to make candy with a sour and unique flavor. Here, I think $MyPCName$ should eat it and judge for yourself.
I hear candy balloons have appeared in Maple World. If it were me, I would bring the whole candy balloon. I do not know whether you have that kind of guts…
If you inspect candy balloons, you should be able to obtain sugarcane. Bring 10 sugarcane to Natalie in Tria. She will prove that candy made the way I say is much tastier!
I hear the day when people exchange candy is coming soon. Do you know anything about it? That Mason fellow was going around everywhere claiming he had the perfect candy recipe…
Ah, sorry. I was thinking about something, so I did not even notice you came. Ahem. What is it?
Ah, sorry. I was thinking about something, so I did not even notice you came. Ahem. What is it?
Tap $npc:11000019[gender:0]$$pp:를,을$ and say you have something to ask.
Tap $npc:11000019[gender:0]$$pp:를,을$ and say you have something to ask.

Conder gave me a large note and asked me to appraise candy made with the sugarcane $MyPCName$ brings. With this, I think we can bring out a clean flavor. I will give you the candy, so $MyPCName$ should take it. Conder will not remember anyway…
Right, there is no time for this. Please hurry to Maple Alliance Command Headquarters. Everyone should be waiting for $MyPCName$.
I have been late to introduce myself. I am Loin of the Secret Knights. I have heard much of $MyPCName$'s achievements. You truly worked hard in that snowy field.
$npc:24003001[gender:1]$$pp:가,이$ gave me a talisman to use if you said you did not know where the entrance is... They said using this makes you dizzy. Close your eyes, chorong.
Say you have absolutely no idea where it is.
Ah! $MyPCName$! I was looking for you anyway. Please hurry and go, $MyPCName$. I wish you luck!
Correct. I hear in-depth research was conducted using the Lamestone that $MyPCName$ recovered.
Welcome, $MyPCName$. I was waiting for you.
We have received word that Wizard Master $npcName:11000042[gender:1]$ has completed a remarkable spell to track Madria's stronghold.
It seems the time has finally come.
Please hurry and go, $MyPCName$. I wish you luck!
You arrived right on time, $MyPCName$.
We really moved without rest. We did not even have time for a founding ceremony, let alone to exchange names.
All the commanders already know this, but since the Tria invasion, the Maple Alliance has gathered information on the forces of darkness from many angles.
But officially, there has not yet been a battle where the Alliance joined forces for a 'counterattack.' There have been battles large and small, but no firm information to speak of.
In other words, we have not yet gotten even a little closer to the enemy's root.
$MyPCName$, this is the mission I will give you. Pursue Madria's dragon together with $npcName:11000042[gender:1]$, and through it, find the enemy's stronghold.
Yes. The Lumeragon tracking spell. $npcName:11000042[gender:1]$, having succeeded in analyzing the Lamestone recovered from Karkar Island, finally managed to create it.
But from this point on, I believe the situation will change. That is thanks to Wizard Master $npcName:11000042[gender:1]$ achieving unexpected results.
It will be quite difficult... but right now, the Maple Alliance has no spare strength. To fill the gap in the Tria Royal Guard's forces, every unit has deployed all available personnel.
There was information that the dragon Madria commands closely resembles a Lumeragon. If so, we have a definite key leading to them.
Thank you, Your Majesty. Teleporting such a long distance made me a little tired. But somehow it feels like all the important discussion is already over?
Thank you for coming all this way, Wizard Master $npcName:11000042[gender:1]$.
(Say you will definitely do it.)

Not a moment of hesitation. I like that about you. Do not worry. You need only assist Wizard Master $npcName:11000042[gender:1]$ and perform reconnaissance. $npcName:11000042[gender:1]$ will handle the thinking.
Hm, by the way, $npcName:11000042[gender:1]$ is late. I was told they would arrive by a very fast method…
Well, the core of it is over. Still, I accurately explained that thanks to your efforts, the Alliance has entered a new phase.
That is not what I mean, Com. Man. Der. You did not say a single word about the Lumeragons' fantastic mana arrangements and their tremendous potential?
E-enough! I understand completely! It seems I did not examine your report properly...! I will convey your rap... no, your story just now to the Alliance forces in detail.
Of course. By comparison, the Lumeragon tracking spell I completed is only a primitive spell, barely able to imitate their brilliant level of knowledge.
I promise on the honor of the knight order.
(That is a good method, $npcName:11001577[gender:1]$. But can you obtain it?)
Well, if even this much helps the Maple Alliance, I am truly happy as a dragon maniac.
This is strictly a reconnaissance mission. If you discover Madria's stronghold or an equivalent military area, the Alliance forces will handle what comes after.
...There is no helping it, Your Majesty. How about this method? (Whisper whisper)
...I-in that case, shall we discuss the operation further? $npcName:11000042[gender:1]$, participate in the search operation with this friend, using the tracking spell to pursue Madria's dragon.
I know exactly where to start and what to do. Just leave it to me.
(...It is real. A real dragon maniac has appeared.)
$npcName:11000042[gender:1]$, if you complete this mission successfully, our royal family has a gift we would like to give you.
Good. In that case…
The Nermantoise 10th Anniversary Limited Figure, 'Onyx Dragon Afrien' Obsidian Edition.
First, according to the results of the first tracking spell, Lumeragon mana was detected in a certain area of Frozen Lava Hole. Come find me at Frozen Lava Hole!
That much is general information. Honestly, with only this, we would not have been able to learn specific information about the dragon we are tracking. It could be an ordinary dragon.
You came, $MyPCName$. The figure... no, I was worried about the peace of Maple World, so I rushed here, and ended up departing too suddenly. Haha.
Ordinary people do not know much about terrain like this, but dragons truly love places like this. Dragons really like hot things.
First, according to the results of the first tracking spell, Lumeragon mana was detected in a certain area of Frozen Lava Hole. Come find me at Frozen Lava Hole!
($npcName:11000042[gender:1]$ seems busy analyzing mana.)
But look at these stones. According to the tracking spell, the Lumeragon mana was coming from these <font color="#ffd200">runestones</font>.

Runestones let you use fairly large spells with only a small amount of your own magical power. Because they draw mana from the earth and arrange it, you can cast enough magic without using the caster's own magical power.
I feel like we can get a clue. If we know the overall placement of the runestones, I think we can learn the size of the dragon we are looking for and various other information.
(Tell them what you investigated.)
After analyzing the mana here, I detected a kind of spatial alteration magic. But why would they go so far as to use runestones to cast alteration magic?
I see... Judging by the range of the runestones, I can roughly estimate the size of the dragon we are looking for. If so, my analysis results seem credible as well.
My hypothesis is this. [A giant Lumeragon wanted to quietly enjoy a hot spring bath while hiding itself without leaving traces of its own magic.]

Now then, based on the information we gained here, shall I use the tracking spell once more? If we know the size of the dragon we are tracking and the magic it used, we can obtain more certain information.
But the cleanup was not thorough. They probably did not expect a skilled mage to investigate before the runestones crumbled.
As expected, I learned more information than when I used the tracking spell the first time. The more clues there are, the higher the accuracy becomes, huh?
If until now we were fishing with a thread tied to a tree branch, from now on, let us try real dragon fishing.
(Now then, hurry and teleport.)
$MyPCName$, the next place where Lumeragon mana reacted is a lava area deep in Magma Gorge.
It is frustrating that the trail ended not far away, but the Lumeragon mana reacted more strongly there than here. I am sure we can obtain a clearer clue there.
Good work getting here. But it is really hot here... I did not know magma was this hot... As expected, outside the blanket is…
(Say wh-what are they talking about.)
You really could not date a mage. Do you know how much mana teleporting consumes? And if the targets increase to two or three people, it gets many times harder.
(...Say you understand.)
The easiest moment to break up with a mage lover is when you say, [Teleport me home]. Got it?
A dragon's skin is like steel, so when they are wounded, they enter hot fire or lava to fill in scratches and heal. Like melting a damaged sword in hot fire to repair it.
You see the dragon scales scattered everywhere, right? Just from this, we can tell what the dragon we are tracking did here.
$MyPCName$, investigate the dragon scales scattered around here. One or two samples will not be accurate, so I want to know the traits of every scale possible.
During that process, old scales naturally fall from the body, and since scales are still a proper part of the body, they contain a wealth of information about physical condition and mana traits.
Anyway, $MyPCName$, it seems there are many truly interesting clues here as well.
I want to help too, but it is too hot to approach... Sorry, $MyPCName$.
This is... a rather surprising clue. The fact that dark energy was found on the dragon scales means…
(Hold out your hand and show Orde.)
You are right... It is a very tiny amount, but I can definitely feel dark energy. It must be traces that rubbed off when you touched the scales.
(Say you somehow felt an aura of darkness from the scales.)
Think about it. Finding traces of a Lumeragon is surprising enough, but that dragon also has dark energy. Is that not too perfect to be coincidence?
Hmm... Maybe we can learn the source of this dark energy.
To be honest, this one we are looking for seems certain to be Madria's dragon.
Wait just a little. With the information we just obtained, I will use the tracking spell once more...!
In that case, from now on, I will adjust the tracking spell mainly around where this dragon headed.
Somewhere in the Land of Darkness, I can feel dark energy entangled with Lumeragon mana.
(Ask if they are leaving you alone again this time.)
(Look at them pitifully.)
But from here, I cannot fully sense that energy. First, I need to sense the mana again at $map:02000146$, which is close to the Land of Darkness.
Now, $MyPCName$. I will go ahead-
Well... Still, investigating all sorts of things with $MyPCName$ seems to be giving me a lot of study and experience. Let us call it even.
Ugh... As expected, teleporting multiple people is too hard. Looking at me so pitifully is against the rules, $MyPCName$.
Nyaha... I lose, I lose. Come with me, $MyPCName$. But if I collapse, you are taking responsibility, okay?
(Say thank you.)
Nyaha... I lose, I lose. Come with me, $MyPCName$. But if I collapse, you are taking responsibility, okay?
Thanks to their unique respiratory organs, dragons can obtain mana from the air just by breathing.
$MyPCName$, we do not have time to stand around here. That place has long been famous for drawing troublemakers after dark energy.
That place is full of vaporized dark matter, and it seems Madria's dragon replenished dark energy there.
(Say the Land of Darkness is dangerous, so Orde should stay here.)
Tch... This has gotten complicated. It seems Madria's dragon had business in the Black Fog Forest.
Simple. You just need to eliminate the troublemakers. In the process, dark matter will get all over your body, and I plan to investigate using that energy. Like the mana traces on the dragon scales.
Um... To be honest, I am a little tired... I used tracking spells in succession... And we teleported too, right? The two of us. No wonder I am tired!
You can reach the Black Fog Forest through Black Rock Mountain in the Land of Darkness. Look carefully.
All right, $MyPCName$. I will rest here and gather my strength. While I do that, investigate, and then let us find the next destination.
(Ask what you should investigate in the Black Fog Forest.)
Well now... I know they say it is darkest under the lamp, but this is too much.
(Ask what happened.)
Anyway, now I will use this clue to look for the next investigation area. I think the goal is not far away.
With such a terrifying place there, how could Maple World have been safe unless the entire Land of Darkness was sealed? I think the royal family's decision was right.
Oh... To think this much dark energy could be detected just from going there and back.
You remember the natural hot spring at Frozen Lava Hole, right? Basically, it is the same magic used there, but the scale and depth of the magic here are on a completely different level.
$MyPCName$, this is the place where the Lumeragon mana mixed with dark energy was used.
Look, our bodies are floating around. That is proof that phase magic powerful enough to break the laws of gravity controls this place.
First, I found out what magic the Lumeragon mana mixed with dark energy was used for, and where it was used.
There is no need to waste breath explaining. The place where that magic was used is very close to here. Let us talk while seeing it with our own eyes.
Maybe that is only natural. It is not ordinary magic, but dragon magic. How could humans beat that?
Hmm... Good analysis, $MyPCName$. I think the Lumeragon mana left on our bodies during the investigation may have acted like a pass for this place.
First, about this enormous phase conversion magic, even if every mage in Maple World rushed in, they probably could not remove it. The scale of the magical power itself is different.
(Say maybe it is because we had Lumeragon mana.)
Well, the tracking is over now. From now on, let us see with our own eyes what lies beyond this twisted phase space.
We do not need to remove the magic directly. We make the magic collapse on its own. Mana over. Load.
I would like to call the Alliance forces right now, but there is no time. We need to collapse this phase conversion magic before it is too late.
We are different. We have accurately grasped the traits of the magic used here, right? If so, the answer is simple.
On top of that, I am concerned that the phase changes are deepening every moment. If we come back tomorrow, this area itself might not be visible anymore…
(Say, but did you not say it would be impossible even if every mage came?)
All we need to do is pour in a lot of mana with the same traits as the dark energy used in this phase magic.
Gather materials there that can be used to draw the magic circle. I will prepare for the mana overload in the meantime.
First, let us draw a magic circle here for mana overload. Conveniently, strong dark energy was being emitted from the canyon on the right.
If the mana forming the magic exceeds the proper amount, it overloads and loses its form and function.
Try going toward the canyon on the right. I think you can gather dark energy matter there that can serve as material.
(Say you think you saw dark energy floating around in the field to the left.)
Hmm... But dark energy in powder form seems like too dry a material. It is perfect for drawing a magic circle, but outdoors, it is difficult to handle when trying to maintain the circle's shape.
Living dark energy shows just how steeped in darkness this place is, but it also seems like a good chance to obtain dark energy close to its essence.
You gathered quite a lot, huh? This should be enough to draw the magic circle.
Oh... $MyPCName$, that is pretty impressive. I was so focused on constructing the spell formula that I did not notice those details.
$MyPCName$, the goal is right before us now. Please lend me just a little more strength. I am counting on you!
(Ask where the runestones are.)
($npcName:11000042[gender:1]$ seems busy constructing the spell formula. Go to the field on the left and gather dark energy essence.)
While I prepare the magic, place the runestones in the six magic circle rings.
Well, thanks to you, the preparations are almost finished, $MyPCName$. The magic circle has been deployed, and now only one final step remains!
We just have to try it. If not us, there is no one who can pull this off right now.
You can think of those rocks as natural runestones created when the mana of the phase conversion magic became lodged in the gaps between stones.
Thanks to those rocks, I think we can save a lot of time. Then let us begin!
While I prepare the magic, place the runestones in the six magic circle rings.
(Ask if Orde is ready.)
Besides... when I think that a Lumeragon stained by darkness is roaming Maple World, I cannot just sit still from worry.
(...Say, could this be... Madria's castle?!)
What a hurtful thing to say! I want to become a hero like $MyPCName$ too.
(Ask if it is not because of the figure.)
(Say it seems Madria's army is coming.)
All right, let us do as much as we can. Then we will look for a chance to request support from the Alliance forces!
(Say you need to hold them back as much as you can.)
(Say you cannot just leave Madria's army behind.)
(Say you do not have a chance, but Orde seems to.)
All right, let us do as much as we can. Then we will look for a chance to request support from the Alliance forces!

If it had not been for $npcName:11000042[gender:1]$'s large-scale teleport, we could not have arrived in time. A teleport on this army-level scale is honestly a little surprising. It seems they are not just an eccentric.
Ugh... It is not a matter of whether I can or cannot. It is something I absolutely must do…
(Say you will somehow hold out until Orde brings reinforcements.)
(Ask if they can do it, though it will be difficult.)
(Say you think you really could not date a mage.)
We will clean this up here, so please support the Dark Wind side, $MyPCName$.
But $npcName:11000042[gender:1]$ is not the only surprising one. $MyPCName$, you as well... hehe.
There is much to discuss, but let us do it after the battle. I hear Black Eye and Dark Wind are currently fighting on the flank.
Maybe there will be no need for you to step in. That friend Black Eye must be showing off his skills to his heart's content for the first time in a while.
We will clean this up here, so please support the Dark Wind side, $MyPCName$.
It is thanks to Master $npcName:11000042[gender:1]$. An ambush linked with multi-person teleportation seems like a tactic worth studying further.
No issues with anyone.
Engagement over. Jin, report the damage.
It is thanks to Master $npcName:11000042[gender:1]$. An ambush linked with multi-person teleportation seems like a tactic worth studying further.
A perfect ambush, captain. I have never seen an ambush more perfect than this.
Let us hurry and join the other units.
Hehe... But as you can see, thanks to you and $npcName:11000042[gender:1]$, we suppressed the enemies in an instant.
Let us go to the vigilantes by the canyon. The vigilantes are blocking their retreat over there.
You are safe, $MyPCName$. Thanks to you stopping their advance, we were able to round them all up.
Let us hurry and join the other units.
It is thanks to you and $MyPCName$.
Anyway... we finally found it, Madria's stronghold.
(Say it was thanks to Orde.)
What are you talking about? It was possible thanks to $MyPCName$.
But the fight is not over. Madria's castle is still intact.
By the way, $npcName:11000042[gender:1]$, can you interpret these runes written on that castle gate? I want to gather as much information about them as possible.
Good. Before they can reorganize their ranks, let us finish reorganizing as well and begin the full-scale assault.
By the way, $npcName:11000042[gender:1]$, can you interpret these runes written on that castle gate? I want to gather as much information about them as possible.
The forces we defeated must only be a very small part.
It is not difficult. Let me take a look...
I can only see it as a sign made with that in mind.
The part called Rakan bothers me. I have received a report of a similar word before.
Madrakan... Fortress of Wrath. It seems to be named after Madria.
It seems she wanted to show off terribly. If Madria's invasion had succeeded, this place might have been used as a slave camp, like Katramus.
... It says... Madrakan... Fortress of Wrath.
From now on, all Alliance operations will focus on the assault on Madrakan.
The operation is simple. We will assault the Madrakan walls, the center, and the spire. You will take the vanguard, $MyPCName$.
Good... This is the beginning of the Maple Alliance's counterattack.
Let us hurry and finish reorganizing as well.
$npcName:11003135[gender:0]$, send this information to headquarters immediately. As of now, I will set 'Rakan' as the highest-priority keyword for information gathering.
(Inform Her Majesty of the victory.)
Hurry and deliver this news to Her Majesty.
$MyPCName$, deliver the news of victory in the Madrakan assault... No, the Maple Alliance's first victory, to Her Majesty.
There is someone who has been waiting for this news more than anyone.
The operation is simple. We will assault the Madrakan walls, the center, and the spire. You will take the vanguard, $MyPCName$.
It is all right, $MyPCName$. Driving her army and fortress from this land alone is amazing.
(Say you failed to capture Madria.)
Thanks to the efforts of $npcName:11000042[gender:1]$ and $MyPCName$, we were able to attack first before Madria began her invasion. Truly, thank you for your hard work, hero of the Alliance.
(Say fortunately no one was seriously injured.)
$MyPCName$, thank you so much.

If that person had been here... $npcName:11003069[gender:1]$ might not have made that choice. I contacted them to ask them to come here for the sake of the unstable $npcName:11003069[gender:1]$, but there is still no news. Also, that <font color="#ffd200">ghost-like being...</font> is probably one of the <font color="#ffd200">forces of darkness</font>. There is that one who uses wicked words and schemes whose depths we cannot know, and even <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11003062[gender:0]$</font>, whom we met. He had remarkable skill...

I thought <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11003075[gender:0]$</font>$pp:와,과$ <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11003069[gender:1]$</font>$pp:는,은$ were names that vanished completely after the Snow Kingdom disappeared... Ah, and. Orders came down from <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000001$</font>. They say to conclude the investigation here and <font color="#ffd200">return</font>. I have also ordered our unit members to withdraw. We will depart soon.
Suddenly... seeing powerful people appearing who could not be seen before, I felt as if pieces were gathering on a huge chessboard. When the board is completely filled, what will happen...?
<font color="#909090">(That swordsmanship, that skill... It is not unfamiliar. As if I had crossed blades with him before...)</font>

Surprised by only this much... The Black Star Society's information network is beyond comparison with you Guard nobodies. In any case, whether fortunately or unfortunately, there are no traces of the Lumeragons that strange person is looking for. Aside from meaningless ruins where they were worshiped, nothing remains in this world.

Hello, $MyPCName$! I made candy while eagerly waiting for the day I would meet $MyPCName$. I cannot guarantee the taste, but you can gain a special ability, so try eating it.

Since the meerkats serve as scouts, there is nothing happening on Karkar Island that they do not know. They will definitely know Mika's whereabouts. Remember this. If anything happens to Mika, you are finished too.

That is all the reward I will give you. I gave you enough information, so you cannot complain. At this rate, I might look forward to our next deal. Though you will have to remain useful until then... hehe.
Ask if he knows the children's whereabouts.
Tell him to stop joking and give the promised information.

According to my information, one of those children seems to have a gem called Lamestone, which is passed down through generations of Dragon Masters. If that information is true, Biset handed it to one of the children before he died, and there is a high chance the dragon-like strange person is also looking for that Lamestone.
But $MyPCName$... am I making you waste time because of me? I feel as if I am asking for <font color="#ffd200">help</font> too naturally... I am sorry.
$MyPCName$... That gives me strength. Thank you very much. Then tell me when you are ready to depart.
Say you are together because it seems related to the forces of darkness you are tracking.
Answer that of course you plan to go together.
Then... will you go with me to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000383$</font> too? From now on, I intend to go there to find $npcName:11003069[gender:1]$.

If you leave Ludari City, you will reach some ruins, and Mika often wanders around that area. She says walking around the ruins gives her energy or something... But searching all those vast ruins would be impossible, so go to the village called $map:02010063$$pp:라는,이라는$ and find a meerkat called $npc:11001313[gender:0]$$pp:라는,이라는$.

Sorry, mi... It seems I made you suffer by giving wrong information, mi... As an apology, I will definitely help you find Mika, mi! I will send my comrades to investigate the surroundings, so please wait a little, yung.
You should be able to chase the Blacknov by taking another train at $map:02010009$. I look forward to your dazzling performance, rookie!
Say you do not know exactly where the place they are talking about is.

...I found it. At the top of <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000263$</font>, the steeply rising ice wall. A door that can lead to $map:52000086$$pp2:로,으로$ has appeared there. Now we must hurry. Let us meet inside.
Say thank you and ask if they have recently seen a strange person in the form of a dragon.
Ask if they might know where that strange person went.
Say you would be grateful if they did.

Go find <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11001315[gender:1]$</font>$pp:를,을$ in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02010023$</font>, mi. She is my friend and the granddaughter of the Moropapa chief, mi. She is kind-hearted, so if you talk to her nicely, she will help, yung.

I did hear that the Moropapa tribe suffered at that strange person's hands not long ago, mi. And since the Moropapa tribe knows Maple World better than anyone, it would be good to go ask them directly, but the Moropapa tribe dislikes outsiders, yung... Still, if you want to meet them, I will try to speak well for you, mi.

Go find <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11001315[gender:1]$</font>$pp:를,을$ in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02010023$</font>, mi. She is my friend and the granddaughter of the Moropapa chief, mi. She is kind-hearted, so if you talk to her nicely, she will help, yung.

Outsiders are not welcome guests among our Moropapa tribe. It was not always that way, but ever since the Land of Darkness was sealed, my grandfather, the tribe chief, seems to have become wary of outsiders. I do not know the reason well, but it is tribal law, so I think it will be difficult to help you.
Who? Ah... You must be the one $npcName:11001313[gender:0]$$pp:가,이$ mentioned. $npcName:11001313[gender:0]$$pp:가,이$ did ask me to help you, but…
Ask if you could speak with the tribe chief once.

Grandfather is not in good health right now, so you cannot meet him. Not long ago, he overexerted himself while facing someone who appeared in the village and caused trouble... I need to hurry and make medicine for Grandfather, so please excuse me.

Um... If so, I am sorry, but could you check inside the jars placed around the village? I need the dried Moromoro inside the jars to make Grandfather's medicine, but it seems insects have appeared inside, so I could not do anything. They are only insects, but I am timid…
Really? I could not help you at all... Thank you. For Grandfather's sake, please do this.
<font color="#909090">(It seems the tribe chief was attacked by the strange person.)</font> Ask if there is anything you can do to help.
Please check the jars around the village. If I only had dried Moromoro, I could quickly make medicine for Grandfather…
Tell them not to worry and to leave it to you.
Say thank you, since it must be a difficult request.
Grandfather is in the hut behind me with eggs on the roof. Please go inside.

Thankfully, thanks to you, Grandfather seems to have regained consciousness. He still should not overdo it, but seeing how he insists on getting up even when told to lie down, I think he will soon return to his healthy self.
Even though we only met briefly, I can tell you are a good person. Grandfather is in the hut behind me with eggs on the roof. Please go inside.

Um... So, if you need to, I think you may meet Grandfather. He certainly dislikes outsiders, but you helped me, and thanks to you, Grandfather could recover, so he must feel grateful. I spoke well of you first, so I think he may listen to you for a moment.

$MyPCName$, you are a wise person who has given much help in resolving everything that has happened so far. That is why I called you here, because I want to ask your opinion.
Is there any way to conduct the investigation more effectively? Any opinion is welcome, so please tell me.

There are many difficulties in carrying out investigations into <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11001851[gender:1]$</font>$pp:와,과$ the forces of darkness. In truth, rebuilding $map:02000001$ after the invasion also requires many hands, so we have an <font color="#ffd200">absolute shortage of personnel</font>. But we cannot stop investigating the <font color="#ffd200">forces of darkness</font>, who may threaten us at any time and in any way.
But... given who the enemy is, it is dangerous unless the person has proven skill. $MyPCName$, outstanding adventurers like you are not easy to find. That is why I am always grateful.
Say it would be good to recruit more people to help.
Say it would be good to expand the investigation range.
Ask how about receiving help from explorers.
That is right. We need to search not only $map:02000001$, but other places as well, and find their traces or stronghold... but as I said...
Ask how about receiving help from explorers.
