I see... It is all right. The fact that $MyPCName$ returned safely is enough. Other heroes are each conducting their own investigations, so there should be progress soon.

No. Compared to how $MyPCName$ has worked hard alone... Anyway, because of the surrounding monsters, we could not track them to the end, but we did witness them entering $map:02010029$$pp2:로,으로$. Some people were injured during the pursuit, but we will treat them quickly and chase again!
Tell them not to overdo it, since they must still be struggling in many ways.
It seems the strange person headed to Rubelisk Temple in $map:02010029$. We will finish reorganizing and come to support you as quickly as possible.

That child called $npcName:11001363[gender:1]$$pp:라는,이라는$, it must have been quite a rough experience for a girl, but perhaps she has already recovered. She came to us and asked us to tell $MyPCName$ thank you.
$npcName:11001310[gender:0]$$pp:는,은$ and I will prepare to return. When you have finished your business and are ready to leave, please return here and speak to $npcName:11001310[gender:0]$.

I do not know the details, but I know it as the place that led the Merzid Kingdom to ruin. It was originally a temple for the Lumeragons, but after the Merzid people were consumed by the power of darkness, there are rumors it was used as a place for secret rituals. Something that person is after may be there... In any case, be careful!
Say they were badly injured and fell into the valley.
Oh! It is you! You came at just the right time. We were just talking about you. Hehe, speak of the devil?
Say it is all right, and ask them to leave the rest to you and protect the others.

Understood... In that case, we will also finish reorganizing and support you as quickly as possible. Considering the last sighting location and direction of movement, it seems likely that the strange person went toward Rubelisk Temple.

I see. The terrain is so harsh... they probably did not survive. Well, you could say they brought it on themselves. Please do not worry too much. Fortunately, the Lamestone was recovered and everything worked out, did it not? Hahaha.
Say that in the end, you failed to find information about Madria.
Say not to be too discouraged, since you protected Maple World from another threat.

Haha... I hope everyone thinks that way and does not lose heart. Come to think of it, considering that Varkant tried to use the Lamestone, could we not use it instead to defeat the forces of darkness?
Right... That was originally why we came here... But so many incidents occurred that we seem to have completely forgotten. If we return like this, everyone will probably be disappointed.
Ah, you mean that kidnapped girl. The original owner is right there... My thinking was shallow. She did happen to have a message she wanted delivered…
Say you will meet them once before returning to Tria.

Really? Thank you!!! But... I will not take it right now.

What are you saying... They are always like this whenever they meet, so do not mind them. Anyway, thank you so much. Thanks to you, we all gathered safely again, and Dunba and I were able to escape from the Black Star Society. Though I do not know for how long.

It is a very precious necklace to me... but all of us also carry the sadness of losing precious people, like you and the Guard. If this necklace can prevent someone else from becoming sad, then I want to do that.

$MyPCName$, I need to follow that person before I lose track of him. We may be apart for a while, but the fact that we are friends will not change. I will come again.

<font color="#909090">(A trainee... guardsman?)</font>
Ask where you can meet him.

Ask how to get to $map:63000041$$pp2:로,으로$.
From what I heard, if <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11003164[gender:0]$</font>$pp:가,이$ completes this mission safely, $npc:11003165[gender:0]$ promised to appoint him as a full guardsman.
My greeting is late! I am called <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11003164[gender:0]$</font>.
Our mission is to escort the transport carriages carrying items for the audience ceremony so they can safely pass through $map:63000041$$pp:를,을$. Then shall we go to $map:63000041$$pp2:로,으로$?
Ah, I forgot to tell you. The road leading to $map:63000041$$pp2:로,으로$ is located northwest of $map:02000062$. As soon as you leave here, head straight northwest!
Among the peers I trained with, I am the only one who still has not become a full guardsman. I do not understand why...
Are you finally coming to your senses? You do not seem badly hurt, but it took longer than expected for you to wake up.
This may be sudden right after waking up, but you must come with me to <font color="#ffd200">$map:52000033$</font>$pp2:로,으로$. Her Majesty is waiting for you.
As you just heard, I would like you to investigate who is behind this incident. This is for the kingdom, so please do your best.
Keep in mind, when you meet Her Majesty, you had better show proper manners.

Did you perhaps come to me after losing your way? I understand. Anyone who comes here for the first time tends to get lost. You can reach <font color="#ffd200">$map:52000117$</font>$pp:는,은$ by heading southwest as soon as you leave this place.

First, meet <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11003163[gender:0]$</font>$pp:를,을$ in <font color="#ffd200">$map:52000117$</font>. He knows everything happening within the kingdom, so he will be a great help in the investigation. Of course, he also handled matters related to this transport carriage escort.
Good, you understand! Then I will trust you with it.

It seems <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000492[gender:0]$</font> is currently absent. Oh, come to think of it, someone using <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11003167[gender:0]$</font> came by just now! I think they said they were a cleaner, and they seemed like a good person.
Say you will do your best.
Say you will not report it.
Oh no... They already looked pitiful at a glance, and now they have even been kidnapped. You may never see them again. Those people are absolutely merciless.
Say <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11003167[gender:0]$</font>$pp:가,이$ might be someone connected to <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11003163[gender:0]$</font>$pp:와,과$.
Yes. Very many! They are truly bad people. They often barge into my workplace, <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000121$</font>, and cause trouble. Ugh, what on earth are the higher-ups doing…
H-hey... What is wrong with you! When did I say it would take long? I will help! I said I will help! So, you know, I would like you not to report this to the kingdom.
Whew, you really scared me. Go to <font color="#ffd200">$map:2000084$</font> and meet <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000396[gender:0]$</font>$pp:를,을$. That guy will help you.
H-hey... It is scary when you clench your fist like that... Fine. I do not need plenty of time, so would you open your fist?
What a heartless person. Just you wait! Next time I will definitely... Huh!? You were listening!? Ah, I was just thinking that next time, I will definitely become friends with you. Kuhaha!
<font color="#909090">(Tell $npc:11000396[gender:0]$ that you came after receiving $npc:11000173[gender:0]$'s recommendation.)</font>

It is very simple. A very simple job that only requires using your body a little?
You will do the work $npc:11000396[gender:0]$$pp:가,이$ was doing instead.

Now, the second task! There should be <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000120$</font> scattered all over <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000084$</font>. Gather them for me. <font color="#909090">(In a low voice)</font> And this is... an extra task. Could you lend me your ear for a moment?
Ask what work you need to do.

Drive out <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000173[gender:0]$'s minions</font> from this place, <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000084$</font>. The truth is, those are the ones making things hard for $npc:11000396[gender:0]$$pp:를,을$ here.
There are exactly two tasks. Let us handle one first. If you go up this way, there should be <font color="#ffd200">scrap tires</font> piled up. Move them to the front here.
<font color="#909090">(Bring your ear close to $npc:11000171[gender:0]$.)</font>

You should be able to talk with <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000396[gender:0]$</font> now. Go ask anything you were curious about.
Kuhaha! You are pretty good! All right. As promised, I made arrangements so you can talk with $npc:11000396[gender:0]$$pp:와,과$.
Thanks to you, our junkyard can breathe a little easier too. This greeting may be a little late, but thank you for helping.
Shh, you absolutely must not say I told you to do this.

Well... If there had been someone like that, there is no way I would not remember... <font color="#909090">(It is unfortunate, but it seems you should return to <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000173[gender:0]$</font> for now.)</font>

...Thank you, my foot! Because of what you just did, I have been marked by those Dark Wind Society people! What are you going to do about this? Take responsibility! I said take responsibility!
The Dark Wind Society will storm this place soon. Then I am... d-done for!

I-I'm saved... Yes. You sucker... I mean, <font color="#ffd200">customer</font>! What information do you want? As thanks for saving me, I will specially provide <font color="#ffd200">information up to Class A</font> <font color="#ffd200">once</font>, free of charge!
Ask $npc:11001262[gender:0]$ about the suspicious mask and the Barota captain.

It is <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000153$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000100$</font>. As an organization with the best intelligence network in Maple World, they should have the information you want.
Ask $npc:11001262[gender:0]$ if he really cannot tell you.
I am sorry, but it is impossible. Actually, for information Class S or higher, we begin collecting it only after receiving a request…
Oh dear... The information $MyPCName$ wants is Class S or higher. The information I can provide only goes up to Class A. Unfortunately, I cannot tell you.
You came to meet the captain? What should I do? The captain is currently absent. Is this perhaps important?
Huh? You mean Eve's house? <font color="#ffd200">Eve's house</font> is the second house southwest of <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000147$</font>.
I believe I have provided all the information I can provide. Next time, I would appreciate it if you prepared the fee before visiting our information brokerage. Kekeke...
Well... I do not know if I should say this, but the captain is probably at Eve's house. He often visits Eve's house even normally.
Say yes.
Tell $npc:11001024[gender:0]$ about everything that has happened so far.
Some of that is already known to me. But there are also things I am hearing for the first time. Interesting…

Since this is our first meeting, I will introduce myself first. I am <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000044[gender:0]$</font>, <font color="#ffd200">captain of Dark Wind</font>. Now, why did you come to find me?
What is it? Judging by your expression, you have business with me, not $npc:11000069[gender:1]$$pp:가,이$.
Now, let us quickly return to <font color="#ffd200">$map:52000073$</font>$pp2:로,으로$ and continue the story.

No matter what happens, we must capture <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000064[gender:0]$</font>$pp:를,을$. If we fail to catch him, even <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000069[gender:1]$</font>, the daughter of <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11003219[gender:0]$</font>, will be in danger.
It seems you have not been involved in kingdom affairs for long, but you seem to know quite a lot.
<font color="#ffd200">$npc:11003219[gender:0]$</font> was killed by his trusted disciple, <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000064[gender:0]$</font>. It was truly a shocking event.
Ask if the captain of Dark Wind is not $npc:11003219[gender:0]$$pp:가,이$.
$npc:11000064[gender:0]$... That man killed the captain. No matter the reason, I cannot forgive him!
Come to think of it... It suddenly occurs to me that <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000064[gender:0]$</font>$pp:가,이$ may be connected to someone named $npc:11003167[gender:0]$.
Say you will help with anything you can during the mission.
Come to think of it, it seems a <font color="#ffd200">guest</font> has arrived. They seem to have something to say to you, so why not hear them out?
Good. From now on, Dark Wind will cooperate with you. Of course, you must also help us.
$npc:11000064[gender:0]$$pp:와,과$ $npc:11003167[gender:0]$$pp:는,은$ share the common trait of assassinating people who have a major influence on Maple Island.
If you have power like that person... please! Save our kingdom! <font color="#909090">(That person...? Who could they mean?)</font>
He was a <font color="#ffd200">man with yellow hair</font>. That person saved me when I was in danger in $map:02000017$.
Ask about <font color="#ffd200">that person</font>.

When I asked his name, he said he was in a situation where he could not tell me. And he said he had to clear up the misunderstandings piled up against him. He also said he would return to the place he came from.
The truth is, it is too frightening a place to investigate alone. $map:52000037$$pp:는,은$...
I am scared to be left alone, but... I want to help <font color="#ffd200">$MyPCName$</font> somehow.
Unfortunately, he did not tell us his destination this time. Still, just in case, please go to <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000069[gender:1]$'s house</font>.
Say the man with yellow hair might be connected to $npc:11003167[gender:0]$$pp:와,과$.
A man with yellow hair... What are you two talking about?

These days, he seems to be away from headquarters more often without saying where he is going. I have no idea where he keeps wandering. It even seems he sometimes goes somewhere other than <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000069[gender:1]$'s house</font>$pp:가,이$…
Huh? <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000044[gender:0]$</font>? He has not come here today.
It seems I showed far too much emotion, unlike myself... First, let us return to <font color="#ffd200">$map:52000073$</font>$pp2:로,으로$.
Did you see that? If we do not capture him, things like this will keep happening! Whew... First, let us return to <font color="#ffd200">$map:52000073$</font>$pp2:로,으로$.

Oh, and please do not trust <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000044[gender:0]$</font>'s words too much. The <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000064[gender:0]$</font>$pp:는,은$ I know would never do something like that.
There must be some misunderstanding. There is no way <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000064[gender:0]$</font>$pp:가,이$ would do something like that.
Tell $npc:11000044[gender:0]$ about everything that has happened so far.
Say it seems difficult.

I am sorry to interrupt an important conversation, but we have received a report about someone presumed to be <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000064[gender:0]$</font>$pp2:로,으로$. The reported location is <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000167$</font>. The informant's name is <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11001116[gender:1]$</font>. Please hurry and confirm it there.

Do you see the entrance to <font color="#ffd200">$map:2000328$</font> next to this place? I saw someone wearing a <font color="#ffd200">strange mask</font> go inside there. I think that person may be responsible for ruining the garden, so please go in quickly and catch them.

What? The <font color="#ffd200">strange mask</font>$pp:가,이$ was not polluting the garden, but trying to purify it? Oh dear... It seems I misunderstood. But what happened to the garden? Can it return to the way it was?
By the way, I am sorry it seems I made you come all this way for nothing. Then goodbye.
Still, someday it will return to its original beautiful state, right? Thank you for checking.

Ah, you mean that suspicious person? Actually, I only heard about it from <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000533[gender:0]$</font>, so I do not know the details. $npc:11000533[gender:0]$$pp:는,은$ should be working in the center of the wasteland, so go there.
What is it? Judging by your clothes, you do not look like someone who came here to work.
You are looking for a man with yellow hair? Then you came to the right place. I am that witness.
If you resolve my request, I will tell you the man's whereabouts.
I will keep my promise. Go to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000139$</font>$pp2:로,으로$. Not much time has passed, so you should be able to meet him soon.
Ask exactly what needs to be done.
Actually, there is something I want to ask in exchange for the information. It is related to a problem happening at our site.
Defeat the <font color="#ffd200">wild monsters</font> roaming <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000148$</font> and remove the rust from the <font color="#ffd200">rusted pipes</font>.
Thank you for helping us.
Ask $npc:11003206[gender:0]$ if he has seen a man with yellow hair.
Where did he go? He went to <font color="#ffd200">$map:2000193$</font>$pp2:로,으로$ up there. If you do not hurry, you will miss him.
Thank you for saving me! I am $npc:11003206[gender:0]$.
Ask $npc:11000211[gender:0]$ if he has seen a <font color="#ffd200">man with yellow hair</font>.
I have not seen anyone like that. I have been alone this whole time. But how did you know I was here and come find me? The only person who would know is my brother…
Ask $npc:11000867[gender:0]$ if he has seen a man with yellow hair.
I wondered if it could be true, but you really saved my younger brother. You are a really good person, you know?
Thank you for saving my younger brother. I will definitely repay this debt.
Thanks to you, I was able to save my younger brother. I will be grateful.

The <font color="#ffd200">man with yellow hair</font> I saw headed to <font color="#ffd200">$map:52000126$</font>$pp2:로,으로$. He looked quite exhausted, almost as if he had been starving for days... <font color="#909090">(It seems you should hurry to $map:52000126$$pp2:로,으로$.)</font>
Say you will defeat the <font color="#ffd200">troublemakers</font>$pp:를,을$ wandering around <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000138$</font>$pp:를,을$.
I feel like I am about to remember, then it stops, then it faintly comes back when I think it will not... It must be because business is poor, so I have a lot on my mind. Hehehe...

I feel like I should remember this, but I cannot remember at all. Maybe my memory has gotten worse because business has been poor lately due to the <font color="#ffd200">troublemakers</font> wandering around <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000138$</font>$pp:를,을$.
Ah! In that case, that changes things. I will work hard to remember, so go ahead. I am a merchant, after all. Hehehe…
Ask $npc:11000213[gender:0]$ if he has seen the man with yellow hair.

By the way, will you not buy our fruit? As you can see, we have prepared fruit so sweet that bugs swarm all over it. <font color="#909090">(The fruit looks like you would chew more bugs than fruit.)</font>

A <font color="#ffd200">man with yellow hair</font>? I have never seen someone like that. If you mistook me for that person, that is truly unfortunate... <font color="#909090">(It seems you guessed wrong.)</font>
Ask $npc:11000213[gender:0]$ what he did before becoming a beggar.
Y-you do not need to know my past... Why would you ask something like that! That is rude! <font color="#909090">(It seems he has a past he does not really want to remember.)</font>
Heheh, then I have repaid everything I owed, right? Ah, come to think of it, there is no time to stand around like this. Hurry!

I do not know if you will believe me, but I am not the one who killed Captain <font color="#ffd200">Wynn Stilton</font>. And until the misunderstanding is cleared up, I have no intention of returning to Dark Wind headquarters.

The <font color="#ffd200">yellow-haired guy</font> is staying at <font color="#ffd200">$map:52000046$</font> to the right of the alley entrance. To go there, you first need to leave to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000138$</font>$pp2:로,으로$, right? Hurry! You never know when that person might disappear.
$npc:11003206[gender:0]$ and I found the <font color="#ffd200">yellow-haired guy</font>. Do you know how much we ran around town to repay you for saving my younger brother?
Say you will drag <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11003215[gender:0]$</font>$pp:를,을$ back by force if necessary.
I am sorry, but I cannot let you capture me.
So in the end, you will not believe me...
Ask if they did not see <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11003215[gender:0]$</font>$pp:는,은$.

That could have been terrible! If a friend named $npc:11003210[gender:0]$ had not told us, we would not have found <font color="#ffd200">$MyPCName$</font> collapsed there. <font color="#909090">(It seems you received great help from $npc:11003210[gender:0]$.)</font>
Yes. Unfortunately, there was no one there except <font color="#ffd200">$MyPCName$</font>. It seems <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11003215[gender:0]$</font>$pp:는,은$ has already left for somewhere else.
I heard you failed to capture <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11003215[gender:0]$</font>$pp:를,을$. It could not be helped... I acknowledge that man's fighting skill, at least.
Honestly, I was truly frightened earlier. Do you know how worried I was that I might never see <font color="#ffd200">$MyPCName$</font> again? So please never get hurt again.
Do not worry. As long as he keeps lingering around here, our chance will come again. First, let us go out to <font color="#ffd200">$map:52000055$</font>$pp2:로,으로$ and gather information about him.

What should we do now? <font color="#909090">(For now, it seems best to return to <font color="#ffd200">$map:52000073$</font>$pp2:로,으로$ and report everything that has happened so far to <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000044[gender:0]$</font>.)</font>
To me, <font color="#ffd200">$MyPCName$</font> is a h-h-h-hero as wonderful as a stag beetle! A hero must never die.
We don't have any more border troops to deploy! We're at our limit!
Thank you for all your hard work!
That's my direct subordinate for you! I've always recognized your talent! Hahaha!
$MyPCName$! I've been waiting for you!
Really? Thank you! Then I'll be waiting! You have to come back with good news, okay?
There isn't as much here as I expected... I'm a little disappointed…
Has some new research stirred up our dear Ney-Ney's research instincts again?
Ney-Ney~ You're acting awfully flustered for that~
You always tease me!
Haha! Ney-Ney's reactions are just too cute to stop~!
If $MyPCName$ helps us, it will be a huge help!
Wow~! Really? Then please help us! Please defeat <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021004[gender:0]$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020016$</font> so our energy research can continue!

Fortunately, a researcher's report says <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020904$</font>'s bodily fluids act as a catalyst for extracting energy from Ener crystals, so we may be able to increase Ener extraction!
The problem is how to obtain <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020904$</font>'s bodily fluids…
Please drive out <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020806$</font> from <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020034$</font> so the expedition can continue!
Wow! Really? You really do help me whenever I'm in trouble!

Would you defeat <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020505$</font> and <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25020402$</font>, who are interfering with research in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020001$</font> and <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020004$</font>, so Ener research can continue?
I'll send this to the data analysis team right away so they can study its combat patterns!

The expedition members' reports about the evil spirit in the black cloak were all over the place, but after putting the information together, I'm convinced its identity is <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11001813[gender:0]$</font>!
All right, got any useful information?
Since $npcName:11001813[gender:0]$ is a top-level threat to us, we have to find out what he's plotting!
Don't tell me you came back empty-handed.
Kitten, what are you doing over there? Come here.
Who's going to do that, and how?
So, you heard everything earlier, right?
So I put together a training course just for you, darling~ Ta-da!
You don't have time to sit around like this, do you? Now hurry up and go train~
You made it back safely! You're not hurt anywhere, are you?
Ah, let me see! See? Your whole body is burning up!
Your cheeks are so red too... $MyPCName$, didn't you push yourself too hard?
(Ask where they think they're touching!)
Hm? Hehe, is that so?
Oh, before you report the move to the captain, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11003537[gender:0]$</font> asked you to stop by for a moment.
Whew~
<font size='40'><font color="#909090">(Did he blow into my ear?)</font></font>
<font color="#909090">(... Is he serious?)</font>
Will you hear my request...?
I'll mark the location of $map:52100106$ on your navigation! I'll contact you again once you enter that place!
I'll mark the location of $map:52100106$ on your navigation! I'll contact you again once you enter that place!
I'll mark the location of $map:52020006$ on your navigation! I'll contact you again once you enter that place!
I'll mark the location of $map:52020006$ on your navigation! I'll contact you again once you enter that place!
Ah! That's right! $map:02020018$! It is definitely $map:02020018$!
Judging by the text that was cut off earlier, there seems to be something important about $map:02020018$…
So all the floating islands in $map:02020018$ were floating in the air through Ener! Amazing!

After detecting the diary's composition through the Cat's Eye satellite, it appears the remaining torn pages are being held by <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021703$</font> or <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021704$</font> in $map:02020018$!
You found it already? That's amazing! But... wait? You're still in $map:02020018$, aren't you?
The similarities between the ruins in $map:02020003$, where the investigation first began, and the ancient ruins of Victoria Island…
Please! Fight <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:23001006$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020051$</font> and collect as many behavior patterns as you can!
If you defeat $npcName:25021703$ or $npcName:25021704$ in $map:02020018$, you should be able to recover the remaining pages of the diary!
If you defeat $npcName:25021703$ or $npcName:25021704$ in $map:02020018$, you should be able to recover the remaining pages of the diary!
If you defeat $npcName:25021703$ or $npcName:25021704$ in $map:02020018$, you should be able to recover the remaining pages of the diary!
Phew~ Do you know a place called $map:02020017$?
Go to $map:02020017$ right! this! instant! and wipe out every $npcName:25021202$!
The $npcName:25021503$ in $map:02020003$ keeps stealing Sky Fortress parts, and it's seriously interfering with the expedition!

Yes~ understood! Just defeat <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25021403$</font> living in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020014$</font> and bring me as many <font color="#ffd200">$item:30001252$</font> as you can!
The postscript even says, <font size='40'>'If not for $MyPCName$'s efforts, $map:02020033$ would have fallen, and those efforts were so impressive they naturally drew admiration.'</font>
Is <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000088$</font> all cleaned up?
When we don't know where they might invade <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000001$</font> from next, do you think the kids have room to deal with monster pranks too?
Oh no... What should we do... We're short on troops because of field missions, and if our research facility in $map:02020033$ is destroyed, it will be a huge loss…
Then please defeat as many hostile monsters as possible in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020016$</font>! I'll get everything ready so we can begin building the camp right away!

According to analysis by the Green Hood engineers, if we analyze the memory chips of robots produced in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020035$</font>, we may be able to manipulate their AI and turn them into allies!
Yes, I promise! If we end up traveling together, I'll put your name in the new edition of '$npcName:11003080[gender:0]$'s World Travels'! This time I should donate a few copies to $map:02000031$ too~
$MyPCName$, I'll look forward to seeing you shine in $map:02000001$ too!
$map:02000381$? The queen went there? No... What in the world happened?
The forces of darkness...? Come to think of it, I heard something major happened around $map:02000001$ or $map:02000100$... Was that their doing?
$MyPCName$, I'll look forward to seeing you shine in $map:02000001$ too!

In the end, the <font color="#ffd200">Blue Lapenta</font> was shattered by a giant demonic desire created as small greed gathered one by one. And... Captain Wynn Stilton was killed by <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000044[gender:0]$</font>...
Welcome, $MyPCName$! Did you meet $npc:11000064[gender:0]$? After meeting that person in person, I understood why the previous guardian of the Blue Lapenta favored him so specially.

<font color="#ffd200">Turka</font> found out that Captain <font color="#ffd200">Wynn Stilton</font> was the <font color="#ffd200">guardian of the Blue Lapenta</font>, then approached <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000044[gender:0]$</font> and used his greed... The captain tried to protect the Blue Lapenta to the very end... but the power formed from the black desires of foolish people, including <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000044[gender:0]$</font>, was tremendous...

The captain opened that safe himself... and inside it was... the <font color="#ffd200">Blue Lapenta</font>. It was truly... shining beautifully... But then $npc:11000044[gender:0]$ suddenly burst in with people consumed by greed and madness...

It seems very likely that Wynn Stilton intended to pass the position of <font color="#ffd200">guardian of the Blue Lapenta</font> to $npc:11000064[gender:0]$. If the day comes when the shattered <font color="#ffd200">Blue Lapenta</font> can be restored... I intend to honor that will and entrust $npc:11000064[gender:0]$ with <font color="#ffd200">protecting the Blue Lapenta</font>.

If everything you told me is true... this may be the greatest crisis threatening Maple World since the Blue Lapenta was broken. Given the situation, report every detail to $npcTitle:11000075[gender:1]$ without leaving anything out.

The reason $npc:11000064[gender:0]$ could survive even the moment the Blue Lapenta broke was probably... because the will of the Blue Lapenta accepted him as its guardian. Likewise, it must have been the will of the Red Lapenta that led you, $MyPCName$, to $map:52000011$, asking you to protect not only the Red Lapenta but also its guardian, $npcName:11000015[gender:1]$.
But the unusual part is this. I could faintly sense the power of the Blue Lapenta.
And one more thing: we believe someone is artificially combining the power of the Blue Lapenta with the power of shadow to accelerate the chaos in the rift.
That's right. You may have heard the story that the power of the Blue Lapenta was inherited long ago.
A place where the power of the Blue Lapenta remains... I see. That is a very plausible story.
To shake the power of spacetime to this degree, the power of the Blue Lapenta, the Lapenta of space, would not be enough. The power of the Red Lapenta, the Lapenta of time, would be needed.
Who on earth could be doing this? If it is the power of the Blue Lapenta, then already...
Thank you for telling me. Artificial power of the Blue Lapenta...
And now you ask for a <font color="#ffd200">Lapenta fragment</font>? You are the shameless ones!

We barely saved <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11001229[gender:0]$</font>'s life with the power of the <font color="#ffd200">Lapenta of Life</font>, but... $npcName:11001229[gender:0]$ has fallen into a deep <font color="#ffd200">sleep state</font>. There is nothing more we can do now. At present... we do not know when or how they will awaken...

<font color="#ffd200">$map:02000179$</font> is filled with sacred energy flowing from the Lapenta of Life, so everyone should be able to recover quickly. Hurry to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000179$</font>~

The power of <font color="#ffd200">Lapenta</font>... It is true that recently, while traveling all over Maple World... I felt something unfamiliar…

From what I hear, people are making a fuss that this crystal shard is the return of the vanished Worldstone Lapenta. They say it <font color="#ffd200">grants special power to the one who holds the crystal</font>... Well, let's treat such things as superstition and move on.

From what I hear, people are making a fuss that this crystal shard is the return of the vanished Worldstone Lapenta. They say it <font color="#ffd200">grants special power to the one who holds the crystal</font>... Well, let's treat such things as superstition and move on.

From what I hear, people are making a fuss that this crystal shard is the return of the vanished Worldstone Lapenta. They say it <font color="#ffd200">grants special power to the one who holds the crystal</font>... Well, let's treat such things as superstition and move on.

$MyPCName$, I am late with my greeting. I am Ranemone, a physics mage invited as a Lapenta expert.
<font size='40'>You smell like Lapenshards. No, to be precise, I can feel Lapenta energy from your body.</font>

Was that the power of <font color="#ffd200">Lapenta</font>...? But to call it the power of Lapenta…
This is... <font color="#ffd200">the tears of the Sages...</font> People were calling this a <font color="#ffd200">Lapenshard</font>. Meaning a fragment of Lapenta…
Yes. It is far too faint to call it the power of <font color="#ffd200">Lapenta</font>. So after I began feeling this power... I investigated the source of the power.
Could you ask them whether, if they have the <font color="#ffd200">Red Lapenta of Time</font>, they can use that power to return to the past?

$map:02000304$ is a higher-dimensional world where multiple times coexist... It is the central axis of cosmic time! No one has discovered or visited it yet. That is because it goes beyond the order of time maintained by the power of the Red Lapenta.
For now... we have no choice but to trust in the self-purifying power of the <font color="#ffd200">Red Lapenta</font> that must exist somewhere...

It has not been verified yet, but... using it, it may even be possible to create a <font color="#ffd200">time-mixed</font> state where multiple times coexist. Because of that, if anything were to happen to the <font color="#ffd200">Red Lapenta</font>... sigh...

Ugh... I don't know, I really don't know... I heard that somewhere in this <font color="#ffd200">Ant Tunnel</font>, a monster called <font color="#ffd200">$npc:23090005[gender:0]$</font> has something called the <font color="#ffd200">Red Lapenta</font> that can control time, so I came to find it...

Going back to the past means disturbing the order of time. And trying to use the Red Lapenta... do you know how dangerous that is? If something goes wrong, the time barrier could collapse completely just like the spatial barrier did, and a world even more frightening than the Dark Lands might open.
You want to use the <font color="#ffd200">Red Lapenta of Time</font> to return to the past? Hmm... well... it may be possible. But!! It must not be done!
Could you go to $map:02000008$ and ask Dr. $npc:11000869[gender:0]$ whether, if they have the <font color="#ffd200">Red Lapenta of Time</font>, they can use that power to return to the past?
Right... using the Red Lapenta... must not be done... and it cannot be done... But... it is possible... right...? Possible...
I am worried... that perhaps something may have happened to the <font color="#ffd200">Red Lapenta of Time</font>...
This is... completely unexpected... Could there be... some problem with the <font color="#ffd200">Red Lapenta</font>...? Aaaah~ No, that can't be. It can't be... it must not be... Hmm...

If this $map:52000011$, maintained by the power of the Red Lapenta, is destroyed... the order of time will collapse and chaos will grow. If that happens... the safety of the Red Lapenta cannot be guaranteed... and the forces of darkness, including the Demon King, will use that opening to become even stronger.

Please tell $npc:11000843[gender:0]$ in $map:2000309$ about the situation here and ask them to help find the cause of $map:52000011$ shaking. However, you must keep it secret that I am the <font color="#ffd200">guardian of the Red Lapenta</font>.

$MyPCName$! Please. As my helper, could you find the <font color="#ffd200">guardian of the Red Lapenta</font> and find a way to save the young $npc:11000057[gender:1]$ from the moment you saw in $map:2000304$?

Whoever it was even broke the recording devices that thoroughly monitored the lab! We must identify and catch the culprit... otherwise... the <font color="#ffd200">order of time</font> maintained by the power of the <font color="#ffd200">Red Lapenta</font> may collapse!

However, please keep it secret that I am the guardian of the <font color="#ffd200">Red Lapenta</font>. I will see you again in $map:2000076$.

There seems to be no need to hide this from someone who came here by the will of the <font color="#ffd200">Red Lapenta</font>. I am actually the <font color="#ffd200">guardian of the Red Lapenta</font>. Before <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000845[gender:1]$</font>, the previous guardian of the Red Lapenta, passed away, she entrusted this position to me.
I see. To think it is unstable enough to be felt as energy waves in the outside world... Perhaps the power of the Red Lapenta, which seeks to protect the order of time, led you here, $MyPCName...

I see... then you already know. That $npc:11000015[gender:1]$ is the guardian of the Red Lapenta... Though it all seemed like coincidence, the fact that you, $MyPCName$, protected $map:52000011$ together with $npcName:11000015[gender:1]$ was probably the will of the Red Lapenta, just as $npcName:11000015[gender:1]$ said.
Just knowing that you will help, $MyPCName$, makes me feel reassured. Fortunately, the Red Lapenta is still being protected safely without any trouble.

It does not exist in the world we live in now. For safety, it is in another dimension of time. To protect the Red Lapenta, $map:52000011$ must not collapse. The moment $map:52000011$ collapses, the Demon King will discover the Red Lapenta's location.
Ask where the Red Lapenta is.

Before I came home, Director $npcName:11000843[gender:0]$ told me something. They told me to find a reliable helper instead of recklessly acting alone like this time. They said the <font color="#ffd200">guardian of the Red Lapenta</font>, who maintains the order of time, might have a way to save $npc:11000057[gender:1]$ from that moment seen in $map:2000304$...

Fate... no matter what result your actions bring now... remember that it is fate that must be accepted.

$MyPCName$! Please. As my helper, could you find the <font color="#ffd200">guardian of the Red Lapenta</font> and find a way to save the young $npc:11000057[gender:1]$ from the moment you saw in $map:2000304$?

Right now, the order of time that briefly went astray is gradually recovering to its original state, so the moment when the Time Floor stopped in $map:2000304$ and the present time coexist. Among the stopped moments of the past was also the time in the past when <font color="#ffd200">Clark</font> guarded the <font color="#ffd200">Red Lapenta</font>.

The order of time is still gradually returning to its proper place. To meet that girl, you must find that space before the order of time fully recovers. In my memory, there was a giant sphere with evil energy swirling behind the young girl. Hmm... as the guardian of the Red Lapenta, who must protect the order of time, this is all I can tell you...
And they said that you, $MyPCName$, who met the <font color="#ffd200">guardian of the Red Lapenta</font> in $map:52000011$... might be able to help.

In addition, according to $npcName:11004802[gender:0]$'s analysis, the energy of the <font color="#ffd200">Red Lapenta</font> is being detected inside the dark substance. It is clear that the <font color="#ffd200">Dark Legion</font> is behind this.

The fact that you came this far is also the will of the Red Lapenta... There is no need to hide it any longer. I am actually the guardian of the Red Lapenta. Strictly speaking, <font color="#ffd200">a temporary guardian.
Red light...? Could it be... the energy of the <font color="#ffd200">Red Lapenta</font>?!

No one knows where the Red Lapenta is hidden except $npcName:11000001[gender:0]$, one of the Seven Heroes. $npcName:11000001[gender:0]$ is unconscious now, so how did they know and scheme something like this?
It seems you came for the same reason I did. I sensed someone trying to approach the <font color="#ffd200">Red Lapenta</font>.
Before <font color="#ffd200">Clark</font>, the previous guardian of the Red Lapenta, passed away, he entrusted this position to me.
The score... <font color="#ffd200">Aria for Light and Darkness</font>... is the key that can find the Red Lapenta hidden by Clark again.

...That is all. As expected, $npcName:11004873[gender:0]$ has the score. If an aria was heard inside the rift and both darkness and Red Lapenta energy were found there, the score must have fallen into the hands of the <font color="#ffd200">Dark Legion</font>.

People believe that $npcName:11000001[gender:0]$, one of the Seven Heroes, guarded the Red Lapenta, but because of the grief of losing his wife, he did not take on that duty. Clark anticipated that and entrusted the guardian duty to me.

She was the wife of Henesys Elder $npcName:11000001[gender:0]$... the mother of $npcName:11004873[gender:0]$. Until she passed away due to unavoidable circumstances, she <font color="#ffd200">lived guarding the Red Lapenta</font>.

Hmm, to summarize, the Red Lapenta is hidden along the time axis connecting the past, present, and future, and to make it exist again in the present timeline, the song from that score must be performed.

But judging from how faint the Red Lapenta's energy is, it seems the score is not being performed properly. However, if the aria from that score combines with darkness and is sung inside the rift, the axis of time will twist along with space, accelerating the rift.
Wow~ that's incredible. Clark hid the Red Lapenta within time, just like a time mage. So that is why no one could find it. What a perfect countermeasure!
Tell them the story about the score and the Red Lapenta that you heard from Oscar.
I see. This incident has now gone beyond the disappearance of orchestra members. It is a serious situation involving citizen safety, the spacetime rift, and the Red Lapenta.
But right now, no clues about the Red Lapenta come to mind.
I... see... the <font color="#ffd200">Green Lapenta</font>... Hmm... This has truly become something we must consider very, very carefully...
$MyPCName$, have you heard about the Red Lapenta?

It is a place where clean souls in their original pure and clear state gather. A supreme world... completely separated from the world we live in now. To go there, you must not miss the moment when the <font color="#ffd200">Green Lapenta of Life</font> reaches perfect resonance.

Actually, the <font color="#ffd200">Green Lapenta</font> currently located in $map:02000023$ is not the real one. It is like an illusion onto which the real Lapenta's energy is projected. Also, many people think I am the guardian of the Green Lapenta, but... the one who actually guards the Green Lapenta is $npc:11000032[gender:0]$.

As I said before, $map:02000220$ is a world in a dimension completely different from this life. There are often moments when the life energy of the <font color="#ffd200">real Green Lapenta</font> you saw in $map:02000179$ is maximized. At those times, <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000227$</font>, which connects the soul dimension and this life, opens.

The reason <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000068[gender:0]$</font> could attack the dimensional gate leading to $map:02000179$, where the real Lapenta exists, is that he too shares fate with $npc:11000685[gender:0]$ as a Lapenta guardian. He indirectly sensed Lapenta's power and was drawn by its energy.

And right now, <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000227$</font> is open. Do you remember I said the one below $map:02000023$ is an illusion onto which the real Green Lapenta's energy is projected? <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000227$</font> should be open on the shaded forest path behind it.

Sometimes $npc:11000068[gender:0]$, the doppelganger of $npc:11000032[gender:0]$, targets Lapenta and attacks the life barrier... But with the help of righteous heroes, $npc:11000032[gender:0]$ is protecting Lapenta well.
All of this was to deceive the eyes of enemies targeting Lapenta and safely protect the Green Lapenta and its guardian, $npc:11000032[gender:0]$.
I thought the Green Lapenta was in $map:02000023$... And I heard that $npc:11000031[gender:0]$ guards the Green Lapenta...
Huh? Monsters from the Shadow World are trying to destroy the Green Lapenta? But... $npc:11000032[gender:0]$ is guarding it...? That's strange...

Truly... $npc:11000064[gender:0]$'s eyes held a warm heart and sincerity. The strength to remain true to oneself without wavering before any temptation comes from that sincerity. It is also a virtue that anyone who must protect <font color="#ffd200">Lapenta</font> must possess.

Um... do you see that vortex...? $npc:11000032[gender:0]$ is inside it. Someone is trying to destroy the <font color="#ffd200">Green Lapenta</font>. $npc:11000032[gender:0]$ is trying to protect the Green Lapenta... sob...
Please. $npc:11000032[gender:0]$ is my one and only precious friend. Please help <font color="#ffd200">keep $npc:11000032[gender:0]$ and the Green Lapenta safe</font>.
Please. $npc:11000032[gender:0]$ is my one and only precious friend. Please help <font color="#ffd200">keep $npc:11000032[gender:0]$ and the Green Lapenta safe</font>.
The guardian protecting the Green Lapenta was not $npc:11000031[gender:0]$, but actually...! It was $npc:11000032[gender:0]$... $npc:11000032[gender:0]$, you are truly amazing!
$MyPCName$, your title is Guardian of the Alliance, right?
The Guardian of the Alliance is also the guardian of Greenhood! That means there are basic guidelines required of all Greenhood members!
The other three heroes are treated as guardians of Lapenta. But what about Ten? There is only a single monument built for him!
I still cannot understand the obsession you showed while searching for them. It does not seem like you did it simply to play the role of a vague guardian of justice.

$npc:11004798[gender:0]$... the hero of the past, $npcName:11001812[gender:0]$. To think he, a symbol of darkness, was originally a guardian of light. And... to think $npcTitle:11000075[gender:1]$, a symbol of light, is a being carrying the seed of destruction.

The Lapentas left behind by the Sages also possess a power that seeks to protect themselves. Finding the one who will inherit the next guardian role is also done when the current guardian reads and conveys Lapenta's will. A guardian chosen that way protects Lapenta, and Lapenta also has the will to protect its guardian.

"I believe that someday you will be worthy of it. Until then, Oscar will serve as guardian in your place. Instead, I leave you this score for the <font color="#ffd200">Aria of Light and Darkness</font>."

I'll read it. "My beloved son, I leave these words before it is too late. Please understand why your father was harsh with you. It was all my fault. It was to make you the guardian of Lapenta who would succeed me."

This place, $map:02000146$, was originally called $map:52000115$, where a memorial honoring the Seven Heroes stood. But one day, the memorial collapsed and a large structure rose up... and its true identity was a passage connecting this place to the Dark Lands.

There was even a fool who said they would investigate whether this component came from the <font color="#ffd200">Dark Lands</font>, went there personally, touched a strange crystal, and was bedridden for a while.
By the way, now that we are closer to the Dark Lands, I can feel Lumieragon mana more clearly.

In truth, this power of darkness is not unfamiliar to us. <font color="#ffd200">The Dark Lands sealing operation...</font> It has many similarities to the deep darkness that disappeared after that. So many that it would not be unreasonable to say they are the same.
By the way, now that we are closer to the Dark Lands, I can feel Lumieragon mana more clearly.

Darkness had already deeply seeped into $map:02000146$. In particular, a strange trait found in the creatures there, known as <font color="#ffd200">$item:20000047$</font>... Inside it, a component emitting <font color="#ffd200">blue light</font> was discovered. It has never been found anywhere else, not even in the <font color="#ffd200">Dark Lands</font>.

Recently, suspicious ground tremors were detected west of Victoria Island. And I can feel it. Darkness is drawing closer... To face the growing threat of darkness, it is time to awaken new power and prepare a foundation for <font color="#ffd200">growth</font> unlike before.

If $npc:11000032[gender:0]$'s hypothesis is correct, the <font color="#ffd200">power of darkness</font> is continuing to <font color="#ffd200">expand</font>... and the collapse of <font color="#ffd200">$map:52000115$</font> and the opening of <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000146$</font> may be like the <font color="#ffd200">first foothold</font> for the deep darkness to return to this land...

Wait a moment. What exactly are you all talking about? <font color="#ffd200">The Seed of Darkness,</font> I know about it too. It originated from the god of darkness and his power. And the god of darkness was completely destroyed after the <font color="#ffd200">sealing of the Dark Lands</font>. So the Seed of Darkness should not be able to exist at all.
