They say the souls of dead ancient shamans there have been revived as evil spirits and wander around. The terrifying demonic energy is so strong that even the overseers cannot easily go near it.

It will take a little more time before the full Lumina Liberation Army operation can begin... But even during that time, innocent people will suffer in that terrible place. If we had just a few highly skilled comrades, we could work together and rescue the residents of $map:02000292$...

You played a very large role in this matter. Thanks to you, the Guard Force and the Lumina Liberation Army, who might have clashed and come into conflict from different positions, had a chance to understand each other and rebuild trust.
Could you be... the <font color="#ffd200">Lumina Liberation Army</font>...?
Hm? Are you a new member of our Lumina Liberation Army?
Ask what the Lumina Liberation Army is.
Ah... the <font color="#ffd200">Lumina Liberation Army</font>... There are very few people who know about them... You... hear news quickly, don't you? How much do you know?
Ask whether they know anything about the Lumina Liberation Army.

But... they say some people escaped from that Tower of Slaves recently. The group they formed to rescue the others trapped as slaves is the <font color="#ffd200">Lumina Liberation Army</font>! Rumor has it they succeeded in rescuing several slaves who were being transferred elsewhere.

Hmm... so there were slaves who were forced to manufacture $item:20000046$ under the rule of the watchers... I had heard rumors that slaves existed, but... I still don't know the details. Especially that... <font color="#ffd200">Lumina Liberation Army</font> is something I have never heard of before...
You don't need to know! We don't trust anyone except the <font color="#ffd200">Lumina Liberation Army</font>!

The customer who came to buy poisonous herbs and told me about the Lumina Liberation Army said they were chasing the Lumina Liberation Army for a bounty, but after finding their last meeting place in $map:03000134$, they couldn't find any more traces.
So among the slaves, rumors have spread widely that the <font color="#ffd200">Lumina Liberation Army</font> will someday come to rescue them.

Well...? I wouldn't know. Unless I were part of the Lumina Liberation Army... If the Shadow Legion caught them, they would be wiped out at once. Unless they were fools, would they really leave traces so easily?

They say the Shadow Legion commander is on high alert because of the Lumina Liberation Army. So not only the Tower of Slaves, but also the slave transport units are being guarded much more tightly than before.
Ask whether there is a way to meet the Lumina Liberation Army.
Well... maybe the Lumina Liberation Army left traces in a code only they could recognize... But who knows.

The Lumina Liberation Army, including me, were slaves imprisoned in the <font color="#ffd200">Tower of Slaves</font>. Most of the slaves are people abducted from Maple World by the Shadow Legion. At first... we believed and waited for the Guard Force to rescue us... But as more and more time passed, we came to understand clearly.

As we sent off our comrades one by one, we made a vow. We would rescue everyone trapped in the <font color="#ffd200">Tower of Slaves</font> with our own hands! That was how the <font color="#ffd200">Lumina Liberation Army</font> began.
Say that you came alone because you wanted to know about the Lumina Liberation Army.
Ask where the Lumina Liberation Army's last meeting place is in $map:03000134$.
Say that you want to help with the Lumina Liberation Army's activities.
Say that you will report about the Lumina Liberation Army and request support.
I have gone on at length. In any case, thank you for helping. Will you continue... to help our <font color="#ffd200">Lumina Liberation Army</font> activities? As a member of the Guard Force, I mean.
Tell everything about the Lumina Liberation Army.

Go to $map:02000146$ right now and report to $npcName:11000076[gender:0]$ about the <font color="#ffd200">Lumina Liberation Army</font>, as well as news of <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000064[gender:0]$</font>.

$map:03009023$... It is a temporary holding camp for slaves being transferred from the top floor of the Tower of Slaves to another place. Our Lumina Liberation Army will begin the <font color="#ffd200">$map:03009023$ rescue operation</font> now. $MyPCName$, will you join us?
Report everything about the Lumina Liberation Army, the Tower of Slaves, and news of $npc:11000064[gender:0]$.
It has been a while, $MyPCName$! Are you here to report about the <font color="#ffd200">Lumina Liberation Army</font>?

Go to $map:02000146$ right now and report to $npcName:11000076[gender:0]$ about the <font color="#ffd200">Lumina Liberation Army</font>, as well as news of <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000064[gender:0]$</font>.
Even before then, if a situation arises where the <font color="#ffd200">Lumina Liberation Army</font> needs support, I will permit you to help them unofficially.
Go to $map:03009023$ and work with the Lumina Liberation Army to rescue the people unjustly imprisoned there!

I... was dragged around here and there with the other people who had been trapped on the top floor... and then I was rescued from $map:03009023$... My brother said the Lumina Liberation Army is truly a great benefactor to us. Please be sure to tell the other members of the Lumina Liberation Army that I am very grateful too.
Good. Then go to $map:03009023$ and work with the Lumina Liberation Army to rescue the people unjustly imprisoned there!
My brother said the Lumina Liberation Army is truly a great benefactor to us. Please be sure to tell the other members of the Lumina Liberation Army that I am very grateful too.

They are in $map:03009024$, which the Lumina Liberation Army prepared as temporary lodging for the rescued people on the top floor of the northeastern tower in $map:03000135$. Actually, when I told my younger sister about you, $MyPCName$, she said she wanted to meet you at least once before returning home... Would you like to meet <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000807[gender:1]$</font>?

However, the Lumina Liberation Army's support will only be given for actions that are truly for the good and ordinary residents of Maple World, and that do not require anyone's sacrifice as a condition.

The Lumina Liberation Army has decided to help and support the Guard Force's activities only when they are for the good and ordinary residents of Maple World, and do not require anyone's sacrifice as a condition.
I see... If only this decision had come a little sooner... In fact, just before you arrived, Her Majesty ordered the Guard Force to actively support the Lumina Liberation Army.
Thanks to you, it seems the Lumina Liberation Army has let go of some of their resentment toward the Guard Force... That is fortunate. But always keep $npcName:11000804[gender:0]$'s advice in mind.
What did the Lumina Liberation Army say they plan to do with the survivors rescued through the successful $map:03009023$ rescue operation?

$MyPCName$! All the survivors from the $map:03009023$ rescue operation returned safely to Maple World. The first joint operation between the Lumina Liberation Army and the Guard Force was very successful.
What? <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000064[gender:0]$</font> is in the <font color="#ffd200">Tower of Slaves</font>...?
If the Guard Force stepped in and helped the Liberation Army's activities, we could rescue the people unjustly imprisoned in the Tower of Slaves more quickly... I hope you will hurry.

If the Guard Force stepped in and helped the Liberation Army's activities, we could rescue the people unjustly imprisoned in the Tower of Slaves more quickly... If more time is delayed like this... distrust and resentment toward the Guard Force, and toward $npcName:11000075[gender:1]$ $npcTitle:11000075[gender:1]$ as well... will only grow stronger.

My younger sibling and I were also deceived by their lie that they would <font color="#ffd200">take us somewhere fun</font>, and we came all the way here. We were separated right before being imprisoned in the Tower of Slaves. Maybe... those things might know what happened to my sibling and where they are.

There is <font color="#ffd200">a friend I need to find</font>. <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000064[gender:0]$</font>... They were a friend who planned an escape with me from the <font color="#ffd200">Tower of Slaves</font>... But right before the escape, they were dragged away by a Shadow Legion commander and never returned.

After I was separated from my brother... I was so scared... and it was so hard... There were truly horrible things on the top floor of the <font color="#ffd200">Tower of Slaves</font>... Especially the Shadow Legion commander... was so... so...
That commander... always wore a red cloak... One day, they dragged someone up from the lower floors of the Tower of Slaves... and in front of all of us... sob...

Slaves... To think we are only learning of such a thing now... how shameful... What on earth did $npc:11000064[gender:0]$, who is practically the root cause of all this, do there this time to be imprisoned in the Tower of Slaves...?

Red Cloak... no, I suppose we should call her <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000057[gender:1]$</font> now... In any case, the Shadow Legion came storming in. Fortunately, $npc:11000119[gender:0]$ and $npc:11000015[gender:1]$ arrived with reinforcements at just the right time, so the damage was not great... but otherwise, something truly terrible would have happened.

We need to find out the identity of the new Shadow Legion forces appearing from that deep darkness moment by moment, and what they are truly after... <font color="#ffd200">An adventurer with power as great as yours, $MyPCName$</font>, should be able to do it. That is precisely why, shameless as it may be, I sought you out.
$MyPCName$! We have received new information about the <font color="#ffd200">Shadow Legion</font>, known as the Demon King's army.
Page 547. $npc:23000025[gender:1]$ is also one of those included in the Shadow Legion. If you touch them recklessly, the Shadow Legion may swarm in all at once.
Ask whether there was any other information about the Shadow Legion.

That means many people are still inside, suffering through painful slavery under the surveillance and control of the Shadow Legion... And they said the peak of that suffering... is on the very top floor... the moment you face Slave Warden $npc:24000516[gender:1]$ in $map:02000297$.
If... that door is the entrance to $map:02000213$, we must move more carefully. We need to gather as much information as possible about the Shadow Legion and thoroughly plan our combat operation.
As expected... that place was the Shadow Legion's summoning ground... And <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000064[gender:0]$</font>... what was he doing there?
I suspected those Devlin were part of the Shadow Legion... but there was someone stronger than them.

<font color="#ffd200">$map:02000213$</font>! And someone called <font color="#ffd200">$npc:23000007[gender:0]$</font>... <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000213$</font> appears to be a kind of 'summoning ground' where <font color="#ffd200">$npc:23000007[gender:0]$</font> constantly summons Shadow Legion members and strengthens them with the power of darkness.
There are rumors that they resisted the Shadow Legion and eventually lost their life, and rumors that they were won over by the Shadow Legion and became one of them...

That friend saved me when, right after being separated from my younger sister, I was running wild trying to find her and nearly lost my life to Shadow Legion soldiers. They always listened to my stories and comforted me... But thinking back, they never once talked about themself.
Ask what they will do if they were won over by the Shadow Legion.

My orders are to block off $map:03000146$ from other areas and prepare in advance to stop any possible Shadow Legion reinforcements... For now, could you go and bring back some <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000214$</font> and <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000215$</font>?
Fine, well... whether it is your sense of responsibility as the Guard Force or curiosity... as long as you don't side with the Shadow Legion and betray us...

Through the Devlin, I feel we have come a little closer to the true nature of the Shadow Legion, whose identity was unclear. But... perhaps the Devlin are only the tail of the Shadow Legion. Beyond the body of the Shadow Legion, we must uncover even its leader.

That person... was in so much pain... Even now... I feel like I can still hear the screams... The Shadow Legion soldiers said that if we resisted too... or didn't obey... we would suffer like that person.
I will look a little further into whether there is a way to wipe out the Shadow Legion that kidnapped the residents here and made them slaves.

The Shadow Legion commander... told his subordinates to take them to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000213$</font>. They said they would be useful to the shadowmancer... I haven't seen that person since.

There must be something unusual happening if the Rune Bladers came all the way here carrying even the ancient books of their ancestors. Tell them to issue a summons requesting support from the Guard Force, so we can find a way to help them while they are injured and their forces are weakened.

I don't care whether you're the Guard Force or whatever. Because of you, I had to force the unfinished <font color="#ffd200">Lumiwind</font> to fly, and in the end it broke down! And the person who could repair it has already left…
Phew... today is truly hectic too... I wonder when the war against darkness will end... If you have time, will you also lend our Guard Force a hand here?
$npcName:11000031[gender:0]$ says he will support us by decoding the books for us, and by sending the Guard Force from $map:02000023$ to reinforce our troops.
Phew... today is truly hectic too... I wonder when the war against darkness will end... If you have time, will you also lend our Guard Force a hand here?
Welcome, Berserker Guard Force, descendants of brave warriors. Seeing you all as dignified as ever gives me strength.

$npcName:11000051[gender:1]$ went first to $map:02000023$ as the vanguard of the Assassin representative Guard Force, so <font color="#ffd200">$MyPCName$</font>, you should hurry to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000023$</font> and meet <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000031[gender:0]$</font>.

$npcName:11000051[gender:1]$ went first to $map:02000023$ as the vanguard of the Assassin representative Guard Force, so <font color="#ffd200">$MyPCName$</font>, you should hurry to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000023$</font> and meet <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000031[gender:0]$</font>.

Anyway, I hear they asked the Guard Force to join the <font color="#ffd200">Starlight Expedition</font> that will protect <font color="#ffd200">Runicta</font> from <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11001231[gender:0]$</font> and lend their strength. Well... not everyone there welcomed it with open arms, but in the end, everyone united and decided to participate in the <font color="#ffd200">Starlight Expedition</font>.

$npc:11000064[gender:0]$ has joined the Guard Force. You probably already know about $npc:11000044[gender:0]$... After $npcTitle:11000075[gender:1]$ met $npc:11000064[gender:0]$ personally, she entrusted him with the mission of finding $npc:11000044[gender:0]$, who vanished without a trace.
Maple World is in greater danger than ever, so we need the help of outstanding heroes like you, $MyPCName$. Please continue helping the Guard Force until we find $npc:11000044[gender:0]$.

We will know everything if we ask the person directly. Dark Wind members and the Guard Force are searching together right now, but since $npcName:11000044[gender:0]$ was one of Dark Wind's elite agents, he will not be easy to catch.

Thank you! I owe you again. To find $npc:11000044[gender:0]$, we need to divide the areas among ourselves and search thoroughly. Some areas are already being searched by Dark Wind members and the Guard Force.

Someday... the moment when my ill-fated tie with $npc:11000044[gender:0]$ begins again will come. No matter what form he returns in... I will not lose. For now... let's go back and inform the Guard Force about $npc:11000044[gender:0]$.

They say that just before that door closed, the ice spirits who arrived with the Guard Force froze everything. The door, the monster, and even the people beside it... They say my sister, <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000188[gender:1]$</font>, was frozen with them then…
Thanks to you, $MyPCName$, our Guard Force's morale has risen, and you have been a great help. Thank you very much.
You are truly skilled. All the Guard Force soldiers were left speechless watching you, $MyPCName$, charge freely among those ferocious monsters.
Well, I will say less about a past you do not need to know. I heard about you from the Guard Force here and the researchers. You have quite a reputation for excellent combat skill.

Not only this matter, but also how you have done your best as a member of the Guard Force all this time... When I reported everything in detail to $npcName:11000075[gender:1]$ $npcTitle:11000075[gender:1]$, Her Majesty said she would like to meet you personally.
Publicly, I am responsible for commanding the Guard Force here, but in reality, I am carrying out a <font color="#ffd200">mission to recover the shattered $item:30000058$</font>.

Welcome, $MyPCName$. I have heard well of your achievements in <font color="#ffd200">Pekadive</font>. Your reputation among the Guard Force is truly impressive. That is why I wanted to meet you. I wanted to personally meet the hero who has worked for the peace of Maple World and express my thanks.
As it happens, the Guard Force is searching all over $map:02000146$ for traces of $npc:11000057[gender:1]$. If she was injured too... she really could not have gone far.
$MyPCName$, please lend even greater strength to the Guard Force from now on. For the sake of this world, <font color="#ffd200">I ask this in the name of the Empress</font>.

And they say the leader of those <font color="#ffd200">Humples</font> was originally a Dark Wind member? Phew... to think there is such a traitor in the Guard Force we trust and rely on... It is so frightening.

They say the leader of the <font color="#ffd200">Humples</font> was originally a Dark Wind member? Phew... to think there is such a traitor in the Guard Force we trust and rely on... It is so frightening.

$npc:11000064[gender:0]$ has joined the Guard Force. You probably already know about $npc:11000044[gender:0]$... After $npcTitle:11000075[gender:1]$ met $npc:11000064[gender:0]$ personally, she entrusted him with the mission of finding $npc:11000044[gender:0]$, who vanished without a trace.
Right now, the Guard Force scouts are searching for the place suspected to be that 'summoning ground'. News should arrive soon...
Ah, a report has just come in. The Guard Force scouts found a suspicious door in a remote place at the end of the cliff below!

It isn't certain yet. Actually, one of our regular customers, $npcName:11000384[gender:0]$, quietly told me that they had obtained something called <font color="#ffd200">$item:39000010$</font> or whatever. They said someone seemed to have lost it while secretly investigating the <font color="#ffd200">Shadow World</font> without the Guard Force knowing.
Right now, the Guard Force scouts are searching for the place suspected to be that 'summoning ground'. News should arrive soon...

Someday... the moment when my ill-fated tie with $npc:11000044[gender:0]$ begins again will come. No matter what form he returns in... I will not lose. For now... let's go back and inform the Guard Force about $npc:11000044[gender:0]$.
Say that you came to help at $npc:11000615[gender:0]$'s request as a member of the Guard Force.
Remember this. Even if something goes wrong, even until the moment your life ends... you must not let anyone discover that we are secret agents dispatched by the Guard Force.

Yes...! I wish you success. Remember this. Even if something goes wrong, even until the moment your life ends... you must not let anyone discover that we are secret agents dispatched by the Guard Force.
Tell the truth that you are carrying out a secret mission for the Guard Force.
I hope you will lend even greater strength to protecting the world alongside the Guard Force, who are struggling on the front lines of $map:02000146$.
By the way, that friend $npcName:11000807[gender:1]$ said she saw on the top floor... I think it could be $npcName:11000064[gender:0]$, whom the Guard Force is searching for now.

Ah... to think the missing people were living as slaves here... At this moment... as a member of the Guard Force, I am so ashamed I can barely raise my head. They were people I... should have saved first...
Go to $map:02000146$ right now and report the entire situation to $npcName:11000076[gender:0]$. Tell him that Guard Force support is needed so the survivors can return.
Go to $map:02000146$ right now and report the entire situation to $npcName:11000076[gender:0]$. Tell him that Guard Force support is needed so the survivors can return.

Until then, not only we Green Hoods, but all the Guard Force members and heroes across Maple World must join forces. With a greater enemy before our eyes, what we need most right now is <font color="#ffd200">trust in one another</font>.
In the midst of that, when there are problems they cannot solve on their own or when they need the Guard Force's help, support requests come in like this.
I hope you will lend even greater strength to protecting the world alongside the Guard Force, who are struggling on the front lines of $map:02000146$.

I know that until now, you have done your best to help the Guard Force keep this world safe from the forces of darkness. Ahem... well, I have rarely expressed it directly myself... but if you are perceptive... I think you must have sensed that I have respected you as a hero for some time now.
As you already know, throughout Maple World, not only the Guard Force Alliance, but also regional leaders, civilian groups, and residents are all working in their own places to protect this world.

<font color="#ffd200">Mission</font> Find the disguised Guard Force secret agent $npc:11000910[gender:0]$. <font color="#ffd200">Contact Password</font> If you can't avoid it, life is something you should enjoy. <font color="#ffd200">Warning: If the contact password is lost, mission qualification is revoked</font>
In this place, I trust no one except the <font color="#ffd200">Guard Force</font>. Of course, I do not even speak with anyone else.

<font color="#ffd200">Mission</font> Find the disguised Guard Force secret agent $npc:11000910[gender:0]$. <font color="#ffd200">Contact Password</font> If you can't avoid it, life is something you should enjoy. <font color="#ffd200">If the contact password is lost, mission qualification is revoked</font>
<font color="#ffd200">Incident Location</font> Inside $map:03000145$ <font color="#ffd200">Investigator in Charge</font> Guard Force secret agent $npc:11000910[gender:0]$

Ah! I heard about you, $MyPCName$, through Guard Force member <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000910[gender:0]$</font>. Having a friend who shares your purpose is <font color="#ffd200">reassuring</font>.
What? You came from $map:52000055$? Hmm... you don't look like a Dark Wind member…
<font color="#909090">(Dark Wind is focused on restoring $map:02000100$, so it would be hard for them to send reinforcements...?)</font>
Yes. Originally, Dark Wind's leader was $npc:11003219[gender:0]$, just as you knew. Though he is no longer here.
(Originally, it was a Dark Wind research sample, but...)
As usual, he was sitting there mumbling... then suddenly slapped his knee and said, <font color="#ffd200">'Right, Dark Wind reinforcements!'</font> and ran off.
...Bartender, no, Dark Wind undercover agent. If we get only the information we want, no one will be hurt.
That's right. Through a certain route... No, let's just say it is information from me, someone with deep ties to Dark Wind.
Here, we must learn information about 'that operation' Dark Wind is preparing.
So this jazz bar is Dark Wind's disguised base.
You have all been briefed, but this objective is a raid on the disguised base of Dark Wind, the Kerning City intelligence agency.
You heard that, right? Then start telling us some useful information, Dark Wind.
Beyond the door on the left side of the bar is Dark Wind's secret operations room. The information we seek should be there.
Why not come with us? If you tell Dark Wind anything you remember, even a little, it will surely help.
Is this... the base for the audience ceremony goods convoy recorded in Dark Wind's intelligence?
This is terribly lax... By now, Dark Wind should have had more than enough time to establish heavy security.
(It suddenly began appearing all over Maple World... As soon as it was discovered, we in Dark Wind also began researching it.)
We will handle things here, so please support Dark Wind's side, $MyPCName$.
There is much to discuss, but let us do it after the battle. They say Black Eye and Dark Wind are currently fighting on the flank.
We will handle things here, so please support Dark Wind's side, $MyPCName$.

From Dark Wind's perspective, that probably isn't surprising or new information. Before the Black Star Society, other organizations also distributed $item:20000046$ and $item:20000015$. Now the Black Star Society has a monopoly, though.

$map:02000100$ has always been that kind of place. Everyone knows, but pretends they don't! Only Dark Wind keeps picking fights over every little thing... Mosquito-like fools! Nobodies making a nuisance of themselves.
I heard rumors that you investigated because Dark Wind identified the Humples as being behind the audience ceremony goods theft.
Why even ask? But you seem to have gotten close with Dark Wind too, haven't you? Other than talking about $item:20000015$, you didn't say anything else useless, did you?
Ah, right. Damn it. Hurry up and go find out what Dark Wind is plotting!

Somehow, I feel there may be a <font color="#ffd200">hidden truth</font> behind the things I have seen and heard so far. $npc:11000044[gender:0]$... He is the person responsible for Dark Wind, but whether he can be considered trustworthy... I am not sure.
Since Dark Wind keeps trying to poke at us lately, you should keep going in and out of $map:02000153$ like you have been, and if they do anything suspicious, report it to us immediately!
Say that you want to know about Dark Wind from a more objective perspective.
...Why are you asking me about <font color="#ffd200">Dark Wind</font>? Go to $map:02000153$ yourself and meet the leader, <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000044[gender:0]$</font>.

$MyPCName$... Is there anyone who knows the situation in $map:02000100$ and Dark Wind well, and can talk objectively about <font color="#ffd200">the current situation</font>? If we are going to find the <font color="#ffd200">truth that has not surfaced</font>, then perhaps…

In that case, $MyPCName$... perhaps there is some secret not just with <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000044[gender:0]$</font> personally, but with all of Dark Wind. <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11001816[gender:0]$</font>, who led them until recently, was one of the <font color="#ffd200">Seven Heroes</font>, and you know what happened to them too, $MyPCName$.
Ask them to explain in detail what happened to Dark Wind.

I regret that I cannot be of help, but if it is about Dark Wind, go directly to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000153$</font> and hear it from <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000044[gender:0]$</font>. That is all I can say.

I regret that I cannot be of help, but if it is about Dark Wind, go directly to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000153$</font> and hear it from <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000044[gender:0]$</font>. That is all I can say.
Judging by the look of it, you seem to be trying to pry something out of me, but I cannot tell you anything about Dark Wind. Also, $map:02000100$ cannot take any action regarding Dark Wind.

There is already so much to worry about, and now we are cracking down because of rumors that an impure organization led by someone called $npc:11000006[gender:0]$ is inciting the citizens. And that is not all. The budget going into Dark Wind is enormous too.

Right now, Dark Wind members are searching everywhere for $npc:11000069[gender:1]$'s whereabouts, but time is short, so we need every person we can get. $MyPCName$, I would like you to help find $npc:11000069[gender:1]$ too. What do you say?

Not long ago... I secretly received an <font color="#ffd200">anonymous rescue request</font> message. It said they were being chased by Dark Wind, and if we protected them, they would tell us all of <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000044[gender:0]$'s secrets</font>.

I did send Humples members to the sender's location. But we must hurry. We absolutely have to find them before Dark Wind does. Whether that message is true or not, we will know once we meet that person...!

In fact, $npc:11000064[gender:0]$, $npc:11000006[gender:0]$, and the Humples have been investigating <font color="#ffd200">the hidden side of Dark Wind</font>. And in the process, they encountered you, $MyPCName$.
Dark Wind will always watch your achievements.
Dark Wind will always watch your achievements.
Haah... I simply cannot believe it... What will happen to our Dark Wind now...?
Now, it is time to start searching again. You take the <font color="#ffd200">closed area</font> you can see behind me. Don't forget. We must find that person before Dark Wind does! No matter what...
Now, it is time to start searching again. You take the <font color="#ffd200">closed area</font> you can see behind me. Don't forget. We must find that person before Dark Wind does! No matter what...

Did $npcName:11000044[gender:0]$ really plot all of this...? If it is true that he harmed the captain who cherished him like his own son, all because of an ambition to become the leader of Dark Wind... I will never... forgive him!
Welcome. I am <font color="#ffd200">Katvan</font>, leader of Dark Wind.
The Black Star Society is also an organization within that complicated network. That is why Dark Wind cannot officially investigate the Black Star Society recklessly without firm proof. So...

Whenever he hears news of Miss $npc:11000069[gender:1]$, his resentment and anger toward $npc:11000064[gender:0]$ grow stronger. Well... even so, just as the captain said, the fact that Lennon is exploiting a weakness in Dark Wind's wanted network is something my pride cannot allow.

If Eve's words are true, Lennon is currently moving through Dark Wind's wanted network as if it were his own home... Even aside from my concern for Eve, this matter is something my pride cannot allow.

Hmm... I will first review what weaknesses there were in the wanted network. $MyPCName$, please post the <font color="#ffd200">wanted flyers</font> on the <font color="#ffd200">Dark Wind bulletin boards</font> in each area.

Of course. If only that foolish Katvan and Dark Wind weren't around, I would go look myself…

They were all fools who sold their souls to <font color="#ffd200">Turka</font> and borrowed evil power to satisfy the desires that bloomed in their hearts. $npc:11000044[gender:0]$ also could not overcome his desire to become Dark Wind's captain, and made a contract with <font color="#ffd200">Turka</font>.

The Humples members decided to divide the areas among themselves and search. You take the <font color="#ffd200">closed area</font> you can see behind me. Don't forget. We must find that person before Dark Wind does! No matter what...

$map:02000229$... There are still foolish beings there who crave the power of evil like sweet poison and wait for <font color="#ffd200">Turka</font>. It is $npc:11000031[gender:0]$, the leader of $map:02000023$. He is protecting the forest of $map:02000023$ so it will not be covered by the Demon King's shadow. But... it seems some problem has occurred recently.

Right now, <font color="#ffd200">our greatest threat is the Demon King and the forces of darkness, which are slowly tightening around us</font>. In this dangerous situation, even everyone joining forces may not be enough... but if <font color="#ffd200">conflict and distrust spread among us</font>... it would be the same as <font color="#ffd200">completely extinguishing the small spark of hope that this world can return to the peaceful world it once was</font>.

If the power of evil grows stronger, then in the end, the Demon King will <font color="#ffd200">absorb</font> that energy source... Could there be a darker <font color="#ffd200">plot</font> than this...

The Shadow World... dark shamans... awakened and imprisoned the souls sleeping in the tombs of ancient shamans... and that is what the Soul Orb is... Among the Soul Orbs... the oldest one, said to have the strongest energy... I heard that Soul Orb is in a place called <font color="#ffd200">$map:52000012$</font>...

For now... there is no other way but to seal $npc:11000068[gender:0]$ inside the Shadow World... If we kill $npc:11000068[gender:0]$, $npc:11000685[gender:0]$ will also lose his life... We cannot allow that, can we...

Thankfully, he survived... but it seems they took $npc:11000069[gender:1]$.

For now, go with your friend to <font color="#ffd200">$map:02000001$</font> and report what happened. Tell them that our former captain, <font color="#ffd200">Win Stilton</font>, has passed away as well.

There's no need to be modest. We truly defended this place because you were here. Still, this puts us in a difficult position. We'll be unable to pursue <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11003215[gender:0]$</font> for a while as we restore order to $map:02000100$.

That was one hectic mission. Once this mission is over, I'll finally be able to become a full-fledged Royal Guard, right?

Welcome back, <font color="#ffd200">$MyPCName$</font>. I heard that you would personally report the results of your investigation into the attack on the transport convoy. Now, please tell me everything that happened.

$npcName:23000013[gender:0]$, $npcName:23000018$, $npcName:23000001[gender:0]$, $npcName:23000019[gender:0]$, $npcName:23000054$, $npcName:23000020[gender:1]$, $npcName:23000035$, $npcName:23000099$, $npcName:23000017$, $npcName:23000047$, $npcName:23000024[gender:1]$, $npcName:23000034$, $npcName:23000045$, $npcName:23000057[gender:1]$, $npcName:23000026[gender:1]$, $npcName:23000012$, $npcName:23000009[gender:0]$, $npcName:23000029$. <font color="#ffd200">Got it?</font>

Our next operation is to infiltrate the heart of Madrakan and attack the phase-shift nexus. I'd like you to lead the charge, $MyPCName$.

Hooray!! We've driven off Tryia's sworn enemy, Madria!! Victory is ours!!
We won!! We won!!
The operation is simple. We will assault Madrakan's castle walls, its heart, and then its spire. I want you to lead the charge, $MyPCName$.

I heard from <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004571[gender:0]$</font>. He said you helped us.

You want me to describe the information merchant's house again? The house with a glowing green crystal on its roof belongs to <font color="#ffd200">$npcTitle:11004576$</font>. There's only one, so you'll recognize it immediately.
Nice to meet you! I'm <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11004576$</font>, and I buy and sell everything.

Defeat <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:25022602$</font> in <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020070$</font> and bring me <font color="#ffd200">$item:30001349$</font>.

Hm, what's causing this shaking?

Hm, what's causing this shaking?

I didn't expect it to shut down obediently, but I never imagined it would escape and join <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11004430[gender:0]$</font>... This is not good.
